To mitigate environmental non-stationarity without inducing excessive communication overhead, agents exchange localized action fingerprints along network edges and optimize a spatially decomposed reward structure. Empirical evaluations driven by real-world MIMIC-IV patient trajectories indicate that this cooperative multi-agent approach substantially reduces cumulative system delay compared to static Markovian approximations, heuristic dispatching, and independent multi-agent baselines, while maintaining clinical safety constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"物理信息驱动的多智能体协调"（Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination）的框架，将基于MIMIC-IV真实数据校准的BCMP排队网络拓扑作为物理先验，嵌入到去中心化多智能体强化学习（Dec-POMDP）架构中，用于医院患者流转优化。框架通过拓扑感知的动作指纹通信协议和空间分层奖励分解机制实现科室间的协作路由与动态服务扩容，在显著降低系统累积延迟的同时保持了临床安全性。
AI.motivation: 医院各科室本质上是去中心化的自治单元，拥有局部观测、异构资源和相互冲突的运营目标（急诊科追求快速分流，ICU需保留呼吸机，普通病房需稳定床位）。传统的集中式启发式调度或集中式强化学习方法难以适应医院治理的去中心化结构。同时，经典BCMP排队网络的解析模型基于稳态假设和固定路由矩阵，在状态依赖的真实动态（有限床位导致的物理阻塞）下其乘积形式解不再成立。因此需要一种既能保留排队理论结构知识、又能适应去中心化动态决策的协调方法。
AI.method: 1) **物理先验层**：基于MIMIC-IV约6万例住院数据校准开放BCMP排队网络拓扑，确定M个科室节点、K个患者类别、转移概率矩阵P、基础服务率μ和床位容量c_i*（通过Erlang-C与Halfin-Whitt联合计算），同时定义Foster-Lyapunov稳定约束ρ_i<1。2) **Dec-POMDP建模**：每个科室作为自主智能体，观测为5维局部特征（占用率、队列深度、可用容量、SLA警告、当前加速因子）。动作空间为离散双通道——α策略（4级出院加速0~15%）和λ策略（5级准入调控0~100%）。3) **拓扑感知通信**：智能体沿BCMP有向边向邻居广播动作指纹（EMA平滑的策略分布FP_i），不进行全局通信，避免O(M²)开销。4) **空间分层奖励**：R_i = ω_local·R_local + ω_neighbor·R_neighbor + ω_global·R_global，分别对齐科室效率、抑制跨科室转嫁、锚定全局延迟减少。5) **安全约束**：基于MIMIC-IV历史转科路径构建专家动作掩码，将不符合临床规程的转科动作屏蔽。算法采用CTDE架构下的MA2C（Mean-field Advantage Actor-Critic）。
AI.result: 在1.25倍需求冲击下的4000小时仿真中：协作MA2C（随机执行）将累积延迟降至2081.2±571.7小时，相比静态Markov基线（117478.1小时）降低约56倍，独立A2C贪婪执行甚至崩溃至463038.7±243695.6小时。结构消融实验证实：禁用协作路由(λ策略)导致延迟发散至226231小时；禁用动作指纹通信使延迟增至3024.5小时；禁用动态加速使延迟增至3990.8小时。安全性方面，MA2C将乒乓转科率从历史7.375%降至1.727~1.736%，ICU过早出院率从2.585%降至约0.21%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功将经典排队理论的结构知识（拓扑、容量边界）与去中心化多智能体学习的动态适应性相结合，证明了物理信息驱动先验在安全关键医疗调度中的价值——它既约束了探索空间保证临床安全，又通过拓扑通信和分层奖励使智能体涌现出协作路由协商行为，将饱和科室推回排队论中ρ_i远小于1的线性稳定区。未来工作将引入基于LLM的认知智能体来模拟临床医师实时行为与工作负荷动态，以弥合仿真到现实的差距。

title: Language as the Interface: Foundation-Model Contrastive Learning Links Transcriptomes and Electrophysiology
summary: Integrating transcriptomic and electrophysiological data is essential for building multimodal foundation models for neuroscience. Patch-seq provides paired measurements of gene expression and intrinsic electrophysiology from the same neuron, establishing a basis for training cross-modal models. Here we introduce LangPatch, a foundation-model-based contrastive learning framework that uses paired Patch-seq data to align pretrained GenePT representations with electrophysiological phenotypes through a language-based interface. Gene descriptions and verbalized electrophysiological profiles are embedded by the same frozen text encoder. A context adapter and projection modules connect the modalities through paired contrastive learning. Across mouse visual, mouse motor, and human cortical cohorts, LangPatch achieves the highest mean transcriptome-to-electrophysiology prediction correlation among the evaluated foundation-model and representation-learning methods. It also improves held-out cross-modal alignment in the two mouse cohorts (FOSCTTM 0.107/0.135 vs. 0.208/0.222 for JAMIE, an existing cross-modal Patch-seq imputation method). It predicts transcriptomic family, type, cortical layer, and marker-gene expression from electrophysiology, exceeding other baselines on most endpoints. More importantly, the method transfers across brain areas and species: a model trained on mouse visual cortex predicts electrophysiology in motor cortex with approximately 70% correlation retention and in human cortex with 47% (58% on acute-slice recordings). Together, these results demonstrate alignment between molecular and functional representations of neurons, providing a building block for multimodal foundation models in neuroscience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LangPatch框架，以冻结的通用文本编码器作为接口，通过对比学习将预训练的基因语言表征（GenePT）与电生理特征对齐，实现跨模态神经数据的整合与跨脑区、跨物种迁移。
AI.motivation: 神经科学领域需要构建多模态基础模型来整合转录组与电生理数据，但现有方法要么依赖从头训练耦合编码器（如JAMIE），无法迁移知识；要么对单细胞基础模型进行大规模权重微调，而Patch-seq队列数据规模太小（10³–4×10³细胞），微调困难。本文旨在利用冻结的预训练基因语言表征作为先验，以语言作为跨模态接口解决低资源场景下的对齐问题。
AI.method: LangPatch将基因描述（GenePT嵌入）与电生理特征的文本化表述（语言化profile）通过同一个冻结的通用文本编码器（OpenAI text-embedding-3-large，3072维）编码到同一空间。基因侧通过一个0.4M参数的上下文适配器（基于训练集的全局、家族、层级统计条件化的门控残差）调整基因先验；细胞表征为适应后基因向量的表达加权平均。电生理侧通过确定性文本化（特征名+单位+分位数标签+profile token）后由同一编码器嵌入。两侧通过仿射投影层与对称InfoNCE对比损失对齐，加上辅助回归正则项。不更新编码器权重。
AI.result: 在三个Patch-seq队列（小鼠视觉皮层3,654细胞、小鼠运动皮层1,208细胞、人类皮层612细胞）上，LangPatch在转录组→电生理预测中取得最高平均Pearson r（视觉0.522、运动0.520、人类0.414），优于JAMIE、Geneformer、UCE、Nicheformer等基线。跨模态对齐FOSCTTM降至0.107/0.135（视觉/运动，vs JAMIE 0.208/0.222）。反向从电生理预测转录组身份（家族macro-F1 0.779/0.710）也优于基线。跨脑区零样本迁移保留70–71%相关性，鼠→人迁移保留47%（急性切片58%），11/11跨区概念和18–20/25跨物种概念超过排列零。基因归因分析显示优先基因富集细胞类型标志和离子通道基因。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的通用语言模型可以作为转录组与电生理之间的共享几何接口。LangPatch为多模态神经科学基础模型提供了构建模块：一次训练得到的表示可同时服务于未被patch的图谱细胞和未被测序的记录细胞，原则上还可扩展到其他可语言化的模态。但证据局限于两个小鼠皮层区和一个主要人类队列，且依赖外部文本嵌入API。

title: AnyAct: Universal Action for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: As large language models (LLMs) advance, AI agents are increasingly deployed in open-world environments to tackle complex sequential tasks (e.g., document processing, cross-application collaboration), relying heavily on actions ranging from GUI operations to semantic APIs. However, three core challenges persist: the "scale dilemma" of massive tool ecosystems exceeding LLM context windows, the "non-stationarity" of tool quality due to updates or outages, and the "heterogeneity" of feedback formats (pixels, text, structured data) creating information silos. To address these, we propose AnyAct, a universal action layer that unifies available capabilities into a self-evolving action space, enabling agents to operate efficiently and reliably in large-scale, dynamic tool ecosystems. AnyAct's core design focuses on two objectives: constructing this action space via hierarchical progressive retrieval (filtering task-relevant actions) and test-time reliability evolution (pruning unreliable actions), and enabling reliability-aware action orchestration through a heterogeneous observation grounding module that unifies multi-modal feedback. Additionally, it defines a hybrid action space (primitive + semantic actions) and optimizes for a balance between task success rate and execution cost. Evaluations on LiveMCPBench and OSMCP (a new benchmark we developed for multi-granularity action collaboration) demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. AnyAct delivers substantial performance gains over baseline methods across various LLM base models on LiveMCPBench and improvements are particularly notable for models with constrained native capabilities. On OSMCP, it achieves 77.27% overall success with only 50 steps, which is half the steps required by most competitors.

AI.tldr: AnyAct 提出了一种面向开放世界智能体的通用动作层，通过层次化渐进检索、测试时可靠性演化与异构观测接地等机制，统一管理大规模、动态、异构的工具生态，平衡任务成功率与执行成本。
AI.motivation: 针对开放世界 AI 代理面临的三大核心挑战：工具生态规模庞大超出 LLM 上下文窗口（scale dilemma）、工具质量因更新或故障而波动（non-stationarity）、反馈格式异构（pixels、文本、结构化数据）形成信息壁垒（heterogeneity）。现有方法依赖固定动作集或缺乏动态可靠性感知，无法从经验中演化动作空间，难以在成功率与效率之间取得最优权衡。
AI.method: AnyAct 的核心设计聚焦两大目标：（1）构建自演化的动作空间——通过层次化渐进检索（服务器级 LLM 推理 + 工具级 BM25 + 语义重排序）实现粗到细的过滤，并在测试时根据执行反馈（近期成功率 + 连续失败计数）更新每个动作的可靠性分数，对不可靠动作进行剪枝；（2）实现可靠性感知的动作编排——通过异构观测接地模块，使用 VLM 将 GUI 截图解析为机器可读的知识，与文本/结构化反馈一起整合到统一的上下文表示中。动作空间混合原子动作（GUI/shell）与语义动作（MCP API），并以最大化成功率同时惩罚执行步数为优化目标。
AI.result: 在 LiveMCPBench 上，AnyAct 在 Claude-Sonnet-4、DeepSeek-V3、DeepSeek-R1、Qwen3-235B 四种基座模型上均取得 SOTA，整体准确率分别达 93.55%、84.95%、78.49%、77.42%，相比 Naive 基线提升显著，对原生能力较弱的模型提升幅度最大。在新建的 OSMCP 基准上，AnyAct 以仅 50 步达到 77.27% 的总体成功率，优于使用 100-150 步的多数竞争对手；在 LibreOffice Calc、GIMP、Impress、Writer 等多个应用上均取得最佳表现。消融实验验证了检索模块与演化模块的必要性，鲁棒性分析显示在描述噪声扰动下检索 Top-10 工具的稳定性良好。
AI.conclusion: AnyAct 作为首个统一的通用动作层，有效解决了大规模、动态、异构工具生态系统下代理的三个核心挑战，能够自适应构建并演化动作空间，鲁棒地编排异构动作，在任务成功率与执行效率之间实现良好平衡。该方法对基座 LLM 能力要求较低，并贡献了用于多粒度动作协作评估的 OSMCP 基准，填补了该领域的评估空白。

title: Beyond Low-Rank Parameterization: Narrowing the Gap Between LoRA and Full Fine-Tuning via Gradient Decomposition
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used approach to parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), yet a performance gap can remain relative to full fine-tuning (FFT). Many LoRA variants improve the initialization or optimization of low-rank factors. At each training step, however, their first-order weight-space directions are constrained by the current parameterization. We characterize the corresponding LoRA-accessible gradient space and show that it coincides with the tangent space induced by the current LoRA parameterization. This characterization yields an orthogonal decomposition of the full weight gradient at the current model parameters. We term the component orthogonal to this space the normal gradient. Based on this decomposition, we propose GDLoRA (Gradient-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation). GDLoRA reconstructs the full weight gradient from forward activations and backward signals, extracts its normal component, and directly updates the base weights with this component, while retaining standard AdamW optimization for the LoRA factors. GDLoRA incorporates complementary normal gradients without increasing standard LoRA's optimizer-state memory budget under matched adapter and optimizer configurations. Experiments on natural language understanding, mathematical reasoning, commonsense reasoning, and image classification show that GDLoRA consistently improves over LoRA and narrows the performance gap to FFT. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GDLoRA（梯度分解低秩适配）方法，通过刻画 LoRA 参数化诱导的切空间，将完整权重梯度正交分解为切向分量和法向分量，并将法向梯度直接用于更新基权重，同时保留 LoRA 因子的标准 AdamW 优化。该方法在不增加优化器状态内存的前提下，在 NLU、数学推理、常识推理和图像分类任务上缩小了 LoRA 与全量微调之间的性能差距。
AI.motivation: LoRA 等参数高效方法与全量微调之间存在性能差距。现有 LoRA 变体主要改进初始化或低秩因子优化，但其一阶权重空间更新方向受限于当前参数化所能表达的空间。本文旨在显式恢复并利用当前 LoRA 参数化无法表达的正交梯度分量。
AI.method: 1. 刻画 LoRA 可访问梯度空间，证明其等价于当前 LoRA 参数化诱导的切空间 T_LoRA。2. 将完整权重梯度 G 正交分解为切向分量 G_∥（在切空间内）和法向分量 G_⊥（垂直于切空间）。3. GDLoRA 从前向激活和反向信号重建完整梯度，提取法向分量 G_⊥（经 1/N 归一化）用于直接更新基权重，同时 LoRA 因子 A、B 保留标准 AdamW 优化。投影基 U、V 由当前因子的 QR 分解构造，无需对完整梯度做 SVD。该方法不引入基权重的动量或方差缓冲，保持 LoRA 的优化器状态内存预算。
AI.result: 在 RoBERTa（GLUE）、Llama-3-8B（数学推理 6 任务）、Gemma-7B（常识推理 8 任务）和 ViT（图像分类 8 数据集）上，GDLoRA 一致优于标准 LoRA 和其他变体（PiSSA、DoRA、rsLoRA、Fira、LoRA-GA、LoRA-Pro）。相比 LoRA 平均提升 2–4 个百分点；将 Llama-3-8B 数学推理上 LoRA-FFT 差距从 3.12 缩小到 0.62 个百分点。内存方面，GDLoRA 仅比 LoRA 多用 5.9% 显存（21.6 GB vs LoRA），相比 FFT 减少 65%。
AI.conclusion: GDLoRA 通过将法向梯度直接应用于基权重，提供了标准 LoRA 一阶优化方向之外的互补梯度信息，在保持 LoRA 优化器状态内存优势的同时显著缩小了与全量微调的性能差距。该方法可解释性强，对基权重学习率不敏感，并在多种模型架构和任务上一致有效。

title: FedLAFP: Low-Rank Aggregation Meets Full-Rank Personalization in Federated Fine-Tuning
summary: Federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables clients to adapt pre-trained models without sharing raw data or communicating the full model, but statistical heterogeneity makes a single global adapter insufficient for personalized prediction. Existing personalized methods typically use the same low-rank structure for both shared and private adaptation, overlooking their distinct requirements for aggregation and personalization. We propose FedLAFP, a role-aware framework that couples a compact, globally aggregated LoRA branch with a client-private, full-rank-capable RandLoRA branch. The shared branch provides an efficient interface for transferring common knowledge, whereas the private branch combines fixed random low-rank bases with learned scaling coefficients to provide expressive client-specific adaptation without additional communication. Client- and layer-specific mixing coefficients jointly fuse the two branches, and only the shared LoRA parameters are exchanged. A controlled linear study supports this role assignment: LoRA yields more aligned client updates and lower aggregation error, while RandLoRA more accurately recovers client-specific residuals. Experiments across four visual recognition benchmarks show that FedLAFP consistently outperforms local-only and federated LoRA baselines, achieving an average personalized accuracy of $86.93\%$ and exceeding the best baseline average by $1.30$ percentage points.

AI.tldr: FedLAFP提出了一种角色感知的联邦参数高效微调框架，将紧凑的共享LoRA分支用于跨客户端聚合，将客户端私有的全秩RandLoRA分支用于本地个性化适配，通过客户端和层级特定的融合权重平衡两者，仅通信共享部分。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦个性化方法通常对共享和私有适配采用相同的低秩结构，忽视了共享分支需要紧凑且聚合友好、私有分支需要充足表达能力以捕获客户端特异性这一根本差异，导致在统计异构场景下个性化能力受限。
AI.method: FedLAFP采用非对称双分支设计：(1) 共享LoRA分支（低秩A·B分解）通过服务器FedAvg聚合；(2) 私有RandLoRA分支基于固定随机低秩基与可学习对角缩放矩阵组合，实现全秩能力更新且无需通信；(3) 客户端和层级特定的logits经softmax生成融合权重自适应组合两分支输出；(4) 受控线性回归实验验证LoRA聚合对齐性更好、RandLoRA恢复客户端残差更准的角色分配合理性。
AI.result: 在四个视觉识别基准（DTD、Oxford Pets、SUN397、UCF101）上FedLAFP均取得最佳准确率，平均个性化准确率达86.93%，超过最强基线1.30个百分点；在GLUE语言任务（MRPC、SST-2）上同样优于基线；消融研究确认LoRA共享+RandLoRA私有的角色分配最优，客户端-层级融合优于其他融合策略；在不同异构程度下均稳定优于FedLoRA。
AI.conclusion: FedLAFP通过角色感知设计有效解决了联邦异构场景下共享与私有适配的结构冲突，证明了非对称适配器分配的有效性；未来工作将扩展至更大模型、考虑资源异构、引入隐私保护聚合以及自动分配共享/私有容量。

title: Watch-Think-Interact: Bootstrapping Long-Horizon Multi-Turn Streaming Video Reasoning with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Streaming video assistance requires models to answer asynchronous questions from an observed prefix under a fixed context budget. Existing approaches model response timing or compress history, but an online state formed before future questions are known can omit visual details before later questions reveal their relevance; the retained state alone cannot recover them. We introduce Watch-Think-Interact (WTI), a closed-loop framework for multi-question streaming video reasoning. WTI maintains compact natural-language memory entries tagged with source-video time ranges; these entries support direct reasoning when sufficient and otherwise anchor selective recall of finer visual evidence. For each question, WTI answers when current context and memory suffice, continues watching when required evidence has not appeared, or recalls a relevant past interval and decides again after incorporating the returned chunks, without replaying the full observed history. To train this behavior, we construct WTI-82K, comprising 82,335 timed questions across 4,812 causally aligned trajectories, and develop Stream-GDPO to optimize complete multi-question streaming rollouts using trajectory-level feedback for response timing, source-video recall, and memory updates. WTI achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance among the compared open-source streaming baselines, reaching 83.3% on StreamingBench and 73.6% weighted overall accuracy on OVO-Bench.

AI.tldr: Watch-Think-Interact (WTI) 提出了一种用于长视野多轮流式视频推理的闭环框架，通过"主动窗口感知 + 时间索引紧凑记忆 + 选择性源视频回溯"机制解决现有方法因前向压缩丢失证据而无法恢复的问题，并配套构建了 WTI-82K 数据集与 Stream-GDPO 轨迹级强化学习方法，在流式视频基准上刷新开源 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频模型在固定上下文预算下，依赖前向压缩构建在线状态。当后续问题揭示出先前被压缩丢弃的视觉细节的相关性时，这些细节已不可恢复，状态本身无法重建被忽略的证据。
AI.method: 三方面：1）WTI 闭环推理框架——维护紧凑自然语言记忆（带源视频时间区间标签），结合 8 块活动视觉窗口与选择性回溯（每次至多回溯 4 个已观察块，不推进流），策略可在"沉默/回答/回溯"之间决策，回溯后在同一时间步重新决策；2）WTI-82K 数据——82,335 个带时间戳的问题组织为 4,812 条因果对齐的多轮轨迹，覆盖 Real-Time、Backward Tracing、Proactive 三类交互；3）Stream-GDPO 强化学习——扩展 GDPO，对完整多轮 rollout 做轨迹级优化，对 outcome/format/recall/memory 四类奖励分别归一化后再聚合。训练分两阶段：掩码 SFT 冷启动交互协议，Stream-GDPO 优化完整滚动决策。
AI.result: 在 OVO-Bench 上达到 73.6% 加权总体准确率（开源流式模型 SOTA，其中 Real-Time 76.9%、Backward 70.0%、Forward 73.4%，均领先）；在 StreamingBench 上达到 83.3%（超越 VST-7B 79.5%）；离线长视频基准上 Video-MME 66.9%、MLVU 69.9%、LongVideoBench 62.9%，整体保持强劲。组件消融显示记忆与回溯互补（去掉回溯后 OVO-BT 从 73.4% 降至 55.5%，去掉记忆降至 62.8%，仅记忆仅 48.2%）。
AI.conclusion: WTI 通过因果对齐的紧凑记忆与源视频选择性回溯，实现了在固定上下文预算下对长视野流式视频的可恢复推理；Stream-GDPO 的轨迹级优化能有效对齐"早期动作影响后续状态"的流式决策特性，在流式和离线长视频任务上均表现优异，确立了新的开源最优水平。

title: MatToolBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents in Real-World Materials Science Workflows
comment: 25 pages, 15 figures. Mei Wu and Rui Xie contributed equally. Bo Chen and Lu Chen are corresponding authors. Project page: this https URL ; code: this https URL
summary: Multimodal GUI agents have achieved impressive results on general software benchmarks, yet their ability to operate professional scientific software remains largely unexplored. In materials science, sparse domain-specific web data, specialized interfaces, and tacit workflow conventions create blind spots that general-purpose pretraining cannot readily bridge. We present MatToolBench, the first real-environment benchmark for evaluating multimodal GUI agents on professional materials science software, comprising 204 tasks across 10 tools in three modalities: GUI operation, OriginPro scripting, and code-based database queries, all executed inside a Windows 11 VM. Each task is decomposed into fine-grained sub-criteria by domain experts, enabling interpretable partial-credit scoring; the GUI component of our multi-level evaluation pipeline achieves an average F1 of 0.98. For OriginPro figure-generation tasks, we further conduct a human-LLM agreement study to validate the use of a multimodal judge for secondary aesthetic assessment. Our experiments show that strong performance on general benchmarks does not transfer to professional scientific workflows, and that this gap is not a visual-grounding problem alone: failures arise from domain-specific operational knowledge, sparse pretraining coverage of scientific software, weak cross-tool artifact handoff, and critical states exposed only visually. Even the best model reaches only 25% success rate on GUI tasks and 45% on code tasks. MatToolBench therefore serves as a challenging diagnostic benchmark and real-environment testbed for data-scarce, knowledge-intensive scientific workflows.

AI.tldr: MatToolBench是首个在Windows 11虚拟机内评估多模态代理操作专业材料科学软件（10种工具，204个任务）的真实环境基准，覆盖GUI操作、OriginPro脚本和代码数据库查询三种模态。结果显示通用基准上的强表现无法迁移到专业科学工作流，最佳模型在GUI任务上仅25%成功率、代码任务45%成功率，揭示了领域知识稀缺、跨工具工件传递和隐式视觉反馈等核心瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态GUI代理在日常软件基准上表现优异，但其操作专业科学软件（尤其是材料科学工具）的能力尚未被系统评估。专业科学软件存在网络数据稀疏、界面特殊化、隐式工作流惯例等特点，导致通用预训练难以覆盖，形成评估盲区。
AI.method: 在Windows 11虚拟机（Docker容器内QEMU）中构建统一评估框架，包含三个专门代理（GUI Agent、Code Agent、Origin Agent）。每个任务由领域专家分解为多个细粒度评分子标准，支持部分得分；GUI评估器通过OCR与像素分析（平均F1=0.98），OriginPro任务使用确定性导出检查加多模态LLM美学评判（人类-LLM一致性研究验证），代码任务使用参考输出匹配。评估7个前沿多模态模型，并进行提示消融实验。
AI.result: 评估Doubao-seed-1-8、Kimi-k2.5、Claude-sonnet-4.6、GPT-5.4、Qwen3-VL系列共7个模型。最佳模型：GUI平均SR=25.0%（Claude），代码平均SR=45.0%（GPT-5.4），Origin最高SR=68.8%（GPT-5.4）。DigitalMicrograph无模型超过20% SR，OPTIMADE最高达85%。消融实验：移除领域特定提示后JADE SR从25%降至5%，MP从15%降至0%，Origin综合得分从17/32降至5.2/32，提示工程对科学软件至关重要。识别四种失败模式：GUI定位错误、过早终止、死锁循环、领域知识缺失。
AI.conclusion: MatToolBench证明了通用基准表现与专业科学工作流表现之间存在显著的领域迁移鸿沟，失败根源在于领域特定操作知识、预训练对科学软件覆盖不足、跨工具工件传递薄弱以及仅视觉暴露的关键状态。该基准为数据稀缺、知识密集的科学工作流提供了具有挑战性的诊断测试平台，推动面向科研代理的研究发展。

title: actr: aligning thoughts and responses for multilingual safety in reasoning llms
summary: Ensuring the safety of reasoning large language models (LLMs) across languages is essential for their reliable deployment. However, when exposed to jailbreak attacks in non-high-resource languages, these models may generate unsafe responses even when their reasoning traces identify safety risks. To address this issue, we propose aligning cross-lingual thoughts and responses (ACTR), a framework that improves multilingual safety alignment by strengthening the use of existing safety reasoning. Specifically, we first present the think gap score (TGS) to compare the normalized contributions of reasoning traces to attention outputs during response generation across languages, and use reasoning- trace substitution to measure the cross-lingual safety gap. Next, using a corpus of jailbreak queries, we assess neuron importance through changes in response representations caused by neuron masking and compare the high-importance neuron sets obtained with reasoning enabled and disabled to identify safety think neurons that support the use of safety reasoning. Finally, we devise neuron-selective consistency optimization (NSCO), which uses a frozen judge model to reward agreement between the safety categories of reasoning traces and responses while updating only the parameters associated with the selected neurons, requiring no human-annotated responses or preference data. Across two reasoning models, ACTR achieves lower average attack success rates than the evaluated state-of-the-art methods on AdvBench-X and MultiJail, with safety gains extending to unseen languages, while preserving or improving average performance on multilingual knowledge and mathematical reasoning tasks and limiting false refusals of benign requests. Warning: this paper contains examples with unsafe content.

AI.tldr: ACTR是一个针对推理大语言模型多语言安全的框架。它揭示并解决了一个核心问题：模型在推理过程中识别出了安全风险，但最终仍以非高资源语言生成不安全回复。通过提出思维差距分数（TGS）量化该跨语言脱节，并定位"安全思维神经元"，ACTR采用神经元选择性一致性优化（NSCO），仅更新这些神经元的参数即可显著降低攻击成功率，同时保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 推理型LLM在多语言场景下存在关键的安全漏洞：面对非高资源语言的越狱攻击时，模型的推理痕迹能正确识别风险，但其最终回复却仍不安全。这种"思维-响应脱节"表明现有对齐方法未能有效将推理阶段的安全判断传递至多语言回复生成中。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) **思维差距分数（TGS）**——基于注意力输出投影能量比，量化推理痕迹对回复生成的归一化贡献在跨语言间的差异；(2) **安全思维神经元识别**——通过对比推理开启/关闭模式下神经元掩蔽引起的表征变化差集，定位支持安全推理利用的关键神经元（top 3%）；(3) **神经元选择性一致性优化（NSCO）**——采用冻结评判模型对思维-响应安全类别一致性提供二元奖励，仅通过二元掩码更新所选神经元的参数，无需人工标注。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B和Gemma4-12B-it两个模型上，ACTR在AdvBench-X和MultiJail基准上均达到最低平均攻击成功率（ASR）：Qwen3-8B上为0.29%/1.90%，Gemma4-12B-it上为0.72%/1.03%，相对最强基线提升40%-45.8%；安全能力可泛化至未见语言（斯瓦希里语ASR从62.86%降至1.27%）；MMMLU和MGSM通用能力保持或略有提升；XSTest上良性请求误拒率仅从4.40%升至6.40%（随机神经元基线为52.00%）。
AI.conclusion: ACTR通过机制可解释性分析揭示了推理LLM中跨语言思维-响应安全脱节的因果机制，并提出了一种参数高效的无标注对齐方法。该工作证实了针对性神经元干预在多语言安全对齐中的有效性，同时维持了模型的通用推理能力并避免了过度拒绝，为多语言安全研究提供了新的分析视角和技术路径。

title: Breaking the Illusion of Review Reliability under Static Evaluation: SCOPE Fuzzing for LLM-based Scientific Reviewers
summary: The rapid growth of submissions and reviewing workload has accelerated the use of large language models (LLMs) in peer review. Prior studies suggest that LLM-based reviewers can penalize content perturbations, such as overclaiming, indicating a certain degree of reliability. Yet these conclusions are largely based on a narrow set of perturbation strategies instantiated with static templates, providing limited evidence of actual reliability. In this paper, we construct a three-level evaluation framework covering perturbations to surface presentation, argumentative logic, and value judgment. Experiments on representative LLM-based reviewers reveal two limitations of static evaluation: stratified vulnerability, where perturbation effects depend on whether the paper's original review score is high or low, and perturbation undercoverage, where a single template misses vulnerabilities exposed by diverse realizations. To address these limitations, we propose SCOPE-Fuzzer, a strategy-aware fuzzer that combines feedback-driven strategy selection with adaptive mutation of paper content. By iteratively probing reviewers with dynamic perturbations, SCOPE-Fuzzer consistently uncovers vulnerabilities overlooked by static evaluation and other baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM辅助同行评审中的可靠性评估问题，揭示了静态评估方法的两大根本缺陷（分层脆弱性与扰动欠覆盖），并提出SCOPE-Fuzzer——一种基于策略感知的内容自适应模糊测试框架，通过反馈驱动的策略选择与上下文敏感的突变机制，在有限查询预算下更有效地暴露LLM评审者的可靠性漏洞。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在同行评审中的应用日益广泛（如AAAI、ICLR已开展试点），其评审可靠性引发关注。既有研究多基于静态模板的扰动评估（如过度声明），并据此推断LLM评审者具备识别内容操纵的能力。然而，这类评估存在系统性局限：聚合统计可能掩盖子集内的脆弱性，固定模板难以覆盖扰动空间的全部有效实例，从而高估评审可靠性。本研究旨在揭示静态评估的内在缺陷，并提供更忠实的可靠性评测方法。
AI.method: 1. **TREAP框架**：基于亚里士多德三维度说服理论（ethos/logos/pathos），构建三级六策略的扰动空间——形式层（词汇句法复杂化LSC、冗余增加VI）、推理层（过度声明OC、逻辑调整LA）、认知层（价值对齐VA、共情激发EE）。所有扰动均施加于摘要，保持语义相似度≥0.85且困惑度不超过原始的1.2倍。2. **静态评估实验**：在300篇ICLR 2024论文上，测试7类LLM评审者（通用LLM、领域微调模型、多智能体系统），按原始评分均值划分高低分组以揭示分层脆弱性。3. **多探针评估**：对93篇可准确检索摘要的论文，采用1-10个动态实例化扰动，量化静态模板的欠覆盖率（PUR、RUR）。5. **SCOPE-Fuzzer**：包含三组件——动作选择器（LLM排序初始策略，基于"成功则扩展、失败则切换"的启发式策略族切换）、自适应突变器（生成论文特异性的扰动指令并重写摘要）、Oracle（基于评分增益Δ̃ₜ>0判定漏洞）。在预算约束B内求解最大化评分增益的优化问题。
AI.result: 主要发现：1. **分层脆弱性（SV）**：在所有7个评审者上，低分组（D_low）扰动增益为正（如MARG在LSC下达+69.57% PSR_net），高分组（D_high）为负，模式在三级策略中一致存在，揭示了聚合统计的系统性误导。2. **扰动欠覆盖（PU）**：PUR介于0.53-0.76之间，RUR稳定在0.86-0.93，意味着静态模板遗漏超过一半的脆弱论文和约90%的有效扰动实例。3. **SCOPE有效性**：在SEA/OpenReviewer/TreeReview上，预算B=10时SCOPE的PSR_net显著优于PAA、MPS、SPD基线（如SEA达+58.06% vs SPD +43.01%）；PG亦达最高（SEA 0.74、OpenReviewer 0.89、TreeReview 0.69）。配对置换检验（10000次）表明大多数对比达p<0.01显著水平。5. **消融验证**：自适应突变器与反馈驱动选择器均为性能关键组件，但OpenReviewer对策略区分不敏感。6. **人工验证**：22名硕博参与的盲测显示88.9%的扰动保持核心研究内容不变，且修改后文本仍具学术可信度。TreeReview的PSR_net最低，提示结构化问题分解机制可提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明：基于静态模板的LLM评审可靠性评估因SV与PU双重缺陷而系统性高估评审者鲁棒性；LLM评审者在内容扰动下并非真正可靠，尤其在低分组论文上表现出显著脆弱性。TREAP提供了一个结构化、可扩展的扰动评估空间，SCOPE-Fuzzer则通过策略感知与自适应搜索在有限预算下有效暴露可靠性漏洞。论文指出三个关键成功因素——采用现实扰动策略、高效搜索扰动空间、自适应突变。局限在于扰动仅限于摘要、突变LLM与评审LLM多样性不足。研究强调此类扰动仅应用于可靠性评测，不得滥用。

title: Learning from Viable Failure Prefixes: Milestone Viability Potential Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents require reinforcement learning methods that can assign credit to intermediate decisions under sparse and delayed rewards. Existing group-based methods such as GRPO and GiGPO alleviate this issue by comparing rollout returns or repeated anchor states, but they still fail when the compared returns have no variation. We identify this failure mode as zero-credit failure: during early training, many failed rollouts contain useful prefixes, yet existing methods assign them no task-discriminative advantage. To address this issue, we propose Milestone Viability Potential Policy Optimization (MVPO), a potential-routed policy optimization algorithm that learns from viable failure prefixes. MVPO estimates prefix potential over Union-Find viability regions, repairs zero-credit groups with potential-difference advantages, and attenuates the potential branch according to relative performance progress. Experiments with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct show that MVPO outperforms eight strong baselines, including GRPO and GiGPO. Under the same training length, MVPO improves over the GiGPO baseline by +4.4 success points on ALFWorld and +5.3 on WebShop, while adding only 0.16%-0.20% advantage-construction overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MVPO（Milestone Viability Potential Policy Optimization），一种基于势能路由的策略优化算法，用于解决长程 LLM 智能体训练中组基方法（如 GRPO、GiGPO）在稀疏奖励早期阶段因零信用组而无法从失败轨迹中学习的核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 长程 LLM 智能体在稀疏延迟奖励环境中训练时，现有组基方法（GRPO、GiGPO）依赖回报变异性分配信用。当所有 rollout 均失败时，回报方差为零，导致组内优势崩塌为零（零信用组），使有用的失败前缀被当作无信息样本丢弃，造成早期训练稀疏。实验显示早期 WebShop 训练中超过 90% 的 GRPO 步骤和约 65% 的 GiGPO 步骤具有零优势。
AI.method: MVPO 通过以下三阶段修复零信用问题：(1) 使用 Union-Find 结构将语义等价前缀合并为可行性区域；(2) 基于自适应里程碑进度、经验未来成功率和循环统计估计每个区域的前缀势能 Φ；(3) 引入进度感知信用路由——当锚点组有回报变异性时保留 GiGPO 的比较信用，当为零信用组时用势差优势 A^pot = γΦ(c_{t+1}) - Φ(c_t) 进行修复，并按相对性能进度 g_k 衰减势能分支强度 κ_k = clip(1 - g_k, κ_min, 1)。最终优势为 Â = A^epi + ω·A^route，采用 PPO 裁剪目标优化，保持无评论家结构。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 进行实验。1.5B 模型下 MVPO 比 GiGPO 在 ALFWorld 提升 +4.4 点、WebShop 提升 +5.3 点；7B 模型下分别提升 +1.1 和 +2.7 点。在搜索增强问答任务上（Qwen2.5-3B）平均得分从 42.1 提升至 44.3。MVPO 在训练步 52 达到 40% ALFWorld 成功率（早于 GiGPO 的 62 步和 GRPO 的 73 步）。优势构造开销仅增加 0.16%-0.20%。消融实验验证了势能修复、锚点路由和 κ 衰减三个组件的必要性。理论分析给出了基于 L-平滑性的期望改进下界，解释早期加速机制。
AI.conclusion: MVPO 通过从失败轨迹的可存活前缀提取势能信号来修复组基 RL 的零信用故障，在长程稀疏奖励设置下加速早期优化并提升最终性能，且几乎不增加计算开销。其贡献包括：(1) 识别零信用故障作为组基 PO 方法的关键瓶颈；(2) 提出基于 Union-Find 可行性区域的势能路由信用修复机制；(3) 在三个基准上验证强性能。方法局限性在于依赖有意义的前缀抽象，且在短程任务中收益较小。

title: When Should Agents Check External State? Budgeting Observations for Stored Intentions
summary: Prospective memory allows an agent to retain an intention tied to a future condition, but the stored intention does not reveal whether that condition currently holds. Checking it may require web access, multi-step tool use, and paid calls. Existing systems decide when intentions require attention, but do not allocate the resulting observations under a shared budget. We introduce the first resource-allocation formulation for the external observations required by stored intentions under a shared episode budget. BudgetPM offers two policy variants that share a hard-budget executor. BudgetPM-Static uses a lightweight Logistic scorer to learn whether a check improves the current decision. BudgetPM-Sequential distills full-episode hindsight schedules into a lightweight policy that decides when to spend or reserve capacity using only pre-query information at deployment. We evaluate BudgetPM against two public memory-agent systems, five matched controls, and four hand-designed monitoring or budget-adaptation rules. Across two benchmarks and three backbones, BudgetPM-Static outperforms adapted Mem0 and PMA workflows. On PM-Bench, its Logistic scorer reaches competitive quality--cost operating points alongside higher-capacity scorers and retains 99.9--100\% of unconstrained quality with 42--54\% fewer observations. Under severe scarcity and the same hard caps, BudgetPM-Sequential exceeds the strongest tested natural monitoring schedule by 1.92--2.58 Set F1 points. It reaches the same Set F1 and on-time recall with 16--33\% fewer observations. Matched attribution, exact-cost analysis, and a fixed-budget load intervention link this gain to competition between present and future opportunities. These results yield a demand--capacity design rule: local gating works when capacity covers demand, while future-aware supervision adds value when observations compete across time.

AI.tldr: BudgetPM是首个将存储意图（prospective memory）所需的外部状态查询建模为共享预算资源分配问题的框架，提出Static和Sequential两种轻量级策略，通过Outcome监督和hindsight-DP调度分别实现局部价值门控和时序分配。
AI.motivation: 长时运行的智能体持有大量前瞻性意图，每个意图的执行都需要检查外部状态（如订单状态、日历），但这些检查（网页访问、工具调用、付费API）会产生高昂成本。现有系统仅决定"何时关注意图"，而不分配由此产生的有限观测预算，导致固定轮询或回退策略在事件时序不可预测或容量紧张时效率低下。
AI.method: （1）问题形式化：在共享episode预算B下最大化任务质量M，策略π选择每步查询集S_t。（2）BudgetPM-Static：从冻结轨迹中构建局部Outcome标签（singleton vs empty对比），训练轻量Logistic打分器判断查询是否改善当前决策。（3）BudgetPM-Sequential：通过hindsight动态规划在完整冻结回合上求解最优调度S*_{1:T}作为监督目标，将其蒸馏为轻量部署策略；部署时仅使用预查询特征。（4）共享硬预算执行器：基于分数-成本比排序，满足per-step成本上限L、查询数上限N_max和回合预算B。（5）通过exact-cost结构裕度H=DP-CG诊断时序分配价值。
AI.result: （1）完整系统比较：BudgetPM-Static在6种backbone-benchmark组合上均领先，PM-Bench Set F1达0.811-0.885，GoodAI准确率达0.944-0.946。（2）轻量Logistic门控达到与LambdaMART/Ensemble有竞争力的质量-成本前沿，在B60/B80保留99.9%-100%无约束质量的同时减少42-54%查询。（3）在严重稀缺（B5/B10）下，Sequential比最强自然监控调度（Deadline-Outcome）高出1.92-2.58 Set F1点，用16-33%更少观测达到相同服务。（4）需求-容量边界：B15/B20时capacity覆盖demand，Static与Sequential相同；B5/B10时观测跨时间竞争，Sequential优于Myopic；机会负载从k=0增至k=3时，结构裕度从0升至+0.00652。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了存储意图外部状态检查的资源分配形式化，提出需求-容量设计规则：当容量覆盖需求时局部价值门控足够，当现在与未来的观测机会竞争时未来感知分配增加价值。BudgetPM连接了记忆系统与观测接口，证明代理记忆系统应联合管理存储意图与其执行所需的观测。

title: SkillCome: Group Contrast Skill Optimization with Dual Memory
summary: Skill evolution improves the capabilities of large language models by analyzing trajectories generated under a given skill and modifying the skill accordingly. Existing approaches typically generate a single trajectory per question. However, this provides insufficient optimization signals since it requires inferring effective skill edits from a solitary path. It is difficult to pinpoint which actions caused the failure in a failed trajectory, or to determine which actions in a successful one should be incorporated into the skill. Furthermore, they rely on a local batch of trajectories for analysis, making the optimization direction susceptible to noisy evidence. To address these, we propose SkillCome, a Skill-evolution method based on group Contrast optimization with dual memory. For each question, SkillCome generates trajectories and performs group contrast analysis to precisely identify key behavioral divergences between successful and failed trajectories, offering reliable optimization signals. The dual memory system further accumulates evidence from historical steps to track patterns shared across different groups, leading to more generalized optimization directions. Together, SkillCome builds a systematic optimization process that transforms experience from observed successful trajectories into reusable skills. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks spanning question answering, reasoning, and agentic tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. SkillCome consistently outperforms baselines across five models of varying families and scales, with gains up to +5.69 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SkillCome，一种基于分组对比优化与双记忆系统的技能进化方法，通过对同一问题生成多条轨迹进行组内成功/失败对比分析来精准定位行为分歧，并利用跨步记忆累积证据以获得更普适的优化方向，在六个基准上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有技能进化方法通常为每个问题生成单条轨迹，导致优化信号不足：无法从孤立路径中准确推断失败原因或应保留的成功行为；同时依赖局部批次轨迹，易受噪声影响，难以发现跨问题、跨步骤的共享模式。
AI.method: 1) 分组滚动采样：对每个训练问题在当前技能下采样 n 条轨迹，构成组 G，包含成功集 G+、失败集 G- 及混合组 G_mix；2) 组对比反思：对混合组进行组内成功/失败对比，定位关键行为分歧并提出对比编辑；3) 失败反思与成功反思：分别分析失败与成功轨迹池；4) 双记忆系统：失败记忆 M_f 存储跨问题失败模式，对比记忆 M_c 存储组内对比模式，以支持组数为依据；5) 证据引导的技能修订：合并三类编辑，按编辑预算 L 优先选择对比与失败编辑，并在验证集上接受改进技能，记忆在拒绝时仍保留。
AI.result: 在 6 个基准（SpreadsheetBench、SearchQA、LiveMath、ALFWorld、OfficeQA、DocVQA）上对 5 个不同规模/家族的模型评估，SkillCome 在 26 个模型-基准对中取得最佳，平均相对"无技能"提升最高达 27.23 分（DeepSeek-V4-Flash），相对最强基线 SkillOpt 进一步提升 5.69 分；消融显示组对比与双记忆具有协同性；技能具备跨模型、跨数据集可迁移性；在 Codex CLI 环境中仍带来稳定增益；同时优化器 token 消耗显著低于 SkillOpt（0.36×–0.69×）。
AI.conclusion: SkillCome 通过组对比反思提供精准的优化信号，通过双记忆系统累积跨步证据以稳定优化方向，二者协同将观察到的成功经验转化为可复用技能，是首个同时解决"优化信号可靠性"与"优化方向状态性"两个核心问题的技能进化框架，对多种模型、任务与代理环境均具有实用价值。

title: Train Ahead, Distill Back: Bootstrapping On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Language Models
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves large language models by letting a self-teacher with privileged information provide dense token-level supervision on the model's own trajectories. Yet existing methods typically construct the self-teacher from the current, initial, or slowly averaged policy state, leaving the quality of supervision constrained by the teacher's ability to exploit privileged information. We ask whether the model's own optimization progress can instead be recycled into a stronger self-teacher. In this paper, we introduce Bootstrapped On-Policy Self-Distillation (B-OPSD), which temporarily trains the policy ahead to obtain a future teacher, restores the student to the original policy state, and then uses the future teacher to supervise the restarted student. The future teacher improves supervision in two complementary ways, it can generate more reliable privileged trajectories and, conditioned on them, provide more informative token-level targets along the restarted student's on-policy trajectories. Experiments on mathematical reasoning with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B show consistent improvements over standard OPSD in both settings, including gains from 27.50 to 41.30 and from 48.80 to 64.44 in the rollout-privileged setting. Our findings point to a broader principle for self-improving models that future learning progress can be distilled backward, preserving acquired knowledge while bootstrapping beyond the optimization state that produced it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出B-OPSD框架，将模型自身的优化进度转化为对早期策略状态的监督信号，通过临时前向训练构建"未来教师"，再回退到初始策略进行蒸馏，在数学推理任务上显著优于标准自蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）方法中，自教师通常基于当前、初始或慢更新的EMA策略状态，限制了其利用特权信息的能力。论文探索能否将模型自身的优化进度回收为更强的自教师，从而突破当前优化状态对监督质量的约束。
AI.method: 提出B-OPSD（Bootstrapped On-Policy Self-Distillation）"train-ahead, distill-back"框架：（1）第一阶段从初始策略π₀执行K步临时OPSD更新获得未来教师π_F；（2）第二阶段将学生重置为π₀，利用π_F提供特权轨迹和token级目标进行蒸馏。在有答案场景用正确性验证激活未来教师，在无答案场景用模型生成的一致性进行路由选择。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上的AIME24/25和HMMT25数学推理基准测试中，B-OPSD在有答案和无答案两种设置下均持续优于标准OPSD。Rollout-privileged设置下平均分从27.50提升至41.30（4B）、从48.80提升至64.44（8B）。消融实验证明未来教师与未来生成的特权轨迹之间存在兼容性效应，未来监督在训练早期最有效，且匹配训练预算下仍优于继续训练。
AI.conclusion: 优化进度不仅可作为更新后的参数，还可作为可重用的监督源。B-OPSD将临时优化进展转化为对早期策略状态的更强监督，证明了"未来学习进度可向后蒸馏"这一自改进的更广泛原则，为自我改进模型开辟了新方向。

title: From Judgment Quality to Downstream Utility: Rethinking LLM-as-a-Judge for Open-Ended Tasks
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge is increasingly used to evaluate policy responses on open-ended tasks that lack ground-truth answers. Existing work often directly converts the resulting judgments into reward signals for policy training, paying limited attention to intrinsic judgment quality and largely restricting the use of Judges to training-time supervision. We systematically investigate judgment quality and downstream utility by examining both how judgments are elicited and how they are used. For judgment elicitation, we vary the Judge protocol along three dimensions: verdict granularity, critique usage, and evaluation batching. For judgment usage, beyond policy training, we extend Judge to test-time inference through Best-of-N selection, Judge-guided revision, and beam search. We find that, (i) Surprisingly, judgment quality and downstream utility do not always align. (ii) Judge protocol design substantially affects both intrinsic judgment quality and downstream utility. (iii) Judge guidance effectively converts test-time compute into performance gains, with benefits varying across inference strategies. Our results call for a multifaceted evaluation of LLM Judges on open-ended tasks, encompassing intrinsic judgment quality, and downstream utility.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了LLM-as-a-Judge在开放式任务中,从"判断质量"和"下游效用"两个维度进行了多角度分析,发现两者并不总是一致,并提出了评估LLM Judge的多面化框架。
AI.motivation: 现有研究在使用LLM Judge时存在两大局限:(1)将Judge主要限制在训练时奖励信号,忽略了其在测试时推理中的潜在效用;(2)过度关注下游策略性能,缺乏对内在判断质量的系统性分析,且未考察判断质量与下游性能的关系。
AI.method: 沿两条轴系统分析:(1)判断提取——变化判定粒度(T/F vs Rating)、批评使用方式(Critique+Verdict/Verdict+Critique/Verdict Only)、评估批处理(独立 vs 批量)三个维度;(2)判断使用——扩展Judge至测试时推理,包括Best-of-N选择、Judge引导修订、束搜索。使用GRPO训练,在医学和科学领域采用多种策略模型和Judge模型评估内在判断质量(准确性、批评-判定一致性、稳定性)和下游效用。
AI.result: 三个核心发现:(1)判断质量与下游效用并不总是一致——高质量判断未必带来更好的训练后策略;(2)Judge协议设计显著影响两者——Rating提升奖励分辨率和训练效果但判断准确性不一致,Verdict+Critique整体最优,批量评估降低成本但损害判断质量;(3)测试时Judge引导能有效将计算转化为性能提升,Best-of-N随N增大增益提升,修订策略全面提升,束搜索随预算增大而改善。
AI.conclusion: LLM Judge在开放式任务上的评估应多面化,既看其判断能力,也看其对所引导系统的实际改进效果。协议选择影响内在判断质量与下游效用,但两者效果并非总是一致,需根据具体场景选择合适协议。

title: When Tools Silently Lie: Evaluating and Mitigating Blind Compliance in Tool-Augmented Data Agents
comment: 28 pages, 8 figures. Code and benchmark materials: this https URL
summary: Tool-augmented data agents rely on tool outputs for analytical decisions. Yet successful execution can return plausible but incorrect evidence, requiring agents to decide whether to trust or verify it. Understanding this failure requires examining both the evidence obtained through checking and the answer ultimately adopted. We introduce ToxicBench to measure checking and adoption under numerical, label, schema, and retrieval errors, pairing clean and poisoned observations over fixed source data. In the 118-task GPT evaluation across three adapters, poisoning lowers task success by 26 to 39 percentage points. Ordinary retries help under one-shot poisoning, whereas repeated poisoning reveals wrong-answer adoption after checking. Controls on three public tables isolate how supplied evidence affects recovery. After freezing the scorer, we compare its judgments with human annotations on 200 trajectories, finding 96% task-success agreement. Human judgments support retry gains over Base and confirm adoption after checking on audited tasks. We release trajectories, versioned scoring, and reference and delivery audits. These findings highlight evidence availability and answer selection as complementary dimensions of agent reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ToxicBench基准，评估工具增强型数据智能体在面对"静默工具投毒"（工具执行成功但返回被篡改的观测结果）时的检测与恢复能力。研究区分了"检查"（checking）与"答案采纳"（answer adoption），发现中毒使任务成功率下降26–39个百分点；普通重试在一次性投毒下效果显著，但在重复投毒下仍会出现"经验证后的错误采纳"（VPA）。
AI.motivation: 工具增强型智能体在数据分析中常将计算委托给工具，但工具成功执行并不保证返回结果可信。例如查询最高营收门店时，工具可能返回格式正常、数值合理的错误绑定结果。现有评估难以区分"盲目接受错误证据"与"尝试检查但仍采纳错误结论"。本文旨在系统化测量这种"静默投毒"下智能体的证据检查与答案采纳行为，并评估显式验证策略的实际效果。
AI.method:
1）构建ToxicBench基准：固定源数据，通过代理修改工具返回的观测值（保持接口与执行成功），配对干净与中毒环境进行评估；包含数值型（聚合缩放、符号翻转、排名交换等）与语义型（标签交换、处理/对照翻转、列语义交换、过时元数据、偏置检索等）投毒操作符。
2）设计轨迹级指标：区分盲从率（BCR，无检查即采纳）、验证率（VR，执行新证据生成操作）、恢复率（RR）、经验证中毒采纳（VPA，有检查仍采纳错误答案）。
3）对比四种协议：Base（单路由）、Double-pass（双普通路由）、Verification-only（带验证指令）、Generic Guard（带通用检查提示），共享步数与token上限。
4）在三张公开表（Palmer Penguins、Auto MPG、Bike Sharing）上进行结构化证据对照实验，控制第二阶段可用证据。
5）对200条轨迹进行人评，验证评分器96%一致性。
AI.result:
1）118任务GPT评估中，中毒使任务成功率（TSR）下降26–39个百分点（LangGraph 32、smolagents 39、AutoGen 26），跨模型（GPT、Claude、Qwen）九种配置均观察到数值型下降。
2）一次性投毒下Double-pass提升TSR +0.110（95% CI [0.056, 0.171]），但Generic Guard相对Double-pass为-0.025（CI包含0），说明显式验证指令并未明显优于普通重试。
3）重复投毒下，101个VPA案例中有78个仅有被污染的后续检查，证实"经验证后仍采纳错误答案"。
4）公开表对照实验显示：当第二阶段证据干净时，重试与审查均几乎全部成功；当证据完全污染时，全部失败，表明恢复效果强烈依赖可用证据。
5）人评确认Double-pass回归Base优势及VPA现象，评分器与人类TSR一致性达96%。
AI.conclusion: 智能体可靠性应同时评估证据可用性与答案选择两个维度。普通重试在一次性投毒下已是强基线；显式验证提示未能在此基础上带来稳定增益。关键发现是：检查行为本身不能保证恢复，尤其在证据可被污染时。研究强调了智能体应获取独立证据并解决冲突观测的预算感知验证策略的必要性。局限性：任务基于小型合成表；评分器在不同指标与答案风格上召回率有差异；未测试生产工作流与自然发生错误。

title: From Learner Behavior to Reusable Skills for Effective and Efficient Learner Simulation
summary: Learner simulation aims to reproduce how a particular learner behaves on new tasks. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate increasingly fine-grained learning behaviors, existing approaches often need to repeatedly process a growing interaction history to reconstruct the learner. This introduces additional context and inference costs and makes the acquired learner-specific simulation capability difficult to reuse across different LLMs. We therefore propose Learner2Skill, which externalizes the simulation capability acquired from historical interactions into a persistent and reusable Simulation Skill. The Skill captures the learner's current learning state and recurring response patterns, evolves as new real interactions arrive, and can be adapted to a new LLM through lightweight executor calibration without reconstructing the learner from scratch. Experiments show that Learner2Skill more faithfully reproduces fine-grained learner behavior while reducing overall token cost, and that the same constructed Skills can be effectively reused across different LLM executors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Learner2Skill 框架，将学习者模拟能力从历史交互中外化为持久可复用的"模拟技能"（Simulation Skill），通过技能构建、执行器校准和技能进化三阶段，支持跨 LLM 执行器复用并降低 token 成本，在 LearnerTrace-2K 数据集上实现更精细的学习者行为模拟。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的学习者模拟方法需要反复处理不断增长的交互历史来重建学习者表征，导致上下文和推理成本增加，且学习者特定的模拟能力难以跨不同 LLM 执行器复用。如何将已获取的学习者模拟能力持久化和可复用化成为核心挑战。
AI.method: Learner2Skill 框架包含三个核心阶段：(1) 技能构建（Skill Construction）——从历史交互中提取学习状态（知识概念掌握度，由认知模型估计）和响应模式（反复出现的解题策略、错误、停止倾向等），以 SKILL.md 为统一入口组织为可复用技能；(2) 执行器校准（Executor Calibration）——使用少量多学习者的真实交互反馈，通过协议拟合集和验证集识别跨学习者反复出现的技能使用错误，仅更新共享执行协议而非学习者信息本身，使同一技能可适配不同 LLM 执行器；(3) 技能进化（Skill Evolution）——在测试时根据新真实交互更新学习状态（基础认知模型估计 + 近期残差修正）和响应模式（基于证据的自适应更新），模型参数和校准协议保持冻结。
AI.result: 在 LearnerTrace-2K（2000 名学习者、52566 条数学与物理交互、2076 道习题、709 个知识点）上的实验表明：使用 Claude Sonnet 4.6 作为执行器时，Learner2Skill 在六项细粒度模拟指标中五项达到最优（Attempt 99.64、Process 54.19、Final Answer 40.13、Outcome Accuracy 63.43、Consistency 71.54），总 token 成本（299.16M）比次优方法降低约 15.2%，CE（一致性效率）达 0.00239，高出第二名约 39.8%。跨执行器复用中，同一构建的技能可直接迁移至 Gemini 3.8 Flash、Qwen3.8 Flash 和 DeepSeek V4 Flash，无需重复技能构建，总成本分别降至 192.68M、156.33M 和 140.77M tokens。消融实验验证了学习状态、响应模式、执行器校准和技能进化四个组件的互补贡献。在计算机自适应测试（CAT）应用中，使用 Learner2Skill 生成数据的增强训练使 FSI、KLI、MAAT 三种策略的 F1 提升 0.48–2.88。
AI.conclusion: Learner2Skill 实现了学习者特定模拟能力与特定 LLM 执行器的解耦，将该能力外化为可持久保存、跨执行器复用并随新交互持续更新的可复用模拟技能。该方法在保持甚至提升细粒度行为模拟效果的同时显著降低了 token 成本，且生成的模拟数据对真实教育应用（如 CAT）具有实用价值，为个体化学习者模拟提供了一种高效的可持续方案。

title: SimpleEvol: An Agent-Loop Framework for LLM-Driven Automated Heuristic Design with Minimal Human Priors
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for automated heuristic design (AHD), enabling iterative generation and refinement of heuristics. However, the dominant paradigm embeds LLMs as narrow, fixed components, such as crossover or mutation, within heavily hand-engineered evolutionary frameworks. We argue this misapprehends LLMs. It treats them as specialized tools rather than general reasoners, constrains them to low-level operations, and underutilizes their autonomy. Moreover, the extensive human priors in these frameworks violate the bitter lesson principle that general methods scaling with computation surpass hand-crafted solutions. This raises a key question: which AHD framework designs best convert stronger LLM capabilities into better heuristics? To address this, we propose metrics for LLM-driven AHD framework handcraftedness (AHI) and intelligence conversion efficiency (ICE). Evaluating ten LLMs across three challenging combinatorial optimization problems, we obtain a notable finding that frameworks with fewer human priors consistently yield higher ICE. Based on this finding, we propose SimpleEvol, an agent-loop framework for AHD which removes nearly all human priors and allows the LLM to operate autonomously. SimpleEvol consistently achieves the highest ICE, often by a large margin. Our results challenge the trend toward complex AHD pipelines and point to a lighter and more model-centric alternative, suggesting that reducing human priors is a more effective strategy to scale up with model intelligence. The source code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出SimpleEvol，一个极简的agent-loop AHD框架，旨在消除几乎所有人工先验。同时引入两个度量指标：AHI（量化框架手工化程度）和ICE（衡量模型智能到启发式质量的转换效率），通过10个LLM在3个组合优化问题上的实验证明，人工先验越少的框架ICE越高。
AI.motivation: 当前主流的LLM驱动AHD框架将LLM嵌入到大量手工设计的进化管线中（如交叉、变异、种群管理等），将LLM视为专用工具而非通用推理者，限制了其自主性。这违反了"苦涩教训"原则：通用方法随计算扩展优于手工设计。论文质疑：哪种AHD框架设计最能有效将更强的LLM能力转化为更好的启发式？
AI.method: 1. 提出两个分析度量：AHI（M+K+log10(1+Q)，分别量化功能复杂度、LLM操作多样性、交互规模）和ICE（框架性能对模型智能的回归斜率）。2. 模型智能度量I(m)基于MMLU-Pro、IFBench、AIME2025、LiveCodeBench四个基准的几何平均。3. SimpleEvol采用单条演化轨迹设计：每次迭代LLM生成一个候选启发式，配合周期性历史压缩（每5次迭代）和最佳精英保留机制，让LLM自主进行"记录-反思-比较-规划"循环。4. 在TSP（逐步构造）、CVRP（ACO）、FSSP（GLS）三个问题上对比FunSearch、EoH、ReEvo、MCTS-AHD。
AI.result: 1. AHI-ICE呈强负相关：SimpleEvol（AHI=6.001）ICE最高（TSP:2.19, CVRP:6.21），而ReEvo（AHI=9.112）ICE最低（TSP:0.82, CVRP:2.08）。2. 留一法分析显示该关系对模型选择稳健（贝叶斯bootstrap中Pr(Δ>0)在8个对比中均>79%，5个超过95%）。3. SimpleEvol在使用GPT-5-mini时获得最佳绝对性能（如TSP50仅4.77% gap）。4. 在TSPLIB上获得最低平均gap（10.26%）和最多top-1结果（8/15）。5. 成本性能分析显示SimpleEvol占据Pareto前沿位置。6. 消融实验证实精英保留机制贡献最大。7. 165种AHI权重组合下负相关性依然稳健（中位Spearman相关系数=-1.0）。
AI.conclusion: 随着LLM能力提升，AHD的主要瓶颈正从框架工程转向模型智能本身。轻量级、以模型为中心的agent-loop框架能更有效地利用基础模型进步。未来框架应赋予LLM对搜索全过程（规划、反思、记忆）更大的自主权，而非将其嵌入精心设计的外层循环中。最佳利用模型增益的框架将是那些"让出道路"的框架。

title: Absorbed in Inertia: Activation Analysis for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents have become increasingly capable of executing tasks on live desktops through natural-language instructions, based on trajectories of screenshots, actions, and reasoning. We discover that they can stealthily exhibit inertia, in which they repeat fruitless actions despite recognizing that these actions are ineffective. We hypothesize that inertia is reflected in the agent's internal state, i.e., the activation values of the agent's underlying model, and propose a protocol to measure the relationship between the two. Extensive analysis of high-dimensional activation states shows that inertia corresponds to an absorbing region of activation space, where activation values become stale across actions and even after attempts to steer them. We conjecture that drastically changing the agents' activations by re-initializing them is necessary to escape inertia. Specifically, we propose R$^3$ (Reset, Reroute, Restore), which temporarily resets the agent's context trajectory to escape the absorbing region and then restores the historical context to effectively complete the task. Our approach yields 17-55% lower measured inertia across models relative to unmodified agents. These results suggest that changing the context can interrupt recurrence more effectively than directly steering the resulting activations. Our code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文发现并分析了计算机使用代理（CUA）中一种被忽视的失败模式——"惯性"（Inertia），即代理在推理中承认失败后仍重复无效动作。通过对残差激活的高维分析，作者将惯性解释为激活空间中的一个吸收区域，并提出R³（Reset, Reroute, Restore）干预方法，通过临时重置上下文轨迹来逃逸该吸收区域，在四个模型上将惯性降低了17%–55%。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用代理虽然能执行桌面任务，但常出现"隐性失败"——在推理中已承认方法失败，却继续执行相同无效动作。现有失败分类多关注步骤重复或冗余，但未将显式失败承认与重复执行联系起来，因此缺乏对此现象的机制性理解与针对性干预方法。
AI.method: 1. 形式化定义"惯性"：同时满足屏幕-动作精确循环（$y_t=1$）与盲评LLM判定的失败承认（$f_t=1$），即$y_t=f_t=1$。2. 在四个开源CUA（UI-TARS-1.5-7B、OpenCUA-32B、GUI-Owl-1.5-8B-Think、EvoCUA-32B-S2）和两个基准（OSWorld、OpenComputer）上进行实证测量。3. 提取推理-动作边界处的残差激活，拟合任务平衡的"复发方向"$v^{(\ell)}$和"惯性方向"$u^{(\ell)}$，通过嵌套任务验证评估AUC。4. 比较线性激活引导与上下文重置两种干预策略，并提出R³方法：触发时重置上下文、从任务与当前截图搜索可改变屏幕的动作、然后恢复触发前的历史。5. 通过配对轨迹比较、激活邻域分析和屏幕变化率评估干预效果。
AI.result: 1. 复发集中于失败轨迹（最高66%），其中55–89%的复发伴随推理中的失败承认。2. 预动作激活能区分复发与非复发动作（验证AUC 0.72–0.95），并能进一步区分惯性（有承认）与无承认的复发（AUC 0.82–0.90），复发期间激活向量变化微弱。3. 线性激活引导未能一致降低惯性或复发；上下文重置使0–4%重新提出重复动作，而引导仍有69–86%。5. R³在四个模型上将惯性降低17–55%（UI-TARS：33.9%、GUI-Owl：16.5%、OpenCUA：39.2%、EvoCUA：54.9%），屏幕-动作复发率降低17–43%，但任务得分改善因模型而异。6. 激活邻域分析显示重置后预动作激活移向更少关联动作复用的状态。
AI.conclusion: 失败承认本身不保证计算机使用代理的自我纠正。惯性对应于激活空间的吸收区域，其中信息关于失败承认仍可被检测，但持续复发。需要更剧烈的状态变化（而非激活层面的微调）才能打断该模式。改变上下文比引导激活更能有效中断复发，但任务完成率并不必然随之提升。R³通过临时重置使前动作状态从干净上下文重新计算，再恢复有用历史，为代理提供了一条兼顾逃逸惯性与保留任务进度的实用路径。未来工作可研究恢复失败时应保留哪些交互历史部分，以实现更高效的恢复并提升任务完成率。

title: Accelerated surrogate dynamics for dynamical, stochastic system evolution
summary: Dynamic simulations are an entrenched way of gaining insight into the evolution of system dynamics. Their computational cost however is often prohibitively high, especially in cases of stochastic frameworks. Machine learning algorithms are especially suited as simulation surrogates. Nevertheless, they face some very distinct limitations. Firstly, the sheer dimensionality of these systems, however, precludes the use of traditional time series models who struggle with high dimensional feature spaces. Additionally, traditional time series focus exclusively on either long or short range effects, causing local or global drift given enough time. In this paper, we propose a framework that addresses those limitations. Our framework combines a Variational Autoencoder, with a convolutional or graph basis that reduces the dimensionality of the system. This latent vector is propagated in time using a Temporal Fusion Transformer model, which includes both long range and short range effect encoding, as well as static covariate support. We test our framework on three distinct cases, to prove its robustness and in all three we have achieved practically identical to the simulation results at a fraction of the time. Further, our framework is flexible enough to be adapted to any new system and provides an inbuilt uncertainty quantification for targeted experiment design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通用的代理模拟框架,结合变分自编码器(VAE)进行降维与时序融合Transformer(TFT)进行时间演化预测,可高效替代高维随机动力学模拟,在三个不同案例上以极低计算成本实现了与原模拟近乎一致的结果。
AI.motivation: 传统动力学模拟(如KMC、MD)计算成本极高,尤其在随机框架下难以承受。现有机器学习代理方法面临两大瓶颈:一是传统时序模型难以处理高维特征空间;二是LSTM侧重短期依赖而Transformer侧重长期依赖,单独使用会导致局部或全局漂移。本文旨在构建一个能同时应对高维输入、长短期依赖并具备可解释性的通用代理框架。
AI.method: 框架分三模块:(1)编码器ℰ——采用基于卷积或图神经网络的变分自编码器(VAE)将高维物理配置压缩至低维潜空间;(2)传播器𝒫——使用时序融合Transformer(TFT),融合LSTM的短期建模与Transformer的多头自注意力的长期建模,并通过变量选择网络对静态协变量(如模拟参数)进行重要性加权;(3)解码器𝒟——将潜空间预测重建为高维配置。对随机系统,模型额外输出方差分支以量化认知不确定性。VAE与TFT分别独立训练。
AI.result: 在三类典型动力学系统中验证:(1)二维Ising模型自旋交换的Metropolis Monte Carlo——重构快照与能量演化误差<5%;(2)固态电解质边界层形成的Kinetic Monte Carlo——准确预测浓度均值场与标准差场;(3)丙氨酸二肽分子动力学——自由能面(FES)与马尔可夫态模型转移概率均与真实MD高度吻合。三个案例均达到与原模拟几乎一致的结果,推理时间较原模拟提升至少三个数量级(KMC从数天降至数秒),且模型能收敛至物理稳态。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过VAE-TFT-VAE的耦合,首次同时解决了高维随机动力学代理中的降维、长短期依赖与可解释性问题,在保持物理精度的同时实现了数量级加速,适用于多种模拟方法(从随机到确定性、从格点配置到分子图),有望广泛应用于材料科学中的现象研究加速。

title: V-Engram: Trigger-Indexed External Memory for Modular Text-to-Image Personalization
summary: Pretrained text-to-image models contain broad visual knowledge, yet they cannot reliably acquire or refine a specific visual identity from only a few references while preserving compositional control. Token-embedding methods are compact but often underfit identity, whereas adapter-based methods improve fidelity through persistent weight updates that can be costly to store and interfere when concepts are composed. We introduce V-Engram, a trigger-indexed external memory mechanism for Stable Diffusion 3.5. Each concept is assigned an explicit trigger that retrieves concept-specific memory, whose gated directions enter frozen text-encoder and MMDiT context states as relative residuals. Separating this memory from backbone adaptation enables prompt-selective and multi-concept access without merging model updates. Experiments show that V-Engram broadly matches DreamBooth-LoRA in overall subject fidelity while showing advantages in settings such as contextual subject preservation. Prompt-matched loading retrieves only matched entries, reducing most additional adaptation-state loading for a single-concept query. Qualitative results further demonstrate paired-trigger composition and same-class separation, while prompts without registered entries retain the frozen model's base behavior. Together, these results establish trigger-indexed memory as a modular interface for adding targeted visual evidence without rewriting the generator.

AI.tldr: V-Engram提出了一种针对Stable Diffusion 3.5的触发词索引化外部记忆机制，通过精确的token n-gram匹配检索概念特定的方向与门控残差，注入到冻结的文本编码器和MMDiT层的隐藏状态上，实现无需修改骨干网络权重的模块化文本到图像个性化。
AI.motivation: 现有少样本个性化方法面临容量-模块化权衡：Textual Inversion等token嵌入方法容量不足，而DreamBooth/LoRA等适配器方法虽保真度高但权重更新难以存储且在多概念组合时产生干扰。需要一种既能表达丰富视觉证据又能由提示词精确寻址且不修改骨干网络的机制。
AI.method: 为每个概念分配显式触发词（如<dog>），在CLIP-L、OpenCLIP-G和T5-XXL三个分词器流中分别构建注册表，记录token n-gram条目。每个条目存储可训练的方向向量e和逐通道tanh门控a，在推理时通过精确token-id匹配检索条目，并以门控相对残差形式注入到选定隐藏状态位置：Δ = ρ(H)·(e/||e||₂ ⊙ tanh(a))，其中ρ为当前隐藏状态均值的norm（带stop-gradient）。在SD3.5中，CLIP流挂载在倒数第二transformer块之前，T5流挂载在最终编码器块之前，MMDiT中按{0,6,12,19,25,31,37}均匀分布挂载。仅训练Engram方向和门控，骨干完全冻结；训练目标为标准的SD3.5 rectified-flow损失。
AI.result: 在整体主体保真度上V-Engram与DreamBooth-LoRA大致相当（CLIP-I相近但DINOv2略低），但在保留身份的上下文场景中V-Engram优于LoRA；提示词匹配加载仅激活已注册条目，显著减少单概念查询时的额外适配状态加载。定性结果显示配对触发词组合、同类分离以及未注册提示词保持冻结模型基行为等能力；消融实验支持门控残差注入和分布式MMDiT访问的必要性。
AI.conclusion: V-Engram在保真度、模块化和组合访问之间提供了与权重自适应的不同平衡点，而非普遍更优的替代方案；精确token匹配作为外部记忆的寻址机制，有望推广到其他token条件生成或多模态架构中，但跨架构验证仍是未来工作。

title: Learning to Prove, Not Just to Answer: Reinforcement Learning from Formal Verification for Natural-Language Logical Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for natural-language logical reasoning, where the final answer is easy to check but the proof behind it is not. In natural-language logical reasoning, an intermediate conclusion should follow from its premises, and the resulting derivation should support the final answer. Existing methods lack machine-checkable verification of intermediate conclusions and answer-supporting proof dependencies, so they may assign credit to invalid or answer-irrelevant steps. We propose Proof-R1, an RL framework from formal verification that trains LLMs to construct verifiable proofs for natural-language logical reasoning. Proof-R1 admits a generated conclusion into the verified proof state only when the corresponding reasoning action satisfies the proof obligations through UNSAT-based machine-checkable formal verification. Proof-R1 also recovers the answer-supporting dependency closure to trace the proof structure of the final answer and align outcome credit with the proof dependencies. Experiments demonstrate that Proof-R1 improves answer accuracy across three logical reasoning benchmarks and four backbone models and outperforms training-free agents and training-based methods in terms of reasoning-process verifiability.

AI.tldr: Proof-R1是一个基于形式化验证的强化学习框架，用于训练大语言模型在自然语言逻辑推理中构建可验证的证明。其核心创新在于将UNSAT-based机器可检查形式化验证(MCFV)与答案支持依赖闭包(ASDC)相结合，使形式化验证不仅作为奖励信号，而是直接定义策略学习所优化的证明构建过程。
AI.motivation: 现有的自然语言逻辑推理方法缺乏对中间结论的机器可检查验证以及对答案支持证明依赖的追溯，导致信用可能分配给无效或与答案无关的推理步骤。方法仅依赖最终答案正确性的结果奖励，无法识别中间推导的有效性，且验证判定本身无法确定哪些生成的结论可作为后续推理的可信事实，哪些经验证的推理实际支持最终答案。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) MCFV维护语义验证状态S^sem和规则验证状态S^rule，通过SMT求解器的UNSAT判定来接纳生成的结论，并输出四种布尔判定(模式/语义/规则/证明进度)，映射为0.0/0.1/0.3/1.0的验证信号；(2) ASDC构建候选证明证书图G_τ，从最终结论c_g反向遍历恢复答案支持依赖闭包C_τ(c_g)，生成闭包掩码m_{k,t}；(3) 验证对齐优化将动作级优势A_{k,t}=λ_v·A^v_{k,t}+λ_o·A^o_{k,t}通过动作-标记对齐矩阵M^k映射到token级别，采用带KL正则化的PPO风格截断目标函数进行策略优化。
AI.result: 在ProverQA、FOLIO和ProofWriter三个基准、四个骨干模型(Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen3-8B、Llama3.1-8B、GLM-Z1-9B-0414)上的实验表明：Proof-R1在答案准确率和推理过程可验证性(RVR提升10-38点)上均优于训练无关代理(LogicAgent、GoV)和基于训练的方法(SFT、GRPO、PRoSFI)；消融实验证实MCFV和ASDC各自贡献独特；跨后端验证(Z3/cvc5/veriT/Isabelle)和GPT-5.5独立审查(99.73%加权一致)证实验证增益对底层求解器不敏感；梯度分析显示MCFV和ASDC在参数空间中提供正交监督。
AI.conclusion: Proof-R1成功将形式化验证从奖励信号提升为证明构建过程的定义者，通过MCFV确定哪些结论成为可信证明要素、通过ASDC确定哪些动作获得结果信用。实验证明该框架在多个骨干模型和基准上同时提升答案性能和验证通过率，实现了形式化验证与大语言模型策略优化的深度集成，使模型能够对自然语言逻辑问题执行基于证明的可验证推理。

title: Information Bottleneck-Guided Adaptive Hypergraph Transformer for Brain Disease Diagnosis
summary: Exploring high-order correlations and long-range dependencies in brain networks holds significant value for both neuroscience research and clinical diagnosis. However, previous studies have lacked a unified integration of high-order and long-range dependency information in brain networks, and there is substantial redundancy behind various types of information. These issues limit their effectiveness in the diagnosis of brain diseases. To address this, we propose an Information Bottleneck-Guided Adaptive HyperGraph Transformer (IBAHGT). By incorporating the information bottleneck (IB) principle, this approach enables adaptive learning of high-order correlations and both short- and long-range dependencies within a unified framework for brain network analysis, achieving high-precision brain disease diagnosis. IBAHGT consists of three key components: an information bottleneck-guided adaptive hypergraph convolution, which introduces a novel hypergraph information bottleneck (HIB) principle to adaptively learn hypergraph message-passing weights between nodes and hyperedges, optimizes information flow and captures high-order information in brain networks that is maximally informative and minimally redundant (MIMR). The Transformer encoder captures global information within brain networks through the attention mechanism, specifically modeling short- and long-range dependencies. An information bottleneck-guided node-level adaptive fusion employs the IB principle to learn independent weights for each node, facilitating the fine-grained integration of high-order information and global information to obtain an efficient representation for downstream tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms current state-of-the-art methods and can identify biomarkers for clinical applications.

AI.tldr: 提出IBAHGT模型，通过信息瓶颈引导的自适应超图卷积、Transformer编码器和基于IB的节点级自适应融合，在统一框架中联合建模高阶相关性、短程和长程依赖性，并有效融合进行脑疾病诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有方法未能在一个统一框架中整合脑网络的高阶相关性及短程与长程依赖性，且各类信息间存在大量冗余，限制了脑疾病诊断的有效性。
AI.method: 1. **IB指导的自适应超图卷积(IBAHGConv)**：通过超图信息瓶颈(HIB)原则，自适应学习节点与超边间的消息传递权重，获取MIMR高阶信息。 2. **Transformer编码器**：利用自注意力机制捕获短程和长程依赖性，获取全局表示。 3. **IB指导的节点级自适应融合(IBNAFusion)**：基于IB原则为每个节点学习独立权重，细粒度融合高阶信息与全局信息。 4. **损失函数**：结合交叉熵监督损失、IBAHGConv损失和IBNAFusion损失，通过互信息上下界估计实现优化。
AI.result: 在ABIDE、ADNI和ADHD-200三个fMRI数据集上，IBAHGT在准确率、灵敏度、特异性和AUC指标上均优于现有SOTA方法。在ABIDE上达到77.6%准确率（ASD vs NC），在ADNI上达到86.3%准确率（AD vs NC），在ADHD-200上达到72.3%准确率（ADHD vs NC）。消融实验验证了各组件和IB原则的有效性。识别出与临床相关的生物标志物（如ASD的MFG.R和MTG.R连接缺失，AD的PHG.R和HIP.R连接缺失）。
AI.conclusion: IBAHGT在统一框架内学习MIMR高阶相关性及短程和长程依赖性，抑制冗余同时实现多源信息的细粒度融合，获得脑疾病诊断的高效表征。在三个基准数据集上达到SOTA性能，为理解ROI间交互及脑信息处理模式提供新视角。未来工作将探索结构脑网络对功能脑网络多样化依赖性的影响，并整合功能与结构脑网络进行更全面的分析。

title: OptiCom : A Unified Framework for State-Conditioned Composition in LLM-Driven Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to solve complex scientific and practical problems via iterative optimization. However, dynamically coordinating diverse search mechanisms as candidate quality, failure modes, and resource budgets evolve remains a critical open challenge. Targeted empirical diagnostics reveal that mechanism effectiveness is highly state-dependent. Motivated by this, we analyze how individual decisions drive final outcomes, decomposing the expected terminal improvement under a shared budget into cumulative decision opportunities minus cumulative selection losses. Guided by this opportunity-loss theoretical foundation, we propose OptiCom, a unified framework that represents LLM-driven optimizers within a shared configuration space: C=(A,Q,O,E,M,S), corresponding to artifact, query, operator, evaluation, memory, and strategy. Operating within this space, a fast LLM-based Optimization Controller dynamically composes immediate mechanisms through structured Action Packages, while a slower Strategy Adapter refines long-term selection preferences, operator weights, and templates based on accumulated trajectory feedback. Comprehensive evaluations across 32 benchmark groups demonstrate the superiority of framework: OptiCom achieves an average Max-score rank of 1.72 among 14 evaluated configurations, securing the top score in 23 groups. Ultimately, these results highlight the broad applicability and high extensibility of OptiCom as a general-purpose paradigm for robust LLM test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: OptiCom是一个统一框架，通过共享配置空间AQOEMS（Artifact, Query, Operator, Evaluation, Memory, Strategy）和双时间尺度架构（快速Optimization Controller + 慢速Strategy Adapter）实现LLM驱动优化中机制的状态自适应组合，在32个基准测试组中平均最优排名1.72。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM优化方法（如OPRO、TextGrad、FunSearch、AdaEvolve等）采用固定的搜索流水线或单一策略，无法在候选质量、失败模式和资源预算动态变化时自适应地协调不同的搜索机制。经验诊断显示机制有效性高度依赖于优化状态，需要一个统一框架来实现状态条件化的机制组合。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 共享配置空间AQOEMS，将任何LLM优化器表示为六维功能元组，统一现有方法；(2) 累积机会-损失理论分解，将终端改进分解为累积决策机会减去累积选择损失（Theorem 1），并在选择能力假设下给出全局性能下界（Theorem 2）；(3) 双时间尺度自适应架构——快速Optimization Controller通过结构化Action Packages动态组合Q/O/E/M机制，慢速Strategy Adapter基于累积轨迹反馈优化选择偏好、算子权重和模板。
AI.result: 在32个基准测试组（涵盖数学、系统、GPU、算法、推理、创意生成、提示工程、量子电路）中，OptiCom在14个配置中获得平均Max排名1.72（Mean排名2.08），在23个组中取得最高分；相对最强基线的增益范围Max为0.29%-16.33%，Mean为1.28%-17.33%。消融实验验证了Controller即时选择、Strategy Adapter慢速适应和经验重用的贡献；跨5个不同基础模型均显示稳定增益。Token感知案例分析揭示了性能突破与无引导扩展的计算成本之间的不对称性。
AI.conclusion: OptiCom为LLM驱动的迭代优化提供了一个具有广泛适用性和高度可扩展性的通用范式，通过AQOEMS统一表示和状态条件化机制组合实现稳健的测试时扩展。其理论分解（机会-损失）为自适应优化设计提供了原则性指导，实验验证了该框架在多样化任务和基础模型上的优越性。

title: Asking for What Was Never Requested: Horizontal and Vertical Proactivity in Agents
comment: 48 pages. Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL Model: this https URL
summary: An agent that uses tools typically responds to what the user explicitly asks, yet completing the task may require information the user never requested. Work on proactive agents mainly studies whether and when an agent should act on its own, not what information it should pursue. We study a distinct axis of proactivity: its content. Horizontal proactivity pursues unstated information that the current context already identifies, and vertical proactivity pursues needs that only earlier evidence reveals. A need graph, recovered from a benchmark's own decomposition, records which needs depend on which, so both forms, and whether the agent stops at the right time, can be scored from a transcript without a model judge. To learn this behavior, we propose Q&D (questioner and drafter), which trains a questioner to prefer the question whose continuation retrieves more of the required evidence, with no reward model or judge. On held-out splits of three multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, at equal retrieval spend, the trained questioner improves both forms of proactivity over the same model, prompted, and outperforms a prompted model $15\times$ larger in the same role on two of the three, and the gain persists after controlling for question volume and length. Without further training, we place the questioner in an interactive customer-service agent with a simulated customer, where it completes more tasks while asking fewer questions, and in retail it outperforms the $15\times$ larger model with fewer follow-up turns from the customer. These results show that proactivity depends not only on whether an agent acts without being asked, but also on what it chooses to pursue and when it stops.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"主动性的内容维度"概念，将工具使用型智能体的主动信息寻求分为水平主动性（从当前上下文可识别的未陈述需求）和垂直主动性（只有早期证据才能揭示的需求），并提出Q&D（提问者-起草者）算法来训练提问者偏好那些后续能检索到更多所需证据的问题，无需奖励模型或评判模型。
AI.motivation: 现有主动智能体研究主要关注智能体是否以及何时应自主行动，而非应追求什么信息。本文区分了主动性的内容维度：水平主动性（从请求上下文可直接识别的未陈述需求）和垂直主动性（只有先前检索到的证据才能揭示的依赖需求），旨在使主动性可测量并可训练。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：(1) 需求图（need graph），从多跳问答基准的分解中机械恢复，记录任务所需的证据单元及其先决关系，用于无模型评判地评分运行轨迹和标注训练数据；(2) Q&D算法，将智能体分为提问者（决定问什么、何时停止）和冻结的起草者（维护草稿），训练时在某一状态分叉运行，对多个候选问题按后果排序（答案正确性、达到完整证据的步数、单步证据量），通过模仿学习、直接偏好优化和停止对比三阶段训练Qwen3-8B提问者。
AI.result: 在MuSiQue、StrategyQA和2WikiMultiHopQA三个多跳问答基准的保留测试集上，等检索开销条件下，训练的8B提问者在所需证据覆盖率上比同模型提示版本提升5.0-11.2个百分点，深度加权召回提升5.4-12.5个百分点；在两个基准上优于15倍大的GPT-OSS-120B提示模型。在τ²-bench的零售和航空客户服务场景中零样本迁移，零售任务完成率从13%/12%提升至34%/32%，比GPT-OSS-120B少1.6-1.8轮用户追问且成功率更高。
AI.conclusion: 主动性不仅取决于智能体是否被要求而行动，还取决于它选择追求什么以及何时停止。训练教会问什么比教会何时停止更容易；额外的证据尚未显著传导到最终答案（MuSiQue上预测约4.3点的提升，但仅观察到2.4点）。未来工作需要将证据增益带入答案的停止监督，以及前体必须在依赖项之前找到的更大检索池。

title: Foundations of Proactive Agents: Principles, Technical Layers, and Proactivity-Gym
summary: Proactive LLM agents can turn idle compute into useful support before users ask. Yet even correct work can misread user context, impose review costs, or undermine trust. This work proposes foundations for designing, realizing, and evaluating proactive LLM agents around three joint principles (3T): Task Capability, anticipating relevant needs and correctly performing useful work; Temporal Allocation, allocating compute according to resource availability and when results are needed; and Trust, sustaining users' confidence and appropriate reliance on the agent. We connect these objectives to a design space organized around five dimensions: task scope, anticipation horizon, activation trigger, processing timing, and intervention depth, and specify the situation and system modeling needed to support its choices, including user and environment representations, backbone LLMs, and agent harnesses. Lastly, we propose PROACTIVITY-GYM, a simulation-based evaluation testbed including multi-day scenarios, stateful environments, and persona-conditioned simulated users that can evaluate the consequences of proactive assistance across interactions. Evaluations across 23 model-harness configurations uncover substantial performance gaps across 3T and reveal that LLM judges often conflate task capability and trust. A human study with 30 participants demonstrates the importance of the joint 3T optimization: participants show sharp trust declines after intervention misalignment despite correct outcomes, and prefer sleep-time assistance, even when imperfect, to preserve ongoing focus. Together, these findings support designing and evaluating proactive agents through the joint consideration of useful work, compute allocation, and evolving user trust.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了面向主动式LLM代理的基础框架，围绕任务能力（Task Capability）、时间分配（Temporal Allocation）和信任（Trust）三大联合设计原则（3T），构建了一个包含五个设计维度的设计空间，并开发了基于模拟的评估测试平台Proactivity-Gym，用以评估主动式协助在多日交互中的后果。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM代理的研究与部署主要停留在反应式模式，即只有在用户发出明确请求时才执行任务，这限制了代理利用空闲算力为用户提供额外价值的能力。主动式协助虽然潜力巨大，但若时机不当或干预深度不匹配，反而会引入审阅负担、损害用户信任。本文认为仅追求任务能力是不够的，必须联合考虑任务执行、计算资源的时间分配以及用户信任的动态变化，才能真正实现有效的主动协助。
AI.method: 本文提出三大联合设计原则（3T）：任务能力（Task Capability，TC）关注准确识别需求并正确执行有用工作；时间分配（Temporal Allocation，TA）关注根据资源可用性与需求时序分配计算资源；信任（Trust，TR）关注维持用户信心与合理信任度。据此构建了五个设计维度——任务范围（task scope）、预期视野（anticipation horizon）、激活触发（activation trigger）、处理时机（processing timing）和干预深度（intervention depth）。同时开发了Proactivity-Gym评估测试平台，包含10个手写的多日场景（7-10天）、状态化工具环境和三种用户画像条件模拟器，使用基于规则和LLM评判（LLMaaJ）的TC、TA、TR-D和TR-J四项指标进行评估，并在23种模型-框架配置上进行了全面测试。此外，招募30名参与者进行人工研究。
AI.result: 评估显示，即使是最强的代理也存在显著的能力差距：Claude Opus 5在TC上最高仅得65.1分，但TA仅为51.7%、TR-D仅为52.4%，其他模型的TA均低于20%。TC与TA、TR-D的相关系数仅为0.31和0.34，但与TR-J的相关性高达0.70，说明LLM评判倾向于混淆任务能力与信任。30名参与者的人工研究表明：用户对干预深度不匹配的容忍度极低——即使任务结果正确，单次不匹配也会导致信任急剧下降（A→M下降1.86分，而M→A仅回升1.27分）；用户更倾向于接受睡眠时段的协助（即使需要次日修正，接受率达97.8%），而非打扰当前注意力的即时协助（仅26.7%）。研究还发现，用户对自主执行存在系统性低干预倾向，77.21%本应自主执行的任务最终未能成功执行。
AI.conclusion: 本文构建了主动式LLM代理设计与评估的基础框架，明确指出仅靠任务能力不足以衡量主动式协助的价值，必须联合优化任务执行、计算资源的时间分配和用户信任三个维度。当前主流代理在时间分配（尤其是延迟竞争任务）和干预深度对齐方面存在严重不足，且LLM评判与人类对信任的感知存在显著差距——LLM评判对不匹配较为宽容，而人类会因单次干预错位而显著降低信任。Proactivity-Gym作为一个模拟测试平台，揭示了现有系统的不足，并为未来主动式代理的设计与评估提供了实证基础和方法论指导。

title: Task-Relevant Null-Space Residuals for Non-Injective Neural Mappings
summary: Non-injective mappings in neural networks map distinct inputs to the same representation, thereby implicitly inducing equivalence relations in the input space. However, the input differences eliminated by these mappings may still be required by downstream tasks, creating a mismatch between operator-induced indistinguishability and task-required distinctions. For non-injective linear operators realized in the current forward pass, their null spaces exactly characterize these invisible input variations. We propose Task-Relevant Null-Space Residuals (NSR), a general residual framework for non-injective linear mappings. NSR combines null-space component extraction from pre-mapping representations, member-level encoding and gating, and application-specific integration to exploit potentially task-relevant information under downstream supervision while preserving the original aggregation or merging rules. We evaluate NSR in two structurally different settings: token merging and graph aggregation. In token merging, NSR achieves higher semantic segmentation performance than the corresponding compressed baselines in 34 out of 36 evaluated configurations, with a maximum observed gain of 31.51 mIoU points under strong compression. In graph aggregation, NSR achieves 100% training accuracy on Tree-NeighborsMatch at depths d=2--6 across three backbones, alongside gains on heterophilic node classification and molecular graph regression. Together, these results support null-space residuals as a practical complement to non-injective linear mappings, enabling downstream models to learn from input distinctions invisible in the original operator's output.

AI.tldr: 本文提出任务相关零空间残差（NSR）框架，针对非内射线性映射中算子诱导的输入等价性与下游任务所需区分度之间的不匹配问题，通过显式提取前映射表示的零空间分量并经任务监督的互补通路进行处理，同时保留原始聚合或合并规则。在 Token Merging（图聚集）两类结构不同的场景中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 非内射神经网络映射会将不同输入映射到同一表示，由此隐式引入输入空间的等价关系；但被映射消除的输入差异可能仍为下游任务所需，从而造成算子诱导的不可区分性与任务所需区分度之间的失配。对于当前前向传播中实现的非内射线性算子，其零空间恰好刻画了这些"不可见"的输入变化。作者希望在不改变原始映射规则的前提下，让模型获得一条额外通路来利用这些零空间中可能与任务相关的信息。
AI.method: NSR 框架包含三个核心组件：（1）零空间分量提取：基于当前线性算子 A，从前映射表示 X 中通过投影 Z=(I−UA)X 提取算子不可见的成员级残差，满足 AZ=0；（2）成员级编码与门控：对残差 z_i 通过编码器 E 和基于成员/上下文学习的门控 g_i 得到码 c_i=g_i⊙E(z_i)；（3）应用特定集成：在图聚集中，门控残差经 sum 聚合、LayerNorm、Dropout 和输出网络后加到骨干节点更新上；在 Token Merging 中，通过特征路径（用原始合并权重加权码并解码后加到合并表示）和空间路径（用记录的位置对应将码累积到原始 patch 位置，最后解码为位置特定更新）实现。两种图特殊选中的 lift U 分别取 t/(t⊤t)（图聚集，沿聚合系数方向）和 1_K（Token Merging，复制式 unmerging），均满足 AUA=A，使 P=I−UA 投影到 ker(A)。
AI.result: Token Merging：使用 DeiT-Tiny/16 在 Pascal VOC、Cityscapes、ADE20K 三个语义分割数据集上，结合 ToMe、PiToMe、MPM 三种合并方法，在 36 个评估配置中 NSR 在 34 个上获得更高 mIoU，ToMe 在 Pascal VOC 强压缩下最大提升 +31.51 mIoU（3.4×工作点）。图聚集上，NSR 在 Tree-NeighborsMatch 深度 d=2–6 上对 GCN、GIN、GraphSAGE 三个骨干均达到 100% 训练准确率；在 Roman-empire 等异质图节点分类上 15 个骨干-数据集组合中 13 个有提升，最大提升 +10.85 个百分点（GCN）；在 ZINC 子集上将 GCN 的测试 MAE 从 0.4732 降至 0.2947。零空间约束 AZ=0 的数值误差量级在 10^−6 以内，验证了实现的正确性。
AI.conclusion: NSR 是一种面向非内射线性映射的通用残差框架，通过显式暴露算子不可见的成员差异，使下游模型在保留原始聚合/合并规则的同时学习利用可能与任务相关的信息。实验覆盖图聚集和 Token Merging 两类结构不同的场景，证实其作为非内射映射实用补充手段的有效性，并支持"对于多对一神经计算，显式提供对算子不可见变化的访问具有实际价值"这一设计原则。

title: Transolver-$σ$: Joint Spectral-Physical Subspace Modeling for Neural PDE Solving
summary: Neural solvers offer efficient surrogates for numerical simulation of partial differential equations (PDEs). For time-dependent problems, strong one-step accuracy does not necessarily translate into reliable autoregressive rollout. We observe that a solver based only on physical-state modeling can achieve lower one-step error, whereas its spectral-only counterpart can become more accurate at later rollout steps. Motivated by this observation, we present Transolver-$\sigma$, a neural PDE solver based on joint spectral--physical subspace modeling. Within each block, adaptive physical-state interactions and spectral transformations are modeled in dedicated latent subspaces, whose responses are recomposed to enable information exchange between the two representations. Within the physical subspace, we introduce Slice-Residual Physics-Attention (SRPA), which preserves an explicit slice-space identity path while retaining learnable cross-slice interaction. In parallel, an axis-factorized Fourier operator captures global spectral structure. Across five well-established PDE benchmarks spanning steady-state prediction and time-dependent dynamics, Transolver-$\sigma$ achieves state-of-the-art with a benchmark-averaged relative error reduction of 33.4% over the strongest baseline for each metric, while consistently improving autoregressive rollout over single-operator counterparts. Transolver-$\sigma$ further delivers strong gains on coupled multiphysics systems and real-world fluid and combustion measurements from RealPDEBench, demonstrating its effectiveness beyond standard simulation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: Transolver-σ提出了一种联合谱-物理子空间建模的神经PDE求解器，通过在专用潜空间子空间中分别建模物理状态交互和谱变换，并利用SRPA（切片残差物理注意力）保留切片身份路径，在五个标准PDE基准上实现了33.4%的平均相对误差降低，同时改善了自回归滚动预测的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 时间依赖PDE的自回归求解面临"单步精度高但长程滚动不稳定"的问题。物理态建模单步误差低但后期误差累积，谱建模初期较差但后期更准确。论文旨在通过统一两种互补表征来同时提升单步精度和滚动鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1. 联合谱-物理子空间建模：每个block将特征分为物理和谱两个子空间，分别用SRPA（切片残差注意力）和轴分解傅里叶算子独立建模，再用全通道SwiGLU重新组合实现信息交换。2. SRPA：为切片状态增加显式恒等路径，将注意力响应作为可学习的缩放残差修正（Z+=Z+γΔZ），γ初始化为零。3. 轴分解谱算子：沿各空间轴独立做1D rFFT，降低参数复杂度。4. 理论分析：证明残差修正可保持切片间差异，并在受限矩阵模型中证明谱-物理互补性导致排序反转。
AI.result: 在五个标准PDE基准（Darcy、NS2D、Kolmogorov流、各向同性湍流、烟雾浮力）的全部八个指标上均达到SOTA，benchmark平均相对误差较最强基线降低33.4%；在RealPDEBench四个真实测量任务上以仅3.13M参数超越U-Net（23.08M），Foil RMSE降低53%；在REALM耦合多物理问题（IgnitHIT、EvolveJet）上也取得最优；自回归滚动平均误差比单一域基线降低35.6%-68.7%。
AI.conclusion: Transolver-σ通过保留物理态和谱表征在专用子空间中的专精，并通过重复重组实现信息交换，成功统一了局部精度与长程滚动鲁棒性。SRPA将切片注意力从有害的替换转变为有益的修正。理论分析（直径界、排序反转定理）为互补性和近似容差提供了条件保证。在标准基准、真实实验测量和耦合多物理系统上的广泛验证表明该方法的普适性。

title: AssayRouter: Historical Utility Priors for Frozen Molecular Predictor Routing
summary: Laboratories often face a new molecular assay with 16-64 labels and a bank of predictors whose training data and parameters are unavailable. The practical question is which frozen outputs to include in a small local model. AssayRouter treats completed assays as pseudo-targets and labels each candidate by its post-fit utility: the reduction in held-out discovery loss when the candidate is added to the local target predictor. A shared regressor learns to predict this utility from candidate behavior on the support set, without source identity; on a new assay, one frozen ranking selects four sources and separate labels fit a convex combiner. We train only on completed ChEMBL-MT assays and evaluate 24 external regression assays across six frozen interface families. AssayRouter-C lowers strict four-call negative log-likelihood (NLL) by 0.0409 relative to Support-CV@4. Frozen candidate-label permutations confirm that candidate-utility correspondence carries the transferred information, and leave-one-interface-out training shows that the mapping generalizes to unseen predictor families. Completed assays therefore provide transferable supervision for scarce-label routing through frozen prediction interfaces.

AI.tldr: AssayRouter提出了一种从已完成实验（ChEMBL-MT）中学习"后拟合效用"（post-fit utility）先验的方法，用于在标签稀缺（16–64个）的新分子检测中选择冻结（frozen）预测源。通过将已完成实验作为伪目标，测量每个候选源在加入局部目标预测器后减少的发现损失（discovery loss），训练一个不依赖源身份的共享HGB回归器来预测该效用。部署时，对新检测一次性冻结Top-4源选择，然后在独立的拟合集上训练凸组合权重。在24个外部回归检测、6种冻结接口家族上的评估显示：AssayRouter-C相比Support-CV@4在严格四次调用NLL上降低0.0409；候选-效用置换和留一接口训练验证了迁移性。
AI.motivation: 药物发现中常遇到仅有少量标签的新分子检测，而已有大量训练好的预测器但无法访问其参数或训练数据。关键问题是：从这些"冻结"的预测输出中，应该选择哪些进入局部模型？源在孤立评估中可能准确，但在与局部模型组合后可能冗余；反之，较弱的源可能修正关键残差。因此需要的是"组合后的增量价值"而非独立的源强度。
AI.method: 1. 在20个ChEMBL-MT历史伪目标上，对每个候选源测量"后拟合效用"U_e(s)=Δ_e(s|∅)：将源加入局部Ridge目标预测器后，在独立发现集Q_disc上Student-t损失(ν=3)的减少量。2. 候选特征ψ_e(s;R_e)为11维：残差对齐、残差相关性、源均值/标准差、不确定性、SNR、训练规模等。3. 训练一个HGB回归器q_θ(ψ,ι)→U^C(s)（块内中心化），不使用源或检测身份特征，按接口家族条件化。4. 部署时：在路由支持集R_t上对每个候选计算ψ，用冻结路由器一次性选Top-4源A_t，然后在独立的拟合集C_t上训练归一化NNLS权重。5. 严格评估（strict）：每个四次调用组分独立评分后再平均，避免预测平均带来的搜索放大。
AI.result: 1. AssayRouter-C在严格四次调用NLL上比Support-CV@4降低0.0409（95% CI [0.0211, 0.0623]），在77.8%的目标-接口单元上更优，16标签时优势最大。2. 候选-效用置换：严格评分下NLL增加0.1352（[0.0852, 0.1915]），90.7%的细胞支持真实映射。3. 留一接口训练：Permuted增加NLL 0.0497（[0.0135, 0.0963]），所有6个未见接口家族均正向。4. 残差兼容性（NLL 2.2947）vs AssayRouter-C（2.1102）：差距0.1844，说明后拟合价值包含残差相关性无法捕获的信息。5. 摊销选择成本：Support-CV@4需20,445,696次目标端NNLS拟合，AssayRouter需0次。6. 删除任一目标/接口/集合后所有结论方向不变（p=0.03125符号翻转检验）。7. TDC化合物亲本去重叠敏感性与原始结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 已完成实验提供的后拟合候选效用可作为可迁移的监督信号，用于在标签稀缺时通过冻结预测接口进行路由选择。该效用-候选对应关系可跨外部检测、预测器家族和化合物亲本进行迁移。AssayRouter将目标端子集搜索摊销为对每个源的一次冻结评分，同时改进严格路由决策。更大的评估启示是：代理指标（如效用预测MSE）的改进只有在改变Top-K边界并影响组合权重时才转化为部署决策的提升，因此路由器选择应在精确的信息和调用预算下验证部署决策，而非仅依赖代理精度。范围限于连续回归、均质接口库、固定四源动作和20个历史伪目标。

title: MetaCtrl: Your Large Language Models Can Reason Better and More Concisely with a Metacognitive Controller
summary: Large reasoning models improve performance on challenging problems by allocating additional computation before answering, but longer reasoning does not always lead to better results and can introduce substantial redundant reasoning on simple problems. Conversely, aggressively shortening reasoning can degrade performance on difficult ones. Effective reasoning therefore requires dynamically deciding when additional computation is useful based on the reasoner's capabilities and evolving solution state. Existing approaches often rely on predefined budgets or intervention rules, retrain the target reasoner, or require additional supervision. We introduce MetaCtrl, a lightweight controller that adaptively regulates a frozen reasoner without predefined token budgets or reasoner retraining. We formulate reasoning regulation as a sequential metacognitive control problem: MetaCtrl observes the evolving reasoning trace and decides whether to continue, simplify, skip redundant steps, or conclude reasoning. It is trained directly with reinforcement learning using a reward that prioritizes correctness while favoring shorter trajectories among correct solutions, requiring neither supervised intervention trajectories nor problem-specific budgets. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and code, MetaCtrl consistently improves the accuracy of LRMs while reducing their reasoning length. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, it improves average accuracy by 4.7 points while reducing generation length by 53.3%. Without further training, the same controller transfers to an unseen reasoner (e.g., Qwen3-14B), improving average accuracy by 2.9 points and reducing generation length by 50.3%. These results establish MetaCtrl as a plug-and-play controller for improving reasoning accuracy while substantially reducing inference-time generation. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MetaCtrl——一个轻量级的元认知控制器，通过强化学习(GRPO)在不修改或重训冻结的推理大模型的前提下，动态调节其推理轨迹长度，在七个数学、科学、代码基准上同时提升准确率并大幅缩短生成长度，且无需预定义token预算或监督干预数据。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型(LRMs)存在"过度思考"和"思考不足"的问题：简单问题上的冗余推理浪费计算，困难问题上的过早截断则损害准确率。现有方法依赖预定义token预算、对推理器进行重训，或依赖置信度等手工规则，无法基于推理器能力和推理轨迹的动态演化来实时分配计算资源。本文受认知科学中元认知（Nelson–Narens框架）启发，将推理调控视为资源理性的序贯元认知控制问题。
AI.method: MetaCtrl 由一个基于 Qwen3-4B 初始化的控制器组成，在段落边界（".\n\n" 等）介入冻结的推理器。动作空间为四个离散干预动作：Continue（不干预）、Fast Think（提示简洁推导）、Skip Think（跳过冗余中间步）、Stop Think（提示收尾作答）。训练使用 GRPO，目标函数为"正确性门控的效率奖励"：正确轨迹得到基础奖励并叠加相对效率加成，错误轨迹获得固定负奖励，效率优化仅在正确轨迹间进行。无需监督干预轨迹或预算标签。
AI.result: 在 MATH-500、AIME 2024、OmniMath、OlympiadBench、AMC、GPQA Diamond、LiveCodeBench 七个基准上：(1) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B（已见）平均准确率提升 4.7 点，生成长度减少 47.3%；(2) Qwen3-14B（未见）平均准确率提升 2.9 点，生成长度减少 50.3%；(3) 在数学、科学、代码三个领域平均减少 47.3%、58.2%、72.1% 生成 token；(4) 端到端推理延迟降低 42.6%–70.8%（双 GPU）或 49.5%–73.3%（共享 GPU）；(5) 4B 参数的 MetaCtrl 在平均准确率上以 7.6 个百分点优于 552B 参数的 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 作为控制器；(6) 可零样本迁移到 Qwen3-8B/14B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 等不同架构推理器。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，将元认知控制从问题求解中解耦是一种有效且可迁移的高效推理机制：只需训练一次轻量级控制器即可在不重训的前提下提升多种不同规模、不同架构推理 LRM 的准确率–效率权衡。未来工作方向是将 MetaCtrl 扩展到多推理器协同系统，实现跨模型与轨迹内两级计算分配。

title: ReMem: Rethinking Perception and Memory in Long-Context Recommendation Agents
summary: Recent Recommendation Agents (RecAgents) offer a promising alternative by shifting recommendation to an active, user-side paradigm, where generative agents autonomously perceive external platforms, reason over user preferences, and execute decisions. However, existing RecAgents still suffer from two critical limitations: brittle item perception based on noisy and heterogeneous item pages, and inefficient long-context reasoning over extended user histories and multi-step interaction traces. To address these challenges, we propose a novel recommendation agent framework, termed as ReMem, that combines OCR-based multimodal perception with time-evolving dynamic memory.
