We present EngiWorld, the first benchmark structured around the complete design loop: 1,301 expert-curated tasks spanning 6 engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and 3D visualization) and 26 professional software platforms, with both GUI and CLI interfaces and 6 task types ranging from software-selection to open-ended tasks. We further introduce an artifact-centric evaluation methodology built on a unified domain-verifier suite, which programmatically checks the geometric validity, physical feasibility, and rule compliance of final and intermediate artifacts, and scores quantitative design tasks continuously by specification attainment rather than binary success. Evaluation of seven frontier models reveals a substantial capability gap: the strongest model achieves an EngiScore of only 44.3, and just 3.6% of multi-software attempts succeed. EngiWorld provides the first rigorous foundation for measuring progress toward agents that operate professional engineering software end to end.

AI.tldr: EngiWorld是首个面向专业工业工程软件（CAD/CAE/CAM/BIM/EDA/3D可视化）的完整设计环路基准测试，涵盖1,301个专家策展任务、26个软件平台，评估七个前沿模型后发现能力差距显著，最强模型EngiScore仅为44.3，多软件任务成功率仅3.6%。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM/MLLM智能体在通用计算机使用任务上取得快速进展，但专业工业工程软件（如CAD、CAE等）的可靠自动化仍未实现。现有基准存在三大局限：(1) 成功判定仅对比最终状态或参考解，无法验证工程制品的功能完整性；(2) 缺乏足够的交互深度，无法维持参数化逻辑和长操作序列；(3) 存在反馈鸿沟，智能体仅接收文本信号而非工程师依赖的原生领域反馈（渲染输出、仿真收敛曲线等）。论文旨在填补通用智能与专业工程需求之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 构建EngiWorld基准，包含：(1) 1,301个专家策展任务，覆盖6个工程领域和26个软件平台（37种环境配置），通过CLI/GUI接口交互；(2) 6种任务类型（单软件、多软件、软件选择、定量设计、图像建模、开放式任务）；(3) 基于制品的评估方法论，通过统一领域验证器套件编程化检查几何有效性、物理可行性和规则合规性，定量设计任务按规格达成度连续评分而非二元成功。评估7个前沿模型（GPT-5.6-Sol、Claude Opus 5、Kimi K3、Gemini 3.7 Flash、Qwen 3.8 Max/Flash、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash）在300个分层采样任务上的表现。
AI.result: Claude Opus 5以44.3 EngiScore领先，GPT-5.6-Sol为38.0；所有模型在300个任务中有128个全部得零分。多软件任务仅3.6%成功率（168次尝试中仅6次成功）。能力差距在跨应用依赖协调、精确几何/物理约束满足、交付前验证等环节均显著。失败模式分两大类：(1) 声明完成但制品未通过验证器（GPT占87%，Claude占73.9%）；(2) 决策回合耗尽（占GUI失败55.3%，CLI失败36.6%）。消融实验表明视觉信息呈现方式、运行时图像访问、无障碍信息、截图分辨率和交互历史长度对不同模型有不同影响，视觉反馈并不自动转化为更好的工程决策。开放式任务vs多软件任务的对比表明：减少工作流约束可提高成功率（任务09有4个模型在开放式版本上成功但多软件版本全部失败）。
AI.conclusion: EngiWorld揭示了通用智能与专业工程需求之间的根本差距：当前智能体可操作单个工具但无法可靠执行跨阶段工程工作流。基准为构建能闭合工程设计环路（而非仅操作单个工具）的工业智能体提供了严格的基础。定量评分机制有效区分有效制品之间的质量差异，但验证门控阻止几何缺陷制品获得分数。视觉信息、无障碍元数据等额外结构化观察并不自动改善工程决策，使用价值取决于智能体如何将其整合到执行策略中。

title: WISE-ATTA: When to Ask for Labels in Budgeted Active Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Active test-time adaptation (ATTA) improves robustness under distribution shift by updating a deployed model during inference while selectively querying supervision. However, most existing ATTA methods implicitly assume that supervision can be requested for every incoming test batch, which can incur substantial annotation cost over long test streams. In this work, we introduce \emph{budgeted ATTA} in which labels are available for only a fraction of test batches. This formulation shifts the central challenge from deciding \emph{what} to label within a batch to deciding \emph{when} supervision should be applied over time. To address this challenge, we propose a budget-aware approach \emph{WISE-ATTA} that allocates supervision over the test stream based on lightweight signals computed online, prioritizing periods where supervision is likely to be most useful. When a batch is selected for supervision, we further employ a drift-based sample selection criterion that targets samples exhibiting ongoing, unconverged adaptation dynamics, enabling effective updates from a single labeled example. We evaluate this approach on synthetic corruptions (ImageNet-C) and natural distribution shifts (ImageNet-R/K/A). Across settings, WISE-ATTA achieves competitive or improved performance compared to recent ATTA methods while requiring substantially fewer labels. Overall, we find that the timing of supervision is a key, yet underexplored, aspect of active test-time adaptation. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WISE-ATTA 方法，将主动测试时适应（ATTA）问题重新定义为"预算化"场景，关注在整个测试流中"何时"请求监督（而非仅在每个 batch 内"选什么样本"标注）。该方法通过基于熵的 batch 效用分数与自适应分位数阈值在时间维度上分配标注预算，并在被选中的 batch 内通过预测漂移（相对于 EMA anchor）选取单一最有益样本。在 ImageNet-C/R/K/A 上使用更少标签取得了与或超过现有 ATTA 方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 ATTA 方法隐含假设每个测试 batch 都能请求监督，专注于"每个 batch 内选哪些样本"标注。但在长测试流中，每个 batch 的监督价值差异很大，且总标注成本随流长度线性增长。本文关注一个被忽视的问题：在有限标注预算下，"何时"在整个测试流上分配监督同样关键。
AI.method: WISE-ATTA 包含两个组件：(1) **Budget-paced batch 选择**：使用 batch 内低熵预测数量作为 batch 效用代理信号，维护最近 W 个 batch 效用分数的滑动窗口，通过自适应分位数阈值和基于"预算债务"的 pacing 控制器（无需知道流长度）在时间维度上分配标签；(2) **Drift-based 样本选择**：维护 EMA anchor 模型，对被选中的 batch 选择当前模型与 anchor 预测差异最大的单个样本（即处于"持续适应中但尚未收敛"的样本）。仅更新归一化参数（无监督时）与分类器头（有监督时）。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-C（CTTA 和 FTTA 协议）以及 ImageNet-R/K/A 自然分布偏移上，WISE-ATTA 在 RN50-BN 和 ViT-B-16 上均取得最佳平均错误率，且在多数情况下标签使用量比基线少 50%（≤0.5 labels/batch）。在 r=0.5 固定预算下，相比 EATTA 提升约 1.0–1.3 点；W=250 历史窗口、M=1 warmup、δ=1 slack 设置下鲁棒。低预算下（r=0.2）增益最显著（ImageNet-R 上提升 4.12 点），标签倾向于在前 10–40% 流段集中分配。对标注延迟敏感：延迟增大时所有 ATTA 方法均退化。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，监督的"时机"（when）是主动测试时适应中一个关键但被忽视的维度。WISE-ATTA 通过时间维度的预算分配与漂移驱动的样本选择，在显著减少标注的同时实现了竞争性或更优的鲁棒性。未来工作应关注延迟感知扩展、异构 batch 内的多源偏移，以及更新本身的预算化。

title: Locating Answer-Correctness Signals in Frozen Large Language Models
summary: Language models expose internal signals that predict whether an answer is correct, readable from a single forward pass of a frozen model without additional generations. Yet existing probes often commit to one signal family or layer and can be brittle under distribution shift; in retrieval-augmented settings, many specialized detectors instead target passage faithfulness, which can diverge from correctness when retrieved evidence is unhelpful or conflicting. We therefore ask where answer correctness is readable, which internal signal families carry it, and how they should be combined. We search over hidden states, token probabilities, residual-stream features, attention, and their fusion, treating the selected readouts as a predictive measurement rather than a mechanistic localization. We run this analysis separately in closed-book and with-context settings, since context can change which readouts are informative. A consistent anatomy emerges: correctness concentrates in the answer span, recovered from the answer tokens even under retrieval, and the families carry it complementarily, so fusing them helps most out of distribution, where a single signal is weakest. The protocol is effective across two backbones and gates a retrieval controller as one downstream use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BEATRICE方法，从冻结大语言模型的单次前向传播中提取四类内部信号（隐藏状态、token概率、残差流分量、注意力分布）来检测答案正确性。研究发现隐藏状态信号最强但其他三类信号具有互补性，多信号融合在分布外场景提升最显著。该方法在两个骨干网络上验证有效，并被用作下游检索控制器PGIR。
AI.motivation: 现有正确性检测探针通常依赖单一信号家族或单一层，在分布偏移下表现脆弱；检索增强场景下的专用检测器多针对段落忠实性而非答案正确性，二者在检索证据无效时可能分歧。需要系统研究答案正确性信号在模型内部的位置、信号家族及其组合方式。
AI.method: BEATRICE从冻结LLM单次前向传播提取四类token级特征：(1)单层隐藏状态（验证集选层17）；(2)下一token分布的五维标量统计；(3)各层attn/FFN贡献的L2范数与logit-lens推力；(4)跨段注意力的熵与质量。构建15个组合编码器（4类信号的非空子集），用token级CNN分别编码context/question/answer三段，再以MLP融合。训练一个融合头通过贪心前向选择在验证集AUROC上筛选编码器子集。在with-context设置下，候选池额外包含closed-book编码器。最终将检测器接入PGIR控制器，分别用closed-book探针决定是否触发检索、with-context探针决定是否信任检索结果。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-9B上的六个开放域QA数据集（三个域内多跳，三个零样本单跳），BEATRICE在几乎所有列上以单次前向传播领先23个基线：closed-book域内测试AUROC 0.839，with-context域内测试0.932；零样本PopQA在with-context下达0.948。配对bootstrap显示所有with-context列和域内closed-book列的领先显著。消融实验揭示：(1)单信号中hidden states最强，但其余三类各自恢复其1/3到1/2的错误，且无两两冗余；(3)三信号（隐状态+残差+注意力）优于四信号全融合；(3)正确性信号集中在answer span，去掉answer token损失约0.02 AUROC；(4)with-context下保留一个closed-book编码器能稳定提升。附录G的家族消融显示，辅助家族仅在主编码器边界附近翻转决策，扮演窄范围纠错角色。注意力家族对字面支持敏感，其可靠性取决于检索质量（在NQ上当45.1%错误答案被逐字抄入段落时下降）。附录H用真实E5检索重复实验，Qwen 0.891、Gemma 0.911均领先。在Gemma 4上BEATRICE同样领先，PGIR以平均EM 0.319、F1 0.397和约4.3次生成/问题位居宏平均第一。
AI.conclusion: 四类内部信号呈一致的"解剖结构"：一个家族主导、其余互补，正确性信号集中在answer span，closed-book与with-context共享这一结构但细节不同。多信号融合的收益在分布外最大，正是单信号最脆弱之处。该读出可在不重训的前提下零样本迁移，并直接驱动检索控制器。结论强调应将"读出"视为对基础模型的预测性测量——知道哪些家族承载证据、证据集中于何处、何时融合能带来增益——而非单一的探针分数，这使探针设计从对编码器的试错转向对模型的测量，并可随模型更新重复进行。

title: Generative Interactions: Weaving Multiparty Human Motion with Bilevel Latent Dynamics
summary: Human social behaviour is not a collection of independent motions, but a jointly organised process in which group dynamics and individual variation continuously shape one another. Yet existing social motion models often prioritise plausible trajectories while leaving interaction state implicit, limiting their ability to transfer across groups, tasks, and partial-observation regimes. To address this gap, we introduce Bilevel Representations for Agent Interaction Dynamics (BRAID), a hierarchical sequential latent-variable model for generative multi-person interaction. BRAID explicitly formulates social motion generation as a meta-transfer learning problem: shared interaction priors are learned across datasets and adapted through arbitrary context sets of observed people and joints. The model represents each scene through a group-level latent state that captures shared interaction dynamics and person-level latent states that capture individual behaviour conditioned on the evolving group context. This modelling choice enables coherent generation under full, sparse, or partial observations while exposing compact social-state vectors that can serve as an interface for downstream embodied-agent systems. We evaluate BRAID under a unified SMPL-based representation on social forecasting, tracking and in-filling, and response generation, using metrics that assess not only reconstruction accuracy but also realism, diversity, temporal alignment, and interpersonal coordination. We further analyse the hierarchical latent space, showing that it captures separable group- and individual-level structure.

AI.tldr: BRAID提出了一种用于多人社交运动建模的层次化序列潜变量模型，通过群体级与个体级双层潜变量显式捕捉共享交互动态与个体行为变化，在完整、稀疏或部分观测条件下实现统一的社交运动预测、补全与生成。
AI.motivation: 现有社交运动模型侧重轨迹合理性而忽略交互状态，难以跨群体、跨任务、跨观测设置迁移，缺少可复用的群体与个体联合结构化表征。
AI.method: 将多人社交运动生成建模为元迁移学习问题，引入双层潜变量：群体潜变量 z^g 编码共享交互动态，个体潜变量 z^p 在群体上下文下编码个体行为；采用精度加权的后验融合（自下而上证据与自上而下的先验）处理变分推断，并通过联合 ELBO + 重建损失训练；使用冻结预训练时序运动 VAE 解码身体姿态。
AI.result: 在 Panoptic Haggling、DnD、DD100、DuoBox、Embody3D 等数据集上，BRAID 在社交预测、补全、缺失关节/伙伴重建等任务上于 SDTW、跨个体 SDTW、FD 等指标上一致优于 MAGNet、RoHM、Social Processes、SNP 等基线，并展现出显式的群体活动结构与跨群体的个体身份可识别性（top-1 重识别准确率 41.4%）。
AI.conclusion: BRAID 通过统一的关节级上下文接口支持完整/稀疏/缺失观测与未来预测；其群体与个体潜变量提供可解释、可复用的社交状态表征，可作为具身智能体系统的紧凑信念接口，但也存在层次潜变量未完全解耦、多样性与长时序精度之间的权衡等局限。

title: Context Language Models
summary: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. Building CLMs zero-shot with existing models outperforms SOTA context management strategies across a variety of tasks: 11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOPs on BrowseComp-Plus, 5% higher scores with 59% fewer FLOPs on 12-hour EdgeBench, and 65% greater improvement with the same compute on a 24-hour multi-repository agent-swarm task. Moreover, by shifting context management from external harness control to intrinsic model behavior, CLMs naturally enable both in-context and parametric learning of context-management strategies. We show that CLMs can be steered with natural-language instructions evolved through a standard skill-optimization loop, improving held-out accuracy by up to 35.9 points on a context-management task while reducing compute. We also introduce an online reinforcement learning method for CLMs, improving Qwen3.5-9B performance on BrowseComp-Plus by 47.6% while using 12% fewer FLOPs. Finally, we co-design Suffix Cache Reuse for CLM serving, further reducing server-side compute by 35% relative to standard SGLang at matched performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Context Language Models (CLMs)，将语言模型的上下文视为可任意编辑的文件，使模型本身而非外部harness负责上下文管理。CLMs在长时程任务上以更少算力超越现有SOTA策略；可通过in-context技能演化与基于GRPO的成功门控效率优势的强化学习进一步优化；并提出Suffix Cache Reuse以减少CLM服务中的重prefill开销。
AI.motivation: 传统语言模型的上下文管理依赖外部harness的固定策略（compaction、offloading、retrieval），缺乏自适应能力。Sutton"苦涩的教训"启示我们应让LM自主搜索和学习超越人类先验的策略。现有action-based方法虽增加模型自主性，但仍受限于harness预定义的有限动作集。
AI.method: 1) 将context视为可编辑文件，LM通过Bash命令自由编辑上下文文件，每次修改自动同步到下一次调用的live context；2) 形式化定义CLM转换方程c_{t+1}=f_θ^CLM(c_t)取代标准LM的追加操作；3) 引入prefix-reuse FLOPs度量指标及Suffix Cache Reuse (SCR)服务优化；4) 提出ContextBench诊断基准解耦上下文管理与推理能力；5) 上下文内：通过自然语言指令引导或文本演化循环优化技能文档；6) 训练：采用stepwise GRPO并引入success-gated efficiency advantage奖励高效的成功轨迹。
AI.result: 零样本CLM（Qwen3.6-27B/GPT5.6-Sol）在多个长时程任务上优于SOTA：BrowseComp-Plus上准确率提升11.4%、FLOPs减少21.5%；12小时EdgeBench上得分提升5%、FLOPs减少59%；24小时多仓库agent-swarm任务上端到端加速提升65%。数学优化任务上CLM全面超越OpenEvolve等专用进化流程。技能演化在ContextBench上将保留测试准确率最多提升35.9点。Qwen3.5-9B经RL训练后在BrowseComp-Plus上从28.8%提升至42.5%（+47.6%），FLOPs减少12%。SCR相比标准SGLang服务端算力减少35%。
AI.conclusion: 将上下文管理从外部harness控制转为模型内在行为是有效的：CLMs在零样本、in-context学习及RL训练下均取得显著性能提升与计算效率改善，涌现出多代理编排记分板、内部笔记角色、可复用压缩函数等创新行为。然而模型可编辑上下文也带来新的安全风险（如prompt injection通过上下文持续存在），需未来工作研究防御机制。

title: Spatiotemporal Hyperedges for EEG Seizure Detection and Prediction
summary: Seizure detection and prediction from EEG are clinically important but challenging because seizures are rare, temporally localized, and propagate as coordinated events across multiple channels. Recent dynamic graph neural networks model this by running a temporal model over a sequence of per-time-step pairwise channel edges. However, this pairwise construction misses the spatiotemporal coupling that constitutes a seizure, at substantial training cost. We propose HyBrain, which summarizes spatiotemporal EEG evidence through a small set of soft hyperedges rather than pairwise edges. A per-channel Mamba backbone produces one token per (channel, second), and a spatiotemporal hyperedge block pools these tokens into E_h shared group embeddings through soft memberships and broadcasts them back. The same encoder serves three downstream tasks: window-based detection, one-second point-wise detection, and preictal seizure prediction. On TUSZ and CHB-MIT, HyBrain achieves the best AUROC on every reported setting against ten baselines, with the largest gap on long-clip preictal prediction. It also matches the most efficient baselines in training time and peak GPU memory. A qualitative analysis shows that even a single learned hyperedge cleanly captures the preictal -> ictal -> postictal trajectory on a real seizure clip.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyBrain，一种基于时空超边的EEG癫痫检测与预测模型。通过少量软超边替代逐时间步的两两通道边建模，实现高效的多通道时空耦合捕捉。在TUSZ和CHB-MIT数据集的三个任务（窗口检测、逐秒检测、发作前预测）上均取得SOTA的AUROC，同时显著降低计算和内存开销。
AI.motivation: 现有动态图神经网络将癫痫建模为逐时间步的两两通道边序列，但这种成对构造：（1）无法直接建模跨时间-跨通道耦合（如某通道在某一时刻影响另一通道的稍后时刻）；（2）将多通道癫痫事件分解为大量双边边轨迹，训练代价高昂。需要一种能够直接建模高阶时空耦合且计算高效的替代方案。
AI.method:
1. **输入表示**：每通道STFT提取1秒频谱特征，得到(channel, second) token。  
2. **逐通道Mamba骨干**：对每个通道独立用选择性状态空间模型编码时间动态，保留时间轴。  
3. **时空超边聚合块**（核心创新）：  
   - 学习少量$E_h$个超边查询$q_k$与token的sigmoid软隶属度$\alpha_{i,k}$（支持多超边重叠）  
   - 聚合：$z_k = \sum_i \alpha_{i,k}\tilde{h}_i / \sum_i \alpha_{i,k}$  
   - 广播：$\tilde{h}'_i = \sum_k \alpha_{i,k} z_k$  
   - 残差融合局部+全局信息  
4. **时间注意力层**精炼长程依赖，输出共享表示$G$。  
5. **任务特定头部**：PMA风格读出，分别支持窗口级预测和逐秒预测（后者加logit平滑正则）。  
**理论保证**：超边块等价于全局token间的一个秩至多$E_h$的混合算子$AD^{-1}A^\top$，在sigmoid下具有全局支撑（任意两token间$M_{ij}>0$）。相比GRU/Mamba边流，激活内存降低约$\mathcal{O}(Nd/E_h)$倍。
AI.result:
**窗口级检测**（Table 2）：HyBrain在TUSZ 12s (0.899)、TUSZ 60s ($E_h=3$: 0.908)、CHB-MIT 12s ($E_h=1$: 0.917) 三项AUROC均为最佳。  
**逐秒检测**（Table 3）：加平滑正则($\lambda=0.3$)后，TUSZ 12s/60s和CHB-MIT 12s AUROC分别达0.926/0.938/0.929，均为SOTA。  
**发作前预测**（Table 4）：TUSZ 60s上AUROC 0.758 (vs.最强基线EvolveGCN 0.697)，提升显著。  
**学习效率**：训练时间29-30秒/epoch（与GRU-GCN相当，比EvoBrain快2×），峰值显存332MB（比GRU-GCN/EvoBrain低约12-14×），推理延迟降低达95.5%。  
**消融**：移除超边块导致AUROC下降1.1-4.2pt、F1下降5.1-9.2pt，60s设置上损失更大。  
**超边数敏感性**：$E_h \in \{1,3,5,7,9\}$范围内AUROC稳定在[0.868, 0.908]，单个超边即可捕捉preictal→ictal→postictal的三阶段轨迹。
AI.conclusion: HyBrain以少量可学习的时空超边替代逐时间步的两两动态图，在三个EEG癫痫任务上均达到SOTA，尤其在长片段发作前预测任务上提升最明显。相比边流动态GNN基线，峰值GPU内存降低一个数量级，且训练/推理速度显著提升。理论分析表明，超边块提供了秩至多$E_h$的全局token混合能力；实证显示即使$E_h=1$的单超边也能清晰刻画发作前-发作期-发作后消失的相位判别签名。这表明紧凑的时空超边表达可在远低于边流动态GNN的计算成本下匹配或超越其癫痫建模能力。

title: ContextRender: From Execution Dependencies to Agent Context
summary: LLM agents performing long-horizon tasks accumulate tool results that later steps may need. Passing the full history to every invocation is costly even when it fits within the context window, while reducing it risks omitting needed information. Existing context management methods can overlook how earlier tool results are used in subsequent execution, leaving needed information out of context. We introduce ContextRender, which manages context through a persistent graph of execution dependencies. We develop Tool-Flow Analysis to track how later operations reuse information from earlier tool results, providing a signal called observed reuse. A renderer combines this signal with recency and semantic relevance to select results within a fixed history budget, retaining omitted results for later use. Across AppWorld and 8-objective QA with three execution models, ContextRender outperforms the evaluated context management baselines using a 6K history budget, well below the models' maximum context windows. Within this budget, it achieves task performance close to or above that of passing the full history while reducing mean inference cost by 10.2%-32.2% relative to Full history. Ablations show that observed reuse improves task performance and retention of results reused later.

AI.tldr: ContextRender是一个LLM智能体上下文管理系统，通过持久化执行依赖图谱跟踪工具结果的复用关系，结合"观测复用"、时效性和语义相关性在固定历史预算内选择保留哪些历史工具结果，从而在远低于模型最大上下文窗口的预算下达到接近或超过全历史传递的任务性能，同时显著降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体执行长时任务时积累大量工具结果，全部传入每次调用成本高昂；现有基于时效性或语义相似度的上下文管理方法会遗漏那些被后续操作反复引用、但与当前步骤表面相关性不高的早期工具结果，导致关键信息丢失。
AI.method: 三个核心组件：(1) 持久化上下文图存储消息、工具调用和完整工具结果；(2) 工具流分析(TFA)通过精确大小写匹配追踪后续操作对早期工具结果中值的复用，生成"观测复用"信号；(3) 渲染器将观测复用与时效性衰减、语义相关性结合，计算有用性评分并在固定token预算内贪心选择完整工具结果，未选中结果保留在图中供后续调用复用。
AI.result: 在AppWorld和8-objective QA基准上使用GPT-4.1、Muse Glimmer 30B和DeepSeek V4 Pro三种模型评估，6K历史预算下ContextRender在所有九个设置中均优于五种上下文管理基线（Prune、Compact LLM、Recency+Summary、Semantic Retrieval、ACON），任务性能提升3.3%-32.5%，平均推理成本相比Full history降低10.2%-32.2%且在多数对比中成本更低；消融实验显示添加观测复用使AppWorld TGC提升4.1%、QA F1提升4.5%，长期未复用结果的召回率约为仅用时效性+相关性的3倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过将上下文管理从基于交互列表的启发式方法转变为基于执行依赖图谱的追踪方法，能够更准确地识别哪些历史工具结果对后续步骤仍然重要；观测复用信号是对时效性和语义相关性的有效补充，尤其对长间隔后被复用的旧结果具有显著召回优势，证明了执行依赖信息对智能体上下文选择的价值。

title: Cross-Entropy Guided Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) large language models scale model capacity by routing each token to a small subset of experts. Their routers are regularized with load balancing terms and learn affinity scores through the language-model objective. However, these objectives do not provide direct alignment between routing affinities and token-level error. We introduce token-error supervision for sparse routing in two forms. The first form predicts an error score per expert. The affinity-weighted aggregate of these scores is aligned to the next-token cross-entropy loss, while the individual scores attenuate affinity before top-$K$ selection. The second directly aligns the router's affinities to the model's objective without requiring an additional head or inference-time modification. Both formulations use the Itakura--Saito divergence or an exponential negative log-likelihood for aligning affinities and token errors. Across two sparse MoE backbones and four multiple-choice question-answering benchmarks, we evaluate both supervision mechanisms. On Granite, our method improves accuracy by approximately 2.3 percentage points on average over a parameter-matched routing baseline. With stronger supervision, the gain on ARC-Challenge reaches 2.94 points. Both mechanisms preserve the native sparse execution budget and aggregation policy. Our code is available in the supplementary materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种稀疏MoE路由的token级误差监督机制：TES（带误差预测头的affinity衰减）和ACS（无head的affinity浓度监督），均使用Itakura-Saito散度或ENLL对齐路由器亲和度与token级交叉熵损失，在Granite和OLMoE上MCQA任务取得稳定精度提升。
AI.motivation: 标准稀疏MoE路由器仅通过语言模型目标和负载均衡正则项间接学习专家亲和度，缺少路由亲和度与token级预测误差之间的直接对齐信号，无法判断所选计算路径是否会产生高/低误差预测。
AI.method: 提出TES：训练轻量级per-expert误差预测头，将误差得分经affinity加权聚合后用IS散度或ENLL对齐next-token CE，并在top-K选择前用started-log衰减affinity。提出ACS：无head方案，直接将归一化选中affinity的平方浓度C_t作为监督目标，同样使用IS或ENLL对齐token损失，保持原生路由与执行预算不变。
AI.result: 在Granite 3.1 3B-A800M和OLMoE-1B-7B-SFT上对ARC-Challenge、OpenBookQA、SciQ、MedMCQA四个MCQA基准进行3 epoch LoRA适配。Granite上TES-IS平均比Dual Affinity基线提升2.3个百分点，ARC-Challenge上λ_m=10^-2时达到2.94点提升；ACS-IS在冻结affinity下相对CE平均提升2.1点，训练affinity下ARC-Challenge相对提升3.07点。OLMoE上提升较小且任务依赖。误差预测分析显示预测误差与观测NLL呈正相关（Pearson≈0.45）。层范围消融显示最终层监督是简洁且具竞争力的默认设置。
AI.conclusion: 直接用next-token交叉熵监督稀疏MoE路由（无论通过误差预测头还是affinity浓度）能在保持原生top-K执行预算和聚合策略的同时获得精度提升，监督强度和深度是关键设计选择；更强的监督在多个任务上带来额外增益，最优机制依赖于骨干和任务。

title: OmniVCBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning Towards AI Virtual Cells
summary: Artificial Intelligence Virtual Cells (AIVCs) are envisioned as scientific agents that simulate cellular responses, explain underlying mechanisms, and support hypothesis-driven discovery. Existing AIVC benchmarks, however, operate primarily at the simulation layer, motivating complementary evaluation of how models interpret experimental evidence and formulate biological hypotheses. We introduce OmniVCBench, a figure-centric, source-traceable benchmark for the interpretation component of an AIVC. It contains 6,077 curated single- and multi-subfigure question--answer pairs derived from figures and experimental contexts in the scientific literature. Guided by Bloom's taxonomy, we instantiate interpretation-layer counterparts of the AIVC Predict--Explain--Discover agenda through three scientific reasoning tasks. We further introduce AIVC-Judge, a task-conditioned MLLM-as-a-judge framework with category-specific, reference-aware rubrics for evaluating open-ended responses. A complementary Model-Derived Hard-Negative Mining (MDHNM) strategy converts plausible errors observed during model inference into MCQ distractors for lower-cost evaluation. Within the evaluated heterogeneous model pool, MCQ accuracy correlates positively with AIVC-Judge scores, providing a complementary view of performance alongside open-response evaluation. Code and data demo are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: OmniVCBench是一个面向AI虚拟细胞（AIVC）"解释层"的图表中心、源可追溯基准，包含6,077道来自科学文献的单/多子图问答对，覆盖三个认知任务层级（L1证据推理、L2机制解释、L3假设提出），并配套提出AIVC-Judge开放式评估框架与MDHNM干扰项挖掘方法。
AI.motivation: 现有AIVC基准主要评估"模拟层"（预测细胞状态），而缺乏对模型解读实验证据与提出生物假设能力的系统评测。本文旨在填补这一空白，将评估从模拟扩展到证据解释这一互补能力层。
AI.method: 方法核心包括：(1) 从OmniScience语料库中筛选1,080篇Nature Communications论文构建6,077条QA对，按Bloom分类法分为L1/L2/L3三层；(2) 提出AIVC-Judge——基于层级特定rubric的MLLM-as-judge评估框架，进行claim级证据核查并输出维度分、整体分和证据追踪；(3) 提出MDHNM（Model-Derived Hard-Negative Mining），将模型推理中观察到的错误改写为MCQ干扰项；(4) 配套OmniVCTrain（548k条）用于SFT/RAG适配；(5) 通过三轮独立PhD标注者全员一致审计确保质量（Fleiss κ=0.856）。
AI.result: 评估15个MLLM后：(1) GPT-5.6-sol以55.1% MCQ准确率和3.28/5 AIVC-Judge得分领先，但L3开放式响应从L2的3.68降至2.76；(2) MCQ与开放式响应在11个共享模型间相关性达Spearman ρ=0.964，但专有模型组内仅r=0.208；(3) L3最弱维度为"论证质量"和"证据权衡"（GPT-5.6-sol仅1.92/1.67）；(4) Qwen3-VL-8B经SFT（rank-32）和多模态RAG在MCQ上分别提升+1.97和+1.60百分点；(5) 4个真实生物输出证据采集试点显示，单步主动测量可修正9处预测错误且无回归。
AI.conclusion: OmniVCBench将源可追溯的细胞实验图、按Predict-Explain-Discover组织的三层任务、配对的开放式与MCQ评估相结合，揭示了当前MLLM作为AIVC解释组件的明显不足——即便最强模型在L3证据论证上也低于3/5。该基准及配套的Judge实现、rubric和数据资源为开发能连接模拟预测与证据推理的解释组件提供了评测基础设施。

title: Adam under Generalized Smoothness with Second-Moment-Type Stochastic Gradients
summary: Adam is widely observed to remain stable even when the objective deviates significantly from global smoothness. Under the generalized smoothness framework, however, existing analyses rely on strong tail assumptions on the stochastic gradients, such as almost-sure boundedness or sub-Gaussianity. Whether Adam converges on generalized smooth objectives under only second moment information on the stochastic gradients, without such concentration assumptions, was identified as an important open direction by Li et al. (2023). This paper gives an affirmative answer under fairly general conditions: such tail assumptions are not necessary. Building on the Adam self-normalization framework of Jin et al. (2026), developed for classical smoothness and bounded variance, we extend the stopping-time and de-preconditioning strategy to the $L_0$-$L_p$ generalized smoothness condition and a generalized second moment ABC condition. Even when the stochastic-gradient condition provides only second moment information that may grow along the trajectory, the stochastic trajectory of Adam remains in a locally well-behaved smoothness region, with stretched-exponential tail decay under bounded variance and global smoothness. Consequently, we establish high-probability convergence rate guarantees over the full range $p<2$, with confidence dependence of order $\delta^{-1/2}$, while the stepsize prefactor depends on $\delta$ only through a single logarithmic factor. We further construct a hard instance showing that, under only second-moment information, this $\delta^{-1/2}$-type confidence dependence is sharp. Finally, in the regime $p<1$, we combine the trajectory control with polynomial-growth estimates on rare events to obtain convergence rate guarantees in expectation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Adam优化器在$L_0$-$L_p$广义光滑性条件下，仅依赖随机梯度二阶矩信息（不假设次高斯性或几乎确定有界性）的高概率收敛性。作者扩展了Jin等人(2026)的自归一化停止时间框架，证明了Adam的随机轨迹保持在局部良好行为的光滑区域内，并获得了对数置信依赖的步长预因子。论文得到了对所有$p<2$的高概率收敛率$\tilde{O}(d/\sqrt{\delta T}+d^2/T)$，其中置信依赖为$\delta^{-1/2}$，并构造了硬实例证明此$\delta^{-1/2}$依赖在仅二阶矩条件下是尖锐的。对于$p<1$的情形，还通过多项式增长估计获得了期望收敛率。同时给出了$1\le p<2$时的期望下界$T^{-1/3}$，表明该率不能统一推广到整个广义ABC类。
AI.motivation: 现有Adam在广义光滑性下的理论分析依赖强尾假设（如几乎处处有界或次高斯性）。Li等人(2023)明确指出，在仅二阶矩条件下建立Adam收敛性是一个重要的开放方向。本文旨在不施加强浓度假设的情况下证明Adam在广义光滑目标上的收敛性。
AI.method: 论文基于Jin等人(2026)针对经典光滑性和有界方差开发的Adam自归一化框架，将其扩展到$L_0$-$L_p$广义光滑性条件和广义二阶矩ABC条件。核心技术包括：(1) 停止时间与去预处理策略，将自适应分母控制与梯度控制分离；(2) 自归一化技术，通过归一化量而非原始随机梯度来控制轨迹；(3) 辅助能量函数$\mathcal{L}_t=\Psi(\mathbf{z}_t)+E_t$结合Lyapunov方法实现轨迹定位；(4) 使用Freedman不等式控制鞅差序列；(5) 多项式距离增长引理处理$p<1$的稀有事件积分。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 对所有$p<2$，以至少$1-\delta$的概率建立高概率收敛率$\frac{1}{T}\sum\|\nabla f(\theta_t)\|^2=\tilde{O}(d/\sqrt{\delta T}+d^2/T)$，置信依赖为$\delta^{-1/2}$；(2) 步长预因子对$\delta$仅通过单个对数因子依赖；(3) 构造一维硬实例证明$\delta^{-1/2}$依赖是尖锐的；(4) 对$p<1$，建立期望收敛率$\mathcal{O}(d(1+\log T)/\sqrt{T}+d^2(1+\log T)^2/T)$；(5) 对$1\le p<2$，构造固定类硬实例，证明存在$T^{-1/3}$的下界，表明$\text{polylog}(T)/\sqrt{T}$的期望率不能对该Adam族在完整广义ABC类上统一成立。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明Adam在高$L_{\alpha$广义光滑性和广义ABC二阶矩增长条件下实现高概率收敛。自归一化和停止增强能量控制轨迹，最终去预处理步骤产生$\delta^{-1/2}$的置信依赖。$p<1$的期望定理与$1\le p<2$的固定类下界区分了校准Adam族的两个机制。结果表明，在仅二阶矩信息条件下，强尾假设对Adam分析并非必需的，但$\delta^{-1/2}$的置信依赖是不可避免的。

title: A neural network that maintains and retrieves memories based on context
summary: Every day, people continuously infer situational context and adjust the way they understand and remember the world. Context, signaled by the prefrontal cortex, is known to modulate working memory and episodic memory, but the algorithmic understanding of this modulation remains limited. Here, we train a recurrent neural network (RNN), augmented with an episodic memory buffer, to infer context using Bayesian inference as it continuously makes predictions of upcoming scenes while watching naturalistic movies. When the inferred context modulates the RNN's recurrent connectivity (the basis of working memory) in a low-rank manner, the model's activity patterns best match neural responses in human participants who watched the same movies during fMRI. Context also modulates episodic memory retrieval, such that the model retrieves memories based on not only content similarity but also context similarity. This is implemented as a key-value system with self-attention, designed to additionally encode context and retrieve context-congruent memories. The resulting model not only better resembles human brain representations but also learns to retrieve memories like humans much faster than a model without context modulation. Together, our findings suggest a computational mechanism by which context modulates information maintenance and long-term memory retrieval in naturalistic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种上下文调制的情景记忆-循环神经网络（EM-RNN），该模型通过贝叶斯推断在观看自然电视剧时持续推断情境上下文，并通过低秩门控机制调制工作记忆（WM）和情景记忆（EM）检索。模型与人类fMRI数据高度匹配，且能以远快于基线模型的速度习得类似人类的情景一致性记忆检索模式，为前额叶皮层（PFC）如何调制工作记忆和情景记忆提供了计算机制。
AI.motivation: 情境上下文对认知至关重要，尤其对工作记忆和情景记忆起调制作用。然而，前额叶皮层调制工作记忆和情景记忆的算法机制仍不清楚——以往研究要么单独建模工作记忆（如基于RNN），要么单独建模情景记忆（如基于键-值记忆系统），缺乏一个统一的、能根据自然情境动态推断上下文并联合调制两种记忆的框架。
AI.method:
1. 在Song等人(2026)的EM-RNN基础上增加PFC样算法：上下文通过贝叶斯推断生成（基于下一场景预测似然），后验概率作为上下文信号。
2. 测试RNN上下文调制的四种方式：输入调制、输出调制、全秩WM调制、低秩WM调制（基共享循环连接上叠加单位秩矩阵）。
3. 在EM缓冲区中显式编码上下文（4维概率向量），检索权重由内容相似度与上下文相似度的逐元素乘积经softmax（τ=0.1）生成。
4. 训练数据：《我们这一天》第一季2-18集；测试数据：第1集，与33名fMRI被试观看相同。
5. 输入：CLIP视频嵌入+CLAP音频嵌入（均降维至50维）；输出：人工标注的人物/地点/时间语义向量（10维）。
6. 比较模型表征相似性矩阵（RSM）与脑区RSM的Pearson相关；比较模型记忆检索矩阵与人类"顿悟"按钮检索数据。
AI.result:
1. 低秩WM调制条件的模型表征与人类大脑最为匹配，显著优于无调制、输入调制、输出调制及全秩WM调制条件（t(32)>17，FDR校正p<.0001）。
2. 低秩WM调制产生更高效的轨迹：更直（低曲折度，t(19)=5.519, p<.0001）、更低维度（PC1解释40.83% vs 34.43%，p=.0002）、不同上下文终点更具正交性（p=.022）。
3. WM+EM模型比单独的WM模型更匹配脑表征（t(32)=9.502, p<.0001），且上下文切换更快。
4. WM+EM模型以远快于无调制模型的速度习得类似人类的记忆检索（达到r=0.2仅需22次训练迭代 vs 94次）。
5. 该优势依赖于检索选择性（低温度softmax τ=0.1）以及显式表征上下文作为检索依据。
6. 贝叶斯上下文推断准确率达62.10%，下一场景预测准确率r=0.565。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出了一种统一的计算框架，解释了情境上下文如何调制工作记忆与情景记忆：上下文通过贝叶斯推断被推断，并通过对共享循环连接的低秩门控调制RNN的工作记忆动力学，同时通过显式编码在键-值情景记忆系统中以内容相似度×上下文相似度的检索权重实现情景一致性记忆的快速检索。这一"分工"机制使键-值系统无需隐式学习上下文结构，从而加速人类化检索模式的习得。结果表明，PFC可能通过此类低秩调制和显式上下文表征联合实现其对短时与长时记忆的调制功能。

title: DIET: Deletion-response Expert Trimming for Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) increasingly adopt mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures to reduce active computation, but their full expert storage remains costly. Existing one-shot pruning criteria mainly rely on static activation or routing statistics and cannot capture layer-level re-routing after expert deletion. We introduce DIET, a training-free expert pruning framework based on deletion responses. A single all-expert calibration pass records expert outputs and router states for matched conditional and unconditional tokens. Candidate deletions are then replayed from cached tensors, requiring no additional model forward passes. The resulting deletion-response signatures characterize each expert by the changes induced when it is removed. DIET selects retained experts by minimizing Overall Diversity Loss (ODL), which preserves directional coverage in signature space, and combines intra-layer local search with an inter-layer regression-guided budget search to allocate experts across layers. On LingBot-Video 30B-A3B, pruning 50% of experts (6,144 to 3,072) reduces the checkpoint from 57 GB to 30 GB and enables single-card deployment on a 48 GB GPU without fine-tuning. Under a fixed 284-case VBench protocol, the VBench Total increases from 0.7941 to 0.8115. Across tested retention budgets, DIET consistently outperforms competitive pruning baselines adapted from large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DIET，一种面向视频扩散 Transformer（DiT-MoE）的免训练专家剪枝框架。该方法通过单次全专家校准捕获路由状态与专家输出，并利用缓存张量的张量运算高效模拟删除响应，从而基于"删除响应签名"在签名空间中通过最小化总体多样性损失（ODL）选择保留专家。结合逐层组合优化与跨层回归引导的预算分配，DIET 在 LingBot-Video 30B-A3B 上将 50% 的专家剪掉后，检查点从 57 GB 降至 30 GB，可在单卡 48 GB GPU 上部署，并在 VBench 基准上 0.7941 提升到 0.8115，一致优于从 LLM 移植的多种剪枝基线。
AI.motivation: 视频 DiT-MoE 模型参数体量巨大，尽管稀疏激活降低了计算量，但全部专家仍需常驻显存，造成部署困难。现有一次性剪枝准则多依赖静态激活或路由统计，无法捕捉专家删除后由分组 top-k 路由引发的离散重路由与门控重分配。此外，对大规模视频 DiT-MoE 进行穷举式 leave-one-out 评估计算代价极高，且难以微调。因此亟需一种无需前向传播、无需微调、且能直接刻画删除后动力学行为的剪枝方法。
AI.method: DIET 由三部分构成：(1) 冻结状态重放机制——通过一次性全专家校准记录所有专家输出与路由状态，对任意专家删除的分组 top-k 重路由仅通过缓存张量的张量运算即可重建，无需额外前向传播；(2) 删除响应签名与 ODL——为每个专家构造跨案例的删除响应签名，将每层保留专家选择建模为在签名空间中最小化被剪专家到保留专家的最近邻余弦距离之和，采用 GRASP 初始化 + 单步交换 + 模拟退火进行组合优化；(3) 跨层预算分配——通过正则化线性代理拟合层保留数与基准得分的关联，在全局预算约束下以约束线性规划提出非均匀分配，并经端到端生成验证。
AI.result: 在 LingBot-Video 30B-A3B（48 层、每层 128 专家、4 组 top-8 分组路由）上的 284 例固定 VBench 协议中：50% 剪枝（6144→3072 专家）将检查点从 57 GB 降至 30 GB，可在单卡 48 GB GPU 部署，VBench Total 由 0.7941 提升至 0.8115，Quality 与 Semantic 双双超越密集基线；20% 极端剪枝下仍优于所有移植 LLM 基线（Total 0.7596 vs 次优 HTS 0.7216）。回归一致化分配相较均匀分配带来额外 1.2 点提升。NAEE 风格重构基线虽将重放误差降低约 40%，但 VBench Total 仍比 DIET 低 2.80 点，表明严格重构目标并非视频扩散 MoE 剪枝的优良代理。消融显示使用加性响应范数或低秩 PCA 替代 ODL 会导致 2.66–5.44 点的下降。
AI.conclusion: DIET 证明了在视频扩散 Transformer 上将专家库压缩一半且无需微调是可行的。其核心在于：联合删除响应违反线性叠加，因此应以方向性功能覆盖而非严格激活重构作为剪枝目标；冻结状态重放使 6144 次单专家删除的组合问题可仅凭缓存张量运算求解；分层 ODL 与跨层回归引导分配共同识别出层敏感度异质性。该工作将 MoE 剪枝从基于静态启发式推进到基于测量到的删除动力学，为无训练部署大规模视频生成 MoE 提供了实用路径。主要局限在于层局部 ODL 未追踪下游级联激活漂移，且结论尚待跨架构验证。

title: Can a Cacheable Decision Model Follow Rules?
summary: Certo is a small non-generative decision model (Qwen3-4B): it scores candidate actions from their text and returns a probability, instead of generating an answer. The accurate design reads the state, the rules, and each candidate together (a joint scorer), so cost grows with the menu. Independent encoding lets each candidate be encoded once and reused across states (about 5x cheaper at 77 candidates), but separates state from candidate. We ask how much rule-sensitivity survives that move, and whether it can be trained back. Four experiments on Certo: (1) the tested conversion to cacheable scoring loses rule-sensitivity (recall@1 1.00 -> 0.24) while the joint scorer holds 1.00, and a shortlist+rerank rescue fails; (2) targeted counterfactual supervision restores strong performance on held-out synthetic rule tasks (paraphrase, counterfactual, composition; reproducible across seeds), though we do not isolate whether predictions depend on the supplied rule; (3) on real rules the added benefit is not established -- after fixing a truncation confound, the joint scorer wins significantly on the short tier (0.861 vs 0.500) and directionally on the hard tier (0.655 vs 0.483, n=29); (4) a matched cross-domain real-prose mixture did not help and reduced contract accuracy (-9.3, -16.2 points). A cacheable encoder can be made rule-sensitive on its training distribution, but transfer to unseen-source real rules is not established; the joint scorer keeps an edge at the cost of caching.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于"决策模型在规则遵循与缓存效率之间的权衡"的实证研究。作者以自研的4B参数决策模型Certo为对象，比较了联合评分器（joint scorer）与可缓存的独立编码评分器在规则敏感任务上的表现，并通过四组实验探究"将规则敏感性训练回来"的可行性及其在真实规则上的迁移效果。核心结论是：缓存架构会牺牲规则敏感性；针对性合成训练可在合成任务上恢复；但未能证明该能力迁移到未见来源的真实规则。
AI.motivation: 许多生产决策并非开放式生成——意图路由、政策合规、规则判定等任务只需对固定候选打分即可。联合评分器（cross-encoder）虽然准确，但因候选需与状态重新融合，无法跨状态复用表征，在大候选菜单下成本高昂。独立编码虽支持候选向量缓存以显著降低延迟（K77时约5倍加速），但状态与候选在网络内不交互，可能恰好损害"规则应用"所需的能力。本文即围绕这一架构权衡展开系统研究。
AI.method: 模型：Certo（基于Qwen3-4B的LoRA适配决策模型，支持Choice/Score/Noul三原语，温度缩放概率输出）。四种评分器：(1) A_pair 联合交叉编码器；(2) A_10 联合多头（≤10候选）；(3) B 单向量对偶编码器（余弦相似度，缓存候选）；(4) C 多向量晚期交互MaxSim（缓存候选）。训练采用多类Brier损失与排序概率EMD损失，匹配预算（相同训练样本与步数）。四组实验：(1) 在匹配预算下比较四种评分器在路由与规则敏感选择上的recall@1及延迟，并测试短名单+重排序；(2) 用反事实对的合成数据继续训练B，并在四项保持任务（释义、反事实、组合、新规则类型）上做配对bootstrap评估；(3) 在JevBench真实规则任务上评估，先用输入审计修正截断混淆，再做配对bootstrap；(4) 控制性真实散文试点（隐私策略训练→合同测试），配对bootstrap。所有区间均为5000次重抽样，依赖单位分组。
AI.result: 实验1：A_pair在规则敏感任务上保持1.00，B降至0.24，C降至0.08；A_pair延迟随菜单增长（K5→K77：52→242 ms），B/C约46 ms近乎恒定；短名单+重排序因缓存编码器在重排前已丢弃合规候选而失败。实验2：反事实监督下B在释义（0.99–1.00）、反事实对（98.7% vs 30%）、组合（0.73）、新规则类型（多条件1.00、优先0.73）四项保持任务上均显著超越基线与对照；第二随机种子复现成功，路由能力无显著变化。实验3：输入审计发现截断混淆——长文档下候选被右截丢弃；修正后A_pair在短层显著优于treatment（0.861 vs 0.500，CI [+0.167, +0.556]），在难层方向性优势但不显著（0.655 vs 0.483，n=29，CI [-0.069, +0.414]）；合成训练对真实规则无显著增益，迁移未确立。实验4：用40%隐私策略真实散文替换合成数据，未见源合同准确率下降9.3与16.2点（CI均完全在零左侧），合成与路由保留基本未变；该试点混淆了合成暴露减少与新增散文两个因素，无法分离因果。
AI.conclusion: 可缓存的独立编码决策模型能在训练分布内的合成规则任务上泛化（释义、反事实、组合、新类型），且结果在第二个随机种子上复现；但研究未能隔离"其预测是否真正依赖所提供规则而非习得的决策模式"——这需要规则固定反事实控制来确认。更关键的是，该能力向未见来源真实规则的迁移未被确立：合成训练未带来提升，跨域真实散文训练甚至降低了合同准确率。联合评分器在真实短层规则上保持统计显著优势（难层优势方向性但不显著），代价是候选需重新计算。实务含义为应用相关的权衡：小菜单且规则敏感选联合评分器；大菜单需权衡缓存延迟优势与精度损失（Certo在K77下0.422 vs 0.652）。方法论上，截断混淆提示评估窗口是模型的一部分，区分适配与截断的输入应成为常规实践。

title: Mixture of Self-Improving Branches For Agent Harness Optimization
summary: Harness optimization provides a practical setting for recursive self-improvement (RSI), where agent-generated modifications inform subsequent changes through execution feedback. Recent work such as Meta-Harness implements this process through iterative code generation and evaluation, but retains a fixed development set and proposal policy. These constraints channel evolution along a single search trajectory, increasing the risk of converging to a local optimum. We make the improvement process itself adaptive by organizing search into branches with evolving development subsets and proposal policies. Each branch retains development cases solved by more of its leading harnesses than by those of other branches, drops cases solved by every leading harness across all branches, and revises its proposal policy using its own search history. To deploy the resulting complementary harnesses, we propose a router to select one development-selected branch head for each new input before execution. Across mathematical reasoning and agentic coding benchmarks, our system achieves relative improvements over Meta-Harness of 34.8% on Olympiad-level mathematical reasoning, 11.6% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, and 3.8% on SWE-bench Lite, with harness selection and router configuration based solely on development data. These results show that evolving branch objectives and proposal policies can yield complementary harnesses whose strengths a router combines without access to test outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"自改进分支混合"框架，将harness优化中的递归自我改进过程组织为多个并行分支，每个分支拥有动态演化的开发子集和分支特定的proposal引导策略，最终通过路由器选择互补的分支head用于部署，在数学推理和agentic coding基准上显著优于Meta-Harness。
AI.motivation: 现有Meta-Harness等harness优化方法在递归自我改进过程中保持固定的开发集和proposal策略，导致搜索沿单一轨迹进行，容易收敛到局部最优。互补优势的harness可能因总分较低而被忽视，缺乏进一步开发机会。
AI.method: 1）分支搜索：多个并行分支各自维护开发子集、候选历史和proposal引导；2）开发子集动态演化：通过比较各分支frontier在每个案例上的覆盖率，将分支有相对优势的案例保留在对应分支子集中，所有frontier都解决的案例被移除；3）分支特定proposal适应：每个分支根据本地搜索经验（成功机制、失败模式、未解决问题）更新SKILL.md，形成不同的探索优先级；4）开发数据驱动的路由器：基于分支head独占的开发案例，用GEPA优化路由指令，在执行前为每个新问题选择分支head。
AI.result: 在四个设置上（Math-Gemini 3 Flash、Math-Claude Sonnet 4.5、Terminal-Bench 2.0、SWE-bench Lite）均优于Meta-Harness：相对提升分别为34.8%、5.2%、11.6%、3.8%。路由器在两个设置上超越单个最优分支head。消融实验表明开发子集更新和proposal适应组合效果最佳（62.0% vs 单独使用的51.0%/50.0%）。频繁的开发更新间隔（每轮vs每5轮）也带来显著提升。分支间确实发展出互补能力（如Branch 1侧重答案检查，Branch 2侧重自由形式推导）。
AI.conclusion: 分支化搜索结合动态开发目标和分支局部proposal引导，加上开发数据驱动的路由器，可以在不接触测试结果的情况下发现并组合互补harness，在数学推理和agentic coding任务上均取得显著提升。但token开销较高（任务解决token为Meta-Harness的1.21-1.71倍），且路由在两个设置上略低于单个最优head，互补能力的完全利用仍有改进空间。

title: Active Budget Can Kill Sensitivity: Diagnosing and Repairing TopK Sparse Autoencoder Reliability
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly scaled to wider dictionaries to recover fine-grained structure from large language model activations. However, a feature is useful for interpretation only if it remains a stable unit of analysis when the same meaning is expressed in different surface forms. We study this reliability question for TopK SAEs via feature sensitivity. Experiments demonstrate that scaling selectively reduces the sensitivity of rare features, while common features remain comparatively stable. A controlled width\(\times k\) factorial experiment identifies the active budget k as the root cause: the degradation arises from the selection boundary rather than dictionary width alone. We attribute this failure to the geometry of TopK selection. The active margin, the distance to the cutoff, predicts feature loss without thresholds. Guided by this margin diagnosis, we introduce pairwise rank stabilization. Our method targets ordering failures at the cutoff and improves rare-feature sensitivity by \(8.83\) percentage points, while keeping reconstruction and alive-feature coverage near the baseline. Overall, our results suggest that wide TopK SAEs should be evaluated not only by reconstruction, sparsity, and feature count, but also by feature reliability under semantic variation and boundary geometry for stable interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文发现宽Top稀疏自编码器（TopK SAE）在扩展时存在罕见特征（rare feature）的可靠性退化问题，并通过控制实验将其根源定位为活跃预算k（而非字典宽度）。作者提出基于激活边界几何的"主动边际"诊断，并设计了一种成对秩稳定化（pairwise rank stabilization）方法，在不损害重建质量的前提下将罕见特征敏感度提升8.83个百分点。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）常被扩展以从大语言模型激活中恢复更细粒度的结构，但一个特征只有在相同语义以不同表面形式表达时仍保持稳定，才是可解释的可靠分析单元。本文研究TopK SAE中特征的可靠性（feature sensitivity），揭示扩展过程中罕见特征稳定性下降的机制。
AI.method: 方法分三部分：(1) 定义特征敏感度S_i为源文本激活特征在保持语义的释义下仍保持激活的概率；(2) 通过宽度×k的3×3因子实验分离字典宽度和活跃预算的独立影响；(4) 引入top-k边界诊断量（主动边际active margin = a_(k) - a_(k+1)）；(5) 提出成对秩稳定化损失，在源-释义配对上惩罚源激活特征被释义侧硬负例（hard negatives）反超的边界交叉。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 罕见特征敏感度从0.650降至0.585，普通特征保持稳定（0.998→0.956）；(2) 因子实验证实活跃预算k是退化根源，k从32增至128使罕见特征敏感度下降14.8pp，而宽度边际仅1.9pp；(3) 主动边际以AUROC 0.728–0.850预测释义引发的特征丢失，无需阈值且跨GPT-2各层、Qwen、Gemma均成立；(4) 成对秩稳定化在验证集上提升罕见特征敏感度+12.3pp，在独立保留测试集上提升+8.83pp，重建MSE和活跃特征覆盖率几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 宽TopK SAE的可靠性不能仅由重建误差、稀疏度和特征数量衡量，还需衡量特征在语义变化下的可靠性及边界几何。罕见的低频特征因竞争加剧而靠近选择边界，对释义引起的微小扰动更脆弱。成对秩稳定化表明：针对诊断出的排序失败而非全局边界加宽，可以有效修复罕见特征的可靠性。该框架为SAE评估提供了超越重建指标的新维度。

title: Co-PiLOT: Constrained Physics-Informed Latent Optimization for Target-Driven Inverse Design
summary: Inverse design of physical systems (molecules, devices, microstructures) often reduces to optimizing a high-dimensional structure against an expensive black-box simulator. Direct search is difficult because the space is non-Euclidean, feasibility is hard to encode, and each evaluation is expensive. We present Co-PiLOT, a latent optimization approach that maps candidates through a generative encoder-decoder, uses the decoder as a learned validity prior, and searches the latent space with physics-informed black-box optimization. The framework is applied on the inverse design of magnesium alloy microstructure/texture. We develop a vision transformer based-encoder; paired with latent diffusion, diffusion transformer and rectified-flow transformer-based decoders on $\sim80{,}000$ EBSD-derived microstructure dataset to learn a minimal bottleneck, $z$. The ViT-FMDiT model ($z$=$768$) reconstructs high-fidelity microstructure images (FID $27.86$, MS-SSIM $0.178$), which our self-segmenting orientation codec converts into input grids for crystal plasticity solver. Finally, we introduce MERIDIAN, an active latent optimizer driven by deep-kernel Gaussian-process uncertainty, failure-aware feasibility prediction, manifold-aware trust regions, and target-aware acquisition. Within a budget of $160$ simulations, the ViT-FMDiT and MERIDIAN combination yields the best target-driven objective score, reducing the relative target error by $3$--$22\%$ against seven baselines (DANTE, TuRBO, BAxUS, CMA-ES, DDOM, SEIKO, DDPO) on the same decoder.

AI.tldr: Co-PiLOT提出了一种面向物理系统目标驱动逆设计的约束物理信息潜空间优化框架，通过生成式编码器-解码器与黑盒优化器在潜空间中协同工作，并在镁合金微观结构逆设计任务上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 物理系统（如分子、光子器件、多晶材料微观结构）的逆设计面临三大结构性障碍：(1) 设计空间离散且非欧几里得，梯度方法无法通过无可用adjoint的昂贵仿真器应用；(2) 大多数候选点物理上无效，且可行性无法用简单的box约束表达；(3) 每次评估耗时数小时，预算仅有10²–10³次，无法进行暴力采样或高维BO。现有的潜空间BO方法假设廉价oracle，不能处理昂贵且偶尔发散的物理仿真器。作者针对镁合金多晶微观结构/织构的工业逆设计问题，提出了首个端到端的闭环框架。
AI.method: 框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于ViT-H/14编码器与三种扩散解码器（FM-DiT、SDXL、DiT）的生成式编码器-解码器族，在81,756个EBSD微观结构数据上训练，最小瓶颈z∈{512,768,1024}；(2) 方向编解码器Ψ（5步流程：连续展开BFS、类级Markley锚点、框架居中、立体投影、量化），实现RGB图像与HCP方向场的可逆映射，舍入误差≈0.6°；(3) Meridian优化器，结合深度核高斯过程不确定性、失败感知可行性分类器g_ψ、流形感知信任区域（主动子空间+自适应潜空间壳层投影）、目标感知采集（qLogNEI+属性头EI）和质量加权DPP批选择。Crystal plasticity求解器DAMASK作为oracle，返回(σ_y, n, K, σ_u, ε_u)。问题形式化为z⋆ = argmax J(f(D(z)); p⋆) − λ·ReLU(g(D(z)))。
AI.result: 在微观结构重建实验（E1）中，ViT-FMDiT-768实现FID=27.86、MS-SSIM=0.178，被选为最佳瓶颈容量。在AZ31逆设计实验（E2）中，160次仿真预算下，ViT-FMDiT-768+Meridian在目标驱动目标J_V2上达到−0.132±0.004（σ_y=159.1 MPa, n=0.299, σ_u=314.0 MPa），在韧性加权目标J_V1上达到0.961±0.008，相对目标误差比7个基线（DANTE、TuRBO、BAxUS、CMA-ES、DDOM、SEIKO、DDPO）降低3–22%。Meridian在4个解码器×2目标的全部8项研究中均最优，统计显著性p≈1.5×10⁻⁵。
AI.conclusion: Co-PiLOT成功地将昂贵仿真器驱动的逆设计转化为在习得生成设计空间上的主动搜索，首次实现了图像域生成先验与晶体塑性求解器在160次仿真预算下的闭环耦合。框架的5元组抽象(D,f,J,C,O)具备领域无关性，有望推广到其他具有学习先验和慢oracle的物理系统。局限性包括：仅能搜索习得先验可表达的微观结构；DAMASK oracle为HCP现象学塑性律，无损伤、各向同性；未展示向其他多晶材料或物理域的迁移。

title: Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL
summary: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents typically relies on sparse outcome-based rewards. This leads to a severe cold-start problem, as early-stage policies often fail to solve sampled tasks, leaving little useful reward signal for learning. To mitigate this problem, we use on-policy distillation (OPD) to provide token-level guidance on the student's own rollouts. We find that the benefit of this guidance depends on the performance gap between the teacher and the student. When the teacher substantially outperforms the student, distillation helps guide the student through the early training stage where outcome rewards provide little learning signal. As the gap narrows and eventually reverses, however, continued distillation becomes less beneficial and may hinder further improvement. Motivated by this observation, we propose Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling (GATS), which augments the student's RL objective with an OPD term whose weight adapts to the teacher-student performance gap. Specifically, GATS gradually reduces teacher guidance as the student approaches the teacher's reference performance and withdraws it once that reference is reached. This enables GATS to leverage task-trained teachers smaller than the student, since teacher guidance is primarily needed during early training. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with three Qwen2.5 teacher-student configurations, GATS achieves the highest average success rate among the compared methods in all three configurations, improving over reward-only GRPO by 4.37%-11.87% under matched student rollout budgets. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出GATS（Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling），通过让在线策略蒸馏（OPD）权重随师生性能差距自适应调整并在学生追上教师时永久撤回，缓解稀疏奖励智能体强化学习中的冷启动问题，使学生能超越固定权重OPD的天花板。
AI.motivation: 稀疏结果奖励下，长时序智能体RL在训练初期面临冷启动：早期策略无法发现成功轨迹，组内优势为零，缺乏有效学习信号。固定权重OPD虽能加速冷启动但会限制学生上限；手动退火调度又与训练动态脱节。需要一种自适应于师生能力差距的教师引导调度机制。
AI.method: 1) 先在目标任务上用GRPO训练并冻结教师π_T，取其末端训练成功率的K步滑动平均作为参考M_T。2) 学生训练时，同时计算GRPO损失与基于自身rollout的OPD损失。3) 用滞后一步的学生滑动成功率M_S,t计算差距自适应权重λ_t = max(1 - M_S,t/M_T, 0)。4) 当M_S,t ≥ M_T时设置撤回标志d_t=1，此后永久跳过教师前向，仅用GRPO继续训练。总目标：L_GATS,t = L_GRPO + (1-d_t)λ_t L_OPD。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld三个基准、Qwen2.5系列三组师生配置（1.5B→7B、1.5B→14B、3B→7B）下，GATS在所有配置的平均成功率均最高，相对纯GRPO提升4.37–11.87个百分点。固定权重GRPO+OPD和SOD因永不撤回教师而表现低于GRPO；ATOD因手动退火在各任务间波动大。消融显示GATS优于线性、余弦、阶梯等固定时间表，且对衰减形状不敏感、对手调超参数N不敏感。训练动态表明GATS在冷启动阶段获得加速，教师撤回后仍能继续提升并超越教师参考。
AI.conclusion: GATS把教师引导视为临时辅助：用师生性能差距自适应调节OPD权重，达到参考水平后永久撤回教师，从而兼顾冷启动加速与后期自由探索。实验证明学生可超越更小、任务训练的教师。差距自适应调度的优势在于直接关联训练实际进展，而非预先规定持续时长。未来可探索任务特定调度和任务分布变化下的教师再激活。

title: You Cannot Pick a Provider From the Price List: Market-Aware Routing for Open-Weight LLM Inference
summary: Existing LLM routers choose among models using static per-model costs. We show that open-weight inference markets introduce a second, largely ignored decision axis: after choosing a model, a client must still choose which provider serves it. Measuring live endpoints across [nummodels] open models, competing providers, multiple task types, and three measurement waves, we find that provider choice cannot be inferred from the price list. The same model can vary sharply in quality, latency, availability, and price across providers; higher-priced providers are consistently faster, but price does not reliably predict quality or availability; and provider feasibility is task-selective, with one deployment nearly normal on knowledge tasks but catastrophically degraded on multi-step reasoning. We formulate same-model provider selection as a price-taker market-aware routing problem. A simple measured-map policy routes to the cheapest provider that is both quality-equivalent and healthy, yielding matched-quality savings while avoiding degraded endpoints. Because the map drifts, we introduce FACET, an online provider router that certifies per-(provider x task) feasibility facets and fails safe to an anchor before serving uncertified arms. Across relaxed deployment assumptions, FACET tolerates imperfect task assignment and sparse feedback, while systematic evaluator bias exposes a quality-signal trust boundary that can be mitigated with ground-truth probes or audits. Live provider runs further confirm that certification can move real traffic from a premium anchor to a substantially cheaper certified endpoint. Our results suggest that market-aware LLM routing must measure not only which model to use, but also who serves it.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并验证了开放权重LLM推理市场中"提供者选择"作为一个被忽略的路由决策维度。作者通过实测证明：相同模型在不同提供商之间在质量、延迟、可用性上差异巨大，定价无法预测可行性；并提出了FACET——一种在线提供者路由器，通过认证(provider×task)可行性面（facet），在服务前确保安全失败回退到锚点。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由器仅在模型层面进行选择，假设选定模型后服务是同质的。然而，开放权重模型由多家提供商以不同量化、推理栈和可靠性部署，同一模型在不同提供商处可能在质量、延迟、可用性和价格上差异显著。论文挑战"从价目表选择提供商"的假设，揭示市场感知路由的必要性。
AI.method: 方法包括四个层次：(1) 跨6个开放模型、3次测量波次的实测分析，揭示提供商异质性；(2) 测量映射路由（measured-map routing）——在每个(model×task)单元选择最便宜的质量等价且健康的提供商；(3) FACET在线路由器，采用逆bandit结构：每个(provider×task)作为一个"面"（facet），需累积证据认证后才服务流量，否则回退到锚点（anchor）；(4) CUSUM检测器持续监测已认证面。包含严格的安全-成本权衡分析和消融实验。
AI.result: 关键结果：(1) 价格仅与延迟相关(ρ=-0.61)，与准确性(ρ=0.05)和可用性(ρ=0.00)无关；(2) 测量映射路由器达到94%准确率，成本仅1.57×最便宜提供商，而高端路由为3.67×且仍有17%低于质量底线；(3) FACET在S1(初始廉价陷阱)、S2(认证中途下滑)、S3(混合变化)三种漂移场景下将灾难性暴露降至0.0-1.2%，而朴素bandit达5-8%；(4) 36小时实际部署(Llama-3.3-70B，12个提供商)将流量从$1.04/M的锚点迁移到$0.21/M的已认证提供商，服务成本降低63.7%；(5) FACET对不完美任务分配和稀疏反馈具有鲁棒性，但系统性的评估者偏差构成显式信边界，可通过真值探针或审计缓解。
AI.conclusion: 市场感知的LLM路由必须测量不仅"使用哪个模型"，还要测量"由哪个提供商服务"。FACET作为针对灾难性廉价陷阱和任务选择性可行性的保险机制，将不可观测的质量约束通过观测在线学习转化为可操作的路由决策，在保持成本优势的同时避免将流量路由到质量未达标的端点。

title: Pixels to Keys: Exploring Spatial and Motion Cues in Gameplay Inverse Dynamics
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Multimodal Digital Agents (ECCV 2026): this https URL
summary: Video games offer scalable environments for studying perception and control in embodied this http URL online gameplay videos could supply demonstrations, but they rarely include player inputs for training. Inverse Dynamics Models (IDMs) have thus been proposed to infer inputs from frames. Large (up to 1B parameters) IDMs trained on $\sim$1K-2K gameplay hours demonstrate feasibility and cross-environment generalization at this scale, but researchers do not clarify what the key components are to recover individual actions and often report only aggregate accuracy that can mask rare-action failures. We study the problem in a data-constrained scenario to evaluate how spatial motion features, model architectures, and training objectives affect an IDM's outcome and we analyse our models on per-key and balanced metrics such as $F_1^{macro}$. Our experiments on Trackmania highlight the importance of factors like the model architecture and motion flow extraction in preprocessing, while also showing the limits of evaluation through unbalanced metrics. The application of the same architecture and training recipe to Cyberpunk 2077 reveals uneven performance across game mechanics. Our per-action evaluation and failure analysis highlight ambiguities from camera motion, delayed effects and imbalanced key-press frequencies that call for explicit modeling of 3D scene structure, long-term state and the adoption of proper losses in future implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在数据受限场景下，从游戏视频帧中推断玩家键盘输入的逆动力学模型（IDM），通过在Trackmania和Cyberpunk 2077上的消融实验，系统分析了模型架构、光流输入和对比学习预训练三个关键因素的影响，并提出应使用per-key和macro-F1等平衡指标进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的大规模IDM（高达10亿参数，训练于1000-2000小时数据）虽证明了可行性，但研究者未阐明恢复单个按键动作的关键因素，且通常仅报告聚合准确率，掩盖了稀有动作的失败。本文在数据受限场景下研究空间运动特征、模型架构和训练目标对IDM的影响，并强调per-key和平衡评估指标的重要性。
AI.method: 问题形式化为从5帧RGB序列预测5个导航键（W/A/S/D/Space）的多标签二分类。在Trackmania和Cyberpunk 2077数据集上进行消融实验，主要研究三个因素：(1) 架构对比（CNN vs. ViT vs. Hybrid Transformer），(2) 输入中附加光流通道（RAFT），(3) 对比学习预训练（SupCon）。使用soft-F1损失和macro-F1作为主要评估指标，通过交叉注意力可视化分析模型决策依据。
AI.result: 最佳模型HT-RGBF-PT-F1在Trackmania上达到Acc=0.938，F1-macro=0.793；在Cyberpunk 2077上Acc=0.911，F1-macro=0.617。主要发现：(1) HT架构大幅优于纯CNN和ViT；(2) 光流输入使F1-macro相对提升约6%，F1-Sp提升45%；(3) 对比学习预训练带来一致的小幅提升；(4) 失败案例分析揭示了相机/角色运动混淆、延迟效应和按键频率不平衡是主要挑战。预训练的DINOv3嵌入和BCE损失未带来明显优势。
AI.conclusion: 混合Transformer架构结合光流输入和对比学习初始化是最佳组合。聚合准确率指标会掩盖稀有按键的失败，应采用per-key指标进行训练和评估。未来的IDM需要显式建模3D场景结构以分离相机和角色运动，并采用更长的时序上下文来处理延迟效应。规模本身不能解决视觉歧义问题。

title: GRFBrain: Graph-Structured Rectified Flows for EEG Dynamic Modeling
summary: Forecasting time-varying functional connectivity from electroencephalography (EEG) requires modeling both history-dependent trends and structured variability across channels. Conditional flow matching provides a framework for distributional forecasting, yet it remains unclear whether graph-informed source distributions offer practical advantages over isotropic noise and strong deterministic predictors. We introduce a graph-structured residual flow framework that separates conditional mean prediction from stochastic residual transport. A history-only predictor estimates the future connectivity graph, while a graph Gaussian source encodes dependencies derived from past connectivity through a Laplacian-based covariance. A conditional velocity field transports source samples to future graph residuals, with transport time explicitly distinguished from physical EEG time. Our study identifies the conditions and controls needed to distinguish useful residual transport from improvements attributable to deterministic prediction, learned representations, and sampling effects.

AI.tldr: GRFBrain 提出了一个图结构化的残差流框架（GSRF），用于 EEG 时间动态建模与功能连接预测。其核心是将未来状态分解为历史可预测参考和残差，并用一个基于历史图拉普拉斯的条件高斯源（GGRF）替代标准各向同性噪声源，在联合节点-边残差空间中通过条件流匹配进行传输，以实现下游的癫痫检测等任务。
AI.motivation: EEG 信号中包含重要的跨通道功能连接信息。传统的确定性预测方法（如 EvolveGCN、ODEBrain）只能学习条件均值，抑制了状态转换处的不确定性结构。标准的流匹配方法从各向同性高斯噪声出发，忽略了通道间的依赖关系。本文旨在探索历史信息是否能作为源分布的几何结构，从而定义更具信息量的预测任务。
AI.method: 方法包括三部分：(1) 历史条件图高斯源 (GGRF)：利用历史图的拉普拉斯矩阵构建协方差，能量与 IID 高斯匹配以隔离协方差结构的影响；(2) 联合节点-边速度场：基于联合节点-边 Transformer，节点和边之间进行双向消息传递（边到节点的注意力偏置，节点到边的消息）；(3) 残差中心化与归一化 CFM 损失：未来状态被分解为历史参考和残差，速度场在残差空间学习运输。推理时只需在零残差状态处查询速度场一次，无需数值积分。
AI.result: 在 TUSZ（癫痫检测）和 TUAB（异常 EEG 分类）数据集上，GRFBrain 优于包括 ODEBrain、标准流匹配和 Rectified Flow 在内的多种基线。在 TUSZ 12s 任务中 F1 达到 0.523，AUROC 达到 0.877；在 TUAB 上 AUROC 达到 0.878。消融实验表明：(a) 条件 GGRF 优于 IID 高斯和全局 GGRF；(b) 双向节点-边交互优于单向或无交互；(c) 联合节点-边监督优于仅边或仅节点；(d) 短预测时域（1s）效果最佳；(e) 最大池化优于平均/求和池化。
AI.conclusion: GRFBrain 验证了历史条件化的图结构源分布能为 EEG 表征学习提供更丰富的预测任务。联合节点-边速度场和参考中心化的残差分解是提升癫痫检测性能的关键设计。论文明确区分了运输时间 τ 与物理 EEG 时间 s，识别了条件源结构相对于确定性预测、学习表示和采样效应的独立贡献。局限在于评估仅限于分段 EEG 和短时域监督。

title: Video-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Understanding Agents via Harness Evolution
summary: Video understanding agents acquire evidence through an executable harness that controls what they observe and how they use those observations. However, execution traces contain only the evidence acquired by the current harness, leaving competing explanations for failure unresolved and limiting the basis for self-improvement. We introduce Video-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement in which a video understanding agent uses its own language model to revise its harness. Through active video investigation, the model revisits the original training videos to test competing failure explanations with additional observations, grounding proposed changes in evidence beyond the existing trace. Cost-aware harness evolution turns these diagnoses into reusable revisions and determines which revisions to retain by considering both answer accuracy and visual cost. Across our evaluation settings on video understanding benchmarks, the evolved agent improves accuracy while processing fewer frames and achieves competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs against existing video understanding agents. These results demonstrate the potential for video understanding agents to improve their own evidence acquisition and use through harness evolution. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出Video-RSI框架，通过"工具演化"实现视频理解智能体的递归自改进。核心思想是让同一个冻结的语言模型同时担任求解器（Solver）和编辑器（Editor），通过主动视频调查（Active Video Investigation）和成本感知演化（Cost-Aware Harness Evolution）两个机制，在固定模型权重的前提下改进视频证据获取与使用的可执行代码层。
AI.motivation: 1. 视频理解智能体的表现取决于其可执行工具层（harness）所控制的证据获取与使用方式，但执行轨迹仅记录当前工具获取的证据，无法区分失败原因（采样不足、感知错误、未利用已有证据），从而限制了自我改进的证据基础。2. 现有自动化智能体设计与自改进方法多依赖执行轨迹或提示词编辑，缺乏对原始视频的额外证据访问；针对视频场景的VideoHarness-RSI仅依赖轨迹信息，难以区分竞争性失败解释。3. 改进不应只看准确率，还需兼顾视觉观测成本（帧数），因此需要同时考虑修改的依据与保留的标准。
AI.method: 方法包含两大机制——主动视频调查：编辑端回访训练视频，通过生成诊断查询（改变时间区间、采样密度、模态、感知问题等）检验竞争性失败解释，积累证据后形成可复用的修改假设；成本感知工具演化：基于诊断对工具代码（提示词构建、工具实现、观察处理、记忆与执行控制）进行协同修改，并通过同时考虑答案准确率与视觉帧均值的门控规则（允许准确率提升伴随有界成本增长，或成本降低伴随有界准确率损失）决定是否保留候选版本。被采纳的版本作为下一轮演化的起点，共执行20轮修改尝试，最终冻结最优工具用于评估。模型采用DeepSeek-V4-Pro（求解器与编辑器共用）与Qwen3.6-Plus（视觉观测），全程权重冻结。
AI.result: 1. 在MLVU、LongVideoBench、Video-MME、EgoSchema四个基准上，演化的工具在准确率与帧数两方面均优于复现的VideoSeek与VideoHarness-RSI基线；例如MLVU上准确率较VideoSeek提升4.8个百分点且帧数减少27.2%，整体呈现有利的精度–效率权衡。2. 消融实验表明：主动调查在四个基准上均带来准确率提升（MLVU上比仅轨迹变体高8.2个百分点），成本感知选择则在保持或提升准确率的同时显著降低帧数（Video-MME上帧数约为仅准确率门控的一半）。3. 20轮演化中，首次接受的修改主要降低帧数，后续修改持续提升准确率；最终工具相对初始版本在四个基准上减少10.8%–44.1%的帧数。4. 保留的关键代码变化包括结构化感知（带图像引用与时间戳的定向观察）、基于关系图的证据复用（不消耗新帧的中间证据组织步骤）以及选择性观测例程（按问题类型扩展概览帧数、定义计数单位等）。
AI.conclusion: Video-RSI证明，在不改变模型权重的前提下，通过让同一模型以编辑器身份回访训练视频进行失败诊断，并将诊断转化为可执行工具代码的修改，可实现视频理解智能体的递归自改进；主动视频调查提供了超越执行轨迹的证据基础，成本感知选择使演化在准确率与视觉观测成本间取得更优平衡。该工作展示了工具演化作为改进冻结模型视频智能体证据获取与组织方式的可行路径，未来工作可探索更丰富的诊断查询类型、更大规模演化预算，以及将成本扩展至完整模型计算开销等方向。

title: Topological Coherence for Self-evolving Multi-agent Systems
summary: Complex tasks inherently couple workflow structure, agent responsibility, collaboration, and memory access: task regions delimit responsibility and tool scope, cross-region dependencies give rise to handoffs, and ownership boundaries delimit private and selectively shared memory. Existing methods can jointly optimize agent and communication structures, yet such optimization does not by itself require responsibility, handoff, and memory boundaries to remain consistent with task dependencies. We term this requirement topological coherence. We introduce TOCOMAS, a Topology-Coherent Multi-Agent System. TOCOMAS grounds a task graph in tool interfaces, organizes compatible task nodes into reusable responsibility domains, and derives dependency-induced and profile-conditioned collaboration together with boundary-regulated memory visibility. During online self-evolution, TOCOMAS proposes coupled changes to agent, collaboration, and memory policies, retaining for subsequent tasks only candidates that satisfy structural constraints and improve evaluated reward. Across BBEH, WorkBench, SWE-Bench-Verified, and CoMemBench, TOCOMAS improves task success over baselines across backbones. CoMemBench also shows gains over the self-evolving baseline in verified progress, handoffs, and memory isolation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TOCOMAS（拓扑一致性多智能体系统），通过将任务拓扑作为公共参考，将智能体责任、协作接口和记忆边界耦合起来，使多智能体系统在自演化过程中保持结构一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化多智能体方法可联合优化智能体与通信结构，但未显式约束责任分配、交接和记忆边界与任务依赖保持一致，导致结构变更后各层关系可能不一致（拓扑非一致性）。本文将这种一致性要求形式化为"拓扑一致性"，并据此构建协同演化机制。
AI.method: 1) 拓扑智能体组织：将任务图映射到工具接口，构建工具接地的可执行拓扑H_q，按操作兼容性将任务节点分组为责任区域S_q，通过商拓扑H̄_q保留跨区域依赖，并将区域分配给能力匹配的智能体；2) 结构自适应协作编排：跨区域任务依赖推导出必需的交接边E_q^req，结合画像条件空间边E_q^sp构成协作图G_q，并采用边界感知的路由函数；3) 边界保持记忆协调：记忆可见性受责任所有权和共享边界策略Λ_q约束，语义检索在可访问视图内进行；区域转移时记忆随归属迁移；4) 一致性约束的结构演化：执行反馈τ_q和累积经验E^(t)指导结构提案Ω̃_q^(t+1)，通过结构有效性检查（唯一能力所有者、兼容交接、边界一致）和奖励边际接受机制更新组织。
AI.result: 在BBEH、WorkBench、SWE-Bench-Verified和CoMemBench上，TOCOMAS在Qwen3.8-27B和DeepSeek-V4-Flash两个骨干上均优于Direct LLM Call、Peer Review、SMoA、ADAS、OMAC和自演化基线EvoMAS；GPT-6-luna对比同样领先。Qwen3.8-27B下WorkBench达77.68%，SWE-Bench-Verified达48.00%，CoMemBench SR/VNCR/VHS/ICS分别达14.30%/41.60%/51.00%/84.90%，远超EvoMAS的1.00%/30.42%/30.73%/26.80%。消融实验显示各模块均有贡献：移除组织导致VNCR降14.33点；移除协作编排致VHS降40.85点且SR降至零；移除记忆边界使ICS降19.96点；固定结构则WorkBench SR降6.52点。参数敏感性表明组织亲和度0.60和记忆检索k=3最优。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑一致性可作为多智能体系统组织与演化的指导原则：将任务拓扑作为公共参考，派生责任域、协作接口和记忆边界，能在保持各层关系一致的同时实现自演化。该机制在通用任务性能、验证交接和污染隔离上均带来显著提升，验证了耦合结构约束对自演化多智能体系统的有效性。

title: BrainNet Studio: A Unified Toolkit for Brain Network Construction, Intelligent Analysis, and Visualization
summary: Brain networks characterize structural and functional relationships among brain regions and support research on cognition, brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. Their time-varying topology and higher-order spatiotemporal dependencies are not adequately represented by conventional static networks. Existing tools primarily focus on static connectomes and provide limited integration of dynamic network modeling with modern graph and sequence learning methods. We present BrainNet Studio, an integrated toolkit for static and dynamic brain network analysis. It provides a unified workflow encompassing network construction, feature extraction, predictive modeling, candidate biomarker identification, visualization, and assisted interpretation. The toolkit integrates 27 algorithms, including deep learning, graph neural networks, and spatiotemporal sequence models, to support classification and the identification of discriminative brain regions and connections. A large language model generates researcher-verifiable summaries of functional connectivity, structural connectivity, and structure-function coupling at individual and group levels. Within a consistent computational framework, users can configure analytical tasks, compare methods, inspect outputs, and extend functionality without repeatedly assembling application-specific pipelines. BrainNet Studio provides a practical and extensible platform for connectome analysis in cognitive neuroscience, exploratory studies of brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. The toolkit is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: BrainNet Studio 是一个面向静态与动态脑网络的统一分析工具包，集成27种特征提取算法（涵盖深度学习、图神经网络、时空序列模型）和基于结构化证据的大语言模型报告模块，支持脑网络构建、特征提取、分类预测、候选生物标志物发现、可视化与辅助解释，并通过ADNI数据的NC-AD分类任务进行了系统评估。
AI.motivation: 现有脑网络分析工具主要依赖静态连接组模型，缺乏对动态脑网络建模与高阶时空依赖关系的有效整合，且需要研究者手动组装多阶段流程。本文旨在构建一个统一、可扩展的工具包，将动态网络构建、高阶时空特征学习、智能可视化和LLM辅助解释集成于一致框架中。
AI.method: 四大功能模块：(1) 脑网络构建与可视化模块，基于ROI级fMRI/DTI数据，采用滑窗法生成动态功能连接序列，并定义形式化网络表征 R_{s,m} = C_m(X_s, S_s; θ_m)；(2) 特征提取模块集成27种算法，分为四类——动态时序方法（GAT、STGCN、STAGIN、CNN/BiLSTM/Transformer）、复杂时空与高阶拓扑方法（ST2GCN、CD-DSTCN、LR-STIGCN、NeuroH-TGL、STHAN）、联合结构-功能方法（OT-MCSTGCN、MSTGAC、ADRNet）以及静态关联与时序聚合方法（传统ML、GNN族）；(3) 生物标志物发现模块通过模型内部信号将决策映射为连接重要性 W_m 与区域重要性 r_m；(4) LLM报告模块基于结构化证据（边缘/节点/系统级FC、SC及结构-功能耦合度量，经BH-FDR校正和NBS统计）生成可验证的分析报告。使用ADNI数据集203名被试（AAL90图谱），10折交叉验证评估NC-AD二分类性能。
AI.result: 在NC-AD二分类任务（143名被试）中，复杂时空与高阶拓扑方法表现最优：STHAN取得最高ACC 0.9510±0.0322与F1 0.9387±0.0558；ST2GCN取得最高AUC 0.9530±0.0478，ACC 0.9367±0.0499；LR-STIGCN AUC 0.9428±0.0460。联合结构-功能方法中OT-MCSTGCN表现最佳（ACC 0.9175±0.0297）。基于ST2GCN的候选标志物分析显示，Top-20连接中60%为半球间连接，涉及前额-顶叶、颞极、杏仁核与眶额区域；Top-20区域中额叶与顶叶占70%，包括双侧三角部额下回、角回、缘上回等，与AD认知储备及前颞叶网络研究文献具有空间对应关系。
AI.conclusion: BrainNet Studio提供了一个实用且可扩展的统一平台，整合动态脑网络构建、高阶时空特征学习、生物标志物发现与LLM辅助报告功能，降低了高级分析方法的技术门槛，支持认知神经科学、脑疾病探索性研究与脑机接口应用。未来工作需扩展至其他数据集与任务，独立评估LLM报告质量，并验证候选特征的跨数据集可复现性。

title: SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents
summary: Advances in the coding capabilities of LLM agents allow them to inspect and modify their own instructions, tools, and execution procedures. Existing approaches use this ability to search for improved agents through repeated downstream evaluation, which incurs substantial costs and ties the search to the evaluated tasks. We introduce \textbf{SelfSearch}, a reward-free search procedure in which agents modify themselves using records of previous self-improvement episodes. These records capture the reasoning, tool actions, and outcomes of earlier modification attempts, providing concrete experience for improving both task solving and self-modification. Without downstream reward signals during search, SelfSearch improves population-mean success over the initial agent in all six model--benchmark settings, with individual agents gaining up to 11.2 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On SWE-bench Multilingual, an agent improves success by \textbf{5.0} percentage points while reducing execution cost by \textbf{38.5}\% on tasks solved by both the initial and evolved agents. SelfSearch achieves competitive task success with evaluation-guided search baselines at lower search cost. With only \textbf{\$4.03} in search cost, it produces a harness that solves \textbf{82.0}\% of Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks with DeepSeek V4 Flash under the settings of a public nine-harness comparison, matching the top-scoring harness, Codex. These results suggest that experience gained through self-modification can improve agents' downstream capabilities and efficiency.

AI.tldr: SelfSearch是一种无需下游奖励信号的智能体自我修改搜索方法。智能体通过利用先前自我修改回合的记录（包含推理、工具操作和结果）来改进自身实现，无需下游任务评估即可在所有六个模型-基准测试设置上提升任务成功率，同时降低搜索成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体自我改进方法依赖下游任务评估来指导搜索过程，导致成本高昂且将搜索与评估任务耦合。本文旨在探索能否利用自我修改过程本身的经验（即回合记录）来指导智能体改进，从而摆脱对下游评估的依赖。
AI.method: SelfSearch是一种无奖励搜索过程，其中智能体使用先前自我修改回合的记录（推理、工具操作、结果）来修改自身实现（指令、工具、执行逻辑）。每代运行两个谱系（capability能力扩展和adaptive自适应推理方向），共享回合记录，保留生成的智能体用于后续评估。模型权重保持固定，整个代码库可编辑，运行时不归智能体编辑。
AI.result: 在六个模型-基准测试设置中均提升了种群平均成功率：Terminal-Bench 2.1上个体最多提升11.2个百分点；SWE-bench Multilingual上提升5.0个百分点，同时在双方共同解决的任务上降低38.5%的执行成本；仅用$4.03搜索成本，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上达到82.0%解决率，与九款公开harness中最高的Codex持平；改进的harness可跨模型家族迁移。
AI.conclusion: 通过自我修改获得的经验可以为智能体下游能力的改进提供有价值的信息，无需依赖下游评估信号。SelfSearch以更低的搜索成本达到与评估引导搜索基线相当的性能，证明了自我修改经验作为改进信号的可行性，并提出未来可将其与评估引导选择相结合。

title: KV-Kaizen: Learning Context-Adaptive Cache Compression Choices
summary: As the context size of text processed with an LLM grows, the size of KV caches can outstrip the memory allocated for the original model weights. This impacts LLM throughput negatively, since decoding is memory-bound and decode cost grows with cache size. Recent work alleviates this bottleneck by discarding the least relevant tokens. Eviction introduces a tension, since a one-off decision to discard content may prove detrimental later. Instead, we focus on alternative choices that can lead to cache compression without evicting tokens. We achieve this by learning a selector that is able to produce, based on context, a per-layer cache configuration towards an overall compression budget. The selector operates along three axes: sharing one cache across layers (depth), caching at fewer bits (precision), or truncating the low-rank latent cache representations (rank). We call the resulting method KV-Kaizen, for the many small per-layer choices it compounds. We observe that these interventions taken independently and uniformly over all layers limit achievable compression because they degrade accuracy. Crucially, composing them locally and adaptively to the context can instead preserve accuracy while achieving large memory savings. At inference, the selector runs once, before pre-fill. In evaluations on instruction following and reasoning tasks, our selectors reach the Pareto frontier of accuracy against cache size, against learning-free and post-hoc baselines. On long-context tasks, KV-Kaizen improves on eviction and can be composed with it, reaching a 32x smaller decode-time cache on a 14B model while preserving accuracy. A 4x cache size reduction incurs no accuracy degradation from 7B parameters up, and a compressed model is more accurate than a smaller uncompressed one with the same cache size. Together, these findings support pre-training large models and compressing them only afterwards.

AI.tldr: KV-Kaizen 通过学习一个轻量级选择器，为 LLM 的每一层 KV 缓存自适应地选择深度（跨层共享）、秩（低秩截断）和精度（量化）的组合配置，在统一预算下实现大比例缓存压缩而不丢失 token，并能进一步与 token 驱逐方法叠加。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 处理上下文长度的增加，KV 缓存大小可能超过模型权重本身的内存占用，严重影响吞吐量（解码受内存带宽限制）。现有的 token 驱逐方法存在一次性丢弃后无法恢复的风险，因此需要一种非驱逐式的、能根据上下文自适应分配缓存压缩预算的方法。
AI.method: 训练一个轻量级选择器（2.6–3.7M 参数，双层双向 Transformer）读取输入的 token 嵌入，通过 Gumbel-softmax 为每一层从动作空间 {inherit, (rank, precision) 对} 中选择配置；采用语言建模损失 + 预算约束正则化损失联合微调骨干网络；预算可通过 FiLM 条件化输入以支持多目标压缩比。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5/Mistral/OLMo 等 1.5B–32B 模型上：4× 缓存压缩从 7B 起几乎无损精度；14B 模型在 16k 长上下文下 4× 配置叠加 SnapKV 达到 32× 解码时缓存压缩且保持精度；选择器在精度-缓存大小 Pareto 前沿上优于静态/随机/搜索基线；MLA 转换 + 训练后实现精度优于相同缓存大小的更小未压缩模型。
AI.conclusion: 支持"先训练大模型、后压缩缓存"策略：模型规模越大，对压缩容忍度越高；通过组合三个互补的压缩轴，可以以最小精度代价实现高压缩比，且与 token 驱逐正交可叠加；预算条件化选择器可服务多个压缩目标但训练成本增加；深度轴在其他轴无法满足预算时才被使用。

title: Which Attention Heads are like the Human Head? Not the Ones that Compute
summary: Brain-AI alignment is often interpreted as a sign that model and brain perform similar computations. Whether the aligned units are causally involved in model computation is rarely checked. On an abstract pattern-completion task (AAABAAA $\rightarrow$ B), we compare LLM attention-head representations with human EEG and test how ablating those heads affects task performance. Alignment and causation dissociate: brain-aligned heads contribute to performance, but their removal is substantially less disruptive than removal of heads selected via attribution patching. We compare two head sets that prior interpretability work defines without reference to the brain: concept vectors (CVs), which represent abstract patterns across formats, and function vectors (FVs), selected for their contribution to correct-answer prediction. Brain alignment shows little association with FV scores, while its association with CV scores varies across models. Among brain-aligned heads, we find recurring attention profiles: one emphasizes distinctive elements (novelty heads), the other repeating elements (repetition heads). The novelty family tracks salience and attends to the same elements that humans look at, yet its removal is less damaging than random ablation on average. Repetition heads contribute modestly to performance and are associated with abstract-pattern representation (CVs). Across 17 models spanning 3B-72B parameters, FV-ranked removal is substantially more disruptive than brain-ranked removal. Brain alignment thus captures how the model reads the stimulus, and only faintly captures how it represents the pattern and solves the task.

AI.tldr: 该论文测试了一个核心假设：与人类大脑活动对齐的LLM注意力头是否也是任务表现所依赖的因果性组件。作者在抽象模式补全任务（AAABAAA→B）上，将LLM注意力头的表征与人类额叶FRP（注视相关电位）EEG信号进行比较，并通过消融实验测试其因果贡献。结果发现大脑对齐与因果重要性相分离：与FV（功能向量，由归因修补选择）排序的消融相比，大脑排序的消融对任务表现的损害显著较小。大脑对齐的头分为两类——关注重复元素的"重复头"和关注独特元素的"新颖头"。新颖头与人类注视模式高度一致，但对任务表现的贡献却低于随机消融，暗示其可能是架构的"副产物"。
AI.motivation: Brain-AI alignment常被解读为模型与人脑执行相似计算的证据，但很少检验这些对齐单元是否在模型计算中具有因果作用。本研究旨在直接检验：通过神经信号对齐筛选出的注意力头是否就是任务表现最依赖的那些头，以及大脑对齐究竟捕获的是模型如何"读取"刺激还是如何"解决"任务。
AI.method: 1) 任务：抽象序列补全（AAABAAA→B等8种模式），3-shot提示，200个英语多选题试验。2) 人类数据：25名被试的64通道BioSemi EEG额叶FRP（17个额叶电极）以及注视数据，构建8×8 RDM作为对齐目标。3) 三种头评分：大脑评分（与额叶FRP RDM的Spearman相关）、修补评分/函数向量FV（基于归因修补的AIE）、概念评分CV（跨格式、跨字母表的模式RSA）。4) 模板匹配：基于聚类发现"重复"和"新颖"两种注意力模板，在17个模型（3B-72B，含Llama、Qwen、Phi-4、DeepSeek）上测试其泛化。5) 累积零消融实验评估因果贡献。6) 与人类注视数据的8×7模式×位置比较。
AI.result: 1) 大脑评分与修补评分几乎无相关（平均ρ=0.017），大脑排序的消融峰值损害仅12.8pp（24.5%头时），远低于FV排序的42.6pp（12.5%头时）。2) 概念评分与大脑评分的关联在Llama中为正（ρ=0.10-0.33），在指令调优Qwen和Phi-4中为负。3) 重复头：与CV分数正相关（ρ=0.45），与概念头共层（16-35层/22-39层），消融后准确率下降5.5pp但概念RSA和分类器性能保持完整。4) 新颖头：消融损害低于随机消融（少1.4pp），在8项额外任务（少样本学习、散文、检索、共指等）中也低于随机。5) 新颖头注意力在所有17个模型中与人类注视正相关（平均ρ=0.373），重复头负相关（平均ρ=-0.285）。6) 新颖头注视的一致性集中在5个独特符号也是正确答案的模式上，无法分离稀有性与答案相关性。
AI.conclusion: 大脑对齐捕获的是模型如何"读取"刺激，而非如何表示模式或解决任务。与人类神经表征的相似性并不能可靠地识别对正确答案贡献最大的模型组件。大脑对齐的注意力头中存在重复与新颖两种稳定出现的注意力剖面，但新颖类注意力对任务表现贡献有限，可能是架构与训练的"副产物"（spandrel），而非功能性计算单元。这一发现对脑AI对齐研究的方法学提出了重要警示：仅凭表征相似性不能推断计算等价性。

title: Diagnosing and Improving Probabilistic Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as decision assistants who must reason probabilistically from available evidence under explicit decision costs. We propose a decision-theoretic framework that decomposes LLMs' decision loss into two components: forming accurate beliefs from provided evidence and translating those beliefs into actions that optimize a provided utility function. Using a synthetic benchmark with known ground truth, we apply the decomposition to characterize probabilistic reasoning in frontier and open-sourced models. We further evaluate whether RL interventions targeting beliefs, decisions, or both improve these components across three domains, whether improvements transfer across components and elicitation formats, and whether decision performance can improve without improvement in belief formation. We find that targeting one component of probabilistic reasoning redistributes decision loss, improving the target without necessarily transferring to others, and that jointly targeting belief formation and decision-making improves both but hinges on matched formats between training and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于决策理论的框架，将LLM的概率推理决策损失分解为信念损失（belief loss）和优化残差（optimization residual），并在合成基准测试上诊断前沿与开源LLM的概率推理能力，进一步通过强化学习干预探究改善策略组件对LLM概率推理能力的影响。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多被用作决策助手，需要从证据中进行概率推理并根据明确的决策成本做出行动。然而，如何衡量和诊断LLM的概率推理能力，以及如何通过训练提升这一能力，仍缺乏系统性的理论基础与实践方法。现有工作多关注LLM置信度的校准或模型内部偏好的推断，未能有效分离信念准确性与决策优化两个核心组件。
AI.method: 提出决策理论框架，将总遗憾（total regret）严格分解为信念损失与优化残差两部分；在已知真实后验的合成基准上，对五个LLM家族进行诊断；设计四种强化学习干预（仅信念训练B、仅决策训练D、分离多任务训练B/D、顺序对齐训练B+A），采用GRPO与LoRA微调，在三个领域（合成数据推断、天气预报、临床推理）上评估干预效果，使用独立式与两轮式两种提取格式。
AI.result: 诊断发现：当前LLM在简单任务上表现良好，但随着特征维度增加，信念损失成为主要错误源；推理努力水平不足时，优化残差显著。RL干预发现：(1)仅信念训练能降低信念损失，但未必转化为更优决策；(2)仅决策训练能改善决策但几乎不改善信念，表明模型可能学到绕过信念形成的捷径策略；(3)联合训练可同时改善两者，但效果依赖训练与评估格式是否匹配；(4)这些发现可泛化到未见过的损失函数。
AI.conclusion: 概率推理中，信念形成与决策优化是两个相对独立的能力组件，训练一个组件并不必然带来另一组件的提升。有效提升LLM概率推理能力需要联合针对两个组件进行训练，并确保训练与评估格式的一致性。该框架为诊断与改进LLM概率推理提供了基础工具，未来可扩展到多分类问题、更大动作空间及不同模型家族。

title: HARISSA: Inference-Time Self-Checks for Efficient and Safe Local Language Model Deployment
summary: Running a language model locally offers advantages in privacy, latency, and cost, but local hardware fits only small models, which are less capable than frontier models. The usual remedy for a hard query, escalating it to a cloud model, gives up the privacy and cost advantages of running locally. A deployment that stays local faces two decisions for hard queries instead. First, it can spend more computation on a query, e.g., reasoning before answering, which raises accuracy at a cost in latency, so it must decide which queries are worth the extra computation (efficiency). Second, some queries are beyond the local model, and delivering a wrong answer is worse than deferring the query to a human in the loop, so it must decide which answers are safe to deliver (safety). We show that both decisions can be made from the model's own hidden states. The prefill state, computed before any token is generated, predicts whether the model will answer correctly, and the answer state, at the end of the generated answer, predicts whether that answer is correct. HARISSA fine-tunes the model so that both states predict correctness, then makes both decisions with one policy that cascades through the ways of answering from cheapest to most expensive, skipping a way the prefill state predicts will fail and deferring the query when the answer it stops with is predicted wrong. On a device running a single model, HARISSA is within one accuracy point of chain-of-thought at 2.7 times lower latency. On a server holding four sizes of one model, HARISSA is more accurate than the FrugalGPT and Self-REF cascades at the same latency, and at the same deferral rate the answer state leaves fewer wrong answers than the standard confidence signals in five of six task and setting pairs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HARISSA，一种仅利用小型语言模型自身隐藏状态进行推理时自我检查的方法。该方法通过在预填充状态（prefill state）和答案状态（answer state）上训练线性探针，统一决策"高效性"（是否值得对查询进行额外推理）和"安全性"（是否应将查询转交给人工）。在单模型设备和多尺寸服务器两种部署场景下，HARISSA 均在准确率与延迟的权衡上优于 FrugalGPT 和 Self-REF 等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 本地部署语言模型具有隐私、延迟和成本优势，但本地硬件只能承载能力较弱的小模型。对困难查询的标准补救措施——升级到云端模型——会牺牲本地部署的隐私与成本优势。本地部署面临两个核心决策：1) 效率决策——哪些查询值得额外计算开销；2) 安全决策——哪些答案应转交给人工而非给出错误答案。这两个决策需要由本地模型自身完成，因为没有更大的模型可作为裁判。论文发现这两个决策信号均蕴含在模型的隐藏状态中。
AI.method: HARISSA 的方法核心包括：1) 微调模型（LoRA）使其隐藏状态能够预测答案正确性，在预填充状态上为每个动作训练一个预填充头，在答案状态上训练一个答案头，二元交叉熵损失联合训练；2) 训练线性探针（logistic regression + 等温回归校准）读取隐藏状态，得到预填充概率 p_k(x) 和答案概率 q_k(x)；3) 级联策略（Algorithm 1）：按成本从低到高遍历动作，若预填充概率低于跳过阈值 τ 则跳过该动作；若生成答案后答案概率不低于回落阈值 τ_f 则采用，否则尝试下一动作；最终若答案概率仍低于转交阈值 τ_d 则将查询转交人工。三个阈值在开发集上通过最小化目标函数 ℛ = 𝔼[e(x)] + λ·𝔼[T(x)] + μ·𝔼[d(x)] 联合选择。
AI.result: 在 MedQA、MedMCQA、BBH 三个任务上的主要结果：1) 设备场景：HARISSA 在准确率上仅比思维链低 0.8 个百分点，但延迟降低 2.7 倍；在 MedQA 上达到 85.7% 准确率（思维链 86.2%，延迟 33.0s vs 81.0s）；2) 服务器场景：HARISSA 在相似延迟下比 FrugalGPT 和 Self-REF 在 MedQA 上高 12 个百分点，在 BBH 上高约 20 个百分点；3) 转交人工场景：在 10% 转交率下，答案概率在 6 个任务-设置对中的 5 个上比序列似然、logit 边际和 Self-REF 置信度留下更少的错误答案；4) 探针分析：答案探针 AUROC（0.83-1.0）显著优于预填充探针（0.63-0.85），微调主要提升探针而非准确率；5) 在 Gemma 4 和 Cogito 模型族上得到类似结论，验证方法通用性。
AI.conclusion: 小型语言模型自身的隐藏状态可以独立决策：对每个查询是否直接回答或先推理、运行哪个模型尺寸、以及是否转交人工。预填充状态上的探针可在生成前跳过预测会失败的动作，答案状态上的探针可扣留预测错误的答案。HARISSA 在设备和服务器设置下均在准确率-延迟权衡上优于现有级联方法，答案概率作为转交信号优于标准置信度信号。该工作为完全本地的语言模型部署提供了实用且无需外部模型的推理时自适应机制。

title: Brain-SAD: A Brain-Inspired Safe Autonomous Driving Control Framework with Dynamic Fear-Oriented Constraint on Dual-Policy
summary: Constrained Reinforcement Learning has recently gained increasing attention in the field of Safe Autonomous Driving, where the general mechanism is to maximize the expected reward while keeping the overall action risk bounded. In this way, the safety issues arising in AD can be mitigated through constrained actions. However, existing Constrained RL methods still lack dynamics on the imposed constraints. For instance, the action cost adopted by the existing Primal-Dual/soft-constrained methods is often defined as static state-to-cost mapping, and the safe-action projection in hard-constrained methods relies on the static projection with the fixed feasible region boundary estimated from offline demonstrations. The above drawback tightly couples the imposed constraints to the training scenarios, leaving the AD policy hard to handle different interaction scenarios, due to the improper state-level action-cost and the static projection boundary. Consequently, in this paper, we propose Brain-SAD, a brain-inspired safe autonomous driving control framework with dynamic fear-oriented constraints. By perceiving the current vehicle-interaction scene, Brain-SAD generates dynamic fear signal as fear reaction to online decide long-term policy for regular interaction or short-term policy for urgent-collision defense. In such two policy, the above fear-reaction will be constructed as the dynamic fear constraints, respectively reflecting the overall fear cost directly coupled with action-impact, and the dynamic fear boundary of the feasible region derived from different risky neighbors, both of which will in turn serve for the online policy optimization. Experimental results show that Brain-SAD outperforms existing methods, achieving higher success rate in shorter task-completion and collision-recovery time, and exhibits stronger reliability across continuous intersections of fluctuating complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Brain-SAD，一个受大脑启发的安全自动驾驶控制框架，通过动态恐惧信号驱动的双策略选择机制，解决了现有约束强化学习方法中约束静态化的问题，在实验中展现出更高的成功率和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有约束强化学习方法（软约束Primal-Dual和硬约束方法）在安全自动驾驶中存在约束静态化问题：动作代价为静态状态映射，安全动作投影依赖固定的可行域边界，这导致约束与训练场景紧密耦合，使策略难以处理不同的交互场景。
AI.method: Brain-SAD框架包含三个核心组件：(1)当前场景想象与双策略选择模块（受杏仁核-前额叶通路启发），通过L步轨迹推演生成动态恐惧信号，经NE/5-HT神经递质竞争产生策略选择信号g_PFC；(2)在线长期动态恐惧约束策略（受纹状体直接/间接通路启发），通过动态恐惧代价Ψ^Fear构建奖励-代价约束，经拉格朗日优化求解最优后验动作分布；(3)在线短期动态恐惧投影策略（受超直接通路启发），基于风险邻居的制动需求构建动态恐惧边界Ψ^Fear约束可达动作集。同时采用在线到离线优化循环（MLE损失、选择损失、Critic/Actor损失）进行联合训练。
AI.result: 在SUMO仿真平台三个复杂度递增的无信号灯交叉口场景中，Brain-SAD在TCT、RECT、SR、Reward等关键指标上均优于14种基线方法（含CADRE、Iso-Dream++、RLfOLD、MARL-CCE、LS-Imagination、CarPlanner、SimLingo、Hybrid-Driving、SafeAuto、SVPG、FNI-RL、FoG-RL、EFT-RL、Goal-Reducer）。消融实验验证了场景想象、动态恐惧代价、KL散度、动态恐惧边界等各模块的必要性。在6个连续交叉口的压力测试中，Brain-SAD以99.9秒TCT和94% SR保持最优性能，且动作分布收敛稳定，恐惧信号与环境复杂度协调一致。
AI.conclusion: Brain-SAD首次将大脑感知-决策-动作的完整功能映射引入安全自动驾驶，通过动态恐惧约束与动作影响的耦合，实现了策略与环境扰动的协调，在连续复杂场景中展现出更强的可靠性。未来工作将探索基于大语言模型推理的更细粒度动态恐惧约束构建方法。

title: PE-EK-PINN: Physics Embedding with Evolving Kernel for Scalable Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) embed governing equations into deep learning, but enforce them only through loss residuals, leaving highly oscillatory wave behavior to be discovered by optimization. As a result, methods that achieve relative $L_2$ errors below $10^{-3}$ on standard manufactured Helmholtz benchmarks can fail on practical radiation problems involving singular excitations, absorbing boundaries, and wave fields spanning tens of wavelengths. Architectural physics embedding addresses this limitation by factorizing the field into analytically derived oscillatory kernels and learnable envelopes.
