AI.method: NowcastDiT 基于标准 DiT（12 层 Transformer、QK-Norm、3D RoPE、adaLN-Zero）做两项最小化适配：(1) **DyPro 动力学感知噪声先验**——通过下三角递归变换使相邻预报帧噪声相关（协方差 Cov(ε^s, ε^(s-k))=γ_t^{k/2} I），相关强度由扩散时间 t 调度，早期强相关、后期解耦，从而在不改变模型主干和训练目标的情况下注入时序一致性；(2) **时间步感知强化学习后训练**——采用 MixGRPO 在混合 ODE-SDE 轨迹上优化，奖励 R(x̂, x*; t)=(1-t)·R_noise + t·R_clean，其中 R_noise 用低阈值池化 CSI+SSIM 强调大范围结构，R_clean 用高阈值 CSI+(-LPIPS) 强调局部强降水细节。配合 Domain Guidance 整合 CFG。
AI.result: 在 SEVIR 和 MRMS 两个雷达基准上 NowcastDiT 均达到 SOTA：相对最强基线，SEVIR/MRMS 聚合 CSI 分别提升 8.7%/15.1%，HSS 提升 2.9%/13.8%，高阈值 CSI 提升 19.9%–31.4%（强降水探测能力显著增强），LPIPS 降低 4.8%/4.1%。SEVIR 上 SSIM 在生成方法中最优；MRMS 上 SSIM 略低于 DiT。累积消融显示 3D RoPE+QK-Norm、DyPro、RL 各有独立贡献；模型规模扩展（参数 scaling）持续提升 CSI；DyPro α=0.5 最优；CFG 与 RL 互补；时间步感知奖励在混合、纯 CSI、纯感知指标下均优于静态奖励。
AI.conclusion: 标准 Diffusion Transformer 已为降水短临预报提供足够的时空生成基础，无需专用架构改造。NowcastDiT 通过 DyPro 噪声先验和时间步感知 RL 后训练两项轻量适配，同时在感知质量与气象技巧上达到 SOTA，验证了"基础模型 + 最小领域适配"路线的有效性，并为后续跨观测系统、跨分辨率、跨预报时效的扩展奠定基础。

title: Selecting The Most Informative Tokens in Natural Language Autoencoders
summary: Natural language autoencoders translate a language model's internal activations into readable explanations. Explaining every token position is costly. Which positions should an auditor inspect to understand a potential threat? We study this question across $4.7$ million explanations on prompt injection and concealment. We compare signals from model computation with a ranker trained only on chat structure. Chat structure usually selects more relevant explanations than the computational signals, without requiring a model forward pass for position selection. On three of four datasets, explaining just $5\%$ of positions retains nearly all of the success rate from explaining every position, where success means obtaining an explanation about the threat. The benefit varies with the audit task. We also show that pretrained verbalizers recover words that models have learned to conceal through fine-tuning, without additional verbalizer training. These results identify where auditors can concentrate explanation generation and show that useful explanations can extend beyond the model a verbalizer was trained to describe.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自然语言自编码器（NLA）逐词解释成本过高的问题，系统研究了应优先解释哪些token位置。基于470万条解释，比较了13种计算信号与基于对话结构的排序器，发现仅利用聊天结构（无需模型前向传播）在多数情况下优于计算信号；仅解释5%的位置即可在三个数据集上保留近全部审计成功率。同时发现预训练verbalizer可直接恢复经微调隐藏的词汇。
AI.motivation: NLA将模型内部激活翻译为自然语言解释，但解释每个token位置成本高昂（平均每位置130个生成token），不适用于实时监控。以往工作依赖固定位置惯例（如最终token或均匀分布），可能遗漏关键信息。需要一种可计算的位置排序方法，使审计员聚焦于最可能揭示威胁的位置。
AI.method: 提出13种仅需单次前向传播即可计算的信号，分属三类家族：(1) 预测分布族（surprisal、entropy、varentropy、temporal_kl）；(2) 注意力模式族（lookback_ratio、sink_drain、head_disagreement、w）；(3) 激活向量族（resid_jump、norm_ratio、peak_ratio、dominant_mass、resid_jump_nla）。使用逻辑回归训练基于聊天结构（chat role、segment、位置）的轻量基线。在4个数据集（OpenPromptInjection、Tensor Trust、Liars' Bench、Taboo Organisms）和4个开源模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Gemma-3-12B/27B、Llama-3.3-70B）上生成共470万条解释，由DeepSeek-V4-Flash作为评判器标注每条解释是否与威胁相关（on-task）。通过AUROC和固定预算下的精度评估247个候选（13个信号+234对二信号集成）在保留验证集中的表现。
AI.result: 1. 激活向量信号在14个数据集-模型组合中的11个里单独最强；两两集成在所有14个组合的测试集上均提升排序。2. 仅基于聊天结构的排序器在14个组合中的12个里AUROC超过最佳单信号，且无需前向传播。3. 在三个数据集上，仅解释5%的位置即可保留至少95.8%的全位置解释成功率（OpenPromptInjection: 99.5%，Taboo: 95.8%，Tensor Trust: 100%）；Liars' Bench因证据分散需更多检查。4. 预训练verbalizer可恢复经LoRA微调隐藏的秘密词（moon/ship/snow），识别率14%-27%，同一文本同一prompt对三个不同organism产生不同答案，排除了文本反转解释。5. 信号方向随数据集变化，需针对具体威胁拟合；聊天结构基线在固定预算精度上通常优于计算信号集成。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明：(1) 审计员应优先使用对话结构而非模型计算信号来分配解释预算，在多数情况下无需模型前向传播即可获得更优选择；(2) 边界token（boundary）和输入末尾位置是最值得检查的区域，且这些位置在模型生成回复前即可用，支持实时干预；(3) NLA解释能泛化至未见过的微调模型，verbalizer可揭示模型被训练隐藏的信息；(4) 解释任务相关性而非内容正确性是检查解释的第一步。局限性在于仅使用单一评判模型、未测试其他层和较长智能体对话。

title: Beam Search as Test-Time Self-Distillation via Counterfactual Contexts
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Towards Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
summary: Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) enables a language model to act as its own teacher: by conditioning on a demonstration, the model produces an implicit reward via pointwise mutual information, which guides on-policy learning without external supervision. However, SDFT operates at training time: it requires gradient updates and access to expert demonstrations, making it inapplicable at inference. We propose test-time self-distillation, a decoding-time method that extracts a steering signal from the self-distillation framework without any parameter updates, reward models, or training data. Our key insight is that counterfactual contexts, i.e. fixed textual templates that hypothetically prime the model for excellent versus poor reasoning, can substitute for the demonstration. The log-odds ratio of a candidate answer under these two counterfactual conditions defines a new reward signal. We derive the optimal KL-regularized policy under this reward, which takes the form of a Gibbs reweighting of the base distribution. Crucially, this reweighting is global: it cannot be decomposed into independent per-token operations without ignoring future trajectory quality. We therefore approximate the target distribution via beam search. Experiments on mathematical reasoning (MATH500), code generation (HumanEval), and graduate-level science QA (GPQA) across multiple model scales show that test-time self-distillation improves over standard sampling, low temperature, beam search and power sampling baselines on average, demonstrating that the self-distillation principle can be operationalized at inference time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出测试时自蒸馏（Test-Time Self-Distillation）方法，通过反事实上下文（counterfactual contexts）替代SDFT中的专家演示，在无需参数更新、奖励模型或训练数据的前提下，利用对比PMI奖励引导解码，并通过对比束搜索（Contrastive Beam Search）近似全局Gibbs重加权目标分布。
AI.motivation: SDFT利用专家演示和点互信息奖励在训练时实现自蒸馏，但依赖梯度更新、专家演示和训练循环，无法在测试时部署。如何在推理阶段提取自蒸馏的指导信号，成为核心问题。
AI.method: 1) 用固定文本模板 c+（"优秀推理"提示）和 c-（"错误推理"提示）替代专家演示，构建对比PMI奖励 R(q,a)=logπ(a|q,c+)-logπ(a|q,c-)。2) 推导KL正则最优策略为Gibbs重加权分布（全局归一化），并证明逐token采样因忽略未来修正项ζ_t而产生不可分解的截断误差（Proposition 1）。3) 提出对比束搜索（CBS）：以K=32个token为块进行随机扩展，每块后用三上下文（基线、正、负）对数似然均值打分，按W=4剪枝保留top N/W候选，迭代T/K次完成搜索，并证明其截断误差有界且随生成推进递减（Theorem 1）。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-0.8B/2B、Qwen2.5-7B和DeepSeek-Math-7B-Instruct四个模型上，对MATH500、HumanEval和GPQA三个基准测试，CBS在12个设置中的11个取得最佳或并列最佳，相对低温度采样最高提升13.8%，相对标准束搜索最高提升12.2%，相对Power Sampling最高提升6.6%。消融实验证实增益源于正负上下文的语义对比（而非简单添加上下文），且CBS输出比标准束搜索少11-20%的token。块大小K呈倒U型，K=32为最优。
AI.conclusion: 自蒸馏原理可通过反事实上下文在测试时操作化，对比束搜索有效近似全局Gibbs目标分布。该方法无需参数更新、奖励模型或训练数据，为推理阶段利用模型自身条件分布指导生成提供了新路径。未来方向包括学习自适应上下文、KV-cache共享降低评分开销，以及在多步规划和智能体决策中应用。

title: A Comprehensive View of Fairness through Distributional Stability
summary: We view fairness as a property of distributional stability. Rather than assessing a predictor under a fixed data distribution, we study how its predictions change under perturbations that modify the composition of protected groups. A predictor is fair if it remains stable under such shifts. Under this perspective, several classical notions of fairness arise as stability with respect to specific perturbations, with the associated unfairness gap given by a Lipschitz constant of a prediction-rate functional. This formulation also yields guarantees that hold uniformly over a range of demographic compositions at test time, without requiring knowledge of the deployment distribution. It leads to a learning procedure based on convex combinations of reweighted predictors, formulated as a second-order cone program, for which we establish generalization bounds. Experiments on standard benchmarks illustrate the approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将算法公平性视为分布稳定性的性质，通过扰动敏感属性G的边际分布来评估预测器在群体组成变化下的稳定性，从而统一了个体公平性、人口统计平价和机会均等三种经典定义。核心方法STABLE通过凸组合重加权预测器，结合二阶锥规划（SOCP）优化目标和约束，并建立了完整的泛化界。实验在Adult Income、COMPAS和ACS Income三个基准数据集上验证了方法的竞争力。
AI.motivation: 传统公平性研究主要在固定数据分布下评估预测器，而实际部署中模型常面对不同人群组成（如不同地区、时间或机构），导致公平性保证退化。本文旨在提出一个统一框架，能够在不知道部署分布的情况下，同时保证训练和部署时的公平性。
AI.method: 1. 定义公平性为分布稳定性（Definition 4）：预测器在敏感属性G边际分布扰动下的稳定性；2. 证明个体公平性等价于局部特征扰动下的稳定性（Proposition 1），人口统计平价和机会均等等价于G的重采样扰动下的稳定性（Propositions 2-3）；3. 引入扰动方差泛函和t-方差泛函，将公平性约束转化为同时控制斜率γ(h)和绝对水平t的条件；4. 通过凸组合K个重加权ERM预测器，构建二阶锥规划（SOCP）求解；5. 通过Hoeffding不等式、Bernstein不等式和分层采样建立约束、不公平度、均匀部署和风险的收敛速率。
AI.result: 1. 理论：建立了约束满足、不公平度控制、均匀部署保证和风险近似四个方面的收敛速率，量级为Õ(n^{-1/2} + m^{-3/2} + N^{-β/(2β+d)})；2. 实验：在Adult Income上，STABLE在EO约束下优于所有基线（DP差距0.013±0.009），在COMPAS上DP约束下优于所有基线；3. 部署稳定性：在ACS Income地理迁移实验中，STABLE是唯一在所有11个测试州上预测率最接近目标值t的方法，而其他方法存在系统性地理偏差。
AI.conclusion: 本文从分布稳定性角度统一了多种公平性概念，提出的SOCP方法同时控制了公平性和部署稳定性，无需知道部署分布。优势在于：(1) 理论保证对所有人群组成均匀成立；(2) 相比DRO在KL散度Ω(1)半径下产生空泛保证，本文框架提供非平凡的部署保证；(3) 实验表明STABLE在公平性和部署稳定性上均具竞争力。局限性在于求解的是特定可处理的代理问题而非原始问题的完整版本，未来可探索更直接的解决方案和端到端保证。

title: Beyond Compression: Diagnosing How Post-Training Changes Mathematical Reasoning
comment: 18 pages, 17 figures, 10 tables. Includes technical appendix. Under review
summary: Post-training is central to mathematical reasoning in modern large language models (LLMs), but endpoint pass@1 alone underidentifies what has changed. Gains may reflect newly reachable solutions, cheaper sampling of latent solutions, surface robustness, or memorisation. We compare three post-training paths under a common diagnostic readout: our sufficiently trained off-policy distillation trajectories, released Qwen3 off-policy-plus-on-policy distillation endpoints, and a released DeepSeek-Math endpoint trained with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO). Our probe uses cross-surface pass@K over verbatim prompts, paraphrases, numerical isomorphisms, and translations, plus consistency, distribution-shape, and verified supervised-fine-tuning (SFT) membership analyses. We find two regimes. On easier AMC problems, large-K ceilings are near saturation, so post-training mainly compresses sample cost. On harder AIME problems, post-training expands the large-K ceiling over the base model: sufficient off-policy distillation already raises this ceiling, Qwen3 released endpoints raise it further, and DeepSeek-Math GRPO does not dominate sufficient off-policy distillation at large K. English-dominant distillation improves non-English reasoning but preserves language-tier gaps. A controlled-overfit audit finds limited sensitivity in current SFT-membership probes. Compression is one regime of post-training, not a universal explanation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"跨表面 pass@K"诊断框架，在三种数学推理后训练路径（离策略蒸馏、Qwen3 离策略+在策略蒸馏端点、DeepSeek-Math GRPO RL 端点）上对比发现：压缩（compression）仅是后训练的一种"模式"（regime），并非普遍解释——简单题上后训练主要压缩采样成本，难题上后训练才能真正扩展大 K 时的能力上限。
AI.motivation: 当前数学推理 LLM 的后训练效果仅以端点 pass@1 评估存在根本缺陷：相同的指标提升可能源于新可达解、潜在解的廉价采样、表面鲁棒性或记忆，但这些机制无法仅凭单点 pass@1 区分。先前关于 RL 主要"压缩采样成本"的论点与另一些显示 RL 能获取新组合行为的论点存在矛盾，缺乏统一诊断协议来厘清。
AI.method: 作者设计了一个共享诊断读出框架：(1) 在三种机制（M1=充分训练的离策略蒸馏轨迹/M2=Qwen3 离策略+在策略蒸馏端点/M3=DeepSeek-Math GRPO 端点）下对比 15 个检查点；(2) 提出跨表面 pass@K 探针，将 100 道竞赛题（AMC 2023 + AIME 2025/2026）扩展为 1200 个变体（T0 原文/T1 释义/T2 数字同构/T3 多语种翻译），K_max=224 在源问题层级池化；(3) 多实例一致性（all-3/any-1/fragile）分离表面鲁棒性；(4) 形式 vs 内容锐化（self-consistency、嵌入聚类、长度 CV 等描述符）刻画输出分布形状；(5) 9 种语言跨语言分析；(6) 控制过拟合记忆审计（200 题 seen vs 200 题 MD5-不相交 unseen，10/20 epoch 过拟合，三种探针：行为前缀续写、行为禁 CoT、前向 MIA）。训练方面在 4×A100-40GB 节点上用 FSDP+bf16+verl SFT 训练器进行全参数微调，3 个 epoch，cosine 调度，峰值 lr=2e-5。
AI.result: 两个截然不同的模式被发现：(1) **简单 AMC 模式**：大 K 天花板已近饱和（pass@224 在 90-100%），后训练主要降低采样成本——基模型 ratio（pass@224/pass@1）高达 40×（DSMath），3 epoch SFT 后降至 ~8.9×，机制差异在饱和天花板下基本消失。(2) **困难 AIME 模式**：基模型仍有大量提升空间，后训练确实扩展了天花板——Qwen3-4B pass@224 从 47→77（SFT-ep3）→90（端点），Qwen3-8B 从 55→83→90；DeepSeek-Math GRPO RL 端点在 pass@1 上略优（+5.8 pp，bootstrap 唯一排除零），但在 K≥48 所有点估计上均不优于充分训练的离策略蒸馏端点（pass@224 45→37，Δ=-8 pp）。多实例一致性上 Qwen3 端点 all-3 从 26%→84%（4B），33%→87%（8B），fragility 降至 6%/3%；DSMath RL 端点则与 SFT-ep3 几乎无差（20% vs 21%）。形式/内容锐化可分离——Qwen3 同时锐化两者，DSMath RL 仅做"支持收缩而无模态合并"（maj 不变但 nu 收缩 -66%）。跨语言方面英语主导蒸馏提升所有非英语（+4 到 +49 pp），但保留强/弱语言层级差距，斯瓦希里语在所有模型/机制上都是稳定底线（DSMath 上甚至从 9→4 退化 -56%）。记忆审计中前向 MIA AUC 仅在 [.51, .65] 范围，远低于 Shi 等人报告的 Min-K% Prob 0.88，表明当前 SFT-成员探针灵敏度有限——这界定了探针能力而非现象本身。
AI.conclusion: 压缩只是后训练的一种模式，不是推理提升的普遍解释。简单问题主要暴露采样成本压缩，困难问题则显示充分后训练（甚至纯离策略蒸馏）即可在基模型之上扩展可达天花板。评估推理进展因此需要超越端点 pass@1 的表面感知、轨迹感知、成员控制诊断。机制不可互换：Qwen3 离策略+在策略蒸馏端点同时实现天花板扩展、表面一致性巩固、答案内容合并；DeepSeek-Math GRPO 端点仅在小 K 时锐化采样分布，不增加大 K 天花板或表面一致性。后训练不会消除继承的语料覆盖不对称（语言层级差距保留），且当前 SFT-成员探针灵敏度不足以可靠检测 SFT 特定记忆。

title: Identifying ODEs from Unstructured Data with Causal Representation Learning
summary: We study the problem of recovering the governing ODE of a dynamical system from unstructured, high-dimensional observations such as images. Existing methods for ODE discovery typically assume direct measurements of the variables, or do not provide theoretical guarantees on the learned variables and equations. While Causal Representation Learning (CRL) methods provide guarantees on identifying variables from high-dimensional observations up to component-wise diffeomorphisms, we show that in general these variables cannot be used directly as input to equation discovery methods, which typically assume that the variables will lead to sparse equations. So we introduce SParse Equivalent Equation Discovery AutoEncoder (SPEED-AE), a framework that combines a pretrained CRL method with a component-wise autoencoder that learns transformations of variables that are amenable to sparse ODE discovery. We show that for polynomial ODEs, this additional step allows us to restrict the identifiability of each variable from polynomial to monomial diffeomorphisms. Experiments on Lotka-Volterra, Lorenz, and a two-pendulum system show that SPEED-AE improves on the disentanglement of the CRL methods and that it recovers ODEs that are closest to the ground truth, while achieving state-of-the-art forecasting performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPEED-AE框架,结合因果表示学习(CRL)与逐分量自编码器,从非结构化高维观测数据中恢复可解释的物理理论。理论分析证明对于多项式ODEs,稀疏性约束可将变量可辨识性从多项式微分同胚限制到单项式微分同胚。在Lotka-Volterra、Lorenz和双摆系统上的实验表明,该方法在变量解耦、ODE恢复和预测性能上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有ODE发现方法通常假设可直接测量变量,或不提供理论保证。CRL方法虽然能从高维观测中识别变量(至逐分量微分同胚),但其识别变量不能直接用于方程发现方法(假设变量将产生稀疏方程)。仅解耦性或仅稀疏性都不能保证同时识别真实结构变量及其控制方程。
AI.method: 提出SPEED-AE框架:在预训练CRL模型(如CITRIS或DMSVAE)之后,引入逐分量自编码器(φ_enc, φ_dec),学习使变换后变量产生稀疏ODE方程的映射。通过理论分析(Lemma 3.1)证明:对多项式ODE,若学习方程与真实方程一样稀疏,则逐分量多项式微分同胚可限制为单项式变换。实现支持SINDy和MNN两种方程发现方法。
AI.result: 在Lotka-Volterra、Lorenz(稳定ρ=14和混沌ρ=28)和双摆(64×64真实图像)系统上,SPEED-AE均优于SINDyAE和MNNAE基线。在相关性差异、ODE系数恢复和轨迹预测方面达到最优,恢复的ODE最接近真实方程。在Lotka-Volterra长轨迹上,LSTM和Transformer误差比SPEED-AE高约20倍。SPEED-AE还能将学到的解耦表示迁移到新参数设置下的相同系统而不损失性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了仅解耦或仅稀疏不足以同时从高维数据学习真实结构变量及其控制方程。SPEED-AE通过CRL与稀疏性驱动的逐分量自编码器的结合,提供了变量可辨识性至单项式变换的理论保证,并在多个基准上达到最优性能。局限在于结果依赖CRL的解耦质量,理论分析限于非消项假设和多项式微分同胚。

title: ARGOS: Reinforcement Learning-Driven Multidimensional Elasticity for Service Orchestration in the Computing Continuum
summary: Data-intensive services in the Computing Continuum must balance analytics quality, resource usage, and cost across heterogeneous nodes with limited and uneven capacity. This balance becomes especially difficult when resource scaling reaches capacity limits, because changes in demand and cluster pressure must then be absorbed without violating client-defined quality ranges. Existing orchestrators mainly adapt resources, placements, or replicas, while analytics requirements such as coverage, sample, and freshness remain fixed. This article presents ARGOS, the Adaptive Reinforcement Learning-Driven Governance for Orchestrated Services, an end-to-end controller that formulates multidimensional elasticity as a per-request Markov decision process over analytics quality and cluster pressure, supported by capacity-aware admission. ARGOS is evaluated under controlled workloads and time-varying multi-tenant arrivals on a heterogeneous cluster. Across the controlled scenarios, the deep reinforcement learning policies consistently outperform the non-learning baselines and approach the independently tuned best-fixed reference. A separate live evaluation reports improvements over the static midpoint under realistic and saturated arrivals, with no recorded CPU or memory violations but remaining coverage violations. These results support deep reinforcement learning as an adaptive mechanism for multidimensional elasticity when resource scaling alone is insufficient.

AI.tldr: ARGOS提出了一种基于深度强化学习的端到端编排框架，将多维弹性(coverage/sample/freshness)建模为每个请求的MDP，在计算连续域异构集群容量受限时通过容量感知准入与每请求控制实现analytics质量与资源压力的自适应权衡。
AI.motivation: Computing Continuum中数据密集型服务的analytics质量需求(coverage/sample/freshness)目前被作为固定值处理，但当基础设施弹性达到容量上限时，仅靠资源扩缩已无法满足SLO，亟需将analytics需求本身作为可调控制维度。
AI.method: 1) 端到端架构：含客户端、ARGOS编排器(含准入控制、每请求控制器、运行时监控、部署管理、审计日志)和异构Continuum三层；2) 每个请求表示为13维MDP状态，7个离散动作(hold/inc/dec on 三维度)，奖励函数含质量+7类惩罚；3) 实现Q-learning、DQN、PPO三种学习策略及静态中点、阈值反应、最优固定三种非学习基线；4) 两阶段评估协议——控制阶段冻结策略对比，实时阶段模拟多租户到达；5) 使用独立训练/调优/评估种子集、SHA-256策略指纹、JSONL追加日志保障可复现性。
AI.result: 在控制实验中，DQN和PPO在所有5个seed×2种运行时下均优于静态中点和反应式阈值，DQN恢复约72-76%的最优固定参考奖励，PPO恢复约67-68%；空间保真度提升至0.931-0.940(参考为0.950)，且服务负载更低(PPO在thread上10.9% vs 参考16.8%)。实时实验中两种深度控制器在合理和饱和到达下均提升平均决策奖励与保真度，PPO在饱和条件下每对比较均优于静态中点，未记录CPU或内存违约但因3节点测试床粒度问题存在coverage上限违约。Q-learning未优于静态中点。
AI.conclusion: 深度强化学习作为多维弹性的自适应机制在资源扩缩不足时有效，但仅在深度控制器层面成立，表格Q-learning不构成部署候选；可复现评估方法(冻结策略、指纹验证、独立种子、审计日志)强化了对比可信度。未来工作应探索连续动作空间、增加seed数与更大规模Continuum拓扑的泛化研究。

title: What Does Post-Training Change in Multilingual Reasoning?
comment: 20 pages, 9 figures, 21 tables. Main paper and supplementary material in one document
summary: Open-source reasoning models provide unequal access to reasoning capability across languages. When a model can solve a problem but cannot deliver a complete solution in the user's language, language becomes an access barrier rather than merely a source of performance variation. We audit Qwen3 checkpoints on competition-mathematics tasks in eleven languages. Across the ten non-English languages, only 15.4-17.9% of problems receive a correct, terminating solution with visible reasoning in the requested language in any of 16 samples, compared with 92.9% in English. To identify the source of this disparity, we evaluate thirteen endpoints from one model family, spanning released checkpoints, multilingual supervised fine-tuning (SFT) at two scales, controlled SFT ablations, and three reinforcement-learning (RL) reward formulations. We jointly track correctness, language adherence, termination, and delivery efficiency. The dominant bottleneck shifts across post-training stages. Released models often reason in English. Multilingual SFT restores target-language reasoning, but accuracy declines across multilingual, English-only, and single-language SFT runs, showing that this cost is not specific to multilingual mixing; non-English reasoning traces additionally become prone to non-terminating loops. RL restores termination in both arms at no cost in accuracy, but only the arm whose reward includes a language term delivers: rewarding correctness alone returns the model to English. Together, these stages establish a constructive post-training path from English-pivoted capability to multilingual reasoning that is reliably delivered.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过控制性阶段分析，揭示了开源推理模型（如Qwen3）在多语言推理中从"具备能力"到"实际交付"的瓶颈迁移，并提出一条由SFT修复语言依从性、RL恢复终止性、正确性门控奖励维持交付的构造性后训练路径。
AI.motivation: 开源推理模型名义上具备多语言能力，但常用最终答案准确率作为评估指标，掩盖了语言不依从、生成不终止等真实失败模式，导致语言成为访问壁垒而非仅仅是性能差异来源。已有研究虽分别记录了多语言准确率、语言依从、效率和可靠性等方面的差距，但这些差距代表不同的失败模式，且通常在不同系统或孤立训练阶段被观察，无法揭示训练某一阶段的瓶颈是什么以及干预后如何变化。
AI.method: 在同一个Qwen3模型族内、固定评估协议下，端到端审计13个端点（2个发布检查点+8个SFT端点+3个RL端点）。定义响应级联合成功J=C∧L∧T（正确性∧目标语言依从∧正常终止），在70道竞赛数学题、11种语言、每题16样本下联合追踪正确率C、语言依从L、终止率T和交付效率。SFT阶段构建多语言SFT语料（基于45K OpenR1长链推理轨迹，经Qwen3-14B翻译并质量筛选）与English-only/单语言专家对照；RL阶段基于同一多语言SFT检查点比较三种PPO奖励设计：纯正确性控制R_corr=C_tr、加性语言奖励R_add=0.7C_tr+0.3ℓ_tr、以及门控奖励R_gate=C_tr(0.7+0.3ℓ_tr)。同时设计"英语问题+目标语言指令"探针和冰岛语/瑞典语/斯瓦希里语/泰米尔语/乌尔都语等未见语言的鲁棒性审计。
AI.result: 发布检查点：英语交付率92.9%，10种非英语语言中仅15.4–17.9%（4B/8B）问题获得完整正确的目标语言推理交付；瓶颈是语言依从而非终止（西班牙语/法语/阿拉伯语依从率≤0.1%），问题语言比指令更强。多语言SFT：将非英语依从率从39.8%提升至99.4%（4B），交付率从35.7%升至84.6%（4B）和86.3%（8B），但产生通用准确率代价（English-only和单语言专家SFT也出现同等幅度的英语正确率下降），且非英语推理轨迹出现非终止循环（4B非英语终止失败率4.7%→21.1%）。RL阶段：纯正确性奖励将终止失败恢复至0.3%但模型退回英语（依从率8.7%，交付率仅15.4%）；加性语言奖励虽可恢复依从（99.8%）但正确错误答案也领取语言学分（错误轨迹占奖励支付的44–82%）；门控奖励R_gate同时恢复终止（0.5%）并维持99.8%依从，交付率81.7%，调整后非英语交付效率达英语的102%。瓶颈依此迁移：发布→语言选择→SFT后终止→RL后回答正确性。
AI.conclusion: 多语言后训练重新分配了相关失败模式而非统一改善单一能力；评估单独的正确率、语言依从或终止率会同时遗漏干预所消除的瓶颈和替代它的失败。三个阶段构成一条构造性后训练路径——SFT修复语言依从、RL恢复终止、正确性门控的语言奖励在保持准确率的同时改进端到端多语言交付——将发布检查点已具备的英语核心能力转化为正确、完整且效率可与英语媲美的目标语言解决方案。但该路径依赖于将问题本身完整本地化：经过SFT和门控RL后，英语问题+目标语言指令仍几乎无法触发非英语推理，表明模型学会的是端到端本地化问题-解决方案的关联，而非通过指令自由切换推理语言的一般能力。

title: VACE: Validation-Gated Alternating Co-Evolution of Agent Models and Harnesses
summary: Language model agents can be improved by updating their model weights or refining the harness that guides task execution. These components are coupled: weight updates change how the model uses the harness, while harness updates change the trajectories used for training. We propose VACE, Validation-Gated Alternating CoEvolution, which alternates agentic reinforcement learning with trajectory-driven harness refinement. After each RL stage, VACE reuses the collected trajectories to propose a harness revision and evaluates the incumbent and candidate with the updated model held fixed. The candidate guides subsequent training only if it improves validation performance. With Qwen3.5-9B, VACE achieves 45.26% test accuracy on OfficeQA and a mean partial-credit score of 75.19% on AutomationBench, exceeding weight-only RL by 6.43 and 9.09 percentage points and ungated alternation by 4.59 and 6.95 points, respectively. Across 44 harness proposals, 17 reduce validation performance at the updated checkpoint and are rejected before subsequent RL training, highlighting the importance of validation gating.

AI.tldr: VACE提出了一种交替联合优化智能体模型权重与"harness"（指导任务执行的系统配置）的框架。其核心是验证门控机制：每次强化学习阶段后，收集轨迹并提出harness修订方案，但在更新后的模型权重上验证，只有验证性能提升的方案才被采纳用于下一轮训练。该方法在Qwen3.5-9B上的OfficeQA和AutomationBench两个基准上均优于仅训练权重和未加门控的交替方案。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体的性能取决于模型权重与harness（指令、技能、工具接口等）两个耦合的组件。仅优化其中一个组件会留下未解决的问题：权重更新改变模型使用harness的方式，harness更新改变训练所用的轨迹。该论文旨在通过联合优化模型权重与harness来应对这一耦合问题，同时避免有损的harness变更损害训练过程。
AI.method: VACE（验证门控交替协同进化）框架包含三个阶段：(1) 智能体强化学习阶段——使用当前harness训练模型权重并收集执行轨迹；(2) 基于轨迹的harness优化阶段——复用训练轨迹诊断失败模式并提出修订候选；(3) 验证门控阶段——固定更新后的模型权重，在相同验证任务上对比当前与候选harness，仅当候选harness验证得分严格更高时才被采纳（平局保留当前harness）。该循环通过Uni-Agent平台实现，采用GRPO结合DAPO风格的优势过采样与零优势组过滤。harness优化器基于HarnessEvolve改编而来。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-9B上，VACE在OfficeQA上达到45.26%准确率，在AutomationBench上达到75.19%平均部分得分。分别超过仅权重RL 6.43和9.09个百分点，超过WHALE式未门控交替4.59和6.95个百分点。在44次harness提案中，17次降低了更新检查点处的验证性能而被拒绝，验证了门控机制的必要性。OfficeQA接受7/12提案，AutomationBench接受18/32提案。
AI.conclusion: VACE验证了模型权重与harness联合优化的价值，其显式验证门控是必要的，因为许多候选修订在更新后的检查点处实际上会降低性能。该框架超越了单组件优化和未门控交替方案。论文承认存在局限性：固定验证集的重复使用可能引入自适应选择效应、固定调度策略可能不够灵活、研究范围仅限于单一模型规模和两个基准。

title: Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training
summary: Recent approaches to reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for large language models increasingly remove the critic to reduce training instability and memory overhead. Even where a critic is trained, it is discarded once training ends, although it has learned to predict outcomes. We revisit this trend and show that a pretrained critic's ability to predict future outcomes can make it a valuable asset for efficient long-horizon reasoning. First, we find that instability in critic-based RL for long chain-of-thought reasoning is largely an optimization artifact: keeping policy updates small and low in variance restores stable convergence. Second, a well-pretrained critic estimates the posterior probability of eventual success from later trajectory states and unfinished prefixes. Its predictions provide outcome-derived, dense, per-prefix learning signals that, during policy optimization, require neither completed rollouts, step-level annotations, nor external reward labels. Building on this insight, we introduce Reward-Free Policy Optimization (RFPO), which repurposes a single calibrated, frozen critic as a rollout-level reward, a value baseline for generalized advantage estimation, and a success forecaster for unfinished prefixes. We further show that binarizing the debiased score stops the policy from exploiting the critic's length bias. Binarized, RFPO matches supervised PPO without a single label in the training loop, while cutting compute and memory overhead. This makes RFPO well suited to long-horizon reasoning tasks, where outcomes arrive late and generation dominates cost: because rollouts can be rewarded before they finish, training no longer has to pay for waiting on every trajectory to complete. Our findings challenge the prevailing critic-free paradigm and establish critic-based, reward-free optimization as a scalable and computationally efficient path for LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RFPO（Reward-Free Policy Optimization），将预训练好的冻结 critic 同时用作 rollout 级奖励、GAE 基线和未完成前缀的成功预测器，通过二值化去偏分数消除长度偏差，无需任何外部标签即可在数学推理任务上达到与全监督 PPO 相当的水平，并显著降低长 horizon 场景下的计算与显存开销。
AI.motivation: 当前 LLM 推理 RL 后训练的主流趋势是抛弃 critic（价值网络），理由是训练不稳定、显存开销大且价值估计不可靠。然而 critic 实际上学习了预测未来成功概率的能力，这一信息被完全浪费。同时，等待稀疏终态奖励（尤其在长 CoT / 长 horizon 场景下）是主要成本来源。因此需要重新审视 critic 的角色，并利用它来避免等待完整 rollout 结束。
AI.method: 1) 稳定性分析：发现 critic-based RL 在长 CoT 上的不稳定是优化伪影——保持策略更新小且低方差（单次梯度更新、mini-batch 等于全 batch、无内循环）即可恢复稳定收敛。2) RFPO 框架：冻结一个经过良好预训练的 critic V̅_φ（从监督 PPO 提取），校准一次后，在策略优化阶段同时扮演三个角色——rollout 级奖励 r̂=𝟙[v(x,y)-b(ℓ)>τ]、GAE 基线、未完成前缀的成功预测器。3) 校准：用 512 条 on-policy rollout 拟合长度十分位去偏项 b(ℓ)（在正确性类别内估计）和阈值 τ（使正样本率匹配验证器正样本率），在 93.4% 校准准确率下冻结。4) 二值化：连续分数会让策略利用 critic 的长度偏差（缩短或加长响应），二值化切断该通道。5) GAE 简化为 A_t = r̂ - V̅_φ(x,y_{≤t})，用 PPO 裁剪目标更新 actor，critic 完全冻结。6) 可选监督分数 p 允许混入部分验证器标签作为连续调节旋钮。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B-Base + DAPO-Math-17k 数学推理任务上：1) 训练稳定性：在 310-378 步内三个零标签 RFPO run 均稳定收敛，熵从 0.32 平滑下降至 0.21-0.22，响应长度保持在起始值 ±13% 范围内。2) 性能匹配：四个基准（AIME25/26、AMC23、GPQA-Diamond）平均 pass@1 达 41.1%，与全监督 PPO 的 41.8% 相当，AIME26 与 GPQA 上分别领先 0.2 和 0.7 点；零标签训练时验证曲线峰值 AIME26 pass@1 为 25.7% vs PPO 25.0%。3) 连续奖励的天花板：用去偏连续分数作奖励时，56% 去偏强度臂在 AIME26 pass@1 达 29.2（高于监督 PPO 的 25.0，全文最高），但随后退化，二值化以该峰值换取稳定性。4) 长度偏差与二值化效果：原始分数奖励下响应长度在 100 步内缩短 73%；不校准的固定阈值仍缩短 20%；完整 Eq.(2) 规则保持稳定。5) 部分监督：50% 标签臂平均 41.3%，与两端相当，pass@8 达 39.1% 高于两极端。6) 关键优势——提前评分：在 5,120 token 训练 cap 下 26.5-28.5% rollout 未完成；在 4,096 token cap 下约一半未完成，RFPO 在该 cap 下平均验证 47.6%，优于同 cap 监督 PPO 的 46.6%，与 5,120 cap 水平相当；4096 cap 下 300 步用 264 GPU-小时 vs 同 cap 监督 PPO 327 GPU-小时、5,120 cap 监督 PPO 388 GPU-小时。7) 计算开销：每步 421s vs 582s（−28%），吞吐 +35%，峰值显存省 9.4 GB/GPU；critic 训练步骤消失，价值前向既给 GAE 也给奖励。8) 退化下限：1,024 token cap 下仅 0.7% rollout 完成，critic 不可用，验证下降 10 点；说明需要足够 cap 使 rollout 形态与 critic 拟合分布相近。9) 连续奖励退化成因：56% 臂中"答案重述"次数从 1.8 升至 68，与验证准确率相关系数 r=−0.87，但熵和分数差距未预警。
AI.conclusion: critic 移除趋势的核心理由（不稳定、不可靠）应归因于优化策略而非价值网络本身；RFPO 证明一个冻结、经过良好预训练的 critic 可作为唯一的 rollout 级奖励、GAE 基线和未完成前缀的成功预测器，无需任何验证器标签即在长 CoT 数学推理上匹配全监督 PPO，同时节省约 19-28% 的 GPU 时间和约 9 GB/GPU 显存。其核心优势在于可对截断 rollout 评分，适合生成成本主导的长 horizon 场景。该工作挑战了主流的 critic-free 范式，建立了基于 critic 的无奖励优化作为 LLM 后训练的可扩展、计算高效路径。

title: Lucid Dreaming for World Models: Learning to Doubt Imagination and Decide by Trust
comment: 30 pages, 22 figures, 8 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: World models enable agents to learn and plan in imagination, but predictions beyond their experience can become unreliable and mislead decisions. Existing uncertainty estimates derived from predictions can remain overconfident on unfamiliar state-action pairs. We propose the Lucid World Model (LucidWM), which learns doubt from experience and propagates trust through imagination. By integrating Subjective Logic into categorical latent transitions, LucidWM distinguishes predicted outcomes from their evidential support and assigns each transition a degree of doubt. The complement of this doubt defines transition-level trust, which accumulates multiplicatively along imagined trajectories to reweight returns for policy learning and guide action selection. Uncertainty estimation requires no additional parameters or forward passes. Evaluated on four base world models against seventeen uncertainty readouts, LucidWM detects environmental changes and signals uncertainty during action-corrupted rollouts. In a controlled navigation case study, acting on trust reduces the number of steps required to reach the goal from 362 to 190. Fifteen demonstration videos show how LucidWM doubts its dreams and acts on that doubt. Videos are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出Lucid World Model (LucidWM)，将主观逻辑（Subjective Logic）融入分类型潜在转移中，从经验中学习"怀疑度"（doubt），并通过信任度（trust）的累积沿想象轨迹传播，以更可靠地量化世界模型在超出经验范围时的认知不确定性，无需额外参数或前向传播。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型的不确定性估计多从预测分布中读取（如熵、方差、集成分歧），在面对未经历过的状态-动作对时往往仍然过度自信；且点状不确定性无法捕捉沿想象轨迹的累积不确定性，导致智能体利用模型错误进行行为学习。
AI.method: 1) 将转换头的logits视为Dirichlet分布的证据，定义"怀疑度" u = W/(W+S)，由证据总量S决定，并引入证据正则（evidence discipline）使证据总量匹配经验计数；2) 将观察通过累积融合（cumulative fusion）与预测结合，保证观察永不提高怀疑度；3) 用怀疑度的补数定义步级信任 τ，多步信任沿轨迹乘法累积为 C_n；4) 在λ-return中用 λτ 替代 λ，实现信任加权回报；5) 决策时通过信任评分候选动作，当信任崩塌时启动否决机制。
AI.result: 在四个世界模型基座（DreamerV3、R2-Dreamer、EMERALD、OC-STORM）和十七种不确定性读出上的实验显示：LucidWM在环境变化检测（maze新房间AUROC最优）和动作腐败检测（DMC和Crafter的ρ₁/ρ₀ lift最优）上均领先；信任加权作为过滤器在深度内比熵多消除23%误差；在导航案例中，基于信任的否决机制将到达目标步数从362降至190；在Crafter上将死亡率从4.08降至3.80/千步，且学习更快（0.35M步达到基座0.96M步才达到的回报水平）。
AI.conclusion: 标准分类型世界模型是LucidWM的两个常数（u≡ε、τ≡1）均被钉死的特例；通过将怀疑度从经验中学习并沿轨迹以信任形式累积传播，LucidWM无需增加参数或前向传播即可提供更可靠的认知不确定性，使智能体能识别环境变化、回滚不安全决策并更快学习。

title: Trajectory Soup: Pushing the Compute-Scaling Frontier of LLM Mid-training via Diverse Trajectories
summary: Mid-training equips pretrained large language models with specialized and reasoning capabilities, but the returns of this stage are bounded since additional serial compute yields little further downstream improvement and can even degrade some capabilities, which places a practical ceiling on how much compute mid-training absorbs. We revisit how this compute should be allocated to a single run or multiple similar optimizations. We find that branches forked from a shared checkpoint under various controlled recipe reaches measurably different regions of parameter space, and establish a form of compatible diversity that extending one run cannot supply. Therefore, we introduce Trajectory Soup, which distributes a mid-training budget over several independent branches, and consolidates strongest checkpoints selected on validation through intra- and inter-trajectory averaging into a single model. A local bias and variance analysis separates the two averaging levels, showing that inter-trajectory averaging removes residual error beyond the reach of averaging within a trajectory, while checkpoint selection carries a bias that bounds how many checkpoints are worth merging. Across model scales, learning-rate schedules, token budgets, and trajectory counts, Trajectory Soup improves aggregate downstream performance over the strongest single-trajectory average under matched budgets and keeps improving as budgets expand, with the advantage preserved after an identical post-training pipeline. These results position trajectory allocation and merging as a practical way to extend the compute-scaling frontier of mid-training beyond serial saturation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Trajectory Soup方法，通过在LLM中训练阶段从共享检查点分叉多个独立分支并进行轨迹内与轨迹间两层检查点平均，将中训练计算预算从单条延长轨迹重分配为多条并行短轨迹，以突破串行中训练的性能饱和瓶颈。
AI.motivation: LLM中训练存在性能饱和的天花板：继续延长单条训练轨迹的计算投入，边际下游收益递减甚至出现能力退化。如何将固定的中训练计算预算在"单条长轨迹"与"多条并行短轨迹"之间进行更优分配，是本文要解决的核心问题。
AI.method: 1) 从同一预训练检查点分叉N条受控多样化的分支（通过数据洗牌种子、学习率、批量大小、学习率调度或优化器等维度扰动），并以训练损失相对差距≤1%作为兼容性筛选；2) 轨迹内合并：在每条分支上按验证损失排序并对Top-K个检查点均匀平均，生成分支锚点；3) 轨迹间合并：再对所有分支锚点均匀平均，得到最终模型。理论方面，在局部二次验证损失模型下用偏置-方差分解证明两层均匀平均的方差最优性，并推导了层级方差缩减公式 E[L] - L* = B_soup(K) + V_intra/(N·K_eff(K)) + V_inter/N。
AI.result: 在Ling-3.0-tiny（7.9B总量/1.3B激活MoE）默认600B token分支长度上，Trajectory Soup (Extended) 在中训练5类能力综合评测上取得68.96%的Overall Average，优于最强单轨迹合并(68.55)、Model Soup Extended (68.67)及Model Soup Limited (68.43)。在2B小模型+WSD调度上同样有效(50.07 vs 49.55)。优势在统一SFT后训练流程后仍然保持(61.52 vs 61.11)。通过固定合并检查点总数M=12并控制候选池大小匹配的消融实验，证明增益来自轨迹多样性而非更密集的检查点采样；近正交分支对的方向夹角与插值收益呈强负相关(Pearson r=-0.80, Spearman ρ=-0.94)。沿轨迹数量N和每轨迹检查点数K的扩展实验表明，增益主要来自轨迹宽度（分支数）而非深度（每分支检查点数），且存在有限的最优K（约10-16个），K随N增加而减少。
AI.conclusion: Trajectory Soup将中训练计算分配的轴从"延长单轨迹"扩展为"增加并行轨迹数"，通过受控多样化分叉与两层选择性检查点合并，有效突破了串行中训练的性能饱和天花板。该方法在模型规模、学习率调度、token预算、轨迹数等维度上均稳健有效，优势可持续到后训练阶段。理论分析在局部二次模型下证明了两层均匀平均的方差最优性，并精确刻画了由检查点选择引入的选择偏差对合并数量的限制。该方法将权重空间合并定位为将并行探索转化为单一交付模型的通用框架，适用于持续预训练、领域适配及后训练等多个共享初始化的场景。

title: Interpolated Policy Distillation: A Controllable Continuum Between Off-Policy and On-Policy Distillation
summary: Off-policy and on-policy distillation have traditionally been formulated as separate paradigms, each favoring a different property of distillation trajectories. Teacher-generated (off-policy) traces are typically high-quality but lie far from the student's distribution, whereas student-generated (on-policy) rollouts are more learnable but often contain erroneous reasoning. We view these paradigms as the endpoints of a policy continuum and posit that a more effective rollout policy may lie in between. We introduce \textbf{Interpolated Policy Distillation (IPD)}, which defines the next-token distribution at every decoding step as an explicit linear interpolation between the student and teacher distributions. The interpolation operates at the distribution level, token by token, and its coefficient provides direct control over the balance between trajectory quality and student learnability. Naively sampling from this policy would require sequentially querying the teacher at every token and is thus expensive. To make IPD practical, we accelerate it with a new speculative-decoding rule while exactly preserving the interpolated next-token this http URL the trajectory level, the resulting rollouts naturally interleave student- and teacher-generated segments. Unlike recent heuristic segment-interleaving methods, however, this interleaving is induced by an exactly realized token-level interpolated policy rather than by hand-designed switching rules. Across text-only and multimodal reasoning benchmarks, IPD consistently outperforms both endpoint policies (SFT and OPD), their conventional two-stage combination (SFT-then-OPD), and recent heuristic segment-interleaving methods, demonstrating that token-level policy interpolation better balances trajectory quality and student learnability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出插值策略蒸馏（IPD），将离策略与在策略蒸馏统一为一条可通过单一系数 γ 控制的策略连续谱，并在每个 token 层面通过线性插值学生与教师分布生成 rollout；为避免逐 token 调用教师，提出基于学生提议/教师验证的推测式采样规则以无偏保持插值分布，并据此对接受 token 用 OPD 监督、对修正 token 用交叉熵监督，在文本与多模态推理基准上一致优于 SFT、OPD、两阶段组合及启发式分段干预方法。
AI.motivation: 离策略（SFT）轨迹质量高但偏离学生分布、可学性差；在策略（OPD）轨迹可学性好但弱学生易产生错误推理。两者在"轨迹质量 vs. 学生可学性"上各有取舍，作者主张应在二者之间寻找一个可控、可精确表征的 rollout 策略。
AI.method: 1) 策略连续谱：定义每步 next-token 分布 m_γ = (1-γ)π_θ + γπ_T，γ∈[0,1] 精确控制策略在师生之间的位置，并给出其与师生 TV 距离的闭式关系。2) 加速采样：把学生作为 draft、教师评估 m_γ 的推测式采样，规则性地接受学生提议或在首个拒绝处以残差分布 [q−p]₊/D_TV(p,q) 做修正，理论上证明对任意 γ 仍精确采样于 m_γ。3) 验证感知监督：被接受的 token 沿用 k₁ 估计器 + PPO 式裁剪代理目标；被修正的 token 用直接极大似然（交叉熵）监督，二者在同一 rollout 内按 z_t 自动切换，形成统一目标 ℒ_IPD。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B→{0.6B/1.7B-Base} 文本推理及 Qwen3-VL-8B→2B（原始与剪掉最后 3 层）多模态推理上，IPD（γ=0.1）平均准确率均高于 SFT、vanilla OPD、SFT-then-OPD 及 SKD/Relay-OPD：1.7B-Base 平均 +1.93、0.6B-Base 平均 +10.64；多模态完整学生 50.22 vs. OPD 48.48，剪枝后学生 44.64 vs. 27.90（接近未剪枝 45.87）。γ 消融在 0.05–0.1 处最佳；γ 从 0.5 衰减至 0.1 优于升至 0.9；IPD 对 SFT 冷启动不敏感，无冷启动即超过 SFT+OPD 的最佳结果。DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B→Skywork-OR1-7B 平均由 41.37 提升至 42.18。
AI.conclusion: 显式地在 token 级定义插值 rollout 策略，并配合无偏推测式采样与按 token 类型自适应的 OPD/SFT 监督，能够同时获得离策略的轨迹质量与在策略的可学性，且对弱学生、剪枝后恢复、强后训练学生及多模态场景均稳健；显式 rollout 策略设计是一条有前景的蒸馏方向。

title: CRJudgeBench: Can AI Detect Plausible but Invalid Code Reviews?
comment: 26 pages, 5 figures, and 14 tables. Under review at ICLR 2027. Dataset available at this https URL
summary: Large language models can generate plausible code-review comments, but such comments may contain technically incorrect claims that mislead developers. We study technical trustworthiness judgment: determining whether a review comment's core technical claims are correct and applicable to the reviewed code in its repository context. Existing code-review benchmarks primarily evaluate review generation, issue discovery, or general comment quality, but do not directly assess whether an agent can determine the technical trustworthy of an individual review comment. To fill this gap, we introduce CRJudgeBench, a benchmark of 1199 instances constructed from real pull requests and expert-verified perturbations, covering both trustworthy and plausible but untrustworthy comments. We further present Sentinel, a repository-grounded agentic judge that actively gathers code evidence to verify review comments before making judgments. Starting from Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct, Sentinel is trained on the CRJudgeBench training split through iterative action-level learning from a privileged teacher. On the 359-instance CRJudgeBench test set, Sentinel achieves 76.60\% accuracy, outperforming GLM-5.3 by 6.13 percentage points and its base model by 19.78 points. These results show that even state-of-the-art general-purpose LLMs struggle to identify untrustworthy comments, while iterative action-level learning substantially improves the accuracy of repository-grounded trustworthiness judgments. Our dataset is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRJudgeBench基准（1199个实例）和Sentinel智能体，用于评估AI判断代码审查评论技术可信度的能力。Sentinel通过动作级蒸馏训练，在测试集上达到76.60%准确率，显著优于现有LLM。
AI.motivation: 现有代码审查基准主要评估评论生成或通用质量，但无法判断单条评论的技术声明是否在其代码与仓库上下文中真正正确。可信但错误的审查评论会误导开发者，因此需要一种评估"技术可信度"的方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建CRJudgeBench：从GitHub真实PR中收集1199条评论（764条可信，435条不可信，后者含人工错误评论和专家核实的LLM扰动实例）；2) 设计Sentinel：基于Qwen3-Coder-30B的ReAct式智能体，在bash环境中主动搜集代码证据；3) 采用LEAP框架进行迭代动作级蒸馏：由GPT-5.6 Sol特权教师在关键步骤提供动作监督，经独立审查器验证后用于LoRA微调，训练3个epoch。
AI.result: 在359条测试集上，Sentinel准确率76.60%，超越GLM-5.3（70.47%）和基座模型（56.82%）。所有模型对可信评论召回率极高（87.77%-98.69%），但对不可信评论召回率极低（2.31%-37.69%），Sentinel将不可信评论F1从33.75提升至53.85。所有模型均存在"倾向判为可信"的系统性偏差。仓库规模与开发历史显著影响性能（如PostHog准确率仅59-68%）。
AI.conclusion: 技术可信度判断是代码审查中先前被忽视的关键维度。Sentinel通过仓库级证据搜集与动作级蒸馏训练显著优于通用LLM，但识别"看似合理但实际错误"的评论仍是核心挑战。未来工作将扩展基准至更多仓库与编程语言，并进一步提升Sentinel对不可信评论的检测能力。

title: Follow the Entities: A Corpus Map for Agentic Search
summary: Answering questions and completing tasks over large document collections often requires connecting evidence spread across multiple documents, such as a project's approval recorded in one, its requirements in another, and its latest status in a third. Recent LLM agents approach this by iteratively searching the full corpus rather than reading only a fixed set of top-ranked documents. However, when the corpus is exposed only as a flat collection of files, a relevant document gives no indication of how it relates to others, so the agent must rediscover these relationships for every query, often missing complementary evidence while simultaneously consuming substantial additional tokens. To address this, we introduce CorpusMap, a navigation layer that organizes the corpus around its recurring entities, which are identifiable from the documents themselves and can link a single document to many others across sources. Specifically, CorpusMap represents each recurring entity as an Entity Page that aggregates information about it and links to every document that refers to it, forming a graph between entities and documents that the agent can traverse to gather otherwise disconnected evidence. Moreover, since CorpusMap is constructed offline by resolving mentions of the same entity across documents, its links are shared across queries rather than rediscovered repeatedly at inference time. Using 7 different models with 3 benchmark datasets, we show that CorpusMap improves both evidence discovery and answer quality over raw-corpus agentic search while using fewer tokens on average, and further outperforms 4 alternative navigation layers, suggesting that entities serve as effective anchors for navigating large document collections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CorpusMap，一种以实体为中心的导航层，将大型文档集合围绕反复出现的实体进行组织，通过离线构建实体页面（Entity Page）来链接相关文档，从而帮助 LLM 智能体更高效地发现跨文档证据。在 7 个模型和 3 个基准测试上的实验表明，CorpusMap 在提升证据发现能力和答案质量的同时，平均减少了 34%–57% 的输入 token，并优于 4 种替代导航层。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体在大型文档集合上进行迭代搜索时，面对的是一个扁平的文档集合，无法了解文档之间的关联，必须为每个查询重新发现这些关系，常常遗漏互补证据并消耗大量 token。需要一种持久化的导航层，预先暴露跨文档的可重用结构，同时保留对完整语料库的访问能力。
AI.method: CorpusMap 以文档中反复出现的实体（人物、项目、产品等）为锚点，通过离线四阶段构建：(1) 类型目录归纳——从语料库中自动归纳实体类型目录；(2) 实体抽取——识别并分类每篇文档中的实体提及；(3) 跨文档实体解析——通过共享注册表将指代同一实体的提及进行链接、添加或标记为未解析；(4) 实体页面渲染——为每个跨文档实体生成实体页面，汇总各来源信息并链接到所有相关文档。最终形成一个实体-文档的二部图作为导航层。
AI.result: 在 EnterpriseRAG-Bench、WixQA 和 HERB 三个基准上，使用 GPT-5.5/5.6 Luna/Terra/Sol、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、MAI-Thinking-1 及 Qwen3.8-27B 共 7 个模型进行评估。相比原始语料库的智能体搜索，CorpusMap 将整体质量提升 6.4–11.7 分，同时平均减少 34%–57% 的输入 token，显著优于 Document Page、Group Page、LLM Wiki 和 Corpus2Skill 四种基线方法。CorpusMap 还支持增量更新、跨模型复用（廉价模型构建、昂贵模型使用）以及使用非 LLM 的现成工具（如 GLinker）构建，且在语料库扩展和开放权重模型上同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的 CorpusMap 验证了一个重要方向：改进语料库的组织方式（而非仅改进智能体的搜索策略）是提升智能体在大规模文档集合上表现的有效途径。实体可作为导航锚点，将分散在不同来源中的相关证据连接起来，为智能体提供共享的可重用结构。

title: Loss-Guided Pretraining Data Selection for Time-Series Foundation Models
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are pretrained on heterogeneous collections containing billions of observations, yet their training windows are typically sampled without estimating whether they provide useful learning signal. We introduce a static data-selection framework that scores each window with a reference forecaster and retains an intermediate interval within every source dataset. Specifically, we connect forecasting loss to optimization difficulty by showing that normalized squared loss controls the per-sample gradient norm under a local Jacobian condition. We then define a reference loss score and apply dataset-stratified selection to preserve the diversity of samples. Across various TSFM architectures, our method outperforms random selection by an absolute margin and even improves both relative MASE and CRPS over full-data pretraining by retaining fewer candidate pretraining windows. Further analyses show strong cross-scale and cross-architecture score correlations, indicating that a small reference model can often select data for larger targets, provided that the reference and target share compatible difficulty orderings.

AI.tldr: 本文针对时间序列基础模型(TSFM)预训练中训练窗口选择缺乏信号评估的问题，提出了一种基于参考损失的静态数据选择框架。该方法使用冻结的参考预测器为每个候选上下文-未来窗口打分，在每个源数据集内保留中间RFL区间，既能优于随机选择，也能在保留更少候选窗口的情况下超越全数据预训练效果。
AI.motivation: 时间序列基础模型在大规模异构语料上进行预训练，但训练窗口通常未经评估其学习信号有效性而被采样。随着预训练数据规模增长，假设每个窗口都应获得同等关注的做法代价高昂且缺乏科学依据。现有时间序列选择方法主要针对任务特定训练或基础模型微调，不适用于大规模预训练数据。
AI.method: 1) 参考损失评分(RFL)：使用冻结的参考预测器为每个候选窗口计算参考损失作为难度分数；2) 理论证明：通过定理3.1证明归一化MSE在局部Jacobian条件下控制单样本梯度范数，建立感知梯度范数的理论联系；3) 数据集分层选择：将RFL值转换为每个源数据集内的百分位排名，对保留率α保留每个源的中间α区间，以保持源覆盖度和数据集级多样性。算法只需一次离线参考模型前向传播，每个窗口存储一个标量，评分可跨目标模型规模和架构复用。
AI.result: 在Chronos-Bolt Base、Moirai-Base和TimesFM 2.5三种架构上评估，80%保留率下方法在所有目标模型上均超越全数据预训练和大小匹配的随机子集，在GIFT-Eval基准上MASE和CRPS均有改善。参考模型分析显示同架构内的跨尺度RFL排序高度一致（Spearman相关系数0.977-0.991），可使用小参考模型选择数据；跨架构迁移是有条件的，取决于难度排序的兼容性（TimesFM与Chronos-Bolt相关系数0.828有效，与Moirai-Small仅0.254无效）。消融实验证实选择中间RFL区间和数据集分层两个组件的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 参考损失选择方法被确立为时间序列基础模型预训练中与模型架构和语料规模同等重要的设计维度。该框架通过识别有用的难度区间同时维持数据集多样性，使预训练数据选择成为TSFM开发中一个有效且可解释的优化维度。

title: Hidden Reasoning Must Leak, but Need Not Be Readable: Fundamental Opportunities and Limits for Chain-of-Thought Monitoring
summary: Can reasoning models trick chain of thought (CoT) monitors and perform hidden computation without revealing it in their thinking traces? We show that the answer depends on the underlying task difficulty and the model size. Simple computations can be performed covertly; however, beyond a threshold depending on model size, successfully solving the task necessarily leaks a near-linear amount of information about the covert task input into the CoT. Therefore, sufficiently complex hidden computation always leaves an information-theoretic footprint. However, concerningly, this leakage need not be readable: Under plausible cryptographic assumptions, even a one-layer Transformer can encrypt its reasoning online so that no polynomial-time monitor can extract information about the hidden computation. Overall, our theoretical and empirical results provide a holistic view of both the opportunities and the limitations of CoT monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了推理模型能否在思维链（CoT）中隐藏其真实计算过程而不被监控发现。研究发现，简单任务可被隐藏执行，但复杂任务的隐藏计算不可避免地会在CoT中留下信息痕迹，且这些痕迹在加密假设下即使存在也无法被多项式时间监控读取。
AI.motivation: 随着大推理模型（如o1/R1）在AI部署中的广泛应用，其CoT可解释性成为AI安全研究的核心议题。理解模型能否隐瞒自身推理过程——即“隐藏计算”（hidden computation）的可行性，对AI监督与对齐至关重要。
AI.method: 本文采用理论分析与实证研究相结合的方法：理论上建立信息论框架，分析不同模型规模与任务难度下CoT中隐藏计算的可能性与信息泄漏下界；实证上构建可加密推理的one-layer Transformer，验证加密隐藏推理在多项式时间监控下不可读取性。
AI.result: 1) 简单计算可被模型隐蔽执行，监控难以发现；2) 任务复杂度超过模型规模阈值后，成功求解会不可避免地在CoT中泄漏近似线性的隐藏任务输入信息量；3) 复杂隐藏计算在信息论层面必留下"足迹"，但足迹不一定可读——在标准加密假设下，one-layer Transformer即可对推理进行在线加密，使多项式时间监控无法提取隐藏计算信息。
AI.conclusion: 研究为CoT监控提供了全景式理解：既揭示了监控的机会（信息论下界保证复杂任务必留痕迹），也揭示了其局限（痕迹可被加密而不可读）。这表明，仅靠CoT监控难以可靠检测隐藏计算，AI监督需结合其他方法。

title: Do Agent Benchmarks Do What They Say? An Executable-Contract Audit of Tool-Using Agent Environments
comment: 10 pages. Submitted to IEEE BigData 2026, Intelligent Data Mining special session. Code, contracts and data: this https URL
summary: Tool-using agents are entering settings where a wrong action carries real cost, and the benchmarks certifying them grade what each simulated tool call reports having done, assuming the tool did what its interface advertises. The audit taxonomies we survey publish no category for that assumption, and a defect beneath a score is present on every rerun. We treat a tool's advertised surfaces as an executable contract, check the implementation against it, and trace each score's provenance through the task files and evaluator code to the verdicts that derive from state a defective tool should have written. Across 34 audited mutating tools in four benchmarks we confirm seven tool defects and one evaluator property at pinned commits. On injected defects the checker raised no false positive in 25 flags, flagged 2 of 5 negative controls, and missed most: in 29 of 33 scored misses a clause covered the defect but no probe revealed it. The checker's own static half, run alone, flags 14 of 17 confirmed sites, so on these findings the dynamic half confirms and traces rather than discovers. Twelve further AgentDojo tools, with six held-out tools and the seven audited first, complete its 25-tool mutating surface, on which at least 5 tools diverge from their advertised surface as our contracts read it, a rate for AgentDojo alone. No gold trajectory reaches either tau2-bench defect; on 1,120 paths built to isolate the telecom defect, a number fixed by construction, the evaluator rewards a refuel of a suspended line and fails the repaired tool. The clearest case is a clinical benchmark whose tool tells the agent each write executed under a documented no-write design its interface does not disclose; its grader takes that message as evidence, so its action success rate records whether a request carried the expected payload, not whether any record changed.

AI.tldr: 对四个主流智能体基准（MedAgentBench、tau2-bench、AgentDojo、MM-ToolSandbox）中34个变更工具进行"可执行契约审计"，发现工具实现与其接口文档之间存在系统性偏离，并追溯这些缺陷到评估分数的来源。结果显示AgentDojo至少有5/25工具偏离其公开契约，MedAgentBench的临床写操作虽未写入数据库但仍被评分；审计检查器精度高但召回低，整体暴露了基准分数的"代理可见假设"未被审计覆盖的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体基准普遍假设"工具按其接口声称的那样工作"，但这一假设从未被审计。现有的基准审计分类法（如BenchGuard、Tool-Veritas、Automated Benchmark Audit，共27个类别）均未覆盖"工具实现与广告接口不一致"这一层面。这导致基准分数可能建立在未经验证的状态转换之上——尤其在医疗、电信、航空等错误操作代价高昂的领域，构成严重的数据质量与测量有效性隐患。
AI.method: （1）为每个工具从其广告接口（docstring、schema、prompt template等）手写YAML格式可执行契约，每条子句引用具体来源；（2）构建由静态半（AST扫描）与动态半（通过适配器在子进程中执行契约并探测状态变化）组成的合规性检查器，定义六类缺陷（Phantom Effect、Unenforced Precondition、Ignored Argument、Partial Effect、Invariant Break、Reset Leak）；（3）通过"分数在险"溯源分析，静态地从缺陷追踪到评估代码读取的字段再到任务判决；（4）验证采用预注册方案，包括注入缺陷、负控制、黄金轨迹回放与构造路径。
AI.result: 在四个基准的锚定审计中确认8个案例（7个工具缺陷+1个评估器属性），每个基准一个"头条级"缺陷类：MedAgentBench的POST分支声称执行成功但无写入且评分器接受该消息；tau2-bench的refuel_data前置条件检查被注释掉；AgentDojo的update_scheduled_transaction对recurring参数仅做真值检查；MM-ToolSandbox的venmo_social的sort_by参数未被转发。AgentDojo完整25工具表面上至少5个偏离契约。检查器对25个注入缺陷零假阳性，但对5个负控制误报2个，召回率低（多数漏检因探针未触发而非契约未覆盖）。在构造的1120条电信路径上，评估器对未修补工具全部奖励、对修补后工具全部失败。
AI.conclusion: AgentDojo全部25个枚举的变更工具均有契约，其中至少5个偏离其广告表面；锚定审计结果是存在性证明而非比率；暴露计数是尽职调查标志而非对已发布分数的修正；检查器低召回意味着CONFORM判决不能确立合规性。建议维护者将写入评分器锚定于存储状态而非工具的成功字符串，审计工具层面而非仅任务和黄金解决方案，并在智能体可读处披露每项有意的简化操作。

title: PowerMarketJax: A JAX Benchmark Suite for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in Power Markets
summary: Power markets are a natural testbed for multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), where multiple self-interested participants repeatedly submit bids. A market-clearing mechanism then determines dispatch and prices subject to power grid constraints and market settlement rules. However, existing MARL environments typically focus on a single market setting, implement simplified clearing mechanisms, or rely on CPU-based optimization solvers that slow large-scale training and limit the systematic study of bidding strategies and market behavior. We introduce PowerMarketJax, a benchmark suite for MARL across five power markets: day-ahead wholesale, real-time balancing, ancillary services, peer-to-peer double auctions, and local flexibility. Each environment implements its own clearing, pricing, and settlement rules while providing a common framework for learning and evaluation. We find that learned bidding behavior depends strongly on the market design: independent learners can miss better strategies when gains require many agents to change together, when more profitable strategies lie beyond a region of lower profit, or when profits disappear as more agents adopt the same strategy. PowerMarketJax implements both market simulation and policy training in JAX, allowing the entire pipeline to run on the GPU with 1,024 X 1,200 parallelisms across both environments and market participants, achieving up to 33X speedup over CPU-based baselines. Our open-source benchmark is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: PowerMarketJax是一个基于JAX的电力市场多智能体强化学习基准套件,覆盖日前批发电厂、实时平衡、辅助服务、P2P能源交易和本地灵活性五类市场,通过GPU端到端编译实现最高33倍加速,用于系统研究市场设计对学习投标策略的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有MARL电力市场环境存在三大不足:聚焦单一市场、清算机制过于简化、依赖CPU求解器导致大规模训练受限,无法系统研究投标策略与市场行为。电力市场具有天然的MARL属性——多个自利参与者重复投标,市场清算决定调度与价格,因此亟需一个兼顾市场设计保真度与计算可扩展性的统一基准。
AI.method: 在JAX中将五类电力市场统一建模为一般和部分可观察随机博弈(POSG),通过单一编译计算图整合市场清算(原对偶内点法LP求解器,日前市场采用relax-round-resolve三阶段程序处理MILP)与策略学习(vmap实现环境和智能体并行,lax.scan实现rollout与更新循环)。每个市场保留各自的清算、定价与结算规则:日前批发采用SCUC与LMP定价;实时平衡采用两结算制;辅助服务采用能量-备用联合优化;P2P采用周期性双向拍卖;本地灵活性采用DSO单一买方pay-as-bid机制。实验在case29gb(66机)、RTS-GMLC(73机)、澳大利亚NEM(151机)、1200户比利时PV家庭和瑞士129母线配电网馈线上进行,对比IPPO/SAC的参数共享(PS)与非共享(NoPS)四种独立学习者。
AI.result: 实验揭示了市场设计深刻塑造独立学习者可发现的内容:日前批发市场中所有发电机同时提价可获£697M利润,但单方面提价无利可图,导致学习者停留在α≈1.5而未触及更高利润联合区域;辅助服务市场联合提价可获£9.05M/日利润,但单方信号近乎为零;P2P市场中约210-240户家庭采用相同套利策略后收益由正转负,因集体充放电压平了价差;本地灵活性市场存在局部学习障碍——小幅提价使利润骤降,需大幅提价(约3.2倍底价)才能恢复;PS因将已承诺机组的梯度同步给未承诺机组,可能误导未承诺机组的报价,NoPS则在P2P中发现了异质套利行为。计算性能方面,全GPU实现在64并行环境下较全CPU和CPU环境+GPU策略分别实现最高22倍和33倍加速,P2P市场1200户家庭实现27929环境步/秒。实现验证显示JAX LP求解器与HiGHS的双价格差异低于1.4×10⁻¹⁰相对误差,日前市场三阶段程序相对精确MILP中位数额外成本仅0-2.04%。
AI.conclusion: PowerMarketJax证明MARL电力市场基准可在保持市场设计保真度的同时实现计算可扩展性,但实验也暴露了独立学习在物理约束电力市场中的内在局限:盈利可能需要多方协调改变,可能位于局部不利区域之外,也可能随采用者增多而消失。这些发现凸显了市场机制本身塑造学习景观的深层作用——它们决定施加于个体的激励以及众多学习者的行动如何反馈到价格、调度与采购中,提示未来MARL算法需应对协调探索、内生市场响应与异质智能体行为等超越简单回报最大化的挑战,并可将此类学习仿真用于压力测试新市场设计。

title: A Sharp Transition in Data Reconstruction under Differential Privacy
summary: Data reconstruction attacks have empirically been successful in recovering training samples from learned models, raising privacy concerns and motivating defenses with guarantees that remain valid against future threats. While differential privacy (DP) provides formal protection, choosing the privacy budget remains a challenge: small budgets severely reduce utility, but it is hard to quantify how large the budget can be without allowing accurate reconstruction. In this work, we study informed attackers who aim to reconstruct a single $d$-dimensional training sample from a $\rho$-zero-concentrated DP model, knowing all other training data. Our main contribution is to establish a sharp transition at $\rho \asymp d$ for data reconstruction: on the one hand, we derive entropy-based lower bounds for any private mechanism and any attack, characterizing a set of target priors for which reconstruction is information-theoretically impossible for $\rho \ll d$; on the other hand, we analyze a simple attack on private linear regression with output perturbation, showing that reconstruction is practically feasible for $\rho \gg d$. Remarkably, the transition moves to $\rho \asymp s$ for data lying in an $s$-dimensional subspace, demonstrating that the privacy budget guaranteeing adequate protection must be assessed in terms of the effective dimension of the data. We validate our findings via experiments on synthetic data and natural images (CIFAR-10, ImageNet).

AI.tldr: 本文研究差分隐私(DP)模型下的数据重构攻击，揭示了隐私预算ρ与数据维度d之间存在尖锐的相变现象：当ρ≪d时重构信息论上不可能，而当ρ≫d时则实际可行；对于低秩数据，相变点移至有效维度s。
AI.motivation: 差分隐私虽提供形式化隐私保护，但隐私预算的选择面临核心难题：预算过小损害实用性，过大则可能允许精确重构。由于难以量化"多大预算会允许重构"，实际中只能依赖保守的小预算。本文旨在建立隐私预算与重构可行性之间的精确理论联系。
AI.method: 理论分析为主：(1) 推导基于熵的下界，证明对ρ-zero-concentrated DP机制，当ρ≪d时对特定先验分布的样本重构在信息论上不可能；(2) 分析针对输出扰动线性回归的简单攻击，证明ρ≫d时重构实际可行；(3) 推广到子空间结构数据，分析有效维度s的影响；(4) 在合成数据、CIFAR-10和ImageNet上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 建立了重构可行性的尖锐相变：在全维情形相变点位于ρ≍d；在s维子空间中相变点移至ρ≍s。这意味着保护所需的隐私预算应基于数据的有效维度而非原始维度来评估。实验验证了该理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 研究为差分隐私预算的选取提供了精确的理论指导：ρ的选取必须根据数据的固有/有效维度来判断，这对实际应用中的隐私-效用权衡具有重要指导意义。

title: Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation: Mitigating the Deliberation Drift Cliff in Test-Time Compute Scaling
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and evaluation artifacts available
summary: Test-time compute scaling has emerged as a cornerstone of advanced machine reasoning, yet performing iterative deliberation directly within continuous latent representation spaces reveals a catastrophic pathology: the Deliberation Drift Cliff. While unconstrained recurrent latent models achieve initial reasoning gains at short horizons (K <= 4), their reasoning collapses when extrapolated to deeper thinking steps (K >= 16), dropping by 22% to 62% across standard logical benchmarks. We resolve the trilemma among expressivity, Lyapunov stability, and computational efficiency in test-time latent reasoning through a 22-round empirical and theoretical investigation. We demonstrate that strictly conservative scalar potential gradient flows suppress long-range drift (cliff 3.40%) but bottleneck peak reasoning accuracy at 32.73%, whereas unconstrained rotational flows achieve high symbolic expressivity (82.33%) but suffer a severe 36.87% drift cliff. To resolve this geometric duality, we establish Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation (PH-LD) and propose the Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition (DG-HHD). DG-HHD parameterizes the attracting flow as a tangent projection tensor network while orthogonally decoupling non-zero circulation (Hodge machine error 1.65e-17, contraction error 5.55e-17), eliminating runtime autograd dependencies to achieve 1.84x vector field and 2.09x RK45 rollout speedups. In a 15-arm symmetrical Pareto benchmark, DG-HHD achieves 58.67% peak accuracy (+25.94% absolute gain over conservative HHD) and retains 35.27% at K=32. Transferred to small language model (SLM) multi-hop causal reasoning, DG-HHD delivers monotonic compute scaling (49.33% to 51.56%) and suppresses out-of-distribution drift (cliff -0.66%). All 30 Level 0 deterministic invariants are certified.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation (PH-LD)框架及Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition (DG-HHD)方法,通过在紧凑球面流形上引入Port-Hamiltonian接触力学与Hodge正交分解,解决测试时潜在推理中的"推理漂移悬崖"问题,在保持Lyapunov稳定性的同时打破保守流的表达能力瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 连续潜在推理在测试时计算扩展时遭遇灾难性失败:当推理深度K超过训练范围(K≥16),无约束循环模型的推理准确率骤降22%-62%。该问题源于表达力、Lyapunov稳定性与计算效率三者间的根本性矛盾(trilemma),现有保守标量势梯度流虽能抑制漂移但限制峰值精度至32.73%,而无约束旋转流虽有高表达力(82.33%)却承受36.87%的严重漂移。
AI.method: 1. 几何约束:将潜在轨迹约束在单位球面S^{D-1}上,使用symplectic RATTLE积分器保持流形约束(机器精度<10^{-6})。2. Port-Hamiltonian接触力学:在扩展相空间R^{2D+1}中建模能量耗散,保证dH/dt≤0的Lyapunov稳定性。3. DG-HHD核心创新:将吸引流直接参数化为切空间投影张量网络v_pot=-P_q·MLP([q,c]),绕过标量势自微分,打破Hessian对称约束;旋转分量通过反对称矩阵W_skew构造并正交投影到v_pot的正交补空间,保证⟨v_{curl,⊥},v_pot⟩≡0(误差1.65×10^{-17})和方向收缩性⟨grad_S,v⟩=-‖v_pot‖²≤0(误差5.55×10^{-17})。4. 自微分延迟消除:采用纯张量前向计算,消除torch.autograd依赖。5. SLM桥接:将Riemannian流场挂载到自回归Transformer架构中。
AI.result: 15臂Pareto基准测试中,DG-HHD峰值精度达58.67%±14.93%(绝对提升+25.94%),K=32深推理时保留35.27%±3.07%,表征秩保持15.15±2.19。ProofWriter多跳推理上展现单调计算扩展(49.33%→51.56%),深度OOD任务零漂移(Δ=-0.66%)。计算效率:向量场调用1.84×加速,RK45积分2.09×加速,端到端训练3.82×加速,推理延迟降低25.4%。30项Level 0确定性不变量全部通过认证。
AI.conclusion: PH-LD框架成功化解了连续潜在推理的trilemma:DG-HHD通过纯张量Hodge分解同时实现了非保守循环表达力、Lyapunov稳定性保证和高计算效率,为测试时推理提供了数学原理严谨且计算高效的连续几何范式,为连续人工智能推理建立了鲁棒且可证明稳定的理论框架。

title: Compiling Learning Problems into Adaptation Programs for Language Models
summary: Model adaptation is typically governed by a fixed recipe, even though different update programs can produce substantially different behavioral outcomes. We introduce adaptation compilation, which reframes where, how, and to what extent a model should adapt as a joint prediction and decision problem. Rather than searching over candidate programs anew for each learning episode, a compiler learns from prior adaptations to predict a vector-valued counterfactual response surface over candidate programs---their expected effects on acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation---and selects a program before adaptation begins. Because this predicted geometry captures multiple behavioral consequences rather than a single winner or scalar score, it can be reused under different downstream priorities without retraining. Across five learning types, preferred programs vary meaningfully across episodes, and this variation is predictable from pre-adaptation information. On Llama-3.1-8B, compiler-selected programs approach exhaustive search while outperforming global and objective-specific defaults. Replication on Gemma-2-9B preserves program heterogeneity and selection headroom, but shows that exploiting this headroom requires accounting for uncertainty when departing from strong defaults. Together, these results show that adaptation search can be amortized across related learning problems, turning prior adaptation experience into a basis for deciding how future learning should occur.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"适应编译"(adaptation compilation)框架,将模型微调中"在哪里、以何种方式、在多大程度上更新"重新框定为一个联合预测与决策问题。编译器从先前的适应经验中学习,预测候选适应程序在获取、迁移、有界性和保持性四个行为维度上的反事实响应曲面,并在适应开始前选择程序。
AI.motivation: 当前的参数高效微调方法通常采用固定的适应架构(固定的LoRA模块位置、秩等),但不同类型的学习(事实获取、行为策略、因果推理等)对模型更新位置的需求差异显著,且最大化获取能力的更新位置未必能最好地促进泛化或保持无关行为。现有方法仅在预定义架构内优化容量或在单次训练中响应优化信号,并未将适应架构本身视为可学习对象。
AI.method: 核心方法包括:(1) 将适应程序定义为模块集合与各模块更新容量的配置g=(v, r_v);(2) 执行程序产生四个行为结果Y=[A获取, T迁移, B有界性, P保持];(3) 适应几何Γ_{D,M}(g)=E_ξ[Y(g;ξ)]描述同一学习回合在不同程序下的期望行为;(4) 从适应前的回合-模型特征s_{D,M}=[e_D, b_{D,M}, q_{D,M}](隐藏状态、冻结模型行为统计、模块级诊断)学习预测器F_ψ;(5) 在效用规格τ下选择程序g*=argmax U_τ(Γ̂);(6) 程序空间采用四个预算近似的LoRA配置(早期/中期/晚期深度rank-16,全栈rank-4);(7) 使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Gemma-2-9B-IT两个骨干,五种学习目标(词汇绑定、事实关联、行为策略、因果映射、程序推理),600个回合(400训练/100验证/100测试)。
AI.result: 实验1:全局固定策略效用0.569,目标固定0.600,回合oracle达0.618,99%回合有唯一最优程序,词汇绑定和事实关联保留最大选择空间。实验2:随机森林预测器几何MAE为0.040(基线0.238),Spearman相关0.803,top-1/top-2 oracle恢复率77%/93%。实验3:编译器效用0.607,oracle遗憾从0.018降至0.011(恢复约39%差距),在22回合改善、7回合退化、71回合持平;同一预测几何可在不同效用下复用而无需重训。实验4:回合隐藏态表示单独使用几乎达到完整表示性能(MAE 0.0399 vs 0.0400)。实验5:留一家族零样本迁移显著退化(MAE升至0.339,top-1恢复率仅14%)。实验6:Gemma-2-9B复制保留程序异质性和回合选择空间,但确定性argmax选择不优于强目标默认(0.435 vs 0.438),尤其在程序推理上因预测差异过小而错误切换,表明需考虑决策置信度。
AI.conclusion: 适应编译可以在已表征学习家族内有效摊销适应搜索:预测几何支持比固定默认更好的程序选择,并可在不同行为优先级下复用。但有两个重要边界:适应几何是模型依赖的(Gemma与Llama仅因果映射共享默认),且利用选择空间需要知道预测优势何时足够可靠以脱离强默认。这将适应编译从固定配方转化为条件决策问题,提示未来方向为置信度感知编译。

title: Complexity-Aware Evaluation of LLM Comprehension
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for software engineering tasks that require understanding existing source code, including behavior prediction, function explanation, debugging, and code review. However, aggregate benchmark accuracy can conceal how model reliability changes as source code becomes structurally more complex. This paper presents a complexity-aware framework for evaluating LLM code comprehension using cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, branching factor, and Halstead volume. We evaluate DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and Llama through two complementary tasks: automatic input-output prediction over 300 Python functions and manually assessed semantic comprehension over a balanced subset of 60 functions. The functions are grouped into Low-, Medium-, and High-complexity bands. DeepSeek-Coder-V2 achieves an overall automatic accuracy of 78.33%, compared with 70.33% for Llama. However, accuracy decreases substantially from Low to High complexity, from 93.52% to 52.78% for DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and from 87.04% to 47.22% for Llama. Incorrect predictions are consistently associated with higher values of all four complexity metrics, and correlation and logistic-regression analyses confirm broadly comparable negative associations between structural complexity and correctness. Manual semantic comprehension shows the same degradation pattern, with accuracy decreasing from 100.00% to 75.00% for DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and from 90.00% to 60.00% for Llama. These findings demonstrate that complexity-aware evaluation provides a more diagnostic assessment of LLM code-comprehension reliability than aggregate accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种"复杂度感知"的评估框架,通过循环复杂度、嵌套深度、分支因子和Halstead体积四个结构指标,将DeepSeek-Coder-V2和CodeLlama-7b对Python函数的代码理解能力按Low/Medium/High复杂度分级评估,发现两个模型的准确率均随结构复杂度上升而显著下降,表明聚合准确率会掩盖模型在高复杂度代码上的可靠性退化。
AI.motivation: 现有的代码基准(如HumanEval、MBPP、CRUXEval)通常只报告聚合准确率,而忽略了被评估函数的结构复杂度分布;基准以简单函数为主时会高估LLM的代码理解可靠性,因此需要一种按结构复杂度分层的诊断式评估方法。
AI.method: 构建300个Python函数数据集(来源:HumanEval、MBPP-sanitized、CRUXEval、LeetCode、BigCodeBench-Hard),使用Python ast模块静态计算循环复杂度(CC)、嵌套深度(ND)、分支因子(BF)、Halstead体积(HV)四个指标,按阈值划分为Low/Medium/High三档;采用零样本提示在DeepSeek-Coder-V2和CodeLlama-7b-Instruct-hf上执行两类任务——(1)300题自动输入-输出精确预测,(2)从三档各抽20题共60题的人工语义理解问答(目的/变量角色/边界情况);采用Spearman相关、多元Logistic回归、卡方检验、Cohen's κ等方法进行统计分析。
AI.result: DeepSeek-Coder-V2总体自动准确率78.33%,CodeLlama-7b为70.33%,但Low→High分别从93.52%降至52.78%、87.04%降至47.22%(降幅约40pp);四个复杂度指标均与错误预测正相关,Spearman相关系数介于−0.33至−0.43之间且全部p<0.001;Logistic回归显示所有系数为负且显著(OR 0.66–0.79);人工语义理解也呈相同下降模式,目的题最易、边界情况题最难;自动任务比人工任务对复杂度更敏感(降幅约40pp vs 25–30pp);标注者间一致性Cohen's κ=0.86。
AI.conclusion: 结构复杂度是LLM代码理解可靠性的关键风险因素;传统的聚合准确率会掩盖高复杂度代码上的退化;CC、ND、BF、HV四个指标互为补充,无单一最优指标;建议在评估LLM代码理解时同时报告复杂度分布,并对高复杂度代码的LLM输出进行额外验证;未来工作应扩展到其他语言、模型家族、仓库级代码及工具辅助场景。

title: Simultaneous Neural Optimal Transport
summary: Optimal Transport (OT) provides a principled framework for learning transformations between probability distributions from unpaired samples. In many applications, however, a single transformation must map several source distributions to a common target distribution. For example, image restoration might require handling different types of degradation without knowing the degradation of each input at inference time. Simple approaches of pooling the source distributions only encourage alignment with the target at the aggregate level and may leave individual sources misaligned. In our paper, we consider the simultaneous OT problem which formalizes the task of learning a shared transport map that minimizes the average transport cost while aligning each source distribution with a prescribed target. We propose a neural method for solving the simultaneous OT problem by learning a shared transport map that minimizes the average transport cost while aligning each source distribution with a prescribed target. We derive a max-min formulation for learning this map. We illustrate its application to image restoration, where a single model handles multiple degradation types using a common collection of clean target images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SimNOT（Simultaneous Neural Optimal Transport），一种用于从多个源分布同时学习共享传输映射到同一目标分布的神经最优传输方法。该方法基于散度的非平衡公式推导出max-min训练目标，采用共享传输映射和源特定势函数，在推理时无需源标签。实验在合成数据和CelebA多退化图像修复任务上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在许多应用中（如多退化类型的图像修复），单一转换需要将多个源分布映射到共同的目标分布。简单地将源分布混合后再做OT对齐只保证聚合层面的匹配，可能导致单个源分布对齐不足；而为每个源学习独立映射则无法得到统一模型。动机需发展一种能够显式考虑每个源分布对齐要求的同时OT框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于ψ-散度的同时非平衡OT公式（公式8），保留共享条件分布结构；2) 推导精确的半对偶表示（定理1），建立max-min优化目标；3) 神经网络参数化：共享（随机）映射T_θ和源特定势函数v_{ω_k}；4) 交替训练势函数（最大化）和映射（最小化）；5) 理论保证：共享ReLU网络可同时逼近任意共享随机核（定理2），二次代价+KL惩罚下最优解具有Monge结构（定理3）。
AI.result: 1) 合成实验：5个高斯源→瑞士卷目标，共享映射恢复了螺旋结构；2) CelebA 64×64图像修复（5种退化：双三次/双线性下采样、JPEG压缩、高斯模糊、高斯噪声）：SimNOT在Mean FID(8.23)和Max FID(11.88)上优于Pooled UOT(9.96/14.39)；3) 泛化到未见强度（如训练×4测试×3和×5）：SimNOT在FID(18.44/32.15)、LPIPS(0.0635/0.1134)和PSNR(25.03/20.93)上均优于Pooled UOT和基于分类器的Conditional UOT。
AI.conclusion: SimNOT将神经OT从成对传输扩展到多源同时学习，通过非平衡公式和半对偶理论提供了原则性框架。实验证明该方法能从未配对样本学习共享转换，且推理时无需退化标签，对未见退化强度具有良好泛化能力。局限在于：势函数数量随源数量线性增长带来计算开销；训练时需源成员信息。

title: Learning to Retrieve Missing Evidence for Long-Term Memory QA
summary: Long-term memory enables language models to use past interactions in future conversations. However, evidence needed to answer a question may be scattered across distant turns, while the question itself omits clues needed to locate it. Retrieved facts can reveal these clues, motivating retrieval decisions conditioned on evidence already found. We introduce MERA (Missing-Evidence Retrieval Augmentation), which separates globally searchable memory from a question-specific evidence state. Verified evidence guides subsequent retrieval without restricting access to the global memory. We train a lightweight planner through reinforcement learning, rewarding queries that recover previously missing evidence. MERA achieves strong answer accuracy across Qwen3-30B and GPT-4o-mini backbones. With Qwen3-30B for evidence processing and answer generation, the trained 0.6B planner achieves 77.40% accuracy on LoCoMo and 71.29% on LongMemEval-S, exceeding a 30B planner without retrieval-grounded training by 4.10% and 3.96%, respectively. On LoCoMo, later retrieval rounds increase cumulative evidence recall from 55.5% to 80.5%.

AI.tldr: MERA提出了一种用于长期记忆问答的"缺失证据检索增强"方法，将问题特定的证据状态与全局可搜索记忆解耦，通过强化学习训练轻量级规划器以恢复先前缺失的证据。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆问答中，回答所需的证据往往分散在遥远的对话轮次中，且问题本身可能缺少定位证据的线索。单次或独立检索可能遗漏关键信息，因此需要根据已发现的证据来决定后续检索什么。
AI.method: 1. 将对话轮次分解为原子事实并建立全局索引；2. 维护问题特定的证据图状态，由验证器把关；3. 轻量级规划器基于当前状态生成结构化检索意图；4. 使用GRPO强化学习，以"恢复缺失证据"而非"匹配查询字符串"作为奖励信号训练规划器。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上，使用Qwen3-30B进行证据处理和答案生成时，0.6B的RL训练规划器分别达到77.40%和71.29%的准确率，超过未训练的30B规划器4.10和3.96个百分点。在LoCoMo上，后续检索轮次将累积证据召回率从55.5%提升至80.5%。
AI.conclusion: MERA通过将证据状态从全局记忆中解耦并基于检索结果而非查询形式进行训练，验证了"证据引导检索"策略的有效性，表明在长期记忆问答中，训练轻量级规划器比单纯扩大规划器规模更有效。

title: Engineering Efficient Self-Play Chess: Search, Replay, and Throughput Under Limited Compute
comment: 26 pages, 17 figures, including appendices. Code and experimental evidence: this https URL ; model artifacts: this https URL ; interactive demo: this https URL
summary: How strong can an AlphaZero-style chess system become under limited training compute when its entire learning loop is engineered for efficiency? We train from random initialization through searched self-play on a single eight-GPU node for 2.5 days. The resulting 6.32-million-parameter model reaches 3,251 benchmark Elo [3,206, 3,297] at 100,000 searches per move (estimated at under five seconds of thinking time) against a fixed-node Stockfish 13 ladder. The run ingests 3.25 million completed games, involves an estimated 100 billion search simulations, and makes 836.6 million training presentations. We investigate search allocation, replay and restart-state selection, policy representation, progressive model sizing, quantized inference, and throughput engineering. Alongside the retained design, we document plausible alternatives that failed to improve the complete learning loop or did not justify their cost. The reported strength is a result of the integrated system, not an isolated Elo gain attributable to any single choice.

AI.tldr: 本文在单节点8块GPU上仅用2.5天、$43.2的算力，从随机初始化训练出6.32百万参数的AlphaZero风格国际象棋模型，在10万次搜索/步下达到3251基准Elo（在Stockfish 13定节点梯级赛下）。核心贡献在于通过搜索分配、经验回放、重启状态、渐进式模型尺寸、INT8量化推理和吞吐量工程的端到端协同优化，在受限算力预算下最大化完整学习循环的产出，同时系统性地记录并分析了多个局部指标看似有效但整体无益甚至有害的方案。
AI.motivation: 在受限计算预算（单节点8卡、2.5天）下，AlphaZero风格自博弈系统的性能瓶颈不在单一组件，而在于完整学习循环（搜索→自博弈→回放→训练→发布）的协同效率。局部指标（如推理速度、训练损失、回放命中率）的改进未必能转化为更强的最终棋力，研究动机在于探索如何通过系统性工程让整个闭环在有限资源下产出尽可能强的棋手。
AI.method: 方法涵盖六大工程维度：(1)搜索分配——放弃KataGo式快/全搜索与预测式自适应分配，保留固定300→800访问预算的PUCT搜索；(2)回放与重启状态——结合0–8ply随机开局与未探索分支存档重启，30%均匀+70%策略惊讶采样，逻辑容量从60万扩展至2000万行；(3)策略表示——采用from-to query-key点积头（参数量降至50k vs 密集头484k），共享卷积主干14块160通道，WDL三元值头加两个训练专用辅助头；(4)渐进式模型尺寸——先用12×128小模型快速积累经验，再用14×160中模型，配对比赛决定晋升；(5)INT8量化感知训练——缩放后激活块+量化感知训练+ONNX/TensorRT重构拟合；(6)吞吐量工程——C++原生搜索循环、TensorRT批量推理、Actor-Trainer重叠（半演员在训练时继续对弈）。三组失败案例（终局目标投毒、TensorRT重构漂移、基于损失的晋升）揭示了局部优化的陷阱。
AI.result: 最终模型参数6.32M，训练2.5天（$43.2租用费），完成325万对局、约1000亿次搜索模拟、8.366亿次训练呈现、40.9万次优化器步。在定节点Stockfish 13梯级赛下：无搜索仅策略时1658 Elo；1000次搜索时2823 Elo；10000次/步4并行时3068 Elo；100000次/步16并行时3251 Elo（95% CI [3206, 3297]）。蒸馏47万参数的学生棋手在100000次搜索下达到2873 Elo，为教师的13.4倍参数压缩但保留大部分棋力。局部优化失效案例包括：自适应搜索停止器仅减少3%周期时间且强度差为±10 Elo内不显著；精确蒙特卡洛图搜索仅避免0.025%–0.18%评估却慢8.6%；推理缓存命中率仅0.97%反而增加开销。
AI.conclusion: 结论表明：(1)受限算力下AlphaZero风格系统的棋力来源于完整学习循环的协同优化，而非任何单一组件；(2)局部指标（推理速度、训练损失、策略保真度）可能误导优化方向——改进策略与深度搜索的吻合度反而削弱了在线学习效果；(3)数据生成、部署保真度、模型晋升必须作为学习过程的组成部分而非独立环节来评估；(4)当前已观察到训练后期收益递减（64/400搜索下后期检查点提升不足20 Elo），进一步突破需要更大模型、更深自博弈搜索、更低回放重用或更大回放窗口等系统性方案，而非简单延长训练时间；(5)系统发布了完整配置、可复现的INT8 ONNX模型（SHA-256已记录）及MIT许可的源代码，为后续研究提供了工程基线。

title: Regime Boundary Alignment for Evidence-Gated Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-augmented language models are expected to answer from the retrieved evidence, but in practice they often keep answering when that evidence is missing. We trace this behavior to the training signal: answer-focused fine-tuning assigns no target to unsupported contexts, so it cannot distinguish a reader that abstains from one that guesses, and unsupported answering stays near 100% even as supported accuracy improves. We introduce Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA), which trains a single reader on matched variants of the same question and gold answer. The reader is trained to produce the gold answer when the context supports it, including when conflicting evidence is also present, and to abstain when the correct support is removed; inference is ordinary decoding, with no verifier, threshold, or regime label. On three multi-hop QA datasets across three seeds, RBA reduces the unsupported-answer rate by more than sixty percentage points relative to conflict-focused training while matching its supported accuracy. On a held-out TriviaQA retrieval-miss slice, the same reader reduces unsupported answering from 100% to below 1% while also improving supported accuracy. These results indicate that evidence-gated answering must be learned on both sides of the support boundary.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA)"方法，通过在同一个问题-答案对上构造匹配的三种上下文变体（纯支持、支持+冲突干扰、仅干扰），使用单一联合似然目标同时监督"回答"和"弃答"两种动作。实验表明该方法在四个QA数据集上将无支持情况下的回答率从100%降至接近0%，同时保持与仅监督回答的基线相当的支持准确率。
AI.motivation: 检索增强语言模型在证据缺失时仍然倾向于给出答案。论文指出这一问题的根源在于训练信号：仅针对"回答"进行微调没有为无支持上下文指定目标动作，导致模型无法区分"主动弃答"与"随意猜测"，使不支持回答率长期维持在100%。
AI.method: 方法核心是构造匹配的三元组 z=(q, g, C⁺, C±, C⁰)，其中C⁺为干净支持上下文，C±为支持+干扰上下文，C⁰为仅含干扰的上下文。通过单一联合似然目标 L_RBA = ℒ_emit + γ·ℒ_withhold 进行训练，同时监督在C⁺和C±下输出黄金答案、在C⁰下输出固定弃答序列"Insufficient information."。论文还提出两个理论命题：(1) 仅回答监督无法识别无支持动作，RBA在理论上可识别；(2) 序列NLL损失可作为边界违反计数的上界。推理阶段无需验证器、阈值或机制标签。
AI.result: 在2WikiMultihopQA、HotpotQA、MuSiQue、TriviaQA四个数据集上，主实验（Qwen3-8B reader）将UAR从100%降至0%，保持66.13%的支持准确率（配对bootstrap 95%CI为[-1.84, 0.67]）。在TriviaQA检索失败切片上，UAR从100%降至<1%。该结果在Llama-3.1-8B和Mistral-7B上也得到重复（Gold变化均在0.2点以内）。消融实验表明：移除无支持监督则UAR保持100%；使用未对齐的弃答上下文则UAR为66.58%；移除答案监督则Gold为0%。边界可迁移到密集检索失败场景（UAR 0.10%），但对部分证据和语义否定等语义不足形式的迁移有限（UAR 76.50%-99.30%）。
AI.conclusion: 证据门控行为必须在支持边界的两侧同时被监督：读者不能从总是应该回答的例子中学习何时不应回答。RBA通过双侧、查询对齐的监督有效学习到了检索失败边界，但该边界对语义形式的不足泛化能力有限，将边界扩展到需要判断部分相关证据是否充分的语义不足情形仍是开放问题。

title: Risk-Controlled Selective LLM Answering by Pricing Label-Free Checks
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 24 tables. Dongyub Jude Lee and Jungseob Lee contributed equally
summary: Serving an answer from a large language model requires deciding when to abstain, yet a verifier's ranking accuracy alone does not determine the error rate among served answers. We introduce PriceCheck, which builds a compact family of decision rules from label-free checks such as re-solving a problem. Each check has a price: its agreement rates on correct and incorrect answers and its cost per run. Prices fitted on a small, class-enriched labelled set compose into predictions of a schedule's coverage and cost, guiding which checks to run and when to stop. A calibration test then selects a schedule at a stated selective-risk target. In mathematics, the selected schedules serve 76.1% of answers on average and keep held-out selective risk below 1.5% on all 15 splits. Under the shared testing protocol, PriceCheck serves more answers at that target than reward models, a prompted judge, the generator's confidence and a trained correctness classifier. At matched coverage, it keeps the fewest wrong answers among these scorers. Across 118 diagnostic schedules, price-based coverage predictions have a rank correlation of 0.97 with observed coverage. These results show that choosing how checks are combined and stopped matters alongside how well a verifier ranks answers. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PriceCheck是一种通过"定价"无标签检查(例如重新解答问题)来构建选择性回答决策规则的方法。它为每个检查分配价格(在正确答案和错误答案上的一致率以及运行成本),组合这些价格来预测调度方案的覆盖率和成本,并通过校准测试在给定的选择性风险目标下选择方案。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在部署时需要决定何时弃答,但验证器的排名准确性并不能决定被服务答案的错误率(选择性风险)。现有验证器仅提供排序,无法指定操作点,也无法说明评分器能在什么风险目标下认证多少答案。需要一种方法来选择、组合和停止哪些检查,以在声明的风险目标下服务尽可能多的答案。
AI.method: PriceCheck包含三步:(1)在有标签定价集上拟合每个无标签检查的价格(完整性completeness、泄漏率leak、单位成本);(2)将检查价格组合为调度方案(schedule),包括级联结构,预测其覆盖率和成本;(3)在校准数据上测试声明的规则族,使用Learn-then-Test框架在指定的1.5%选择性风险目标下选择一个调度方案。每个检查读取候选答案但不读取标签,返回是否一致的二元判定。
AI.result: 在竞赛数学问题上,使用5个微调生成器进行评估:在1.5%风险目标下,选定的调度方案平均服务76.1%的答案,在15个数据划分上都将选择性风险控制在1.5%以下;在共享测试协议下,服务了比奖励模型、提示评判器、生成器置信度和训练的正确性分类器更多的答案;在匹配覆盖率下,保留的错误答案最少。118个诊断调度方案的基于价格的覆盖率预测与观察覆盖率的秩相关系数为0.97。
AI.conclusion: PriceCheck表明,检查的组合与停止方式的选择与验证器的排名质量同等重要。它通过定价无标签检查,将单个检查的测量与完整回答规则的认证联系起来,在选择性预测中提供高覆盖率和受控的风险保证,并优于现有的多种评分器方法。

title: Evaluating Bounded Autonomy in Regulated Agentic AI: A Diagnostic Harness with Constitutional Rewards, Escalation Labels, and Runtime Governance
comment: 9 pages; ancillary evaluation artefacts. Previously submitted to NLLP 2026
summary: We propose RegLLM, a diagnostic harness for bounded autonomy in regulated agentic workflows. It instruments six trustworthiness signals: citation validity, source grounding, schema compliance, escalation correctness, constitutional alignment, and unsafe-action rate. Signals are distinguished by their source of supervision: programmatic verifiers, task-level escalation labels, or AI-judge scores. A deterministic runtime supervisor blocks ungrounded answers and forces escalation, logging interventions. The same domain constitution informs evaluation, training rewards, and serving guardrails. Task-level should-escalate labels make the act-versus-defer decision a measurable training signal. We demonstrate the harness at smoke scale. An offline reference run (n=12) lifts escalation recall from 0 to 0.67 and reduces unsafe-action rate from 0.33 to 0.08 when governance is enabled. Two single-GPU Qwen2.5-3B LoRA/DPO pilots (n=8, same seed and evaluation split) expose substantial variation: nominally identical RL-base configurations yield task success of 0.25 versus 0.12 and escalation recall of 1.0 versus 0.5. An answer-quality adapter changes recall from 1.0 to 0.5 in Run A, but from 0.5 to 1.0 in Run B. An escalation-aware variant produces no measurable change in Run B. These small pilots do not establish reliable adapter effects or production readiness. Their contribution is diagnostic: configuration variance can overwhelm apparent tuning effects on bounded-autonomy metrics, motivating larger evaluation sets and repeated runs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RegLLM 诊断框架，将受监管场景中"回答 vs 升级人工"的决策建模为可验证的训练信号，通过宪法文档同时驱动奖励与运行时治理，并在小规模试点中发现配置方差会压倒适配器效果，呼吁多 seed、大样本评估。
AI.motivation: 在金融合规等受监管领域，LLM 智能体的核心决策不是"答什么"，而是"何时该升级人工"。现有 RLVR 依赖机器可验答案、偏好对齐依赖人工标注、agent guardrail 只做外部拦截——都无法将"何时 defer"训练成可学习、可审计的行为。作者希望把受限自主性（bounded autonomy）变成可度量的训练信号。
AI.method: RegLLM 框架包含：(1) 可插拔宪法文档（以 16 条英国 FCA 原则为例），既作奖励软项也作运行时硬护栏；(2) ReAct 式合规智能体（retrieve/cite/answer/escalate 四工具）；(3) 三类可信度信号——可编程验证器（引用有效性、来源落地、模式合规）、任务级 should-escalate 标签、AI-judge 宪法对齐分；(4) 混合奖励 R(τ)=w_v·R_v+w_c·R_c − λ·𝟙[违规]；(5) 确定性运行时监督器拦截无引用回答并强制升级，记录审计日志；(6) 用 DPO（LoRA，Qwen2.5-3B）训练偏好策略。
AI.result: 离线参考运行（n=12，词法基线）显示加治理后升级召回从 0→0.67，不安全动作率从 0.33→0.08。两轮 GPU 试点（n=8，同种子同评估集）暴露严重方差：RL-base 任务成功率 0.25 vs 0.12、升级召回 1.0 vs 0.5；同一答案质量 DPO 适配器对召回的影响方向在两轮间反转（1.0→0.5 vs 0.5→1.0）；专门设计的升级感知 DPO 变体在第二轮无任何可测变化。运行时监督器在两轮 GPU 试点中触发次数为零（模型每轮都引用了条款）。
AI.conclusion: 本文核心贡献是方法论层面的诊断发现：在常见的 agentic AI 试点规模（n=8、30 步 DPO、10–20 条偏好）下，配置方差会完全淹没适配器效果，单次烟雾测试的"正/负方向"结论均不可信。受监管智能体的负责任评估必须使用多 seed、更大 n 的评估集；框架的价值在于让这一要求在经验上不可避免地显现出来，而非仅作为免责声明被口头提及。同时指出确定性监督器需要加入能力边界（competence-boundary）检测才能真正发挥受限自主性护栏作用。

title: Hierarchical Compression of Vision-Language Model Benchmarks
summary: Thorough evaluation of vision-language models (VLMs) has become prohibitively expensive, as benchmarks span an ever-broader spectrum of capabilities and new models arrive at a relentless pace. Benchmark compression methods that preserve model rankings at a fraction of the cost are well studied for language models, but for VLMs the question remains under-explored. We present PRIMEBench (Pruning Redundant Items for Multimodal Evaluation), a vision-aware hierarchical benchmark compression framework that substantially reduces evaluation cost while preserving model rankings. This hierarchical framework operates in four stages: data cleaning to remove items answerable without the image and all-correct items, category representative selection to pick one benchmark per capability category, item pruning with Vision-Aware Variance (VAW), and category-count pruning. VAW combines inter-model variance with a vision-dependence score computed from multimodal embeddings alone, while encouraging coverage of diverse items within each benchmark. On models held out from item selection, it has the highest mean fidelity at the released 5% retention. The hierarchical design lets practitioners stop at any stage to match their compute budget; the released suite removes over 97% of items while preserving model rankings. Beyond compression, our analyses show how VLM evaluation behaves as model panels grow and evolve, providing guidance for designing future benchmarks that are more efficient, robust to model turnover, and explicit about the limits of evaluation-side pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRIMEBench框架，通过四阶段层次化压缩方法将VLM基准测试的评估成本降低超过97%，同时在5%保留率下保持模型排名保真度最高。
AI.motivation: VLM全面评估成本高昂（每个模型需要数百GPU小时），且现有基准压缩方法主要针对纯文本LLM，对VLM的多模态特性考虑不足，缺乏大规模验证。
AI.method: 四阶段层次化框架：(1)数据清洗移除无需图像即可回答的项目和全对项目；(2)类别代表性选择在18个能力类别中各选一个代表性基准；(3)基于Vision-Aware Variance (VAW)的项目剪枝，结合跨模型方差与基于嵌入的视觉依赖度评分，并使用覆盖单元确保多样性；(4)类别计数剪枝基于分数矩阵的低秩特性选择5个类别。
AI.result: 在30个VLM面板上，释放套件将386,324个项目压缩至9,377个（-97.57%），保持ρ=0.959的排名保真度；在5%保留率下，VAW在未参与选择模型上的平均保真度最高（0.925）；在231个OpenVLM模型上验证，Stage 3达到ρ=0.988。
AI.conclusion: PRIMEBench是首个同时压缩基准和项目的VLM压缩套件，通过视觉感知的层次化压缩显著降低评估成本，同时为未来基准设计提供了关于模型更替、评估效率与剪枝局限性的指导。

title: DScale: Scaling Block-Diffusion Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Verification
summary: Growing large language model applications demand efficient inference. At high concurrency, block-diffusion speculative decoding suffers from verification padding, rejected candidates, and incompatibility between variable prefixes and fixed-shape graphs. Uniform truncation sacrifices acceptable tokens. We present DScale, preserving drafter architecture, weights, and full draft length. A separate 112K-parameter predictor requires neither confidence calibration nor hardware speed-curve preparation. Path-aware tiles reduce padding. Dynamic verify-length (DVL) allocation packs scored prefixes into half the native verification capacity. Fixed-address workspaces propagate changing boundaries through verification and acceptance while reusing captured graphs. On A100-40GB with tensor parallelism 1, Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B cover four datasets and concurrency 8-32, reusing each target's frozen predictor.
