Geometric-mean throughput gains across these configurations are respectively 43.9% and 48.8% over DFlash, 22.2% and 37.7% over DSpark, and 24.4% and 32.0% over Domino, with lower request latency. Cumulative ablations show that adding the three mechanisms successively increases geometric-mean throughput, while budget adjustment improves accepted-token retention. GPU profiling shows that complete decode-step time on GSM8K decreases by 30.8-52.5% relative to DFlash

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DScale，一种针对块扩散推测解码（block-diffusion speculative decoding）在高并发场景下的推理优化运行时。它在保留 DFlash 草稿器架构、权重和完整草稿长度的前提下，通过路径感知瓦片路由、动态验证长度（DVL）预算分配和定址工作空间图集成三个机制，将验证图候选槽位压缩至原生容量的一半，显著提升吞吐量并降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型推理面临高并发下吞吐量与延迟的双重挑战。块扩散推测解码（如 DFlash）在高并发时存在三大瓶颈：（1）注意力瓦片在 prefill 与 verify 间共享，导致验证阶段大量行被掩码造成浪费；（2）请求间可接受令牌数量差异巨大，固定宽度验证浪费槽位；（3）动态前缀与固定形状验证图接口不兼容，CPU 重切片引入同步开销。统一截断会牺牲可接受令牌，降低生成进度。
AI.method: DScale 在 SGLang v0.5.14 上实现 DFlash 的运行时优化，包含三个核心机制：（1）路径感知瓦片路由（Path-aware Tile Routing）：根据 prefill 和 verify 不同查询长度选择不同瓦片高度（prefill 128 行、verify 16 行），消除验证阶段冗余行；（2）动态验证长度（DVL）预算分配：训练一个仅 112K 参数的小型预测器，基于草稿器 logits 差异、隐藏状态和批次上下文预测每个请求的可接受令牌数，将总验证容量压缩至 8N（N 为活跃请求数），通过贪心调整算法在单 GPU 块内完成预算分配；（3）图集成与定址工作空间（Graph Integration）：固定地址缓冲区携带动态边界跨步骤传播，复用捕获的 CUDA 图，避免 CPU 端长度回读与切片重建。预测器无需置信度校准或硬件速度曲线剖析。
AI.result: 在 A100-40GB、TP1 配置下，对 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-4B 在 GSM8K、MATH500、HumanEval、MBPP 四个数据集上、并发度 8-32 的测试表明：DScale 相比 DFlash 几何平均吞吐量提升 43.9%（8B）和 48.8%（4B），相比 DSpark 提升 22.2%/37.7%，相比 Domino 提升 24.4%/32.0%；平均 E2E 延迟降低 31.4%-33.1%；GSM8K 上 GPU 解码步骤时间缩短 30.8%-52.5%。累积消融实验显示三个机制逐步叠加均带来提升；预算调整使可接受令牌保留率从约 71% 提升至 91% 以上。预测器 R² 约 0.68-0.70。
AI.conclusion: DScale 通过路径感知瓦片、评分引导的半容量验证和定址图三大机制，有效解决了块扩散推测解码在高并发下的验证效率问题，在不修改草稿器的前提下实现了显著的吞吐量和延迟改善，为 LLM 服务系统的推理优化提供了实用方案。未来工作可探索其他块宽度和自适应策略。

title: ReLMem: Learning Recurrent Memory for Longitudinal EHR Modeling
summary: Longitudinal electronic health record (EHR) modeling requires integrating new visits with an expanding patient history. Yet the continual accumulation of clinical information imposes increasing computational and memory costs on large language models (LLMs) when they process and retain complete patient histories. A practical alternative is visit-wise recurrent compression, which incorporates each incoming visit into a compact, continually updated patient memory. However, under a fixed memory budget, successive updates must integrate new information without progressively losing critical historical evidence needed to subsequent tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce Recurrent Longitudinal Memory (ReLMem), a framework that learns to maintain fixed-capacity patient memory for efficient downstream prediction with a frozen LLM. ReLMem equips this LLM with lightweight compression adapters to recurrently update the memory from its previous state and each incoming visit, without rereading earlier records. Specifically, we develop a multi-granularity optimization strategy to preserve task-relevant information throughout recurrent updates and support downstream prediction from the final memory. The intermediate supervision aligns attention outputs from compressed memory and the full history under identical queries, while prediction supervision minimizes cross-entropy with ground truth answers conditioned on the final memory. On EHR-based medication prediction, ReLMem approaches the F1 scores of full-history baseline while reducing average retained historical storage by 97.1%. Under the same memory budget, it improves macro- and micro-F1 over the strongest compressed-memory baseline by 4.66 and 4.75 percentage points, respectively. These results highlight the value of learning recurrent patient memory for efficient longitudinal EHR modeling.

AI.tldr: ReLMem提出了一种用于纵向电子健康记录（EHR）建模的循环记忆框架，通过固定容量记忆和冻结的大语言模型（LLM），结合多粒度优化（中间注意力对齐+最终预测监督）和课程学习，高效整合患者历史就诊信息，在减少97.1%历史存储的同时接近全历史基线的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 纵向电子健康记录建模面临两大核心挑战：一是随着就诊次数累积，完整患者历史的计算和内存成本呈二次/线性增长；二是现有压缩方法（如KV剪枝、即时压缩）在固定内存预算下，持续更新可能逐步丢失对下游任务关键的历史证据，导致信息损失累积。
AI.method: ReLMem采用循环压缩机制，将每条新就诊记录与上一时刻的固定容量记忆整合，更新为新状态而非追加。具体包括：（1）任务自适应阶段——先用LoRA对完整历史做监督微调，再合并到冻结的LLM中；（2）循环记忆更新——使用轻量级压缩适配器和B个记忆token，将记忆表示为层级KV对；（3）多粒度优化——中间监督对齐压缩记忆与全历史在相同查询下的注意力输出，最终监督以交叉熵匹配真实答案；（4）课程学习——按就诊次数门槛从短到长渐进引入训练样本。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV数据集的用药预测任务上，ReLMem仅用2.9%的历史预算便接近全历史基线的F1分数（Macro-F1: 61.93% vs 62.22%；Micro-F1: 63.24% vs 63.32%），历史KV存储从4961 MiB降至144 MiB（减少97.1%），更新延迟降低26.3%，峰值GPU内存降低47%。在相同内存预算下，比最强压缩基线CCM-merge在Macro-F1和Micro-F1上分别提升4.66和4.75个百分点。在跨模型（Qwen3-4B/8B、Llama-3.1-8B）和下一就诊诊断预测任务中也表现稳健，F1差距保持在2.5个百分点以内。消融实验证实中间注意力对齐和课程学习均为关键组件。
AI.conclusion: ReLMem验证了学习循环患者记忆的价值——不仅压缩历史，更能在持续更新中保留任务相关信息，为高效纵向EHR建模提供了性能与资源开销的良好权衡。未来需在多中心、跨任务及更广泛模型规模上进一步验证，并探索任务无关的记忆表征。

title: Correct, Don't Delete: Mitigating Emergent Misalignment with Corrective Supervision
summary: Fine-tuning a language model on a narrow set of harmful demonstrations, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned on unrelated questions, a phenomenon known as emergent misalignment (EM). The usual defense is to find the offending rows and delete them, but a row locator failed our held-out test and deleting rows helps less than expected. We ask a different question: given a fixed set of poisoned rows, is it better to correct them than to remove them? We fine-tune Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on a mixture of bad medical advice and benign chat data, select a quarter of the poison rows in advance, and either delete them or replace each with a corrected answer to the same prompt, keeping everything else the same. Replacing the rows cuts the EM rate by about a third and improves answers on held-out medical questions, while deleting the same rows has little measurable effect. The advantage is larger when half the poison rows are corrected, and it holds on a second base model and a second misaligned model organism. The content of the replacement appears to matter: paraphrasing the rows while keeping their bad advice shows no clear benefit, and the correct answers distributed with the dataset appear to do about as well as our rewriter's. Realigning an already-poisoned model with further fine-tuning is known to work, but which data does the work has not been compared directly. We find that a short round of training on corrections beats the same amount of training on generic chat data, that corrections on other medical prompts do roughly as well as corrections of the poisoned prompts themselves, and that instructing the correction writer to model a careful, harm-avoiding assistant adds no measurable benefit over plain corrections. In the settings we tested, correcting harmful training data reduces EM more than deleting it.

AI.tldr: 本文针对"涌现失对齐"(Emergent Misalignment, EM)问题,提出用"修正"有害训练数据替代传统"删除"有害数据的方法,系统证明了修正策略在减少EM、提升任务质量方面显著优于删除策略。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在窄领域有害数据(如错误医疗建议)上微调后,会在无关问题上产生广泛的失对齐(EM)。传统防御方法是定位并删除有害数据行,但作者发现行定位器在保留测试中失败,且删除效果远低于预期。因此作者提出新问题:在固定的有毒数据集中,是修正还是删除更有效?
AI.method: 1. 模型与训练:基于Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct,使用rank-1 LoRA适配器(第24层),在错误医疗建议与良性UltraChat数据1:1混合集上微调;2. 固定行子集:通过固定随机排列定义S10/S25/S50三个嵌套子集;3. 对比条件:untouched(不变)、delete(删除)、rewrite(用gemini-3.5-flash-lite重写为正确且保留任务的回答)、paraphrase(改写但保留错误内容)、curated(用数据集自带正确答案)等;4. 评估:使用Betley et al.的EM指标(56个评估问题),三个评判模型(gpt-4o、gpt-5.6-luna、gemini-3.8-flash);5. 统计分析:每个条件3个种子,配对t检验,预先设定方向性、等效性、未定结果的判定规则;6. 复制与泛化:在Gemma-4-12B-it、金融建议生物、奖励黑客生物上验证;7. 修复实验:对已中毒模型进行107步再训练对比修正、其他提示修正、通用聊天数据三种条件。
AI.result: 1. 修正优于删除:在25%剂量下,rewrite将EM率从28.5%降至19.5%(-9.0pp),而delete仅降至26.8%(-1.7pp,未解决);rewrite vs delete差异-7.3pp(p=0.033,方向性);50%剂量时差异扩大至-12.3pp(p=0.002);2. 任务质量:rewrite在保留医疗提示上比untouched高17.3分,比delete高12.9分;3. 跨模型与跨域泛化:Gemma-4上差异-5.1pp,金融建议上差异-14.9pp;4. 内容相关性:paraphrase(保留错误内容)无明显益处(+1.2pp,未定),说明重要的是修正内容而非新token;5. 离域修正有效:删除S25后添加Stack Exchange不相关领域的修正行,EM降低约5.8pp(rewrite效应的64%),但无任务质量提升;6. 安全指令无额外益处:安全指令改写vs中性改写差异-0.85pp,等效;7. 修复已中毒模型:修正重放将EM降至2.4%,vs通用聊天14.9%(-12.5pp,p=0.015);修正中毒提示与其他医疗提示的修正等效(-0.1pp);8. 能力基准盲区:MedQA、临床MMLU等多项选择基准对所有效果不敏感,差异≤0.83pp,而判断式答案质量跨度超50分;9. 归因定位失败:多种归因方法(包括阻尼梯度影响、EK-FAC等)在20个新鲜组上Spearman相关均≤0.28,内容评判器选择更好。
AI.conclusion: 在测试设置中,修正有害训练数据比删除更能减少涌现失对齐;修正效果大部分(但不全部)可由同一领域的正确数据实现,无论是否落在中毒提示上;重要的是修正的内容,而非安全指令或改写;能力基准(MedQA等)无法检测这些EM效应,需要判断式评估;实际中,便宜的内容评判器比昂贵的归因方法更能选择应修正的行;局限包括:仅rank-1 LoRA、仅三个种子、未测试条件性失对齐、未测试修复在进一步训练下是否持续。

title: SPLASH: Switching Parallel Layouts of Attention with Seamless Handoff for LLM Serving
comment: 28 pages, 11 figures, 8 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: No single way of parallelizing attention serves large language models well under all loads. Low concurrency favors tensor parallelism, many independent requests favor data-parallel attention, and long prompts favor context parallelism. Reasoning, agentic, and RL-rollout workloads make a fixed choice untenable: a batch that begins as many short requests ends as a few very long ones, so the best layout changes while the same requests run. Serving engines nevertheless fix one layout at launch, because changing it has meant draining requests and restarting workers. We present SPLASH, a serving system that switches the parallel layout of attention while requests are running. It builds on one observation: modern attention, with few or no KV heads, decouples where a request's KV cache lives from how attention weights are sharded. This has two consequences. First, layouts differ only in who owns the weights and the cache, and most of that state already sits where the next layout needs it; SPLASH reuses it, moves the rest in the background of ongoing inference, and hands off at a batch boundary, making a switch nearly free: its median overhead is under 0.51% of the step it runs in. Second, the decoupling exposes a layout that existing engines lack: Decoupled Ownership Parallelism (DOP) shards attention weights as tensor parallelism does while keeping each request's cache on a single owner as data-parallel attention does. DOP replicates neither, offers 27-60% more KV capacity than data-parallel attention, and gives the scheduler a choice when KV memory limits admission. A transition-aware scheduler follows the best of the four layouts as load changes. On B200 GPUs serving GLM-5.3, SPLASH improves end-to-end serving throughput by 1.3-1.73x over fixed-layout deployments, and the same layout regimes appear with DeepSeek-V3.2 on H200 and GLM-5.3-Flash on DCU.

AI.tldr: SPLASH 是一个面向 LLM 推理服务的系统，能够在请求运行过程中动态切换注意力层的并行布局（TP、CP、DP-attention 及新提出的 DOP），通过所有权模型揭示各布局在权重与 KV 缓存上的差异，并利用与推理计算重叠的层间数据传输实现近乎免费的切换，中位数开销低于目标步骤的 0.51%，端到端吞吐较固定布局提升 1.3–1.73×。
AI.motivation: 在推理、Agentic 与 RL rollout 等负载下，同一批请求的最优注意力并行布局会在运行中从"大量短请求"演变为"少量长请求"，而现有服务引擎在启动时固定单一布局，切换需重启并清空批，造成损失。该问题源于 TP/CP/DP-attention 各自的冗余与适配场景不同，且 KV 缓存在切换时无法廉价重建。
AI.method: 1) 所有权模型：将四种布局统一为两个独立选择——投影权重放在哪里、每个请求的 KV 历史由谁持有——并由此推导各布局的内存占用、容量上限与切换所需状态（discard/all-gather/all-to-all 三类集合通信）。2) 提出的新布局 DOP（Decoupled Ownership Parallelism）：投影按 TP 分片、KV 按 DP-attention 单 owner 持有，无任何冗余，每层做固定大小的 query all-to-all。3) SPLASH 系统：在普通服务步内，按层流水迁移缺失状态（层 i 传输与层 i-1 计算重叠），在批次边界交接；配合 transition-aware 调度器，按可行集与延迟模型选择当前最优布局。
AI.result: 在 B200/H200/DCU 上对 GLM-5.3、DeepSeek-V3.2、GLM-5.3-Flash 进行固定布局与切换开销评测。固定布局：四种布局各占优势区间（DOP 在 256K–512K 及最大 batch 下领先，比次优高 3.4–11.0%）；KV 容量上 DOP 比 DP-attention 多 27.3%（B200）、59.7%（H200）、19.0%（DCU）。切换：12 个有向方向中 SPLASH p50 开销仅 0.02–11.76 ms，相对阻塞式切换降低 98.24–98.78%（B200）；B200 端到端吞吐较固定布局提升 1.3–1.73×。
AI.conclusion: 将注意力布局视为可在请求生命周期内变化的两个所有权选择，使所有 12 种有向切换均可归结为 discard/all-gather/all-to-all 三种原语，并自然暴露零冗余的 DOP 布局。SPLASH 在不阻塞推理的前提下近乎零成本地切换布局，使部署能跟随负载动态选择最优策略，显著提升 LLM 服务吞吐与容量。

title: ProCTI: Prototype-Refined Global Conditioning for Diffusion-Based Time Series Imputation
summary: Time series imputation has progressed from statistical and deep learning approaches to diffusion-based models, which have shown strong recent performance. Existing diffusion-based methods typically condition the reverse process using local contextual information from the current or neighbouring windows. Meanwhile, global dataset-level structure often remains implicit, limiting performance when local observations are sparse, noisy, or unrepresentative. To address this issue, we propose ProCTI, a diffusion-imputation framework that augments local conditioning with retrieved global dataset-level priors through learned prototypes. A hybrid conditioning mechanism integrates this global context with local signals during reverse diffusion, enabling more accurate reconstruction under varying missingness scenarios. Experiments across multiple benchmark datasets show that ProCTI outperforms strong baselines overall under random missingness, while remaining competitive under attribute-wise missingness. Furthermore, we use a latent-regime data model to characterise the precise conditions under which prototype-derived global conditioning provably improves imputation. We support this with a general theoretical analysis of local-global conditioning.

AI.tldr: ProCTI提出了一种基于扩散模型的时间序列填补框架，通过学习原型库（prototype bank）在反向扩散过程中结合全局数据集级先验与局部上下文信号，显著提升填补精度，并在理论层面刻画了全局条件化何时能带来改善。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的时间序列填补方法主要依赖局部上下文（当前或邻近窗口）进行条件化，当局部观测稀疏、噪声大或不具代表性时，隐式编码在参数中的全局数据集结构无法有效恢复缺失值，导致重建质量下降。论文以北京空气质量数据为例，说明数据集存在显著的全局"regime"结构，需要显式利用。
AI.method: ProCTI包含两个核心组件：（1）可学习原型库P，通过多头跨注意力从窗口级查询向量中检索属性特定的全局上下文向量r_b；（2）混合条件化机制，将r_b以可学习标量α注入到基于频率感知的扩散框架（FGTI）的dominant-frequency分支中，与local高频信号结合形成条件信号h。在理论层面，给出四个结果：Lemma 1（信息论：Z带来条件不确定性降低）、Proposition 1（分数分解为局部得分+regime guidance）、Proposition 2（MMSE减少恒等式）、Proposition 3（latent-regime数据模型下I(Y;Z|O)>0 ⟺ Y不独立于Z|O ⟺ 全局条件化严格降低最优去噪误差）。
AI.result: 在5个真实数据集（Gait、PhysioNet、Weather、Beijing、Stock）上对9个基线进行系统评估：（1）随机缺失下ProCTI在所有数据集上获得最低平均MAE，相对最强扩散基线FGTI减少约3-30%，PhysioNet和Stock提升最大；（2）属性级缺失下，在Gait、PhysioNet、Beijing上ProCTI最优，在Weather和Stock上BRITS更优（论文解释为特征冗余强使Y⊥Z|O近似成立，全局条件化无信息增益）；（3）消融实验证明可学习原型库+跨注意力+dominant分支注入+可学习α为最优组合；（4）概率评估（CRPS、PI90覆盖/宽度）显示ProCTI校准良好；（5）超参数敏感性：32个原型、α=0.1表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: ProCTI通过引入可学习的原型条件化机制，将显式全局数据集级先验融入扩散填补的反向过程，兼具经验性能与理论保障。论文的核心结论是：原型条件化的收益是条件性的——当regime变量Z携带关于缺失值Y的超出观测O的残余信息时全局条件化能严格改善填补；反之在强特征冗余场景下简单回归方法即可胜任。未来工作方向包括原型库可解释性和非平稳regime设计。

title: RLTL;DR: Self-improvement by Internalizing Self-generated Feedback
summary: The common paradigm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is to let agents make multiple attempts at a task, and optimize towards the successful ones. This becomes problematic in the realms of self-improvement, where tasks are so difficult that the agent has a low or even no chance of success, and where there are no teacher models or example solutions to distill from. In this paper, we introduce RLTL;DR. After each failed attempt, we show the policy the verifier outputs and let it write its own feedback, in the form of a single TL;DR insight. The next rollout is conditioned on all previous insights, and we sequentially sample rollouts until a solution is found. Moreover, we enable backpropagation on the in-context insights to internalize a direct task to insight mapping. On challenging tool-calling and coding datasets (filtered to Pass@128=0), standard GRPO training of a Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking policy stays flat at a Pass@1 of 0% to 1%. RLTL;DR breaks through this learning barrier, achieving a Pass@1 of 14-31% with insights in context during training and, crucially, 12-13% when no insight is in context at eval time. We identify that the key is the task to insight internalization. To study this further, we reduce our approach to SFTL;DR, training only on (task, insight) tuples, without showing or backpropagating on any rollouts. Training on only 4k of these tuples recovers almost the full performance of RLTL;DR and classical SFT on full rollouts. This demonstrates a promising compacted training paradigm of the form "on this sort of task, keep this sort of thing in mind", which we hope to inspire future research on.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RLTL;DR方法，通过让策略在失败后自我生成简短TL;DR形式的insight，并将insight内化到模型参数中，从而在传统GRPO无法学习的极难任务（Pass@128=0）上突破学习壁垒，实现Pass@1从0-1%提升到12-13%。进一步研究发现，仅在(task, insight)元组上进行SFT训练（无需回传rollout）即可恢复几乎全部性能，展现了压缩训练范式的潜力。
AI.motivation: 传统RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）在自改进场景下面临学习壁垒：当任务极其困难、策略在128次尝试中均无成功时，所有rollout获得相同奖励，优势消失，梯度为零，无法学习。此外在自改进场景中没有更强的教师模型或示例解可供参考，策略只能通过自身探索逐步内化发现。
AI.method: RLTL;DR包含两个关键技术：(1) 序贯自生成insight——失败后将验证器输出展示给策略，让其生成单句TL;DR形式的insight，后续rollout以累积insight为条件进行采样；(2) insight内化——在反向传播时激活insight token（约17个）的mask，对πθ(f|g)施加SFT损失，从而将task→insight映射内化到模型参数中。此外作者将方法进一步简化为SFTL;DR：仅在(task, insight)元组上做SFT，完全不回传rollout。
AI.result: 在过滤为Pass@128=0的Appworld、Synthetic API（SAPI）、Leetcode等工具调用与编码数据集上，Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking策略的标准GRPO训练Pass@1停留在0-1%；RLTL;DR在评估时（无insight在上下文）达到Pass@1=12-13%，训练时（有insight）达到14-31%。SFTL;DR仅用4k个(task, insight)元组训练即可恢复RLTL;DR几乎全部性能。消融实验表明SFT损失是关键驱动因素，GRPO损失虽非必需但可加速收敛。insight应保持通用简短以利泛化，详细的诊断段落或修正代码反而损害性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了直接对任务级压缩insight进行反向传播内化，能够让策略在无insight上下文的测试条件下也能应用所学。核心机制在于大语言模型反向传播的语义平滑性——训练格式(task→insight)可泛化到测试格式(task→rollout)。这一"压缩训练范式"为联邦学习、从人类反馈学习、长rollout总结学习等开辟了新方向，但仍受限于策略的预训练平滑度与insight质量。

title: Evaluating and Benchmarking the System One Model Jev
comment: Code available at this http URL , model responses at this http URL
summary: Jev is a commercial System One model from TypeSafe AI that does not generate text: given a state and typed questions, it returns a choice from fixed options, a position on a rubric, or the probability that a statement is true, with probabilities the vendor describes as calibrated. Such models target small decisions in information access pipelines, such as routing queries, checking grounding, moderating content, or rating against a rubric. We evaluate Jev (jev-1.13.0) zero-shot on 37 datasets spanning classification, routing, natural language inference, reading comprehension, commonsense reasoning, moderation, legal clause analysis and rubric scoring, with one frozen template per dataset and full evaluation splits: 346,009 requests for under USD 10. For reference, we score Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-E4B on identical requests via their exact next-token probabilities over the options. Jev reaches 95-99% accuracy on IMDB, SST-2, HellaSwag and ARC and 86.7% on Belebele across 122 languages. It beats Qwen on 27 of 37 datasets, with none of Qwen's nine leads outside the bootstrap intervals, and Gemma on all 37. All three models degrade on low-resource languages, fine-grained or noisy labels, and rubric-based quality judgments. Jev's choice probabilities are well calibrated and support selective prediction. Binary probabilities rank well but are poorly placed relative to a fixed 0.5 threshold; thresholds tuned on training data raise micro-F1 on UNFAIR-ToS from 0.50 to 0.75. Jev answers MMLU's calculation-heavy questions more accurately than other MMLU questions (94% vs. 91%), whereas both open models, and all three on C-Eval, find them harder. Rotating the options leaves Jev's accuracy unchanged and withholding the question drops it to near chance, ruling out shallow memorization but not memorized question-answer pairs. We release the code, harness and all raw responses.

AI.tldr: 本文对TypeSafe AI的商业"System One"模型Jev（jev-1.13.0）进行了全面的零样本基准测试评估，覆盖37个数据集、7类任务共346,009个请求，并与Qwen3.8-27B和Gemma-4-E4B两个开源模型在完全相同的请求上进行了对比。Jev在情感分类、主题路由、常识推理等短文本决策任务上表现优异且概率校准良好，在27/37个数据集上超越Qwen，全部37个上超越Gemma；但在低资源语言、细粒度/噪声标签、法律判断和生成文本的评分任务上表现明显下降。MMLU数学题异常高分这一未解之谜经实验排除了浅层记忆的可能。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型越来越多地用于信息访问系统中小型、结构化的决策任务（如路由、内容审核、事实核查、评分等），使用生成式自回归模型做这些决策显得间接且低效。TypeSafe AI的Jev作为专为此类任务设计的"System One"模型，其厂商声称概率经过良好校准，但缺乏公开的、系统性的基准评估。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建37个公开数据集的基准套件，覆盖分类、路由、自然语言推理、阅读理解、常识推理、内容审核、法律条款分析和评分7类任务；每个数据集使用一个冻结模板，将任务映射到Jev的三个问题原语（Choice、Score、Noul）。采用零样本评估，报告主指标及95%自举置信区间、ECE、Brier分数等校准指标以及选择性预测曲线。使用异步客户端以最高1100请求/分钟的速度发送请求。同时使用Hugging Face transformers在bf16精度下对Qwen3.8-27B和Gemma-4-E4B进行完全相同请求的评分（通过下一个token概率而非生成文本），以提供对比基线。发布代码、评估框架和所有原始响应。
AI.result: Jev在IMDB（96.5%）、SST-2（96.4%）、HellaSwag（95.5%）、ARC（98.8%）、Belebele（86.7%，122种语言）等数据集上达到高精度；在37个数据集中27个超越Qwen3.8-27B（其中11个置信区间不重叠，Qwen的领先无置信区间分离），全部37个超越Gemma-4-E4B。Choice概率校准良好（汇总ECE 0.028），但二元Noul概率倾向于略微欠自信（ECE 0.052），多标签Noul则过预测yes（ECE 0.168）。固定0.5阈值在不平衡数据上表现不佳，调优阈值可使UNFAIR-ToS的micro-F1从0.50提升至0.75。选择性预测效果良好，50%覆盖率下准确率显著提升。Jev在MMLU计算密集型科目上反而比非计算科目表现更好（94% vs 91%），这一异常结果在两个开源模型中均不存在；通过旋转选项和隐藏问题的探测实验，排除了浅层记忆和选项伪影的可能，但无法排除问答对记忆。低资源语言和细粒度任务（如AGB-DE F1仅0.204）仍是显著弱点。整个评估成本仅9.15美元。
AI.conclusion: Jev在其System One定位所承诺的短文本、结构化决策任务上表现出色，提供高零样本准确率、良好校准的概率、支持选择性预测的置信度分数以及极低的成本。其局限性主要体现在低资源语言、细粒度/噪声标签、法律判断和生成文本评分任务上，二元概率需要应用特定的阈值调优。MMLU数学题的异常高分是值得关注的未解问题，最可能的解释是训练数据中接触过MMLU问题，但无法确认。研究发布了完整的代码、框架和原始响应，以便复现和扩展评估。

title: Retrieve, Reproduce, Reveal: Dissecting Retrieval-Augmented Software Vulnerability Detection
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is increasingly used to enhance Large Language Model (LLM)-based software vulnerability detection by grounding predictions in retrieved vulnerability knowledge, such as vulnerability reports. However, existing RAG-based software vulnerability detection (RAG4SVD) systems are often evaluated using proprietary models, which challenges open science and reproducibility. Further, studies use different datasets, custom knowledge bases, different backbone models, and diverse metrics, which hinders meaningful cross-system comparison. In this work, we study six open-source RAG4SVD systems and address these reproducibility and comparability challenges through (i) reproduction of their experimental settings under an open-weight setting, and (ii) a unified benchmark using a common dataset, metric suite, and pool of open-weight models. Further, RAG4SVD systems typically consist of multiple components, yet are often evaluated only as a whole system, i.e., end-to-end. Therefore, we perform (iii) a component-level analysis that decomposes representative RAG4SVD pipelines into input abstraction, knowledge retrieval, and detection. Our results demonstrate that reproducibility varies substantially across systems. Under the presented unified benchmark, published RAG4SVD performance does not transfer under a controlled open-weight evaluation and depends strongly on the used model. The component analysis shows that effective RAG4SVD depends on the alignment between pipeline stages. For example, oracle knowledge raises retrieval to near-optimal, yet performance remains low (0.51 pairwise accuracy), demonstrating that retrieval effectiveness alone is insufficient for reliable detection. These findings motivate evaluating RAG4SVD not only end-to-end, but at the level of pipeline components, and provide a basis for more standardized, RAG-aware evaluation practices.

AI.tldr: 该论文对六个开源的检索增强型软件漏洞检测（RAG4SVD）系统进行了系统性研究，针对其可复现性、跨系统可比性以及组件级归因三大问题展开深入分析，揭示了现有RAG4SVD系统在开放权重模型设置下的真实表现差异，并提出了组件级评估的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG4SVD系统普遍依赖专有模型，且各系统在数据集、知识库、骨干模型和评估指标上存在显著差异，导致：（1）结果难以复现（可复现性缺口）；（2）系统间无法进行有意义的比较（可比性缺口）；（3）端到端评估无法揭示哪些组件驱动性能提升（归因缺口）。这些问题阻碍了RAG4SVD领域的科学进展。
AI.method: 研究包含三个层次的分析：（1）RQ1可复现性分析——对四个具有开源权重设置的RAG4SVD系统（SVD-Bench、Llama-VD、LLM4Vuln、Vul-RAG）在本地推理环境下进行复现，以绝对相对偏差量化可复现性；（2）RQ2统一基准测试——在PrimeVul Paired数据集上，使用22个开源权重模型（3B-32B，涵盖7个模型家族）对五个RAG4SVD系统进行受控对比，采用pairwise accuracy和F1作为评估指标；（3）RQ3组件级分析——以Vul-RAG和LLM4Vuln为代表，将其管道分解为输入抽象、知识检索和漏洞检测三个组件，对每个组件进行内在（intrinsic）评估，包括LLM-as-a-Judge评估摘要质量、Hit@k和MRR评估检索效果，以及oracle知识库下的检测性能分析。
AI.result: （1）可复现性差异显著：Llama-VD和Vul-RAG偏差<1%（可复现），SVD-Bench偏差>5%（不可复现），LLM4Vuln因依赖专有模型不可在纯开源权重设置下复现；（2）统一基准下，Vul-RAG表现最优（pairwise accuracy 0.20-0.22），但系统排名与原始论文报告不一致，原SOTA排名未能转移到统一开放权重环境；性能高度依赖骨干模型，且不存在一致的模型规模或代码专业化优势；F1分数具有误导性（如GRACE下Llama模型F1=0.67但pairwise accuracy≈0）；（3）组件分析显示：摘要质量由系统特定的提示目标驱动而非模型能力；检索效果更受查询抽象模型影响而非知识库生成模型；oracle知识下检索接近最优（MRR 0.93-0.95），但平均pairwise accuracy仅0.51，最高0.73，说明检索有效性本身不足以保证可靠的检测，检测器的能力是独立的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: RAG4SVD的进展不能仅通过扩展单个组件（如模型规模或知识库规模）实现，性能受管道各阶段间对齐程度（输入抽象与检索的匹配、知识库与目标分布的对齐、检索知识与检测器的适配）的制约。未来评估应在端到端指标之外，补充组件级评估（抽象质量、知识库覆盖率、检索效果、解析鲁棒性和下游知识使用情况），以推动更标准化、RAG感知的评估实践。

title: When Models Don't Manipulate Manifolds: The Geometry of a Comparison Task
summary: One of the current premises of mechanistic interpretability research is that detailed accounts of the geometry of neural network representations can tell us how models perform computations, and how to effectively intervene on them. While low dimensional manifolds have been observed for multiple concepts in the literature (e.g. numbers encoded on helices, days of the week on a circle, ...), with structure believed to reflect properties of data and tasks, the extent to which models rely on them for computation, and how they manipulate them, remains unclear. We characterize precisely the geometry of computation in a number-comparison task, as an abstraction of comparison for decision making, and how models utilize geometry in an elegant fashion to implement it. Specifically, we study the causal geometry of number comparison in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, a capable and widely studied open-weight model, and find Qwen largely uses linear representations of numbers despite the presence of curved geometry. To compare two numbers, the model first encodes each number along a vector and adds the two representations using attention and the residual connection, bringing them into a shared space in the residual stream. Then, the model uses MLP neurons to compare the pair of numbers on local regions in this shared space, which correspond to smaller intervals of input numbers, and combines these to obtain the position of the maximum. In fact, this reliance on linear representations for comparison also persists when the model compares three numbers. Our findings demonstrate that the manifold hypothesis can co-exist with linear representations: while concepts that are ordered may have manifold structure in representations, the model may use an underlying linear structure of the concept in certain computations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 在数字比较任务中的计算几何，发现尽管数字表征存在非线性流形结构，模型实际上使用线性表征并通过加性混合、局部比较与全局组合完成比较计算，并将其推广至三数比较。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性研究中的一个核心假设是，神经网络表征的几何结构能揭示模型如何执行计算。但当前存在两种竞争性假说：线性表征假说与流形假说。本文的动机在于厘清模型在特定计算任务（数字比较）中究竟依赖表征几何的哪一部分——是操纵非线性流形，还是使用更简单的线性结构。
AI.method: 以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 为对象，采用激活补丁（interchange intervention）、DAS（Distributed Alignment Search）、主成分分析（PCA）、岭回归探针、归因分析（attribution patching）、冻结实验（freezing）以及剂量-响应扫描（dose-response sweep）等因果干预方法，系统定位参与数字比较的层、注意力头、MLP 神经元及表征方向，并在两数与三数比较任务中验证算法的因果有效性。
AI.result: 1) 发现模型在数字表征存在弯曲流形的情况下，主要沿单一因果线性方向 u, v 使用数字；2) 揭示两数比较算法：通过注意力头 H14 与残差连接将 y₁ 的线性表征复制并加到 y₂ 位置，形成共享二维平面 span(v₁, v₂)；3) 发现 12 个关键 MLP 神经元（MLP14 与 MLP15 各 6 个）以"局部比较→全局组合"的方式工作：MLP14 神经元在局部区间内响应，MLP15 神经元将其组合为全局比较器；4) 三数比较中，模型在每个时间步计算"旗标"αₜ = 𝕀(yₜ = max(y₁,...,yₜ))，并通过 L20 注意力头在最后一 token 汇总旗标以读出 argmax 位置；5) 所有发现均通过因果干预（IIA 与位置恢复 PR）得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明流形假说与线性表征可以共存：尽管有序概念在表征中可能呈现流形结构，模型在特定计算中仍可利用其底层的线性方向。本文提出的算法具有描述性与因果性双重性质，能够预测干预对模型行为的影响，为"算法级可解释性"提供了具体范例，并提示研究者应谨慎区分表征几何中可用的结构与模型在计算中实际使用的结构。

title: GARDiff: Graph-Aligned Residual Diffusion for Probabilistic Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Diffusion models have recently shown strong potential for probabilistic multivariate time-series forecasting by modeling complex conditional distributions. Recent decoupled diffusion frameworks further separate forecasting into deterministic prediction and stochastic residual generation, making it natural to derive dependency graphs from deterministic representations and use them to guide residual diffusion. However, we show that this direct structural transfer is unreliable. Although deterministic-derived graphs encode useful global dependency priors, they exhibit substantial edge-level misalignment with residual dependency structures, introducing inaccurate or redundant conditions during residual generation. This reveals a previously overlooked deterministic-to-residual structural alignment problem in decoupled diffusion forecasting. To address this problem, we propose GARDiff, a Graph-Aligned Residual Diffusion framework for probabilistic multivariate time-series forecasting. Instead of treating deterministic-derived graphs as fixed diffusion conditions, GARDiff progressively adapts them to residual generation. Specifically, GARDiff estimates residual uncertainty to distinguish high- and low-uncertainty regions, enabling uncertainty-aware structural refinement, and further performs timestep-aware edge sparsification during reverse diffusion to evolve graph conditions from broad dependency aggregation to localized residual refinement. Extensive experiments on six real-world benchmarks demonstrate that GARDiff consistently improves probabilistic forecasting performance and uncertainty calibration over strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出GARDiff框架，解决解耦扩散预测中确定性图与残差图之间的结构错位问题，通过不确定性感知区域对齐和时间步感知边稀疏化动态优化残差扩散中的图条件。
AI.motivation: 现有的解耦扩散预测框架将确定性预测图中提取的依赖图直接用于引导残差扩散，但作者发现确定性图与残差图在边级别存在显著错位（低Jaccard相似度），直接迁移会引入不准确或冗余条件，暴露出被忽视的"确定性到残差结构对齐"问题。
AI.method: 1) 确定性图构建：从中间表示通过patch嵌入+Top-K稀疏化+结构门控构建G₀；2) 不确定性感知区域对齐：用ασ准则区分高低不确定性patch，保留高不确定性区域的候选边；3) 时间步感知拓扑对齐：用余弦退火调度K(t)从K_max到K_min，使早期去噪保持高连通性、后期局部细化；4) 统一掩码M_pres ∨ M_spar经MaskedSoftmax得到G^(t)；5) 图引导的PatchDN去噪网络生成残差。
AI.result: 在6个真实基准（ETTm1/m2、Weather、Solar、ECL、Traffic）上，GARDiff在CRPS和CRPS_sum上一致优于TimeDiff、TMDM、NsDiff、D3U等强基线，相比D3U最高降低5.5% CRPS和41.6% CRPS_sum；确定性预测也具有竞争力；不确定性估计器EMR达0.92-0.94，与oracle残差性能高度一致。
AI.conclusion: GARDiff通过将确定性图视为全局先验并进行渐进式对齐，有效缓解了结构错位问题，显著提升了概率预测性能和不确定性校准，验证了不确定性感知和时间步感知双重对齐机制的必要性。

title: Width Expansion as a Method for Class Incremental Learning
summary: Class Incremental Learning (Class-IL) requires models to learn new classes over time while preserving previously acquired knowledge without access to past data or task identity. This setting intensifies the stability-plasticity dilemma and makes catastrophic forgetting a central challenge. Existing approaches include regularization, knowledge distillation, replay, and architectural expansion. However, many expansion methods rely on explicit task identifiers or predefined growth strategies, limiting their applicability when task boundaries are unavailable at inference time. This work proposes a dynamic width expansion method that increases the number of neurons within existing layers according to a normalized loss criterion, without requiring task-specific information. An attention mechanism with persistent key-value memory is also incorporated to stabilize feature representations and reduce interference between previously learned and newly introduced classes. The approach is evaluated on Split MNIST and Split CIFAR-100 under the standard Class-IL protocol. Experiments compare fixed-capacity and dynamically expanding architectures, both with and without attention, combined with established continual learning methods including EWC, LwF, and A-GEM. Results show that progressive width expansion consistently improves performance over fixed architectures, particularly when combined with functional methods and A-GEM. The combination of width expansion and attention provides the most consistent gains. Overall, dynamic width expansion based on representational demand provides an effective and flexible strategy for Class-IL, although uncontrolled growth may increase overfitting and computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于类增量学习（Class-IL）的动态宽度扩展方法，结合持久键值记忆的线性注意力机制，在不依赖任务标识符的情况下扩展现有层的神经元数量，以缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 类增量学习中，模型需要顺序学习新类别且推理时无任务标识，固定容量模型面临稳定性-可塑性困境。现有架构扩展方法多依赖任务标识或预定义增长策略，限制了其在标准Class-IL协议下的适用性。
AI.method: 提出两种互补机制：(1) 基于归一化损失准则的动态宽度扩展（WE/WD层），在已有层内增加神经元数量，由全局归一化损失信号 g 和局部神经元利用率 u 加权决定扩展系数 c，并设有界增长约束；(2) 带持久键值记忆的线性注意力机制（基于ELU+1特征映射的正定核），记忆向量在增量步骤间持续保存以稳定特征表示。两种机制可独立或组合使用，并与EWC、SI、LwF、LwM、ER、A-GEM等持续学习方法结合。
AI.result: 在Split MNIST（5步×2类）和Split CIFAR-100（10步×10类，有/无预训练）上的实验表明：(1) 宽度扩展持续优于固定架构，特别是与功能方法(LwF)和A-GEM结合时；(2) WE+Attention组合获最稳定提升——Split MNIST上LwF从29.79%→44.04%，Split CIFAR-100上A-GEM从11.72%→25.17%；(3) 基于正则化的方法(EWC/SI)几乎无效；(4) ER因显式重放而对架构改进不敏感；(5) 预训练冻结主干反而不利于增量适应，特征层的适应性比初始表示质量更关键。
AI.conclusion: 动态宽度扩展基于表征需求提供了一种任务无关、灵活的Class-IL策略，与持久记忆注意力机制互补地缓解灾难性遗忘。但需注意：不受控的增长可能导致过拟合和计算开销增加；扩展特定超参数未经过系统网格搜索；未来工作应扩展至卷积层扩展、选择性剪枝、更细粒度的扩展信号，以及大规模和类别不平衡基准。

title: A Proposed Rubric for Evaluating Expressed Clinical Reasoning in Large Language Model Responses
summary: Rubrics support the structured evaluation of language models. We propose a rubric for assessing expressed clinical reasoning in model responses, drawing on three bodies of work: medical education assessment frameworks (ART, SCT, Key Feature Problems and OSCE); clinical LLM benchmarks (MedR-Bench, HealthBench, TIMER-Bench, this http URL , PrIME-LLM and PatientSafeBench); and general LLM reasoning evaluation research, including the Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility taxonomy, FaithCoT-Bench and C2-Faith. We use groundedness as a clinically oriented adaptation of the taxonomy's factuality category. The rubric brings these concepts together in a multidimensional framework for scoring free-text responses to gold-standard clinical vignettes. It includes provisional behavioural anchors, applicability rules and a separate flag for case-specific safety-critical errors. General-domain frameworks inform its design but are not treated as validated clinical instruments. The rubric does not replace case-specific reference criteria or the task-specific metrics of existing benchmarks. It has not yet been tested for inter-rater reliability, construct validity or clinical utility. Its immediate purpose is to make evaluation decisions explicit and open to scrutiny before empirical testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套用于评估大语言模型(LLM)在临床推理任务中响应质量的多维度评估量表(rubric),整合了医学教育评估框架、临床LLM基准和通用LLM推理评估理论三大领域的概念,旨在为基于纵向EHR病例的临床自由文本响应提供一个共享、可解释的评分词汇,但尚未经过信效度验证。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM临床评估多依赖考试式准确率,无法反映模型在患者记录上的真实推理质量;现有医学教育评估工具、临床LLM基准和通用LLM评估方法各自只覆盖部分维度,缺乏一个统一的、可解释的多维评分框架用于评估模型在纵向、多文档EHR病例中的"表达性临床推理"质量,尤其在评分决策需要透明化、可被审视的背景下存在空白。
AI.method: 采用概念综合(conceptual synthesis)方法,系统梳理三类文献:(1)医学教育评估框架(ART、SCT、KFP、OSCE);(2)临床LLM基准(HealthBench、MedR-Bench、TIMER-Bench、DR.BENCH、PrIME-LLM、PatientSafeBench等);(3)通用LLM推理评估理论(Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility分类、FaithCoT-Bench、C2-Faith、PRMBench)。将Lee & Hockenmaier的"事实性"概念改造为"groundedness"(临床导向的真实性+案例证据支持)。构建七大顶层评分域,每域含子维度与1-5分行为锚点,并附适用性规则、案例特定安全关键错误标志。
AI.result: 提出七维评分框架:Domain 1(事实准确性与groundedness)、Domain 2(推理过程质量,含4个子维度:有效性、连贯性、效率、完整性)、Domain 3(诊断推理,含问题表征、鉴别诊断、检查选择、因果推理4个子维度)、Domain 4(时间推理,4个子维度)、Domain 5(不确定性处理与元认知,含校准、信念更新、寻求上下文3个子维度)、Domain 6(临床安全,含升级识别、避免伤害、抵制迎合3个子维度)、Domain 7(沟通质量与适配,含清晰度、受众校准、指令遵循3个子维度)。每子维度均配1-5分行为锚点;案例特定安全关键错误单独标记;提供附录B完整评分表;明确适用性规则、可加权或未加权聚合方法。
AI.conclusion: 该量表提供了一种实用、多维的评分框架,可对基于金标准临床病例的自由文本响应进行评分,使评估决策显式化、可审视;但作者明确强调该量表尚未经过评分者间信度、结构效度和临床实用性的实证检验,通用领域框架仅作为概念支架而非经验证的临床工具,该量表不取代案例特定参考标准或现有任务特定指标,其实用性优势是经验性问题,需进一步实证验证。

title: Predictive Self-Supervised Learning Provably Identifies Stochastic Signals under Nuisance
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) by predicting in latent space, without generating the input data itself, learns highly abstract, useful representations. Intuitively, this success is often attributed to its ability to discard nuisance information that is irrelevant to prediction. However, this poses a conundrum: both stochastic variation in a prediction-relevant latent signal and true nuisance make observations partly unpredictable; how could they be distinguished? Surprisingly, we prove that common SSL methods can achieve exactly this, by implicitly instantiating a latent-variable model with stochastic dynamics and observation-private nuisance. We trace their ability to recover the stochastic signal to two complementary principles: Predictive mutual information maximization ensures that representations retain the information needed for prediction, while latent distribution matching constrains how this information is encoded, thereby making the retained signal identifiable. We confirm this identifiability result in simulations for Gaussian predictors, which recover the true signal up to an affine transformation even in dynamic, nuisance-laden environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论上证明了预测式自监督学习（SSL）方法能够在存在随机潜变量动力学与观测私有干扰（nuisance）的环境下，通过隐式实例化一个含随机动态和私有干扰的潜变量模型，恢复出真实的信号变量（最多差一个仿射变换）。核心在于预测互信息最大化保证保留可预测信息，而潜变量分布匹配（LDM）约束信息编码方式从而使保留信号可识别。
AI.motivation: 预测式SSL通常被认为能丢弃干扰信息，但一个关键难题是：信号中的随机变化与真正的干扰同样使观测部分不可预测，如何区分？现有可识别性理论要么考虑确定性共享随时间信号，要么考虑存在干扰但缺乏随机动力学，无法同时涵盖两者。
AI.method: 提出一个潜变量生成模型：信号 s 随条件 c 随机演化（条件分布属于指数族），干扰 n 对给定 s 与 c 条件独立（私有干扰）。观察 x = g(s,n)。将常见 SSL 目标函数 InfoNCE/SimCLR/VICReg 统一为 InfoLDM 目标（KL 散度匹配 + 互信息最大化）。在指数族预测模型假设下证明主定理（定理1）：若 InfoLDM 目标全局最优且满足条件多样性、非仿射冗余假设，则真实充分统计量 τ⋆(s) 与学习充分统计量 τ_z(z) 之间存在满行秩仿射关系 τ⋆(s) = Aτ_z(z) + b。特别地，高斯预测情形下推论1给出 s = Az + b 的仿射恢复。证明还通过 Lean 形式化验证。
AI.result: 1) 数值实验：序列信号（d_s 5–20 维，100 维观测，15 维高斯干扰），logdet 与 kNN 熵估计器在 d_s≤10 时 R²>0.95。2) 随机化 Causal3DIdent 基准（224×224，ResNet-18）：在物体信号与背景信号设置中大部分因果因子被仿射恢复（R²>0.9），表现依赖熵估计器选择。3) MuJoCo Hopper 世界模型（含动作、12 维干扰）：学习表征可线性解码 hopper 状态变量，UMAP 显示潜空间拓扑与真实信号一致。证明也指出，若潜空间维度未受限，干扰可能仍被部分编码。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了 SSL 可识别性理论的两个方向：首次同时证明在随机潜变量动态与观测私有干扰并存下，常见 SSL 方法能恢复真实信号。预测互信息最大化负责保留可预测信息，分布匹配负责信号的识别性，二者缺一不可。未来工作方向包括超越高斯情形的其他指数族分布（如 von Mises-Fisher），以及改进熵估计（当前信号恢复与干扰泄露均对熵估计器敏感）。

title: Challenges and Solutions for Bandits in the Wild: Warm-Started Mixture Bandits for Cross-Cohort Slate Recommendation
summary: Many recommender services repeatedly encounter cold-start cohorts, where new users arrive with little or no interaction history. This creates two challenges: learning user preferences quickly from limited feedback and sustaining useful recommendations when each user has a finite catalog that can become repetitive or depleted over time. We propose CohortMix-TS, a warm-started mixture bandit that learns latent user groups from earlier cohorts and uses available metadata to construct group-informed priors for new users. Starting from these fixed priors, the model personalizes independently as feedback from each user becomes available. Session slates combine Thompson sampling with diversity and inventory-depletion controls. We evaluate CohortMix-TS through simulation, semi-synthetic experiments, and a 25-day randomized in-the-wild deployment with 713 registered participants in a Campus Games quiz application. Our evaluations show that cross-cohort transfer improves early recommendation quality and user-level regret, while inventory-aware slate construction helps prevent premature exhaustion of preferred items. In the field deployment, treatment users also showed a larger early-to-late change in correctness than users receiving random recommendations. Together, these results show how warm-start transfer and inventory-aware recommendations can support personalization for short-lived, repeatedly cold-starting cohorts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CohortMix-TS算法，解决冷启动队列推荐中历史信息迁移和有限物品库存管理两大挑战，并通过25天真实部署验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 许多推荐服务（如闪购活动、在线学习系统、健康干预游戏）反复面临冷启动队列问题：新用户缺乏交互历史，需快速学习偏好；同时每位用户有有限物品目录，容易过早耗尽偏好物品。需要一种既能跨队列迁移历史结构、又能感知库存消耗的推荐方法。
AI.method: 1）使用历史数据拟合正则化矩阵分解，物品聚类成A个臂，历史用户聚类成C个潜在群组；2）基于元数据对新用户构造软先验（Beta分布混合），先验强度κ固定；3）每轮用Thompson采样选臂，加入多样性惩罚γ、库存消耗惩罚δ、自适应步速控制器（参数ϕ、η_min、η_max、ρ）；4）在会话间调度批量更新：用Beta函数边际似然重估群组成员概率p_u^(t)，维护共享群组-臂伪计数矩阵ξ，构造留一用户群组均值μ̄更新用户-臂Beta参数。
AI.result: 1）参数化迁移环境（χ=0.75）：Full CohortMix-TS早期奖励0.622、整活动奖励0.669、少数子型奖励0.653、P90遗憾19.18，均为最优；2）库存控制环境：无控制/仅多样性策略在m/(TK)=0.20时早耗率100%，Full selector早耗率0%；3）年分割半合成基准（2024→2025）：CohortMix-TS早期奖励0.597、整活动奖励0.627、伪遗憾37.71，均优于冷启动TS和元数据基线；4）真实部署（RPTU校园游戏，713人，25天）：限制性完整窗口分析（52人）中治疗组早晚正确率变化Δ_u均值0.0455 vs 对照组-0.0168，差异0.062（p=0.043）；参与度指标两组无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: CohortMix-TS通过跨队列历史迁移提升冷启动早期推荐质量，软成员机制应对元数据内异质性，库存感知slate构建防止偏好物品过早耗尽。真实部署显示个性化推荐对用户早晚表现改善有统计学显著影响（限定子集），但全注册人群的正确率因果效应未能确认。算法适用于短周期、反复冷启动的队列场景。

title: Thinking in Depth, Speaking Directly: Recurrent Latent Reasoning for Paralinguistically Grounded Spoken Dialogue
summary: Empathetic spoken dialogue requires models to use both what is said and how it is said to decide how to respond. Explicit CoT can improve paralinguistic perception and make acoustic cues more explicit in replies, yet does not ensure their effective use in response planning. We call this mismatch the perception-reasoning gap. In addition, CoT may not fully capture acoustic cues in words, and generating it adds inference latency. To address these limitations, we introduce LoopSLM, which builds on looped Transformers for latent reasoning, reusing a decoder block to refine hidden states with acoustic grounding at every pass. Its two-stage training further narrows the perception-reasoning gap by separating learning to reason from learning to respond, enabling direct inference without CoT. On EchoMind, LoopSLM improves paralinguistic understanding, reasoning, and reply quality over Qwen2.5-Omni-7B. Against the CoT-SFT baseline, LoopSLM gains over 20 points in reasoning accuracy while generating 64.5% fewer tokens at half the latency. It also outperforms Qwen3-Omni-Thinking on most empathetic reply metrics with 34x lower latency. Despite training only on dialogue data, LoopSLM improves accuracy on general audio benchmarks.

AI.tldr: LoopSLM 是首个采用循环 Transformer（looped Transformer）架构的语音语言模型（SLM），通过将语音驱动的 CoT 监督迁移至解码器深度的潜在循环推理中，并结合 ReCue 声学重锚定机制和两阶段 CoT-to-Response 训练课程，在推理时无需生成 CoT token 即可实现共情语音对话，显著提升了副语言理解与推理能力，同时大幅降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 传统 CoT 监督能改善副语言感知但无法保证其在响应规划中被有效利用，形成"感知-推理差距"（perception–reasoning gap）；同时显式 CoT 生成增加推理延迟，且难以完整捕捉声学线索。需设计一种机制将 CoT 监督融入潜在推理，推理时不输出 CoT。
AI.method: LoopSLM 基于 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 的 28 层 Thinker，将解码器划分为 Prelude（L1–8）、Loop（L9–11，权重共享）、Transition（L12–14）和 Coda（L15–28）。ReCue 机制通过 16 个可学习查询从音频编码器多深度层构建声学记忆，使每次循环都能重新访问声学证据。两阶段训练：Stage 1 用语音接地 CoT（Cue/Need/Risk/Plan 格式，约 70 token）训练 Loop 和 ReCue；Stage 2 冻结 Loop 与 ReCue，仅训练 Coda 以直接生成回复。推理时 R=4 遍循环，无需 CoT 输出。
AI.result: 在 EchoMind 上，LoopSLM-R4 相对 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 在副语言理解和推理准确率上分别提升 9.8 和 6.6 个百分点，所有回复质量维度均提升；相对 CoT-SFT 基线，推理准确率提升超 20 分，token 生成量减少 64.5%，延迟减半；相对 Qwen3-Omni-Thinking 在多数共情回复指标上更优且延迟低 34 倍；仅用对话数据训练即在 MMSU 和 MMAU-Pro 通用音频基准上有提升。消融实验证明增益来源于学习的循环变换而非单纯深度增加。
AI.conclusion: LoopSLM 验证了将语音接地 CoT 监督转化为声学接地的循环解码器深度推理的可行性，是首个使用循环 Transformer 的 SLM。该架构弥合了传统 CoT 微调暴露的感知-推理差距，在无需推理时生成 CoT 的前提下提升副语言推理与回复质量，并通过消融证明收益来源于学习的循环精炼而非单纯深度扩展。

title: Privy to the Foil: Recasting Value Estimation with a Self-Privileged Critic for RLVR
summary: Assigning credit to intermediate steps remains a central challenge in training Large Language Models (LLMs) on multi-step reasoning tasks with sparse terminal rewards, and actor-critic methods such as PPO address this by learning value functions to construct token-level advantages. Their effectiveness, however, hinges on reliable value estimation, a difficult task requiring the critic to both assess progress toward a correct solution and anticipate an evolving policy's future behavior; errors in either can compromise credit assignment and destabilize online training. In this paper, we revisit the standard state-only formulation of value estimation and propose $\pi$PPO, a self-privileged actor-critic framework. By reusing verified same-prompt rollouts as contrastive evidence, $\pi$PPO helps the critic assess intermediate reasoning against successful and failed attempts, while preserving standard policy optimization and the deployment interface. Experiments show that $\pi$PPO consistently improves value-estimation quality by a substantial margin and outperforms representative actor-critic and critic-free RLVR baselines on challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, while remaining effective even when paired with substantially smaller asymmetric critics.

AI.tldr: πPPO提出了一种自特权（self-privileged）actor-critic框架，通过将同提示已验证的rollouts作为对比证据来增强critic的值估计，同时保持actor的原始条件和部署接口不变，在数学推理基准上显著优于主流的actor-critic和无critic的RLVR基线方法。
AI.motivation: 在多步推理任务中，使用稀疏终端奖励训练LLM时，中间步骤的信用分配是核心难题。传统的actor-critic方法（如PPO）依赖critic进行值估计以构建token级优势，但其有效性受限于critic的可靠性：critic既要评估向正确解决方案的进展，又要预测不断演化的策略的未来行为。在长链推理中，奖励仅在极长轨迹末端可观测，导致大量中间状态的学习目标信息弱且高度不确定，值估计不准确会扭曲token级优势并误导策略更新，破坏训练稳定性与最终性能。
AI.method:
1. 理论分析：将RLVR中的值估计重构为信息问题，通过Proposition 1证明上下文条件critic的预测风险严格不高于state-only critic；通过Proposition 2证明成功-失败对比度（success-failure contrast）是critic超越最优常数预测器的必要条件。
2. πPPO框架：对每个提示采样G条rollouts并由验证器标记；为每个目标rollout构建leave-target-out的特权上下文I^(i)，从除自身外的已验证同提示兄弟rollouts中按正确/失败分组采样参考，形成对比证据；critic执行上下文条件前向传播V_φ^+(x, I^(i), y_<t)，而actor仍仅以(x, y_<t)为条件。
3. 优势估计：将上下文条件值代入标准TD残差和GAE计算优势，actor用标准PPO裁剪目标更新。
4. 关键性质：（a）V_φ^+(s_t, I)独立于当前动作a_t，保持有效策略梯度基线，不引入额外偏差；（b）actor训练和推理时的条件一致，保留标准部署接口。
5. 无额外生成成本：参考上下文直接复用策略更新所需的rollout组，随策略演化而刷新。
AI.result:
1. 端到端性能：在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上，πPPO在五个数学推理基准（AIME 2024/2025、BeyondAIME、HMMT25 Feb/Nov）上均取得最高精度，总体平均分别达到50.3%和51.6%，超越最强基线DAPO 4.1和2.3个百分点，超过PPO 6.8和3.7个百分点。
2. 值估计质量：πPPO在整个训练过程中持续实现更高的解释方差（EV）和更低的价值函数损失，改进从训练早期步骤即显现。
3. 非对称critic：使用0.6B和1.7B的更小critic（参数减少约85%和79%）时，πPPO总体准确率仅下降2.5和1.7个百分点，仍超过使用actor大小critic的PPO基线。
4. 分析验证：（a）MC参考对比显示πPPO的预测分布更紧凑，各前缀位置MSE更低；（b）成对排序准确率约94%（PPO为78%），top-1识别准确率约50%（PPO为15%）；（c）在Analyze和Implement等主导推理功能上与MC参考值的相关系数约为0.2（PPO接近零）。
5. 消融实验：去除正确标签或替换为同极性参考会抹去大部分增益；仅使用离线真值答案比完整πPPO低4.7和3.1个百分点，证实了在线对比组织证据的关键作用。
6. OOD泛化：在GPQA-Diamond和MMLU-Pro上，πPPO在4B规模取得最佳综合分60.5，8B规模的非对称变体以1.7B critic取得最佳综合分65.2。
7. 与自蒸馏方法比较：πPPO显著优于RLSD（在4B和8B上分别领先8.9和7.5个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: πPPO将RLVR中的值估计重构为信息问题，证明了仅依赖状态的critic在形式上存在固有局限性，而目标状态之外的证据可以降低这一下限。通过自引发的、leave-target-out的已验证同提示兄弟上下文条件化critic，πPPO在保持actor原始条件和环境定义奖励目标的同时改善了值估计，无需额外生成。该方法在数学推理基准上持续提升critic质量和端到端准确率，并允许使用显著更小的非对称critic，为开发更有效的LLM强化学习训练算法提供了互补的设计视角。

title: Scaling Influence Functions in LLMs through Eigenbasis-Corrected One-Bit Gradient Projection
summary: Influence functions estimate how individual training examples affect the behavior of large language models (LLMs). Analyzing how training data influence different behaviors of an LLM involves repeated influence computation. Reusing stored training gradients reduces the computational cost, but storing full gradients is prohibitively expensive at LLM scale. We study how to compress these gradients while preserving influence estimates for future queries that are unknown at storage time. Through a worst-case analysis, we characterize the optimal fixed-dimensional linear representation and propose eigenbasis-corrected one-bit gradient projection (EOGP) to approximate it at scale. Specifically, EOGP uses EK-FAC to reduce gradient dimensionality, then applies PCA within the retained subspace to learn compression directions from the training gradients. We then apply one-bit quantization to the resulting coordinates, allowing more coordinates to be retained within a fixed storage budget. On GPT-2, EOGP predicts retraining outcomes more accurately than the evaluated compression baselines while using one-sixteenth of their per-example storage. On OLMo 2 SFT models from 1B to 32B parameters, EOGP remains competitive with the baselines allocated over 100 times as much storage per example.

AI.tldr: EOGP提出了一种用于LLM影响函数估计的紧凑梯度压缩方法，通过EK-FAC子空间内的PCA修正和单比特量化，在显著降低存储成本的同时保留高质量的归因信息。
AI.motivation: 在LLM规模下存储完整的训练梯度用于重复的影响函数计算成本过高（单个8B模型示例需16 GB）。现有压缩方法在未知未来查询的情况下难以保留有用信息，需要一种能在极低存储预算下保持影响估计质量的方法。
AI.method: EOGP采用三阶段方法：(1) 通过EK-FAC特征基降低梯度维度，构建候选子空间；(2) 在该子空间内执行PCA以修正压缩基；(3) 对最终坐标应用单比特量化，每个模块存储符号位和一个共享比例。理论证明在归一化最坏情况影响误差准则下，半白化梯度的top-k PCA是最优的k维线性表示。
AI.result: 在GPT-2上，EOGP以1/16的存储量优于现有压缩基线。在OLMo 2 SFT模型（1B-32B参数）上，即使每示例存储小于16 KB，EOGP仍能与分配100倍以上存储的基线方法相竞争。
AI.conclusion: EOGP通过理论最优的PCA压缩目标结合EK-FAC近似和单比特量化，为LLM规模的影响函数分析提供了实用的紧凑梯度存储方案，使可重用梯度存储在数十亿参数模型上变得可行。

title: Is manual software optimization a thing of the past?
summary: Scientific software is increasingly required to process larger datasets while maintaining acceptable execution times. Software optimization traditionally requires substantial expertise in programming, algorithms, and numerical methods. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer the possibility of automating much of this process. We investigate whether LLM-based agents can autonomously achieve substantial performance improvements in scientific software, including mature implementations that have already been extensively optimized by human developers. We tasked an LLM-based agent with optimizing software for three computational problems: t-SNE, single-sample gene set enrichment analysis (ssGSEA), and graphlet counting. Humans defined the scope, correctness criteria, and a verification mechanism, after which the agent worked autonomously, in some cases for several hours. Code maintainers reviewed each resulting implementation and verified its correctness. The optimized implementations were faster in all tested configurations, by up to two orders of magnitude over the fastest existing tools. The improvements included low-level code optimizations, mathematical reformulations, and an entirely new algorithm for graphlet counting. Software optimization can increasingly be delegated to autonomous agents, with the human role shifting from implementing optimizations to deciding which software to optimize, defining objectives, providing verification mechanisms, and ensuring the correctness of the final software. For well-scoped, verifiable problems, we argue that manual software optimization may be a thing of the past.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三个真实科学计算案例（t-SNE、ssGSEA、图let计数），证明基于LLM的自主智能体能够对成熟科学软件实现高达两个数量级的加速优化，涵盖底层代码优化、数学重构乃至全新算法设计，挑战了"手动软件优化不可或缺"的传统认知。
AI.motivation: 科学软件面临数据规模持续增长的性能压力，传统手动优化依赖稀缺的数值计算与算法设计专家；尽管LLM智能体兴起，但在已高度优化软件上能否自主实现超越常量因子层面的实质性加速（如数学简化、新算法）尚不明确，现有评估多报告表面级增益甚至效果甚微。
AI.method: 选取三个科学计算任务（openTSNE的优化阶段、ssGSEA实现、图let/orbit计数），由人类定义范围、正确性准则和验证机制，由Claude Opus 5在Claude Code中自主长时间运行优化；通过现有测试套件、跨库对比（如GSEApy、GSVA、Orca）和暴力枚举进行正确性验证，在消费级M1 MacBook Pro上对比运行时性能。
AI.result: 三个案例均实现显著加速：openTSNE在50万点单线程下Barnes-Hut从62→8分钟、FIt-SNE从9→2分钟（4.4–7.7×，八线程最高达2分钟/28秒）；ssGSEA在2000基因集×1000样本下从GSEApy的5分钟降至2.2秒（136×）；图let计数在BioSNAP蛋白质互作网络（22k节点）上从Orca的35分钟降至13秒（160×），相对暴力枚举加速超20000×，且在随机图上随密度增大差距进一步扩大，渐近复杂度从暴力O(nd⁴)、Orca O(nd³)降至智能体的二次方。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体已能在科学软件优化中实现底层代码优化、数学公式简化乃至全新算法发现等全层级突破；对范围明确、可验证的问题，手动软件优化的必要性正被削弱，人类的角色应转向选择优化目标、定义范围与验证机制并确保最终正确性。

title: It's Not What the Image Shows: Irrelevant Context Destabilises VLM Judges Without Informing Them
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in place of human annotators, making it important that substitutability tests reflect the model rather than incidental evaluation conditions. We introduce MIST, the Misleading-Image Stress Test: 200 English sentences, each built around a phrase readable either figuratively or literally and shown with an aligned image depicting its reading, a misleading image depicting the opposite, or no image at all. The guidelines require the label to be decided from the sentence alone, so no image should change any answer. We expected each image to pull a judge's labels toward the sense it depicts, and neither kind did. Across thirteen VLM judges, an aligned image changed 20.5% of labels and a misleading one 19.4%, close for every judge and both above the 11.6% produced by deleting the ignore-the-image instruction with the image left in place. Yet only 37% of the labels that differ between the two images moved toward the sense shown, and agreement with our human annotators is unchanged whether the image is absent, aligned or misleading. The effect is smaller in the seven judges that pass the alt-test than in the six that never do, but present in all of them: what moves a judge is that an image is there, not which of the two it is, so a substitutability verdict describes a configuration as much as a model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MIST（Misleading-Image Stress Test）基准，用于测试视觉语言模型（VLM）评判者在面对本应忽略的图像上下文时的稳定性。研究发现，即使明确指示模型忽略图像，仅图像的存在就会显著改变模型的标注结果（约15-20%），而图像内容本身（与句子一致或相反）所产生的影响几乎相同，表明驱动标签变化的是"图像是否在"，而非"图像展示了什么"。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型/视觉语言模型替代人工标注者的可替代性测试（如alt-test）通常基于单一配置（一种提示、一种格式、一种项目呈现方式）给出判定结果，但实际应用中，标注项目常附带图像等被指南声明为"无关"的上下文。本文旨在探究这些可替代性判定究竟是描述了模型本身，还是仅仅描述了测试时的偶然条件配置。
AI.method: 构建MIST数据集：200条含潜在习语短语的英语句子，每句配有"对齐"图像（展示句子意义）、"误导"图像（展示相反意义）或无图像。标签由句子本身决定，图像不应改变任何正确答案。评估13个VLM评判者（4个专有+9个开源），每个评判者在4种提示技术（zero-shot、few-shot、CoT、few-shot+CoT）×2种图像指令条件（explicit/silent）下生成约52,000个标签。通过变化率（change rate）、方向（direction）、与人类标注者一致性（agreement）和alt-test可替代性来衡量。
AI.result: 关键发现：(1) 添加对齐图像改变15.9%标签，误导图像改变14.7%（13个评判者平均为20.5%和19.4%），均显著高于仅删除"忽略图像"指令的控制条件（8.8%/11.6%）；(2) 在两种图像下标签发生变化的1776个单元中，仅37%向图像所示意义移动，多数低于随机水平；(3) 与人类标注者的一致性在有无图像、对齐或误导图像条件下几乎相同（54.4%/53.7%/54.7%）；(4) 71%的变化停留在figurative-literal划分线的同一侧，表明图像只是重新排列答案而非改变阅读理解方向；(5) 即使是通过alt-test的7个评判者也表现出这种不稳定性；(6) 模型呈现"主动抑制"而非"忽视"模式，Few-Shot+CoT下仅1个评判者的F/S比超过0.5，6个低于0.4。
AI.conclusion: 可替代性判定描述的是一个配置（configuration）与模型的组合，而非仅描述模型本身。聚合一致性指标掩盖了实例级别的不稳定性。部署报告应明确说明所用提示及附加的任何"无关"上下文。MIST作为一种不变性测试，在评估评判者时比单一运行的可替代性判定更能揭示其鲁棒性。改变标签的是"有图像存在"这一事实，而非"图像内容是什么"。

title: AgentBug-Smith: Automatically Reproducing Real-World Harness Bugs in Agentic Systems
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures. Code: this https URL Data: this https URL
summary: Agent harness bugs exhibit unique characteristics and remain challenging for state-of-the-art software agents to repair. Progress in this area is further hindered by existing benchmarks, which contain only a small and fixed number of executable harness bugs while requiring hundreds of human hours to construct. This work presents AgentBug-Smith, an automated harness bug reproduction approach that continuously discovers and reproduces real-world harness bugs from open-source agentic systems. Across different backbone LLMs, AgentBug-Smith consistently outperforms existing bug reproduction techniques designed for general software, achieving 10.67% - 27.56% higher success rates of reproducing harness bugs. By applying AgentBug-Smith to open-source agentic systems in the wild, we construct Live-Harness-Bench, a live and extensible benchmark that currently contains 200 reproducible harness bugs. We further demonstrate the utility of Live-Harness-Bench through two downstream applications. First, we use Live-Harness-Bench as the evaluation benchmark to systematically evaluate state-of-the-art software agents, revealing their limited capabilities in repairing real-world harness bugs. Second, we use Live-Harness-Bench as a knowledge base of real-world harness bug fixes, from which reusable repair skills can be distilled to improve existing software agents, increasing their harness-bug repair rates by 6.32%. Together, AgentBug-Smith and Live-Harness-Bench establish a scalable foundation for continuously evaluating and improving software agents on harness bug repair, turning real-world agent failures into executable evaluation instances and reusable knowledge for harness improvement, thus contributing to the ultimate goal of recursively self-improving agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentBug-Smith,一种自动化的Agent Harness Bug复现方法,并基于此构建了包含200个真实可执行Harness Bug的Live-Harness-Bench基准。该方法通过多智能体流水线自动完成仓库识别、bug筛选、环境构建和失败复现测试生成,显著优于通用软件bug复现技术,并通过下游应用验证其在评估和增强现有软件Agent方面的实用价值。
AI.motivation: 现有Agent Harness Bug基准(如AgentIssue-Bench)规模小且固定(仅43个),且人工构建耗时巨大(150小时)。通用软件bug复现技术(如SWE-Factory、SWE-bench-Live)难以处理Agent特有的挑战——与LLM提供商、工具、网络服务等外部资源的复杂交互,以及依赖特定执行状态和交互上下文才能显现的失败模式。同时,现有软件Agent修复Harness Bug的成功率远低于通用软件bug(4.67% vs 40.67%),凸显了对Agent导向的自动化bug复现与可扩展基准的迫切需求。
AI.method: AgentBug-Smith是一个多智能体系统,包含三个关键阶段:(1)Harness Bug识别——通过双流机制(精选初始化+GHArchive增量流更新)发现开源Agent仓库,使用基于LLM的判断器筛选与Agent Harness相关的GitHub Issue;(2)Agent执行环境构建——采用规则引导初始化加迭代精化策略自动合成Dockerfile,并在容器级别注入Mock服务环境变量以透明地重定向模型客户端调用;(3)失败复现测试生成——为缺失In-Patch Test(IPT)的Issue自动合成测试,通过联合优化测试与环境实现fail-to-pass状态。Live-Harness-Bench持续应用该方法构建,当前包含200个可执行Harness Bug。
AI.result: AgentBug-Smith在仓库识别准确率达95%、Harness Bug Issue识别准确率达92%。在bug复现成功率上,以GPT-4.1-mini、Kimi-k2.5、DeepSeek-v3.2为骨干模型,均显著优于SWE-Factory和SWE-bench-Live,提升幅度达10.67%-27.56个百分点(最高28.00%成功率)。消融分析证实环境构建和测试生成两个组件均贡献明显。在Live-Harness-Bench上的下游应用中,主流软件Agents(Mine-SWE-Agent、OpenHands、AutoCodeRover)的Harness Bug修复正确率最高仅9.00%;通过从基准中提炼可复用修复技能,mini-SWE-Agent的修复正确率提升了6.32%。
AI.conclusion: AgentBug-Smith和Live-Harness-Bench共同为持续评估和改进软件Agent在Harness Bug修复方面的能力奠定了可扩展基础,将真实Agent失败转化为可执行评估实例和可重用知识,推动了递归自我改进Agent这一终极目标。

title: Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) methods such as GRPO rely on successful self-generated trajectories, but finite rollout budgets can produce all-fail groups with no reward-based policy-gradient signal. While additional rollouts improve the chance of success at higher cost, successful trajectories missing from one model's rollouts may already have been discovered by another. Indeed, we observe that heterogeneous models often succeed on complementary prompts, creating opportunities for mutual learning without a designated stronger teacher. To exploit this complementarity, we propose GRAFT (Gated Replacement of Answer-Failed groups with peer Trajectories), an off-policy-aware framework that replaces all-fail groups with informative peer groups. GRAFT transfers both successful and unsuccessful peer responses with peer-computed advantages, while controlling cross-model mismatch through sequence-level compatibility weighting and token-level importance ratio clipping. Across three heterogeneous model pairs and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, GRAFT consistently improves both models over GRPO with the same per-model rollout budget, gaining 2.1 points on average and up to 4.5 points in model-level average performance. Stored peer trajectories preserve most of the gains, improving over GRPO by 1.8 points on average without simultaneous co-training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GRAFT框架，通过跨模型轨迹交换解决RLVR中全失败组无梯度信号的问题。在不增加推理预算的情况下，利用异构模型间的互补成功实现相互学习。
AI.motivation: RLVR方法（如GRPO）依赖自身采样轨迹，但有限推理预算会产生全失败组，导致奖励策略梯度信号为零。增加推理次数成本高，而缺失的成功轨迹可能已被其他异构模型发现，异构模型在不同提示上常表现出互补成功，这为无需指定更强教师的相互学习提供了机会。
AI.method: GRAFT（Gated Replacement of Answer-Failed groups with peer Trajectories）是一种离线策略感知的跨模型框架，核心包含两部分：(1) 互补且平衡的组替换——当接收方全失败（k_B=0）且对等方组内有成功（1≤k_A<n）时，用对等方完整组替换接收方的全失败组，并保留源端计算的advantage，通过较小候选数m平衡双向交换量；(2) 离线策略感知对等更新——将似然比分解为接收方自身变化与跨模型失配，通过序列级兼容性门控（基于平均token对数似然比的s(o|q)与阈值δ）和token级重要性比例裁剪控制对等数据影响，并对等组放在接收方自有组之后处理（peer-last）。
AI.result: 在三个异构模型对（SmolLM3-3B/Qwen3-1.7B/OctoThinker-3B）和五个数学推理基准（MATH500、AIME2024/2025、AMC23、Minerva）上，GRAFT在每个模型对中均一致优于同等推理预算的GRPO，平均提升2.1分、最高4.5分；在两对中两模型均匹配或超过4倍推理预算的GRPO（n=32）；相比HACPO和SGT分别平均高出4.0和1.5分；使用存储的对等轨迹（无需同步协同训练）仍平均超过GRPO 1.8分（在线提升的84%），且节省27-76%计算量。消融实验表明兼容性门控、平衡交换、token级裁剪和peer-last排序均不可缺。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT成功利用异构模型间的互补成功实现跨模型轨迹交换，无需更强教师或额外推理预算即可稳定提升RLVR训练效果。其"选哪些+怎么学"的联合设计是关键，且收益大部分可通过复用历史轨迹获得，降低了协同训练的部署成本。局限性在于收益依赖模型互补程度（Pair 3提升最小），兼容性分数是经验代理而非精确密度比，目前仅在≤3B基座模型的数学双模型对上演示验证。

title: Beyond Interaction Capacity: Estimator Scaling with Recursive Models for CTR Prediction
summary: Click-Through Rate prediction, a core task in recommendation and advertising systems, relies on modeling interactions among sparse categorical features. Explicit cross networks are a central paradigm for CTR prediction, and recent progress has largely come from increasing the interaction capacity of a single predictor through deeper cross networks and more expressive cross operators. We revisit whether continually increasing interaction capacity remains the most effective way to improve predictive performance, and find that its benefits quickly exhibit diminishing returns even as capacity continues to grow. This motivates a complementary scaling direction that we call estimator scaling, where additional resources are used to incorporate multiple related estimators rather than only enlarging a single predictor. Through theoretical analysis, we show that the gains from estimator scaling are governed by the amount of non-shared predictive variation available across estimators. However, exploiting this variation naively can be expensive: independently trained models provide substantial estimator diversity but require deployment cost to grow with ensemble size. This motivates a parameter-efficient realization of estimator scaling that can incorporate diversity from multiple estimator sources without maintaining multiple full models. Building on this view, we introduce RECursive Averaged Predictor (RECAP), a parameter-efficient recursive CTR model that operationalizes estimator scaling at three levels: distillation across independently trained models, exponential moving averaging over training trajectories, and aggregation over inference-time routes within a weight-shared recursive backbone. Experiments across multiple benchmarks establish new state-of-the-art predictive performance on standard benchmarks, while placing the RECAP on a favorable performance-parameter Pareto frontier.

AI.tldr: 本文针对CTR预测任务提出了一种新的扩展方向——"估计器扩展"(estimator scaling)，以补充传统的"交互容量扩展"(interaction capacity scaling)。论文发现持续增加单个预测器的交互容量会带来收益递减，而通过整合多个相关估计器可以持续提升性能。作者提出了RECAP（RECursive Averaged Predictor），一种参数高效的递归CTR模型，通过三个层级实现估计器扩展：跨独立训练运行的蒸馏、训练轨迹的指数移动平均、以及推理时路由的聚合。实验表明RECAP在五个CTR基准上达到了最先进性能，同时在性能-参数帕累托前沿上具有优势。
AI.motivation: 现有CTR预测模型主要通过加深交叉网络、增加交互分支来提升单个预测器的"交互容量"，但作者发现这种扩展方式很快出现收益递减。即使交互容量持续增长，性能提升也十分有限。这促使作者探索一种补充性的扩展方向——通过整合多个相关估计器来提升性能，即"估计器扩展"。然而朴素地集成多个独立训练模型会带来部署成本问题，因此需要一种参数高效的实现方式。
AI.method:
1) 理论分析：通过二阶泰勒展开将BCE损失分解为均值预测误差和估计器方差两部分，证明估计器扩展的收益由可约简的"非共享预测方差"(non-shared predictive variation) τ²(1-ρ)(1-1/M) 决定。

2) RECAP架构：基于FCN的LCN和ECN两个递归交互塔，核心参数跨递归步骤共享，通过LoRA低秩残差实现路由适配。

3) 三层级估计器扩展：
- 训练轨迹平均：参数层面的EMA（指数移动平均）
- 跨运行平均：通过集成蒸馏将M个教师模型的均值logit压缩到单一学生模型
- 推理时路由聚合：对K条不同路由产生的logit取均值

4) 多预算训练：在多个递归深度上同时训练，增强泛化能力。
AI.result:
在Avazu、Criteo、ML-1M、KDD12、KKBox五个公开CTR基准上，RECAP均取得了最高的AUC值，相对各自最强基线分别提升0.26、0.13、0.01、0.55、0.30个百分点。关键发现包括：
- 交互容量扩展（增加深度/宽度）迅速饱和，而估计器扩展继续提供收益
- 独立训练运行提供最大的非共享方差和最大增益
- 三种估计器源（独立运行、训练轨迹、推理路由）按非共享方差大小产生相应大小的增益
- RECAP以约单模型参数预算接近5模型FCN集成的性能（81.764 vs 81.771 AUC）
- 消融实验证实三个组件各自有效，组合时效果最强
- 超参数敏感性分析表明RECAP对各超参数设置稳定鲁棒
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了在CTR预测中，交互容量扩展会遇到收益递减，而估计器扩展作为一种互补的扩展轴具有持续价值。该扩展的收益受可用非共享预测方差的理论约束。RECAP通过参数高效的递归架构同时实现了跨运行蒸馏、轨迹平均和路由聚合三种估计器扩展机制，在保持单模型部署预算的同时接近多模型集成的性能，在多个CTR基准上建立了新的最先进水平，并将所提方法置于有利的性能-参数帕累托前沿上。这一工作将扩展视角从单一预测器的交互容量扩展转向了估计器的多样性利用，为CTR模型的资源分配提供了新的设计原则。

title: Generated Query Expansion Still Helps Strong Sparse Retrieval: A Controlled Study with SPLADE-v3
summary: Scientific queries are often brief, while relevant papers use specialized vocabulary. Generated query expansion can bridge this mismatch, but earlier work suggests that its value shrinks as the underlying retriever becomes stronger. We test the four generated formats of term lists, a pseudo-document, multiple pseudo-references, and corpus-steered text all together with SPLADE-v3 on NFCorpus, TREC-COVID, and SciDocs. Every condition searches the same frozen document index and follows the same query-side integration rule and 256-dimension budget, isolating the effect of the added content. All twelve method-collection comparisons improve aggregate nDCG@10, with best relative gains of 4.81%, 8.92%, and 9.47%. Eleven remain significant after Holm correction. The gain persists in 103 of 114 interpolation settings, including every setting that assigns at least 30% of the mixture weight to the original query. Shuffled-text and non-contextual lexical-bag controls also remain above baseline in all 24 aggregate comparisons, showing that the added vocabulary carries most of the benefit. A corpus-induced typed concept graph, by contrast, produces no consistent gain, and its relation, depth, validation, random, and gating controls do not rescue it. Generated vocabulary can therefore complement a strong learned sparse retriever, provided that the original query remains strongly represented.

AI.tldr: 本文针对强学习稀疏检索器 SPLADE-v3，系统比较了四种生成式查询扩展方法（词项列表、伪文档、多伪参考、语料引导文本）与一种语料诱导类型化概念图方法 HiQE 在三个科学检索数据集上的效果。研究发现所有生成式方法均能稳定提升 SPLADE-v3，而概念图方法无效。增益主要来自生成内容所提供的补充词汇，前提是原始查询在混合中保持足够权重。
AI.motivation: 科学查询简短且与文献专业词汇存在差异。虽然生成式查询扩展可弥合该差异，但既有研究表明随着检索器增强其价值会减弱，甚至损害最强检索器。因此需明确：在已具备上下文词项扩展能力的强学习稀疏检索器（如 SPLADE-v3）之上，外部生成内容是否仍能带来收益。
AI.method: 采用控制变量设计：冻结 SPLADE-v3 文档索引与编码器，仅改变查询侧表示。四种生成格式（Flat LLM-QE、Query2doc、MuGI-style、CSQE）经同一 SPLADE-v3 查询编码器编码后，通过固定公式 z̃q = Budget256(α·z̄q + (1−α)·ā(q)) 与受保护的原始查询向量混合，α 控制权重，固定 256 维稀疏预算。语料诱导概念图 HiQE 作为对照。通过插值权重扫描、打乱文本与非上下文词袋控制、概念图多种消融（关系、深度、验证、随机、门控）进行稳健性检验。统计检验包括配对 bootstrap、配对符号随机化与 Holm/Bonferroni 校正。在 NFCorpus、TREC-COVID、SciDocs 上以 nDCG@10 为主要指标评估。
AI.result: 全部 12 个生成方法与数据集组合均提升 SPLADE-v3 的 nDCG@10，最佳相对增益分别为 NFCorpus 4.81%（CSQE）、TREC-COVID 8.92%（Query2doc）、SciDocs 9.47%（CSQE），11/12 在 Holm 校正后仍显著。103/114 插值设置优于基线，所有 α≥0.3 的设置均稳定提升。打乱文本与非上下文词袋对照在 24 个聚合比较中均高于基线，表明增益主要来自词汇本身。HiQE 概念图在三个数据集上无一致增益（+0.0013、−0.0126、+0.0006），所有消融亦未恢复增益，门控亦无济于事。
AI.conclusion: 生成式查询扩展在已具备上下文词项扩展的强学习稀疏检索器上仍具价值，其增益来源是生成器补充的科学词汇，但前提是原始查询须在混合表示中保留足够权重（至少 30%）。仅在查询侧增加相关术语并不足以复现该收益，语料诱导类型化概念图未表现出可比模式。未来工作应聚焦检索监督的概念选择、保留短语的表示以及面向逐查询排序影响的门控机制。

title: The Unequal Influence of Bad Advice: Using Training Data Attribution to Modulate Emergent Misalignment
summary: Fine-tuning large language models on narrow, misaligned tasks can undo their post-training alignment and induce novel misaligned behaviors -- a phenomenon known as \emph{emergent misalignment} (EM). EM has been linked to persona-like representations, where fine-tuning might reduce loss by amplifying a harmful or 'evil' persona. It remains unclear which properties of the training data drive this effect: whether all harmful examples contribute approximately equally to misalignment and whether different models are equally affected by the same fine-tuning examples. In this work, we use training data attribution to quantitatively estimate how much each harmful example contributes to EM. We benchmark the quality of the attribution via retraining -- a sound attribution score should enable us to enhance or attenuate EM by filtering data on that score. Score-based filtering can substantially enhance or attenuate EM; we find that both data-attribution scores and a black-box harmfulness score can identify consequential examples. All models we test become misaligned when trained on the same dataset, and influence scores perform best when filtering data from the same model that computed them. We find cross-model generalization of influence scores from scores derived from the three model families we tested, but this generalization does not recover same model filtering performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究训练数据属性方法（TDA）能否识别大语言模型微调中导致"涌现失对齐"（EM）的有害训练样本，发现不同有害样本对EM的贡献并不均等，且最影响样本具有模型依赖性；基于影响函数的过滤可有效增强或减弱失对齐程度。
AI.motivation: 现有涌现失对齐（EM）研究将训练数据简单划分为"有害"与"良性"，未区分哪些有害样本更重要，也未探讨不同模型是否对这些样本有相同反应。本文从数据视角出发，量化每个有害样本对EM的贡献，并验证能否通过数据过滤调控EM。
AI.method: 使用Bergson库计算影响函数（包括EK-FAC近似和梯度余弦相似度），以GRPO-like损失从模型对EM评估问题的回答中构造查询梯度；在OLMo 3 7B、Qwen 2.5/3、Llama 3等多个模型家族上对错误职业/汽车/教育建议数据集进行LoRA微调；通过过滤高/低影响样本重新训练，验证归因质量；以WildGuard作为黑盒有害性基线；以Qwen 3 32B作为评判器评估失对齐率。
AI.result: 1）并非所有有害样本对EM贡献均等：删除20%最高影响样本可降低5个百分点失对齐率，删除20%最低影响样本反而增加10个百分点；2）影响分数可在全分布预测EM程度，并非二元划分；3）所有测试模型在同一数据集上都会失对齐，但最影响样本具有模型依赖性——同模型过滤效果最佳；4）跨模型影响分数存在一定泛化能力，但无法恢复同模型性能；5）影响分数优于黑盒WildGuard有害性分数，捕获了与有害性不同的信号；6）错误性和过度自信与影响分数部分相关，但不能完全解释归因结果。
AI.conclusion: 基于梯度的影响函数（尤其是EK-FAC）可作为调查工具，有效识别训练数据中对涌现失对齐贡献最大的样本，从而通过数据过滤调控EM程度；然而影响函数无法解释为何某些样本更关键，也无法预测样本间交互；不同模型对"最重要样本"的判定不一致，表明EM的触发机制具有模型特异性。

title: RLX: A Unified Multi-Backend Tensor Compiler and Distributed Runtime in Rust
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, peer-reviewed and presented at 2026 IEEE High Performance Extreme Computing Conference (HPEC)
summary: Production machine learning (ML) stacks often split graph compilation and kernel execution across different layers and languages, making backend behavior, deployment guarantees, and performance fallbacks hard to reason about end-to-end. RLX addresses this gap with a single Rust codebase that combines compiler and runtime roles around one primitive-level, three-level intermediate representation (IR), plus a transparent dispatch contract that resolves each operator to native, common-IR, or rewritten lowering and fails compilation when legalization is not possible. The same IR targets fourteen runtime devices (cpu, metal, mlx, ane, cuda, rocm, oneapi, tpu, hexagon, gpu, vulkan, opengl, directx, webgpu) and two specialty codegen paths (Cortex-M INT8 and FPGA), ingests safetensors, GGUF, ONNX, and rten formats, supports F16/BF16/F64/C64 and quantized INT4/INT8 flows with AMP/PTQ/QAT, and scales via tensor-/pipeline-parallel collectives over TCP and RDMA transports. Beyond neural workloads, RLX also extends to scientific/physics-style domains through sparse and dense linear algebra extensions (e.g., CSR LU/CG/matvec and LAPACK- backed factorizations) and 3D Gaussian splatting operators. We evaluate RLX against PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, candle, burn, tch, rten, MLX, CoreML, IREE, Glow, TensorRT, and tinygrad under identical input generation and p50 measurement methodology on one host. On all-MiniLM-L6-v2, RLX-Metal is fastest at every batch (e.g., 16.6 ms at batch 32 vs. PyTorch-MPS 26.7 ms). In the MNIST training table, RLX also has the top-throughput entry (graph-fused MLP: 946,487 img/s), above NumPy+BLAS (787,349 img/s), while retaining 100% top-1 parity on reference checks (e.g., Qwen3).

AI.tldr: RLX是一个统一的Rust张量编译器和分布式运行时，将图编译器和内核运行时融合在单一代码库中，通过三级IR支持14个运行时设备和2个专业代码生成路径，覆盖从微控制器到服务器GPU的全栈部署，在嵌入推理和MNIST训练基准测试中均达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器学习栈通常将图编译和内核执行分离在不同的层和语言中（如Python前端+C++/CUDA后端），导致后端行为、部署保证和性能回退难以端到端推理；Python的GIL、引用计数和动态分派在小批量时增加延迟，限制线程化，并使部署到微控制器、浏览器和定制芯片变得困难。
AI.method: 单一Rust工作空间包含分层crate：rlx-ir定义三级IR（HIR块操作→MIR融合原语DAG→LIR缓冲计划）；rlx-opt提供区域融合、反向/正向/高阶自动微分、vmap批处理、合法化、内存规划和PTQ/QAT；rlx-runtime实现透明分派合约（native→common-IR→rewrite→fail），通过supported_ops声明集保证图路由到能成功执行的设备；支持safetensors/GGUF/ONNX/rten格式导入，F16/BF16/F64/C64/INT4/INT8精度，AMP/PTQ/QAT量化，张量并行和流水线并行通过TCP/RDMA传输扩展。
AI.result: 在all-MiniLM-L6-v2推理基准上（Apple Silicon单主机，seq-128），RLX-Metal在所有批量下均最快（batch 32时16.6ms vs PyTorch-MPS 26.7ms）；在MNIST训练基准上，图融合MLP达到946,487 img/s（超过NumPy+BLAS的787,349 img/s），RLX-Metal训练67,476 img/s为最快；支持100+模型族（Qwen3、LLaMA 3.2、Whisper等）达到参考精度；三级微分（reverse/forward/higher-order）在CPU/Metal/MLX/CUDA间位精确一致；Cortex-M INT8在nRF52840上达到96.6%精度。
AI.conclusion: RLX是首个在单一原生Rust树中统一原语级编译器IR、训练级自动微分、透明多后端分派和边缘代码生成的系统，从微控制器到服务器加速器均使用同一IR；未来工作包括GPU/TPU优化、改进训练支持和多机传输硬化。

title: On Trajectory-Aware Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate text by unmasking several tokens per step, but they are trained and sampled under different conditions. The model is trained on randomly masked sequences, whereas inference follows a trajectory shaped by the model's own predictions. Additionally, each step has no access to what the previous one computed. Recent methods narrow these limitations from separate angles, leaving open how these choices interact. We introduce PUMBA, a unified framework for trajectory-aware training that trains the denoiser on consecutive steps of policy-induced trajectories, passes information between steps, and optimizes them jointly by backpropagation through time. A controlled study of this design space shows that i) exact train--inference alignment fails due to local overfitting, whereas a looser alignment still brings training masks closer to those seen at inference; ii) passing continuous information outperforms discrete gradient estimators through the commitment at each step; and iii) performance improves as backpropagation through time spans more steps, which we support theoretically. Combined, these components match the best checkpoint of a same-size autoregressive model. Building on these findings, we scale PUMBA to supervised fine-tuning of LLaDA-8B, where it improves the trade-off between performance and number of function evaluations (NFEs) in both full-canvas and block diffusion generation. At matched performance, it needs up to 22% fewer NFEs than standard fine-tuning with twice the budget in full-canvas generation, and up to 26% fewer than standard fine-tuning for the same number of steps in block diffusion.

AI.tldr: PUMBA提出了一种轨迹感知的训练框架，通过渐进式解掩码、连续状态传递和截断时间反向传播（BPTT）三个轴的统一，解决掩码扩散语言模型（MDM）训练与推理之间的分布不一致问题。在TinyGSM受控实验中匹配了同规模自回归模型性能，并在LLaDA-8B的监督微调中以更少的函数评估次数（NFE）改善了性能-NFE权衡。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDM）训练时使用随机掩码序列，而推理时遵循模型自身预测形成的轨迹，且各步骤之间无信息传递。现有方法分别针对这些局限的不同方面，但缺乏统一框架研究这些选择的交互作用。核心问题在于训练-推理分布不一致（trajectory shift）和步骤间缺乏信息传递通道。
AI.method: 提出PUMBA框架，沿三个设计轴统一轨迹感知训练：(1) 策略（Policy）：使用渐进式解掩码（PU）构建由推理策略诱导的训练轨迹；(2) 连续性状态传递（Carry）：通过denoiser的隐藏状态在步骤间传递连续信息；(3) 反向传播窗口（BPTT Window W）：通过截断时间反向传播在W个连续步骤上联合优化。在TinyGSM（125M参数）进行受控研究，并在LLaDA-8B上进行全画布和块扩散的SFT扩展验证。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 精确训练-推理对齐因局部过拟合而失败，但宽松对齐仍能缩小掩码差距；(2) 连续状态传递（Carry）优于离散梯度估计器（REINFORCE 41.2%、Gumbel-softmax 42.4%、Straight-through 44.7% vs Carry 51.2%）；(3) 性能随BPTT窗口W增大而提升（W=8时达到55.6%，匹配同规模AR最佳检查点55.3%）；(4) LLaDA-8B SFT中，全画布生成时以最多22%更少的NFE匹配SFT两倍预算的性能；块扩散生成时以最多26%更少的NFE优于标准微调；(5) 理论证明窗口越大，习得采样器与最优采样器之间的KL散度差距越小。
AI.conclusion: PUMBA通过统一渐进式解掩码、连续状态传递和截断BPTT三个组件，有效改善了掩码扩散语言模型的训练-推理一致性。该方法在受控小规模实验和大规模LLaDA-8B监督微调中均验证了有效性，显著推进了性能-NFE帕累托前沿。研究揭示了需要在轨迹对齐与样本多样性之间取得平衡，小训练u值下的局部过拟合是主要挑战。该方法为扩散语言模型的后训练提供了实用指导，未来可探索更丰富的状态表示、自适应窗口和重掩码机制。

title: $S^3$: Spectral Null-Space Swap Makes Reasoning Models Efficient
summary: LLMs trained with Chain-of-thought excel in reasoning capability, but often come with excessive token cost. We find that the core of reasoning capacity lies in the Thinking model's weight component within the null space of a projection defined by the corresponding Non-thinking model's dominant singular directions, and removing the subspace component can largely improve reasoning efficiency without hurting the accuracy gained during thinking-mode post-training. Unlike existing efforts that mostly operate within the dominant subspace, we are the first to unveil the critical role of the null space and harness it for model optimization. Motivated by this finding, we propose Spectral Null-Space Swap ($S^3$), a training-free composition of paired Non-thinking and Thinking checkpoints. Our method keeps the Non-thinking model inside its own dominant subspace and takes the Thinking checkpoint outside it, improving reasoning efficiency while maintaining accuracy. We extensively evaluate $S^3$ on 2B-30B dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures spanning 28 evaluation environments across mathematical, multimodal, and audio reasoning domains. $S^3$ establishes new empirical Pareto Frontiers among training-free model composition strategies: across all settings, it reduces inference token overhead by an average of 27.4% compared to full Thinking models while simultaneously improving overall task accuracy by 1.0 percentage point (e.g., yielding +8.3% accuracy on HMMT25 alongside a 33.0% token speedup). We further use attention entropy for explanation and find that the retained component produces more concentrated attention, and we use a simplified analytical model about optimization to demonstrate why null-space can effectively reduce attention entropy, thereby improving the efficiency of reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Spectral Null-Space Swap（S³），一种无需训练的模型组合方法，通过保留Non-thinking模型的主导奇异子空间并从Thinking模型中引入补空间（null-space）分量，在平均减少27.4%推理token的同时提升1.0个百分点的任务准确率，并在2B-30B的密集与MoE架构、跨数学/多模态/音频推理等28个评测环境中建立新的帕累托前沿。机制上，空空间分量产生更集中的注意力（更低熵），并通过简化解析模型在局部最优性假设下得到理论解释。
AI.motivation: 思考模式后训练虽提升推理能力，但带来冗长的思维链与高昂的token开销。现有研究多关注权重的主导奇异子空间，但Thinking与Non-thinking模型之间真正承载功能差异的部分并非参数能量集中的方向，因此如何定位并选择性转移权重空间中"功能性"差异成为关键问题。
AI.method: 对配对的Non-thinking（W₀）与Thinking（Wₜ）权重差异ΔW=Wₜ−W₀做SVD分解，将其分为与W₀主导奇异方向对齐的分量ΔW∥和正交补空间分量ΔW⊥。作者发现ΔW∥占据较大Frobenius能量却几乎不引发功能变化，而ΔW⊥参数能量较低却驱动主要功能偏移。S³方法在由参数ρ控制的前ρ·min(m,n)个主导奇异方向子空间Sρ内保留W₀，在其正交补上采用Wₜ，组合权重为Wρ=P_{Sρ}(W₀)+(I−P_{Sρ})(Wₜ)。当ρ=1时退化为仅转移null-space分量（W₀+ΔW⊥）。机制分析引入注意力熵H，结合Pythia-1.4B预训练熵饱和验证与"子空间内局部最优"假设，推导出H_Null≤H_Base≤H_Sub的顺序，并证明ΔW⊥与熵梯度负对齐、ΔW∥使熵单调不减。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B（密集）、Qwen3-30B-A3B（MoE）、Qwen3-VL-2B/4B（视觉-语言）、Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B（音频）五类模型上、覆盖AIME24/25/26、HMMT25、CMIMC25、Olympiad-Bench、AMC23、MATH-500、GSM8K、MMLU、MMMU、MathVista、MMAR、MMSU等基准上，S³-0.8平均相对Thinking模型减少27.4%生成token，同时平均准确率提升1.0个百分点；典型如Qwen3-4B在HMMT25上+8.3pp/减少33.0% token，Qwen3-VL-4B在MathVista上达78.05%/减少31.9% token。ρ∈[0.5,1.0]消融显示ρ=0.8为综合最优；ρ=1消融（probe family）证实Sub≈Base而Null≈Full，表明推理增益集中在null-space分量。注意力熵实验在七个数据集上均稳定满足H_Null<H_Base<H_Sub，SimpleQA上Null准确率20.2%且幻觉率78.7%最低。
AI.conclusion: Thinking与Non-thinking模型在权重空间中沿Non-thinking主导方向的分量冗余，真正承载推理能力的部分位于奇异子空间的正交补中。基于此洞察的S³是一种简单、无需训练的后处理权重组合策略，能在不同模态与规模下稳定改善准确率-效率帕累托边界；空空间投影通过降低注意力熵获得更集中的注意力，从而缩短思维链而不损害性能。

title: BITEM at the NTCIR-19 R2C2 Task: Predicting Confidence from Agentic RAG Pipeline Signals
comment: 8 pages. Participant paper for the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task
summary: The BITEM team entered both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task with a single agentic pipeline, in which a model searches, reads and records evidence over a movie corpus while an orchestrator holds the record and rules on what may be submitted. A claim is admitted only once an entailment cascade has checked it against the passage it cites, and an answer is released only once enough checked evidence stands behind it. Each question is run three or four times, every pass retrieving from a corpus stripped of what the earlier passes have already seen. The confidence filed with each answer is computed by the orchestrator from what the run leaves behind and is never asked of the model, which is offered no way to rate itself. The two retrieval runs placed 4th and 5th of 22, pooling the passes was worth 0.0709 nDCG@20, and the gain was largest on the multi-hop and post-processing-heavy questions, where the organisers rank the pooled run top of the field. Sixteen of the 25 answer runs were built on passages these two runs supplied, 12 of them filed by other teams. HMR rewards a system whose confidence is high where it answers right and low where it answers wrong. The pipeline reached an accuracy of 0.9219, 6th of 25, while the confidence filed with those answers gave an HMR of 0.4915, 13th. A few rules crafted over those same recorded signals, with no further model call and no further retrieval, raise that to an accuracy of 0.9375, 5th, and an HMR of 0.6985, 9th. Ranking on HMR alone can reward a system for answering wrongly with low confidence, so we propose accHMR, the accuracy multiplied by HMR, which reports the reward in proportion to the accuracy, and on which the revised rules would have scored 0.6549, 5th. For future work, fitting a model on the numbers the pipeline already produces, rather than writing such rules by hand, would be a real step forward.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了BITEM团队在NTCIR-19 R2C2任务中的参赛系统。该系统采用单一智能体(agentic)管道：一个语言模型在电影语料上搜索、阅读并记录证据，由外部编排器(orchestrator)进行蕴含级联校验和提交把关。置信度由编排器基于运行痕迹计算而非由模型自评。多轮检索通过去除前序已见段落来缩小语料。在段落检索子任务中两个运行分别排名第4和第5(22个中)，池化提升0.0709 nDCG@20；在带置信度的回答子任务中准确率达0.9219(25个中第6)，HMR为0.4915(第13)。作者提出新指标accHMR(准确率×HMR)，并通过手工规则将accHMR提升至0.6549(第5)。
AI.motivation: NTCIR-19 R2C2任务要求系统既能检索相关段落，又能给出带置信度的回答。现有置信度估计方法大多依赖模型自评(logits、采样多样性、自我评估)，存在自信错误无法被捕捉的问题。作者希望探索一种模型无关的置信度估计方法，仅利用智能体管道已产生的副产物信号(如蕴含分数、搜索次数、推理长度、证据数量等)来推断答案的正确性。同时发现HMR指标单独使用存在漏洞——可被低准确率但低置信度的系统刷分，故提出accHMR。
AI.method: 系统由两部分组成：(1)语言模型(Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8)持有八个工具(search_passages、search_entities、get_passage、extract_from_passage、record_evidence、list_nuggets、flag_nugget_bogus、submit_answer)；(2)外部编排器执行工具调用、维持记录、裁决提交。预处理由Qwen3.5-9B进行命名实体标注，语料按200-300词按句子边界切分(共2,091,427段)。采用Elasticsearch稀疏检索+nomic-embed-text-v1.5稠密检索+RRF融合+ms-marco-MiniLM交叉编码器重排。证据记录需经两阶段蕴含校验(MiniCheck-Flan-T5-Large + DeBERTa-v3-large)。每题跑3-4遍，每遍从去除前序已见段的语料检索。置信度由编排器基于"已验证证据支撑的独立段落数"等信号计算，模型无权自评。提交了BITEM-PG-1/PG-2(段落检索)和BITEM-AC-1/AC-2/AC-3(回答+置信度)，并后处理了两种规则化重制版本(single pass longest deliberation, four passes independent agreement)。
AI.result: 段落检索：BITEM-PG-1 nDCG@20=0.3509，BITEM-PG-2=0.4217(Δ=+0.0709，64题中胜42)，在多跳和后处理密集型问题上池化运行被官方排为全场第一(但组织者的Tukey HSD无法分离显著性)。回答带置信度：BITEM-AC-1准确率0.9062/HMR 0.2719，BITEM-AC-2(most confident)准确率0.9219/HMR 0.4915/accHMR 0.4531，BITEM-AC-3(summed agreement)准确率0.8906/HMR 0.3956。手工规则重制：四轮独立一致性规则将准确率提升至0.9375、HMR 0.6985、accHMR 0.6549，accHMR排名从第7升至第5。所有官方运行均无法在答错时给出低置信度(单遍ROC AUC仅0.463)。模型作评判员(MAJ)方法虽准确率最高(0.9375)但校准同样失败(HMR 0.2952)。
AI.conclusion: 池化同一系统的多遍运行对两子任务都有帮助：检索上扩展了聚集段列表并找到了更好的段落，回答上改善了置信度校准。无需再调用模型或检索，仅通过运行痕迹上的简单规则就能把accHMR从0.4531提升至0.6549。HMR单独使用可被低准确率+低置信度系统刷分(如每题固定50%置信度无论对错都得HMR=0.5，零准确率+零置信度得HMR=1.0)，故作者建议加入accHMR(准确率×HMR)作为复合指标。未来工作包括在更大独立集合上拟合回归模型来替代手工规则，以及在评测中加入"语料不支持的问题"以强制系统真正学会表达低置信度。

title: No Scale Left Behind: Multi-Scale Autoencoder with Bi-directional Attention for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) plays a crucial role in healthcare, finance, industrial monitoring, and other sectors. Within and between these settings, anomalies span vastly different temporal scales, from sub-second point spikes to multi-hour drift patterns.
