AI.method: 论文采用以下方法：（1）数据：使用OS Open Roads作为路网，STATS19提供2021-2024年日级碰撞数据，特征包含35个维度（几何形状、节点度、星期、1天至9年的历史碰撞、伤亡类型、AADF流量、OSM兴趣点密度、九项多重剥夺指数）；目标通过累积和矩阵而非滚动段日表计算，使窗口长度计算上"免费"；（2）模型：图注意力层+GRU+零膨胀泊松解码器，Adam学习率0.01训练200轮，分裂共形校准90%预测区间；（3）评估：扩展窗口走前验证，20天输入、14天预测、步长90天，每区六个窗口，指标为AccHR@20（每日碰撞中落在预测风险前20%路段上的比例均值）；（4）统计：五随机种子均值、配对t检验与Wilcoxon符号秩检验、t分布置信区间；（5）基线对比：将GNN与"按累计碰撞次数排序的无参数基线"以及Highway Safety Manual的Empirical Bayes估计器对比；（6）跨基准验证：在ML4RoadSafety的Delaware子集（458,282次碰撞、166个月、109,107条边）上重复扫描。
AI.result: 主要结果：（1）复现审计：11个设计决策中仅4个在第二区可复现，7个失败且4个出现符号反转；（2）种子方差：参考架构单区种子散布最高达35.7分（本文模型约4分），某些区在同一种子下不同区方向相反（+18.53 vs 真正+9.55；+8.01 vs +13.57）；（3）极简基线对比：累计碰撞排序基线（~8年）AccHR@20达83.94%，Empirical Bayes达83.84%，均超过本文GNN的80.08%和参考架构的66.57%；（4）窗口敏感性：同一无参数排序基线在不同回溯窗口下跨度22.71%–83.94%（61分范围），已发表文献中每个GNN数值都被1–5年窗口的基线匹配；（5）度量特性：AccHR@20的最小步长为单次碰撞跨越阈值，固定种子下CUDA散射操作导致同一配置3次跑出0.755/0.832/845（9.0分差）；（6）Delaware验证：在更严格阈值（Top-5%、Top-1%）下窗口依赖性重现（18.4分、14.5分），但Top-20%阈值下仅5.3分（已接近饱和）。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出以下结论：（1）道路级碰撞预测中GNN的多数设计决策无法跨区域复现，七分之四失败表现为符号反转而非简单衰减，这使得"单区域估计界定真实效应上界"的常见假设失效；效应大小能可靠预测不可复现性但仅弱预测可复现性；（2）无论是所构建的GNN还是参考架构，均未在统计意义上超越按累计碰撞次数排序的无参数基线；后者的强度本质上由回溯窗口长度决定，而该领域已发表文献的历史基线均基于过短数据集计算，无法构成公平对照；（3）单次运行报告在稀疏数据和CUDA非确定性下面临严重可复现性问题。论文最终建议：将"窗口匹配的历史碰撞计数基线"和"多随机种子方差报告"作为该任务研究的最低规范，并强调应优先报告失败率而非均值，以准确刻画模型行为。

title: CADENCE: A Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for Fast and Accurate Time Series Classification
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Code and benchmark evaluation scripts available at this https URL
summary: Time series classification (TSC) exhibits a sharp trade-off between accuracy and computational scalability. Meta-ensembles like HIVE-COTE 2.0 reach state-of-the-art accuracy but require extensive compute, whereas ultra-fast random convolutional transforms (e.g., MiniRocket, Hydra) run in seconds but struggle with phase-independent distributions, signal kinematics, and decision tree fragmentation on large class counts. In this work, we present CADENCE (Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for time series Classification Excellence), a unified, CPU-native dual-expert architecture. CADENCE decouples representation learning into two specialized pathways: (i) a Convolutional Linear Expert pairing 10,000 deterministic dilated features with closed-form L2-regularized Woodbury ridge classification, and (ii) a Distributional Interval Expert pairing competing dilated kernels (Hydra) with dyadic Cornish-Fisher moment approximations across signal kinematics and FFT spectral bands, fitted with an ExtraTrees ensemble. An internal validation meta-router with rare-class preservation dynamically selects between pure expert routing and confidence-weighted soft blending, followed by a full refit on 100% of training data. Evaluated across all 109 equal-length UCR Archive datasets over 30 resamples (3,270 total runs), CADENCE achieves a grand mean accuracy of 0.8864. This ranks #2 across the archive, surpassed only by HIVE-COTE 2.0 (0.8895, p_Holm = 0.295, no statistically significant difference), while outperforming Hydra+MultiRocket (0.8818), MultiRocket (0.8797), and HIVE-COTE 1.0 (0.8786, p_Holm = 0.048). CADENCE closes the gap to HIVE-COTE 2.0 to 0.31 percentage points while taking an average of only 17.53 seconds per dataset on a dual-core CPU. Source code and evaluation scripts: this https URL

AI.tldr: CADENCE是一种CPU原生双专家时间序列分类架构,通过卷积线性专家与分布区间专家的组合,在UCR归档的109个数据集上达到平均0.8864的准确率,排名第二,与最先进的HIVE-COTE 2.0无统计显著差异,但计算速度快得多。
AI.motivation: 时间序列分类存在准确性与计算可扩展性之间的尖锐权衡:HIVE-COTE 2.0等元集成方法准确率高但计算昂贵,而MiniRocket、Hydra等快速随机卷积变换在秒级运行但对相位无关分布、长时积分运动学特征和大类数决策树碎片化等问题处理不足。
AI.method: CADENCE采用双专家架构:(1)卷积线性专家——10,000个确定性膨胀卷积特征配合闭式L2正则化Woodbury岭分类器;(2)分布区间专家——竞争膨胀核(Hydra)结合FFT频谱带与信号运动学特征上的Cornish-Fisher矩近似,由ExtraTrees集成拟合;通过内部验证元路由器(保留稀有类)动态选择纯专家路由或置信度加权软混合,并在全部训练数据上重新拟合。
AI.result: 在109个等长UCR数据集上30次重采样(共3,270次运行)中,CADENCE取得0.8864的平均准确率,排名第二,仅次于HIVE-COTE 2.0的0.8895(p_Holm=0.295,无统计显著差异),优于Hydra+MultiRocket(0.8818)、MultiRocket(0.8797)和HIVE-COTE 1.0(0.8786,p_Holm=0.048);与HIVE-COTE 2.0差距缩小到0.31个百分点,而在双核CPU上平均每个数据集仅需17.53秒。
AI.conclusion: CADENCE有效弥合了准确性与计算效率之间的鸿沟,在保持CPU原生快速推理的同时,达到与最先进的元集成方法无显著差异的分类精度,是大规模时间序列分类任务的实用解决方案。

title: KernelOnet: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Kernel Functions
summary: This paper proposes an interpretable neural operator framework, the Kernel Operator Network (KernelOnet), which incorporates kernel functions explicitly into the neural operator architecture, so that the operator structure matches the kernel-expansion form used in boundary-type kernel-expansion methods. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which learn basis functions implicitly through deep networks, KernelOnet replaces the trunk network with explicit kernels and offers three complementary kernels: a data-driven learnable kernel, in which a neural network parameterizes a radial basis function learned from data, and which for constant-coefficient linear problems can be regarded as a non-singular fundamental solution; a physics-informed kernel, which embeds physical information such as analytic fundamental solutions into the network structure, so that the expansion satisfies the governing equation automatically and can be trained without supervision on boundary conditions alone, with no interior solution data; and a hybrid kernel, which splits the solution, according to the linear principal part of the governing equation, into a homogeneous part spanned by analytic fundamental solutions and a source part carried by low-rank learned correction kernels, thereby balancing physical priors against data fitting on nonlinear problems lacking an analytic fundamental solution. On three benchmarks and one engineering problem in a shallow-water waveguide, KernelOnet attains high accuracy; where comparable with DeepONet, it is more accurate with fewer learnable parameters. Its unsupervised configuration needs no interior solution labels, and its per-query inference cost is far below that of per-instance solvers, offering an effective route to acoustic propagation in unbounded exterior domains that general-purpose neural operators struggle to handle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KernelOnet，一种将核函数显式嵌入神经算子架构的可解释算子学习框架，用以替代DeepONet中隐式学习的trunk网络，并提供三种互补的核构造策略：数据驱动可学习核（KernelOnet-RBF）、物理信息核（KernelOnet-PIKF）和混合核（KernelOnet-HK）。在三个基准问题（圆域Laplace方程、星形域非线性修正Helmholtz方程、无界外域复Helmholtz方程）和一个工程问题（浅水波导中球壳振动引发的水下声辐射与传播）上均取得高精度；在可直接对比的问题上以更少参数优于DeepONet；无监督配置无需内部解标签，推理成本远低于逐实例求解器。
AI.motivation: 传统神经算子（如DeepONet）通过深度网络隐式学习基函数，缺乏物理一致性与可解释性，且对大量高精度训练数据依赖较强；而传统核方法虽物理一致但难以自适应调整。本文旨在将显式核函数嵌入神经算子，建立神经算子与边界型核展开方法之间的内在联系，兼顾物理一致性、可解释性与数据驱动的灵活性。
AI.method: 提出KernelOnet框架，将DeepONet的trunk网络替换为显式核函数 ψ_j(x)，保留branch网络输出系数。给出三种核构造：(1) KernelOnet-RBF——神经网络参数化的径向基函数，数据驱动学习；(2) KernelOnet-PIKF——以控制方程解析基本解为核，展开自动满足方程，可仅用边界条件无监督训练，包含配置点型和边界积分型两种等价形式；(3) KernelOnet-HK——将解分解为齐次部分（解析基本解展开）与源项修正部分（低秩学习修正核 K_c≪B），适用于无解析基本解的非线性问题。三者在K_c维度上形成从强物理先验到纯数据驱动的连续谱。理论分析基于RKHS插值误差界与基本解展开的谱收敛性。引入SVD正交化预处理以改善数值病态，并通过输入子空间准则选取截断方向以适用于外域远场。
AI.result: 在Case 1（圆域Laplace）中KernelOnet-PIKF相对L2误差达8.89×10⁻⁴，参数量最少（103,041），优于DeepONet（1.89×10⁻³，180,801参数）；学习到的核函数几乎恢复为基本解的仿射像，且在原点正则化。Case 2（非线性修正Helmholtz，ε=4）中KernelOnet-HK误差2.75×10⁻³，明显优于KernelOnet-RBF（5.11×10⁻³）和DeepONet（5.71×10⁻³），且误差随非线性增长最慢（p≈0.11）；HK修正分支能量占比从0.3%增至26.6%，定量反映非线性成分。Case 3（无界外域复Helmholtz，k=20）中KernelOnet-PIKF（SVD）误差1.36×10⁻³，满足Sommerfeld辐射条件，是唯一适用的算子学习方法。Case 4（浅水波导声辐射）近场与远场均以无监督方式达到约10⁻³精度，对三种声速剖面均鲁棒，相位误差对应等效声程偏差<1 mm。收敛速度与H¹半范误差均与L²结果一致。
AI.conclusion: KernelOnet通过显式核函数建立神经算子与边界型数值方法间的数学一致性，三种核策略形成互补的连续谱，在精度、可解释性、物理一致性与计算效率间取得良好平衡：物理信息核实现无监督精确求解，数据驱动核覆盖强非线性，混合核兼顾物理先验与适用范围。框架特别适用于含解析基本解的线性问题及无界外域声传播，远场预测与近场辐射均无需内部标签。但仍存在局限：核构造尚未自动化、高频/大尺度问题中SVD截断阶数增长过快、整体近似误差的理论保证（涵盖核展开与系数学习的收敛率与泛化误差界）尚不完整，未来可通过自动核库、数值Green函数与块低秩分解等方向改进。

title: EnJoi: Ensemble Joint Score Filter for Generative Data Assimilation
summary: Data Assimilation (DA) aims to recover the full state of a dynamical system that is only partially observed. A solution is to use Score-based models to generate physically consistent trajectories that agree with the observations. These Autoregressive Diffusion models are trained by conditioning on the previous state; however, they do not take into account the uncertainty of their past predictions. We propose a new diffusion-based assimilation algorithm that dynamically balances the confidence in the current state and the new observations. Crucially, we choose to learn the distribution of the joint state containing both the past and future. This allows us to use a modified version of En4DVar, a classical DA algorithm that relies on the covariance of an ensemble of particles. Experiments on fluid and traffic flow simulations show improved reconstruction performance, especially in situations where observations are sparse and non-homogeneous.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EnJoi（Ensemble Joint Score Filter），一种结合En4DVar框架与联合扩散分数模型的数据同化算法，通过集成粒子协方差动态平衡背景态不确定性与观测信息，提升稀疏非均匀观测下的重构性能。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式数据同化方法将前一时刻状态视为精确条件，忽略了背景分布的不确定性，且使用常数对角协方差，无法处理真实系统中空间非均匀的观测模式（如移动传感器、数据缺失）和时变不确定性。这导致模型在修正偏差时过于迟钝或在噪声观测下过度敏感。
AI.method: 1) 学习联合状态(x^k, x^{k+1})的扩散分数，而非仅条件生成未来态；2) 借鉴En4DVar思想，维护粒子协方差矩阵P^k作为背景先验；3) 在引导项中加入经验协方差，通过DPS近似将背景作为似然项；4) 引入尺度化引导（按∇√(2d)归一化）配合Langevin校正步骤，平衡观测与背景置信度；5) 采用Gaspari-Cohn局部化协方差以缓解高维维度灾难。
AI.result: 在Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 1D流体实验中，EnJoi在Bernoulli、Sine、Exponential三种观测模式下均取得最优CRPS（0.010–0.229），显著优于Joint AR和粒子滤波方法；在Kolmogorov 2D流实验中，稀疏观测(4×4)下CRPS为0.12，优于条件PF的0.32；在ARZ交通流实验中（仅2.5%探针车观测），EnJoi以10粒子即达到CRPS 0.15，优于128粒子的粒子滤波（0.23）。优势在观测稀疏且非均匀时尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: EnJoi通过将En4DVar的协方差框架融入联合扩散分数模型，实现了对过去不确定性、观测噪声和物理模型置信度的动态平衡，在多种复杂观测场景中展现出最佳鲁棒性。局限在于联合分数使推理时间翻倍，协方差求逆增加计算开销，且高斯背景假设无法处理多模态先验。未来可探索基于随机插值或最优传输的表达性背景先验。

title: FluxLite: Inference-Time Proposal Control for Discrete Diffusion Models
summary: Many inference-time tasks for pretrained discrete diffusion models and diffusion language models reduce to drawing samples from a tilted version of the pretrained distribution. Feynman-Kac sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) makes this correction exact in principle, but its prescribed weights routinely degenerate when the proposal dynamics are misaligned with the tilt, capping the practical gains from additional particles. We introduce FluxLite, a lightweight, training-free proposal-control framework for discrete diffusion. On the sparse directed graph of pretrained reverse rates, any sparse jump-rate perturbation can be exactly compensated by a $q_t$-weighted graph-divergence term in the Feynman-Kac potential; the target path is therefore preserved while the residual reweighting variance becomes a local convex objective. We instantiate this principle as two practical samplers: a one-hop local reallocation rule (HEU) and a small nonnegative quadratic program over pretrained-rate bases (D-VCG). We further prove population stability under the standard score-entropy training loss, identifying a tilted-path coverage factor that governs robustness to score error, together with finite-particle convergence for a fixed controlled Feynman-Kac recursion. Empirically, FluxLite improves over standard Feynman-Kac SMC baselines by up to two orders of magnitude in terminal KL on an analytically tractable finite-state CTMC benchmark, and reduces row-correlation MSE on 2D Ising sampling by 5-7x in geometric mean and up to 55x at peak.

AI.tldr: FluxLite提出了一种面向预训练离散扩散模型的免训练推理时提议控制框架，通过在预训练反向速率的稀疏有向图上精确补偿跳跃速率扰动，将残差重加权方差转化为局部凸优化问题，从而有效减少Feynman-Kac SMC的权重退化现象。
AI.motivation: 推理时任务（如奖励对齐生成、分类器自由引导、可控文本生成等）通常需要从预训练模型的倾斜版本中采样。Feynman-Kac SMC在理论上可实现精确修正，但当提议动态与倾斜目标不匹配时，权重会退化，限制增加粒子数的收益。现有的扭曲/控制SMC方法虽能缓解此问题，但通常需要额外训练或模态特定启发式方法。核心问题是：是否存在一种统一的、免训练的提议控制原则，能同时适用于连续和离散的推理时SMC？
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1) 图演算：定义q_t加权的图散度算子，证明稀疏跳跃速率扰动可由图散度项精确补偿，保持目标路径不变；(2) 方差控制：将提议设计转化为残差重加权方差最小化问题，提出稀疏加权最小二乘公式，并给出无稀疏约束时的零方差解析解；(3) 实用采样器：HEU（单跳局部再分配启发式）和D-VCG（基于预训练速率基的非负二次规划）。理论方面证明：在标准score-entropy训练损失下引导Feynman-Kac流的群体稳定性，识别控制鲁棒性的倾斜路径覆盖因子；以及固定控制Feynman-Kac递归的有限粒子收敛性。
AI.result: 在解析可解的有限状态CTMC基准上，D-VCG相比D-FKC基线将终端KL散度降低最高达114.8倍；在2D Ising采样上将行相关MSE在几何平均意义上降低5-7倍，峰值降低达55倍。实验涵盖纯退火和联合退火加倾斜两种设置，且优势在不同粒子数下持续存在。在单声道音乐补全和CFG文本到图像生成等大规模任务上也取得一致改进。
AI.conclusion: FluxLite是DriftLite在离散扩散模型和DLM中的对应物。其核心是预训练转移图上精确的CTMC-Feynman-Kac等价类：稀疏速率扰动重新分配通量，q_t加权图散度补偿残差势能而不改变倾斜边缘。HEU和D-VCG实例化了这一方差控制原则；理论将score-ratio损失与引导Feynman-Kac偏差、残差势能振荡与固定网格粒子误差联系起来。未来方向包括混合离散-连续控制、对齐/偏好/预训练耦合、以及向传输图或并行推理架构的蒸馏。

title: Preferent Compression Bounds Are Tight
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, to appear at the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)
summary: The lack of rigorous safety and performance certificates remains a key bottleneck to the deployment of modern learning-based methods. Sample compression has recently emerged as a powerful tool for deriving such certificates, with particularly sharp bounds available for algorithms satisfying a so-called preference property -- also known as stability in the learning theory literature. These bounds find direct application across domains as different as the Scenario Approach, Pick-to-Learn, and Support Vector methods. However, whether they are tight has remained an open problem. In this paper we resolve this question affirmatively and show that the state-of-the-art bound for preferent compressions is provably tight. We establish this by exhibiting an explicit construction based on the uniform distribution and order statistics that attains the bound in the limit. Along the way, we also provide a considerably shorter and more accessible proof of this bound, requiring only elementary counting arguments and no infinite-dimensional duality.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了对满足偏好性(preference property)的样本压缩算法，最优的概率变化上界（来自[3, Theorem 4]）是紧的(tight)，并给出了一个基于均匀分布和次序统计量的显式构造达到该界，同时提供了该上界更简洁的证明。
AI.motivation: 样本压缩为数据驱动方法提供了重要的风险证书保证，但此前最优的偏好压缩上界是否紧致一直悬而未决，限制了其理论完备性和实际部署信心。
AI.method: 论文包含两个主要技术贡献：(1) 使用仅基于初等计数论证的简化方法重新证明现有上界，避免了原证明中无限维对偶的复杂性；(2) 基于均匀分布和顺序统计量构造一族偏好压缩函数c_η，通过令η→0+实现下界匹配，从而证明上界紧致。证明利用三角阵列{p_{k,m}}上的两个关键关系(行内加权和≤1、列间递推≤(1-ε_k)·p_{k,m})，紧致性论证中这两个关系均取等号。
AI.result: 主要结果(Theorem 4)表明：对任意N∈ℕ和δ∈(0,1)，在所有分布和偏好压缩上的下确界inf P(φ(D)≤ε(|c(D)|,N,δ)) = 1−δ。该结果在场景方法、Pick-to-Learn和支持向量机等具有直接应用价值的领域中具有重要意义，确认了现有理论界限不可进一步改进。
AI.conclusion: 偏好压缩的最优风险证书界是紧的，无法再改善；论文还提供了一个更易理解的界证明（仅需计数论证），以及一个简单优雅的均匀分布+次序统计量构造达到该界，对样本压缩理论在控制、机器学习和验证等安全攸关领域的部署具有理论奠基意义。

title: ABC: Advantage-Based Control Variates for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Recent progress in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has highlighted the effectiveness of simple critic-free policy-gradient methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). In contrast, actor-critic methods rely on learned value functions whose approximation error can introduce bias through commonly used advantage estimators such as temporal-difference error. Motivated by this observation, we revisit trajectory-level control variates through an advantage-value formulation, which we call Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC). This formulation reveals that the covariance structure is closely related to the return decomposition used in Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE). Finally, we combine ABC with DAE into a single actor-critic algorithm and evaluate it in an offline-to-online RLVR setting, where the critic is first trained on previously collected trajectories and adapted during online learning. On mathematical reasoning tasks, ABC achieves performance competitive with GRPO using substantially fewer online optimization steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于优势函数的控制变量方法（ABC），将学习到的优势和价值函数整合到策略梯度估计中，既保持无偏性又能显著降低方差。理论证明精确的优势与价值函数最小化协方差，且其方差上界与直接优势估计（DAE）的目标紧密相关。作者将ABC与DAE结合为统一的actor-critic算法，在离线到在线的RLVR设置下，仅用约100步在线梯度更新即可在数学推理任务上达到与Dr. GRPO（~6000步）相当的性能。
AI.motivation: RLVR中主流方法GRPO等弃用critic，但group-based估计器需要多次同prompt采样、只能提供轨迹级反馈、且组内奖励相同时无学习信号；而PPO等actor-critic方法依赖TD误差估计优势，critic近似误差引入的偏差可能抵消其方差降低的收益。需要一种既能提供细粒度token级反馈又能保持无偏性的方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出ABC估计器：将估计的优势函数沿轨迹作为轨迹级控制变量，加上解析修正项保证无偏性（Theorem 2），其中(A^π, V^π)在Loewner序下最小化协方差；2) 在确定性环境下证明方差上界由回报预测误差|G - Σγ^t A^(s_t,a_t) - V^(s_0)|的平方与Fisher信息矩阵之积控制（Corollary 3），恰好与DAE目标对应；3) 实现ABC+DAE统一actor-critic算法，采用离线-在线两阶段训练：离线阶段用DAE在大规模Qwen3生成轨迹（约820万条）上预训练critic（8B+LoRA），在线阶段actor每步用ABC单次更新、critic每步用DAE更新K=32次，不使用clipping、重要性采样或KL正则化。
AI.result: 在DeepMath-103k数学推理任务上，使用Qwen3-{0.6/1.7/4}B作为actor、Qwen3-8B作为critic：方差比对照REINFORCE，value baseline降低~30%，ABC进一步降低（除1.7B因个别极端critic预测误差外）；评估指标MATH500/AMC23/AIME25/AIME26上ABC与Dr. GRPO（~6000步、160万轨迹）竞争力相当，仅用100步（约80万轨迹）即可达到相近性能，且明显优于同设置下的REINFORCE。biased baseline（A^·∇log π）虽初始更快但后续受限，验证了无偏性价值。
AI.conclusion: ABC提供了一种将学习到的优势与价值函数无偏整合进策略梯度的自然方式，其方差特性理论性地将控制变量学习与DAE的回报预测目标联系起来。实验表明，离线criti预训练配合ABC+DAE的actor-critic方法能在大幅减少在线优化步数的前提下匹配现代critic-free的RLVR方法（Dr. GRPO），在已有大规模rollout数据的场景中具有实际吸引力，同时解耦了critic训练与rollout采集，有利于异步RL设置。局限性：实验限于数学推理与确定性环境；critic质量决定方差缩减效果；critic带来额外内存和计算开销；离线数据分布对critic的影响尚待研究。

title: Introducing the CZAR Loss: A Tailored Objective Function for Financial Log-Return Predictions
comment: 22 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables; appeared in ADI (September 2026)
summary: In quantitative finance, standard regression losses are misaligned with the economics of return prediction. As the conditional mean of financial log-returns is close to zero, symmetric losses such as the mean squared and mean absolute errors make the constant zero forecast a near-optimal solution, penalizing models with genuine but noisy directional skill. This applies both during training, where predictions shrink toward zero, and during evaluation, where trivial forecasters can lead loss-based rankings. Under a Gaussian linear prediction model, we show that all symmetric monotonic losses share a universal breakeven directional accuracy against the zero predictor, which rises sharply and becomes unobtainable as the prediction noise approaches the standard deviation of the returns. We introduce the CZAR (Composite Zero-Agnostic Return) loss function, a piecewise quadratic loss built around five key requirements: convexity in the prediction, asymmetry with true return direction that vanishes at zero, near-linear penalization of undershoots and wrong-direction predictions, divergence for large errors, and an adaptive loss floor for evaluation. CZAR is provably convex in the prediction at fixed true value, has closed-form gradient and Hessian suitable for custom objectives in gradient-boosted libraries, and its four hyperparameters reduce to a single choice through correlated defaults. In idealized tests, the minimum directional accuracy required for a CZAR-evaluated forecaster to outperform the zero predictor under mean log loss remains near the 50% chance level, whereas the corresponding threshold for symmetric losses rises sharply with prediction noise. This advantage persists under heavy-tailed return distributions. In a LightGBM experiment on intraday BTC log-returns, CZAR-trained models reduce the `zero-returns bias' and improve directional accuracy on large-magnitude returns.

AI.tldr: 本文针对金融对数收益率预测中标准对称损失函数（如MSE、MAE）因条件均值接近零而产生"零收益偏置"（zero-returns bias）的问题，提出了一种新的分段二次损失函数——CZAR（Composite Zero-Agnostic Return）。该损失函数通过方向导向的非对称性、欠拟合/逆方向的近线性惩罚、自适应损失下限等设计，有效移除零预测吸引子，并在高斯线性模型和LightGBM BTC实证实验中均验证了其优势。
AI.motivation: 金融对数收益率预测中，条件均值接近零，标准对称损失（MSE、MAE等）的最优解近乎是常数零预测。这导致两个问题：训练时模型预测收缩至零（破坏方向信号），评估时平凡预测器可能在损失排名中领先。此外，所有对称单调损失在高斯线性预测模型下共享一条通用盈亏平衡方向准确率曲线，该曲线随噪声增大急剧上升并变得不可实现。作者认为方向信息才是经济上真正有价值的预测目标。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：在高斯线性预测模型 $\hat{y}=\rho y+\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_N^2)$ 下推导对称损失的通用盈亏平衡公式 $\mathrm{DA}=0.5+\arctan(\rho_{\min}\sigma/\sigma_N)/\pi$，并证明常数非对称损失在log平均评估下存在系统性反向预测反而优于零预测器的病态行为。2) 推导五项损失函数设计要求：预测方向凸性、零真值处消失的方向非对称性、欠拟合的近线性惩罚、大误差发散性、自适应损失下限。4) 构建CZAR损失：分段二次损失，使用自适应非对称因子 $\beta_{\mathrm{eff}}(|z|)=1/(1+\beta|z|)$ 对正确方向过冲进行折扣，并使用平滑hinge函数实现自适应损失下限。5) 证明CZAR在固定真值下关于预测凸，推导闭式梯度和Hessian，使四个超参数通过关联默认 $\beta^*(\alpha)$ 和 $C^*(\alpha)$ 缩减为单一选择 $\alpha$。6) 在LightGBM框架下对15分钟和1小时BTC对数收益率进行实证测试。
AI.result: 理想化测试：在高斯线性模型下，CZAR的log损失盈亏平衡方向准确率在整个 $\sigma_N\in[0,1.5]$ 范围内保持在50%附近（偏差≤5个百分点），而对称损失的曲线急剧上升至接近不可实现区。该优势在Student-t分布（ν=3,5）厚尾下仍然存在。CZAR排除了常数非对称损失的病态行为（错误方向预测优于零预测）。实证结果：在LightGBM BTC 15分钟和1小时对数收益率预测中，CZAR训练的模型将L1/L2基线存在的约一个数量级的预测收缩减少至接近单位比，大幅幅真实值的方向准确率（Dz>1σ时DA≈0.50-0.56）超过偶然水平，Pearson相关和秩相关提升数倍，naive Sharpe改善。然而全样本DA差异较小且常在采样误差范围内。使用对称一致性损失进行选择会撤回到无影响退化，证实CZAR同时作为训练目标和模型选择标准的必要性。
AI.conclusion: CZAR是一种凸的、可训练的、评估一致的损失函数，通过构造移除了零收益吸引子，代价是特征化的预测偏置。当目标条件均值接近零时，损失函数不是中立实现细节，而是决定性设计选择。CZAR展示了方向信息而非幅度是经济相关输出的场景下，应优先考虑方向导向的非对称损失。研究还对一般有效注意聚合实践提出了方法论警示：对称损失混淆了方向准确性与预测方差，损失排名应同时考虑 $\sigma_{\hat{y}}/\sigma_y$ 长宽比作为一等诊断指标。CZAR作为样本平均损失逻辑也是选择合适的损失候选准则，在去中心化推理网络和传统模型选择管道中均有应用价值。

title: GEM-KMeans: Memory-Efficient and Accurate Clustering on Massive Scale with GPU Optimization
summary: Memory-efficient scaling on clustering problems without sacrificing statistical accuracy is of central interest for large-scale data analysis and machine learning problems. Nonnegative low-rank (NLR) matrix factorization for $K$-means is a scalable clustering method, which connects to semidefinite relaxations with optimal average-case exact recovery guarantees. However, a direct GPU implementation of NLR requires multiple large factor-sized buffers and substantial data movements that are essentially memory-bound. In this paper, we introduce GEM-KMeans, a spectrally normalized yet mathematically equivalent NLR formulation that fuses the gradient update, nonnegative projection, and sufficient statistics for normalization and iterate movement into a matrix-multiplication epilogue. Instead of retaining three massive factor-sized arrays, our IO-aware GPU implementation materializes only one single factor with small tile-reduction arrays as additional storage in the High Bandwidth Memory (HBM). We derive explicit memory costs and spectrally normalized smoothness bounds for optimizing the clustering objective function. Accurate clustering is demonstrated at massive scales on synthetic and real datasets, where performance gains of GEM-KMeans over existing GPU-accelerated Lloyd's algorithms involve data-dependent runtime tradeoffs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GEM-KMeans，一种基于谱归一化但数学等价的非负低秩矩阵分解方法，用于K-means聚类。其核心创新在于通过矩阵乘法后处理融合梯度更新、非负投影和归一化/迭代移动所需的充分统计量，从而只需在HBM中保留一个因子矩阵和小尺寸分块归约数组，显著降低了GPU实现中的内存占用和数据传输开销，同时保持了统计准确性。
AI.motivation: 大规模数据分析与机器学习中的K-means聚类面临内存效率与统计恢复保证难以平衡的挑战。现有非负低秩（NLR）矩阵分解方法虽具有可扩展性并与半正定松弛的精确恢复保证相联系，但其GPU实现需要多个大型因子缓冲区且受内存带宽限制，难以高效扩展。
AI.method: 1. 将NLR矩阵分解重新表述为谱归一化的等价形式（GEM-KMeans）；2. 设计IO感知的GPU实现，将梯度更新、非负投影以及归一化与迭代移动的充分统计量融合为矩阵乘法的epilogue操作；3. 仅物化一个因子矩阵，配合小尺寸的分块归约数组作为额外存储；4. 推导显式内存成本和谱归一化的平滑度界，用于优化聚类目标函数。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的大规模聚类实验中，GEM-KMeans展示了准确的聚类性能。相比现有的GPU加速Lloyd算法，性能提升涉及依赖于数据的运行时间权衡（data-dependent runtime tradeoffs），在内存效率方面有显著改善。
AI.conclusion: GEM-KMeans通过谱归一化的等价NLR公式和矩阵乘法epilogue融合策略，成功实现了内存高效的大规模K-means聚类，同时保持了统计准确性。该方法为大规模聚类问题提供了一种在GPU上有效扩展的解决方案，尽管其相对加速效果因数据集特征而异。

title: Early Learning Shapes Later Directions Of Representation Change In Continual Learning
summary: Representations continually change as a network learns new tasks. We ask whether early representational changes naturally form a geometric structure that continues to shape later learning. We identify a low-dimensional subspace of early representation drift, which we call a scaffold, and test whether it is reused across subsequent tasks. Across four pretrained visual encoders and two datasets, later representational changes consistently favor this early-defined subspace over matched random alternatives. This reuse is history-dependent: when networks experience different early tasks but identical later training inputs, each network preferentially reuses the scaffold induced by its own learning history. The same preference appears in individual optimizer updates, even though the network's dominant local response directions shift away from the original scaffold. Finally, constraining motion within the scaffold slows new-task acquisition more than matched random constraints, while effects on old-task retention are less consistent. In summary, these results suggest that early experience leaves a persistent geometric imprint on how neural networks adapt to future tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现神经网络在早期任务学习中形成的表示变化方向（称为"scaffold"）会在后续任务中被持续重用，且这种重用依赖于早期训练经验；限制在scaffold内的运动会比限制随机方向更显著地损害新任务学习能力。
AI.motivation: 连续学习研究多关注如何平衡稳定性与可塑性以保留已有知识，本文则从表示变化的几何结构出发，探究早期学习的表示漂移方向是否构成可被后续学习反复使用的低维子空间，即早期经验是否在表征变化方向上留下持久印记。
AI.method: 在四个预训练视觉编码器（ResNet-18、DeiT-Tiny、MobileNetV3-S、MLP-Mixer-B/16）和CIFAR-10/100上构建scaffold子空间：通过池化多条训练轨迹早期任务间的表示漂移方向，取前r个右奇异向量的均值投影矩阵的主导特征向量。定义coverage指标衡量后续漂移在scaffold中的能量占比，并以匹配分类器特征跨度的随机子空间作对照；通过成对分支设计（共享网络状态、不同早期任务、相同后续输入）测试scaffold取向是否依赖早期任务内容；通过有限差分测量参数响应子空间与scaffold的对齐度；通过对AdamW更新产生的特征运动的coverage分析测试优化器层面是否偏好scaffold；最后通过在scaffold或随机子空间上施加二次惩罚的干预实验比较新任务习得与旧任务保留效果，并使用能量匹配控制消除被移除漂移能量的差异。
AI.result: 1) 在八种模型-数据集条件下，后续漂移在固定scaffold中的coverage始终高于匹配随机子空间；2) 控制早期任务分支后，每个分支的后续漂移更偏好自身历史诱导的scaffold，优势在八种条件下均显著为正；3) 局部参数响应子空间与scaffold的对齐度在早期后下降，但AdamW更新产生的特征运动在任务早、中、晚三窗口仍持续偏好scaffold；4) 能量匹配下，限制scaffold运动使新任务习得精度下降6.47-21.58个百分点（八种条件均显著），而旧任务保留效果不一致。
AI.conclusion: 早期经验在神经网络的表示变化方向上留下持久的几何印记：早期表征漂移定义了被后续学习反复重用的低维scaffold，其取向由早期训练内容塑造。限制scaffold内运动会选择性地损害新任务习得而非一致地提升旧任务保留，表明连续学习中表示变化的方向本身具有可继承的结构。

title: Data Unlearning via Inverse Distillation
summary: Multi-step matching models, including flow and diffusion models, produce high-quality outputs but incur substantial inference costs and may reproduce unwanted components of their training datasets. We introduce Inverse Distillation Unlearning (IDU), a unified framework that simultaneously distills a teacher multi-step matching model into an efficient one-step student generator and suppresses outputs corresponding to a designated training subset. We first formulate distillation as a min-max objective over a data distribution and then represent this distribution as a mixture of the forget-set and the generated distributions. This allows us to compare this mixture with the teacher's training distribution and recover only the retained data at the optimum. Our method requires only a pretrained full-data teacher and data from the forget set, without access to retained training examples, extra feature extractors or classifiers. Extensive experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets under flow-matching and score-based diffusion settings demonstrate that IDU substantially reduces the generation frequency of forgotten classes while preserving generation quality on the retained classes. To the best of our knowledge, IDU is the first unified framework for simultaneous unlearning and distillation in unconditional flow-matching and score-based models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Inverse Distillation Unlearning (IDU)，首个在无条件流匹配和基于分数的扩散模型中同时实现数据遗忘（unlearning）与一步蒸馏（distillation）的统一框架。该方法仅需预训练的全数据教师模型和待遗忘数据子集，无需保留数据、外部特征提取器或分类器，即可训练出高效的一步生成器，同时抑制指定数据的生成。
AI.motivation: 多步扩散/流匹配模型存在两大问题：推理成本高昂，以及可能复现训练数据中的不良内容（如隐私、版权问题）。机器遗忘（MU）旨在移除特定训练数据的影响，但现有方法要么针对多步模型，要么需额外的分类器/特征提取器，缺少统一、模型无关且适用于一步生成器的遗忘方案。
AI.method: IDU将逆蒸馏方案中的优化分布参数化为遗忘数据分布与生成数据分布的混合（权重ρ），与教师原始数据分布进行匹配。理论证明：当ρ等于遗忘数据比例π时，最优生成器仅恢复保留数据。具体采用min-max目标，交替更新fake模型（同时拟合遗忘与生成数据）和生成器（利用SiD框架的生成损失），并使用权重ρ ∈ [0,1) 控制遗忘强度。
AI.result: 在MNIST和CIFAR-10上，基于流匹配（FM）和基于分数的扩散（SiD）框架的实验表明：IDU将遗忘类别的生成频率（FGR）显著降低（FM实验中≤0.56%，SiD实验中≤1.25%），同时保留类别的生成质量（Retain FID）与重训练基线相当。在十个单类遗忘任务中均表现稳健。在遗忘权重ρ的消融实验中，FM在ρ=0.6（CIFAR-10）和0.4（MNIST）取得最佳平衡，SiD在ρ=0.2（CIFAR-10）效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: IDU是首个面向无条件流匹配和基于分数模型的统一数据遗忘与一步蒸馏框架，无需保留数据或额外模块即可高效抑制指定类别的生成，同时保持保留类别的生成质量。该方法填补了一步生成器数据遗忘的研究空白，但在FM架构中存在训练后期遗忘回弹的稳定性问题。

title: Koa-action: Fast and Consistent Structured Decision Making with Generative LLMs
summary: Industry applications often demand low-latency classification, yet current large language model (LLM) approaches remain poorly suited for latency-critical applications. Existing prompting and constrained decoding produce verbose, multi-token outputs that require expensive token-by-token generation, while encoder-based models achieve faster inference but sacrifice task flexibility. We propose Koa-action, a framework for low-latency atomic actions -- fast, single-step decisions such as classification, semantic endpointing, Boolean checks, and scoring -- formulated as constrained generation with single-token outputs. By introducing atomic label tokens and applying supervised fine-tuning, our method reduces classification to a deterministic one-step decoding problem. Across standard benchmarks, Koa-action delivers competitive accuracy with consistently low and stable latency. On a production intent-routing benchmark, Koa-action reaches 85.5% accuracy -- competitive with the strongest frontier models (Claude-4.8-Opus, Gemini-Pro-3.1) and ahead of GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5-Pro -- while answering in about half a second, several-fold faster than every frontier model (up to ~7.5x at the median) under identical serving conditions. Against the dedicated single-token system Jev/TypeSafe, Koa-action is competitive on accuracy and faster at the median, while also handling multimodal inputs and multi-label outputs that single-label text systems do not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Koa-action框架，将分类任务转化为单token约束生成，通过引入原子标签token并结合监督微调，实现确定性单步解码，在保持前沿模型准确率的同时，将推理延迟降至约0.53秒（相比前沿模型最高快约7.5倍）。
AI.motivation: 工业级分类应用对低延迟有严格要求，但现有LLM方法存在两大缺陷：基于提示的方法产生冗长的多token输出，推理开销大且无单token保证；受约束解码虽限制了输出标签，但仍是逐token生成，延迟随标签词汇量增长而不可预测。编码器模型（如BERT+分类头）虽延迟低但缺乏任务灵活性。需要在保持LLM通用性的同时获得低且稳定的推理延迟。
AI.method: Koa-action框架包含三个核心技术：(1) 原子标签token——为每个类别引入专用控制token（如[control_1]），扩展词表并保证每个标签恰好解码为一个token；(2) 随机化标签分配——训练时随机打乱标签与控制token的对应关系，使模型依赖提示中的语义描述而非记忆token ID，从而支持推理时的零样本标签集更新；(3) 监督微调目标——仅在输出位置计算受限softmax上的交叉熵损失，所有前置token用-100掩码。解码时设置max_new_tokens=1并限制决策空间至Ω，实现O(1)的确定性单步推理。框架天然支持多模态输入（文本+视觉）和多标签输出（通过软目标分布替代one-hot监督）。
AI.result: 在MIntRec 2.0多模态基准上，Koa-action微调的Gemma-3-27B达62.72%准确率，超过所有前沿VLM（Gemini-Pro-3.1为55.93%）和专用编码器模型（MAG-BERT 60.58%，MulT 60.66%）。在文本分类上（SST-2、Amazon Reviews、生产意图路由、语音端点检测），Koa-action准确率位于前沿模型区间内（差值约1-2点）。生产意图路由任务中准确率达85.5%，与Claude-4.8-Opus和Gemini-Pro-3.1相当。在相同服务条件下，中位延迟0.53秒（P95 0.63秒），比最快前沿模型快约1.9倍，比最慢者快约7.5倍；延迟跨任务基本恒定（0.526-0.529秒）。大batch（最高64）下延迟优势依然存在。随机置换控制token映射后准确率保持稳定（均值61.62%±1.11%），证明零样本适应能力。多语言MTOP基准上因仅英语微调而落后于GPT-4o，但保留了低延迟优势。
AI.conclusion: Koa-action通过将分类重构为原子动作的约束生成，以单token解码实现前沿级准确率、跨数量级更低延迟和任务无关的延迟可预测性。该框架在生产意图路由等真实部署约束下验证有效，支持多模态输入与多标签输出。局限在于当前仅基于英语微调，多语言泛化能力受限，未来工作应扩展多语言监督。

title: Dyad: Extending Large Language Models with Native Typed Decision-Making
summary: We study how to build more capable general-purpose agents by extending large language models (LLMs) with native typed decision-making. We introduce Dyad, an architecture that augments a pretrained LLM with an environment-conditioned action encoder that embeds each candidate action description in parallel, then scores these embeddings against the LLM's internal state to yield a distribution over typed actions. By factorizing decision-making into representations of the evolving interaction state and environment-specific action semantics, Dyad introduces an inductive bias for learning reusable representations while keeping action scoring efficient even as the action space grows. We investigate two complementary reinforcement learning settings driven by environment interaction. With the LLM frozen, training the action encoder alone achieves consistent gains across four unseen environments, enabling modular adaptation without modifying any LLM parameters. Jointly optimizing both components outperforms conventional RL post-training across diverse interactive tasks and model scales, including a 3.80% average absolute gain on ALFWorld with a 9B model, while improving general knowledge, reasoning, and coding.

AI.tldr: Dyad 提出了一种扩展预训练 LLM 的架构，通过添加环境条件化的动作编码器实现原生类型化决策（native typed decision-making），在保持自回归语言推理能力的同时直接对动态动作空间进行并行评分。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体通常通过自回归生成文本来指定动作，将动作选择与词汇表 token 预测耦合，无法直接对类型化动作进行分布预测；专门的 System 1 模型（如 Jev）虽能直接预测类型化决策，但缺乏语言推理能力。Dyad 旨在统一两者：在一个预训练 LLM 内同时支持语言推理（System 2）与类型化决策（System 1），且能处理动态变化的、不可预见的动作空间（如新环境中的网页操作）。
AI.method:
1. **架构设计**：在预训练 LLM 旁添加一个动作编码器 g。状态表示 q_t 由 LLM 骨干 f 在环境描述与历史 h_t 上产生；动作表示 z_a 由编码器 g 在环境描述与动作描述上独立、并行产生。决策时通过 softmax(Z_t · q_t) 直接得到动作分布，无需经过语言模型词汇表。
2. **分解的归纳偏置**：将决策分解为"演化中的交互状态"与"环境特定的动作语义"，使动作表示可缓存复用，支持排列等变性，并随动作空间增长保持评分高效。
3. **两阶段训练**：首先通过教师 LLM 合成的动作选择样本对齐投影器（仅训练投影器，冻结 LLM 和编码器骨干）；然后使用 GRPO/GiGPO 进行智能体强化学习，可冻结 LLM 或联合优化 LLM 与动作编码器。
4. **实现**：基于 vLLM 和 verl 构建端到端训练推理流水线。
AI.result:
- **同域性能**（Qwen3.5-9B，ALFWorld/WebShop）：Dyad-GRPO/GiGPO 在四个对比中均超过对应基线，ALFWorld 上 GRPO 基线最高提升 5.89%（绝对值），GiGPO 基线上也有进一步提升。
- **跨环境性能**（在 DIVE/CodeGym 训练后零样本评估 ALFWorld、WebShop、τ²-bench、SWE）：48 个模型-算法-环境组合中 41 个优于 RL 基线，47/48 个超过原始预训练模型，跨三种模型规模（4B/9B/27B）一致提升。
- **通用能力保持**：在 MMLU-Pro、HMMT、LiveCodeBench 上，Dyad 通常优于 GRPO/GiGPO，能恢复或放大通用能力，而基线在部分场景出现退化。
- **冻结 LLM 模块化适应**：仅训练动作编码器即可在四个未见环境上获得稳定提升，验证了即插即用性。
- **System 1 对比**（JevBench）：Qwen3.5-4B + Dyad（带推理）整体准确率 86.18% 略超 Jev 的 85.01%，且在 ALFWorld 上所有六类任务均优于 Jev 和零样本 Qwen，所需交互步数更少。
- **消融**：注意力池化优于 MLP 加权池化和平均池化（55.92 vs 48.20 vs 41.23 验证奖励）；监督对齐 + 强化学习两阶段互补。
AI.conclusion: Dyad 通过显式分离语言推理与类型化决策，将决策分解为状态表示与独立编码的环境条件化动作表示，使同一预训练 LLM 状态既能支持自回归语言生成，也能直接对动态提供的类型化动作做决策。该设计为通用智能体提供了可复用的决策接口，无需将动作映射到词汇表。实验证明 Dyad 在多种环境与模型规模上均提升了智能体性能，且能更好地保持通用知识、推理与编程能力，同时支持冻结 LLM 的模块化适应，是构建能在多样化、未知环境中推理与行动的通用智能体的有前景基础。

title: Why Backdooring Neural Networks is so Easy?
summary: Securing modern AI systems against backdoor attacks remains an open challenge and requires fundamentally principled estimates of the adversary's budget -- the poison fraction $\pi$ and trigger strength $\alpha$ needed to construct successful yet stealthy attacks. Motivated by recent empirical evidence that poisoning large language models can require a nearly constant number of malicious samples even as clean datasets grow, we derive an exact closed-form analysis of a quadratic neuron trained on a poisoned Gaussian mixture. We show, perhaps counterintuitively, that the same feature-learning dynamics that make neural networks powerful can also make them more vulnerable to backdoors. Specifically, with clean accuracy preserved to first order, $O(\pi)$, we demonstrate that lazy learning imposes the inverse-square-root scaling $\alpha \propto \pi^{-1/2}$ for a successful attack, while feature learning induces a quadratic detector whose loss margin scales as $O(\alpha^4)$, improving the attack budget to $\alpha \propto \pi^{-1/4}$. Consequently, nonlinear feature learning substantially reduces the trigger strength required at small poison fractions, thereby in a sense making feature learners more backdoor vulnerable. These results provide a theoretical mechanism consistent with large-scale empirical observations and demonstrate that security audits based on linear heuristics can systematically underestimate backdoor vulnerability in the widely adopted feature-learning regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个可解的二次神经元模型，从理论上解释了为何现代神经网络的特征学习机制使其更易遭受后门攻击。核心发现是：懒惰学习（线性/核方法）下，触发强度需随投毒比例呈 α∝π^{-1/2} 缩放；而在特征学习下，模型自发形成二次触发检测器，使预算曲线变为更平缓的 α∝π^{-1/4}，且干净精度保持不变。该结论在高斯混合数据及MNIST/Fashion-MNIST/CIFAR-10等真实数据集上得到验证。
AI.motivation: 现有后门攻击预算估计主要基于懒惰学习器（如线性/核方法），假设触发强度需随投毒比例按 α∝π^{-1/2} 缩放。然而大规模实证（如Souly等人2025年对大语言模型的研究）表明，攻击所需恶意样本数近乎与语料规模无关。本文旨在探究：特征学习机制是否改变了这一预算关系，并给出可解释该现象的理论机制。
AI.method: 构建最小可解模型：二次神经元 f(x)=w⊤x+β/2 (u⊤x)²+c，通过最小二乘在高斯混合数据上训练，其中投毒比例为 π、触发强度为 α。对比两种训练机制——线性（β≡0，对应懒惰学习）与特征学习（u 适应数据，特别是 u*=Σ⁻¹v/√(v⊤Σ⁻¹v)）。利用白化变换将问题归约为五维不变量 (S, T, ρ, g, h)，通过求解法方程获得闭式表达，并推导小投毒极限（π→0, α→∞）下的隐身攻击成功率与预算曲线。
AI.result: 1. 线性机制下：触发能量 e=πα²T² 控制 ASR，预算曲线为 α∝π^{-1/2}（定理2）。 2. 特征学习机制下：触发诱导曲率 β∝πA²，导致二次触发检测器，边缘贡献 ∝α⁴，守恒量变为 ϱ=πα⁴T⁴，预算曲线变为 α∝π⁻¹ᐟ⁴（定理3）。 3. 两种机制共享相同的 ASR 上限 Φ((1+S²)/S) 与隐身性（CACC 至 O(π²) 不受影响），仅缩放指数不同。 4. 在 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10 上拟合斜率 k≈−1/4（特征学习）与 k≈−1/2（懒惰），与理论一致；相同投毒比例下特征学习所需触发强度按 π⁻¹ᐟ⁴ 缩减。 5. 部分学习特征下存在线性通道（α∝π⁻¹ᐟ²）与特征学习通道（α∝π⁻¹ᐟ⁴）的交叉，交叉点为 h≈Tπ¹ᐟ⁴。
AI.conclusion: 特征学习动力学在使神经网络强大的同时，也使其更易遭受后门攻击：投毒会"开启"一个二次检测器，将成本指数从 1/2 减半至 1/4，而不抬高攻击上限、不损害干净精度。这一机制为大语言模型中毒数据投毒数与语料规模无关的经验观察提供了理论解释，并表明基于懒惰模型的安全审计会系统性低估特征学习模型的真实漏洞——低估因子随 π⁻¹ᐟ⁴ 增长。

title: Learning Continuous Patient Trajectories from Electronic Health Records
summary: Electronic health records provide irregular observations of latent patient states that evolve continuously over time. Recent autoregressive models condition on clinical histories to forecast future events as sequences of discrete observations. Conversely, multi-marginal flow matching provides a continuous-time formulation, but using multiple observations to supervise training paths does not itself give the learned dynamics access to preceding patient history. We introduce EHRFlow, a multi-marginal flow-matching framework that conditions on encoded patient history, thereby allowing future dynamics to depend on the patient's prior clinical trajectory. Our proposed framework accommodates irregular observation times and supports forecasting at arbitrary horizons. Across controlled synthetic benchmarks, EHRFlow improves clinical-code forecasting and latent-state recovery. On real-world clinical datasets comprising more than one million patients, including an independent external validation cohort, EHRFlow improves horizon-averaged top-5 clinical-code accuracy over autoregressive and history-independent flow-matching baselines. Finally, in a controlled counterfactual simulation, conditional guidance approximates the known effect of an antihypertensive intervention without training a task-specific outcome model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EHRFlow，一个基于多边际流匹配（multi-marginal flow matching）的框架，用于从电子健康记录（EHR）中对连续患者轨迹进行建模与预测。该方法的核心创新在于将学习的向量场（vector field）显式地条件化于患者的完整历史编码，而非仅依赖当前状态。EHRFlow支持不规则采样时间观测和任意预测时间范围，并通过将多观测值整合到训练路径中提升了对潜在连续患者状态的刻画能力。在涵盖超过100万患者的合成基准测试、Synthea模拟数据以及真实临床数据集（包括用于外部验证的CPRD Gold队列）上，EHRFlow在临床代码预测和潜在状态恢复方面均优于自回归基线和历史无关的流匹配基线。此外，在受控的反事实模拟中，条件引导能够逼近抗高血压干预的已知效应，验证了模型在干预条件化预测方面的潜力。
AI.motivation: 电子健康记录（EHR）仅提供对潜在连续患者状态的稀疏、不规则的部分观测。现有自回归模型以离散事件序列预测未来，但无法刻画观测间的连续状态演化；多边际流匹配虽能利用多个观测进行连续时间建模，但训练路径中并未让学习到的动力学获取患者历史信息。临床决策需要考虑患者既往疾病进程、治疗暴露和进展速度，因此有必要开发能够融合历史信息的连续轨迹预测模型。
AI.method: EHRFlow将多边际流匹配扩展为历史条件化框架：(1) 使用变分自编码器学习每次访问的潜在表示；(2) 使用GRU历史编码器将锚点之前K=32个日状态编码为定长历史向量h_a；(3) 训练期间冻结编码器，通过多个观测构造概率路径并回归条件速度目标，将向量场参数化为v_θ(z_s, s, λ, h_a)，其中λ=log(1+Δ)处理不规则时间间隔；(4) 联合训练向量场与解码器，利用单步端点近似提供观测空间监督，无需数值积分；(5) 推理时从锚点潜在状态积分ODE至任意预测时间范围。理论分析证明历史条件化不会增加最优流匹配损失，且在线性高斯示例中可严格降低个体预测误差。模型支持GP-CFM（高斯过程插值）和MMFM（自然三次样条插值）两种变体。
AI.result: 在五个控制合成数据集（Anthracycline、RA on DMARD、CKD、RRMS、心力衰竭）和Synthea上，EHRFlow在跨预测时间范围平均的Top-5临床代码准确率上显著优于自回归和历史无关流匹配基线（q<10⁻⁵）。在CPRD数据集（含外部Gold验证队列）上，EHRFlow(GP-CFM)较历史无关对应基线提升8.4个百分点；在AMC-EHR上提升0.8-2.3个百分点。EHRFlow在潜在状态恢复误差上也最低。在受控抗高血压干预模拟中，条件引导恢复的血压效应误差仅为0.07-2.07 mmHg（相对误差0.3%-10.1%）。消融实验表明：(1) 参数量匹配后性能基本不变，说明增益来自历史信息而非容量；(2) 零上下文回退至历史无关性能；(3) 预训练+冻结的历史编码器优于联合训练；(4) 端到端联合训练降低了性能。
AI.conclusion: EHRFlow成功地将历史条件化与多边际流匹配相结合，实现了对不规则采样的纵向EHR数据的连续潜在状态预测。该方法在大规模真实临床数据上展现了一致的性能优势，证明了结合连续潜在动力学与历史上下文对个体患者预测的价值。轨迹自洽性高（直接与嵌套预测Top-5重叠率93%以上），且插值族选择对性能影响较小。受控反事实实验表明该模型有潜力支持"数字孪生"类应用，但作者强调目前仍需更广泛的外部验证、不确定性评估和前瞻性临床评估方可应用于实际医疗。

title: Fair Policy Optimization in Major-Minor Weakly Coupled Markov Decision Processes
summary: We consider fair resource allocation in sequential decision-making environments modeled as major-minor weakly coupled Markov decision processes (M2WCMDP). In this framework, resource constraints couple the action spaces of a major sub-Markov decision process (sub-MDP) and a population of minor sub-MDPs that would otherwise operate independently. Instead of using the traditional utilitarian (total-sum) objective, we optimize a general class of monotone, concave, permutation-invariant, normalized fairness functions. With homogeneous minor sub-MDPs, we prove that the problem under symmetry reduces to optimizing the platform-plus-mean-participant utilitarian objective over the class of \textit{permutation-invariant} policies, which allows us to exploit efficient algorithms that optimize the utilitarian-based objective to solve this fairness-aware problem. For more general settings, we introduce a count-proportion-based deep reinforcement learning approach with a priority-based sampler that generates feasible count actions. The generality of our framework means that the proposed algorithms and theoretical guarantees transfer to any domain with a symmetric M2WCMDP structure. We consider two applications: the machine replacement problem and the joint control of pricing and taxi relocation problem on a New York City-calibrated dataset. We validate our theoretical findings with comprehensive experiments, confirming the effectiveness of our proposed method in achieving strong fairness-aware performance while remaining scalable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于主-次弱耦合MDP（M2WCMDP）的公平策略优化框架，旨在解决顺序决策环境中的公平资源分配问题。核心贡献包括：在对称条件下证明公平优化问题可简化为基于均值的功利优化（理论保证），并提出基于计数比例的深度强化学习方法（CP-DRL）以实现可扩展求解。在机器替换和纽约市出租车调度两个应用上进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 传统的功利性（总和）目标在多方利益相关者系统中可能导致资源或机会的不公平分配（如司机收入不均、设备维护偏向等）。现有WCMDP框架无法同时建模系统级内生动态与公平性约束，且基于分解或流体近似的经典方法在引入公平目标后不再适用。需要一种新的框架来同时处理：1)系统级协调决策（如定价）；2)参与者级公平；3)可扩展求解。
AI.method: 1. **M2WCMDP框架**：定义了一个主子MDP（平台）和N个次子MDP（参与者），主次子MDP之间通过共享资源约束耦合，主子MDP可进行内生系统级决策（如定价）。2. **公平测度类（ρ-fairness）**：定义满足单调性、凹性、置换不变性、常向量不变性的社会福利函数类，包括广义Gini函数和α-fairness的确定性等价表示。3. **功利归约定理**：在同构次子MDP条件下，证明最优公平策略等价于在置换不变策略类上的功利优化（V⁰₀+λ·V̄₀）。4. **计数聚合MDP**：利用对称性将状态和动作表示为计数形式，消除参与者标签。5. **CP-DRL算法**：使用计数比例状态表示和随机策略网络，引入基于优先级的采样程序保证可行动作生成，并使用置换不变分解规则确保个体级公平执行。
AI.result: 1. **机器替换问题**：CP-DRL在GGF得分上接近最优解（如指数RCCC中N=2时CP-DRL得14.12 vs OPT 14.19），优于Whittle指数策略和多种启发式方法。多任务训练变体CP-DRL(MT)表现稳定。2. **纽约市出租车调度**（15区配置）：在60-300辆出租车范围内，CP-DRL的公平感知目标值比最佳基线CP-ALP高18.9%-25.7%，同时保持更高的车辆占用率和订单接受率。在车队规模增大时，CP-DRL降低平均价格乘数（从3.04降至1.38）。计算时间仅为2.9-6.7毫秒，远低于CP-ALP的26-28毫秒。3. **公平执行**：置换不变分解相比低索引优先的偏倚分解在GGF上产生显著差距，证明个体级执行公平性的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 成功建立了公平感知的主-次弱耦合MDP框架，通过对称性条件下的功利归约实现了计算简化，并开发了可扩展的CP-DRL方法。理论保证和实验结果表明：1）所提框架在保持公平性的同时实现高效的系统级协调；2）协调的定价与调度策略显著优于单纯的分配启发式；3）置换不变的个体级执行是实现公平目标的关键。但仍存在两个开放方向：1）当前优先级采样器是顺序执行的，需设计更高效的可行性保持采样器；2）完全对称性假设可扩展到有限类型的异质参与者群体。

title: EvoMO-SR: Multiobjective LLM-based Evolution of Symbolic Expressions with substructure guidance
summary: Symbolic Regression (SR) is a data-driven method for scientific discovery which searches for interpretable analytical relationships within data. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have also had a significant impact on scientific discovery, enabling the automation of various stages of the process. For these reasons, the possibility of harnessing the embedded scientific knowledge and programming capabilities of LLMs to solve SR tasks has emerged, showing promising performance compared with traditional methods. We propose EvoMO-SR, a novel LLM-driven SR framework in which the LLM generates equation skeletons, with their coefficients fitted separately by an external optimizer. The framework includes a multi-objective survival selection which controls bloating by balancing accuracy and complexity, and a substructure guidance mechanism which mutates expressions with candidate reusable building blocks. EvoMO-SR achieves the best accuracy in seven of the eight in-domain and out-of-domain settings for LSR-Synth, using a small LLM model, i.e., Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. We also evaluated structural recovery through two symbolic accuracy metrics based on canonicalized subtree overlap and term matching, showing that our method has a greater probability of recovering highly accurate symbolic structures.

AI.tldr: EvoMO-SR是一个基于LLM的符号回归框架，采用显式的种群进化循环，由LLM生成方程骨架（Python代码），外部L-BFGS-B优化器拟合系数。其核心创新在于：(1) 基于非支配排序与拥挤距离的多目标生存选择机制（平衡NMSE准确率与AST节点复杂度），以抑制膨胀问题；(2) 子结构引导机制，从亲代-子代差异中动态提取可复用的加性子结构存入固定容量档案（容量10），并以概率p_sub=0.5注入变异提示。在LSR-Synth基准（129题，覆盖物理/化学/生物/材料科学）上，使用小模型Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct即在8个域-划分对比中的7个取得最低聚合NMSE（含全部4个OOD划分），OOD改进倍数达14~2400倍。在oscillator1/oscillator数据集上亦优于LLM-SR和LaSR。同时提出两个结构准确性度量（SA_AST基于AST子树Jaccard，SA_Term基于归一化加性项Jaccard），表明EvoMO-SR在阈值τ≥0.35时有更高概率恢复高度精确的符号结构。消融实验证实子结构引导对较大模型增益更显著。
AI.motivation: 1. 传统GP符号回归方法存在膨胀问题与结构搜索效率瓶颈；2. LLM虽蕴含丰富科学知识与编程能力用于SR，但现有LLM-SR等方法缺乏显式的种群进化与亲代-子代生存选择机制；3. 需要缓解LLM对已知科学公式的记忆问题，公平评估真实数据驱动的SR能力；4. 现有方法对数值准确率与符号结构恢复能力的区分不足，缺乏结构相似性的确定性度量。
AI.method: 方法学：EvoMO-SR框架包含三大组件——(1) 提示构建：角色+任务+科学上下文（含变量物理含义）+输出格式；(2) 初始化种群：LLM生成M=10个方程骨架，L-BFGS-B拟合系数；(3) 进化循环（100代，每代N=10个后代）：随机有放回选择父代→随机选择变异提示（精炼或重提）→LLM生成后代→拟合评估→基于非支配排序+拥挤距离的多目标生存选择（elitism=True，融合父子代）→扫描亲代-子代差异提取新增加性子结构→按NMSE竞争更新固定容量子结构档案→以p_sub=0.5概率将随机子结构注入变异提示实现引导。评估指标：NMSE（ID/OOD）、两个符号准确性度量（SA_AST：AST子树Jaccard；SA_Term：归一化加性项Jaccard，经SymPy规范化、常数替换为占位符等）。
AI.result: 1. LSR-Synth基准（5次运行均值）：EvoMO-SR在7/8个域-划分对比中取得最低聚合NMSE，仅物理ID略逊于LLM-SR；OOD相对改进14~2400倍。Wilcoxon检验（Holm校正）在化学/生物/材料领域ID与OOD均p<0.05。2. oscillator1/2（20次运行）：EvoMO-SR NMSE ID/OOD均最低，但与LLM-SR差异未达统计显著；SA_Term在oscillator2上显著优于LLM-SR（p=0.001）。3. 符号准确性：高阈值（τ≥0.35）下EvoMO-SR恢复高度精确结构概率更高，但整体SA值仍偏低。4. 随机函数生成基准（4个数据集P1-P4）：EvoMO-SR一致优于LLM-SR，P1达SA_Term=1.0。5. 消融：子结构引导对DeepSeek-v4-Flash和GPT-5.4-nano等较大模型增益更显著；多目标选择有效降低表达式复杂度。6. 计算成本：EvoMO-SR比LLM-SR快约5.5倍，输出token约为其1/3.4。
AI.conclusion: EvoMO-SR通过将LLM嵌入显式种群进化循环并引入多目标生存选择与子结构引导机制，在使用小型LLM（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）的条件下即在LSR-Synth基准的多数域-划分对比中超越LLM-SR、LaSR及GP基线（pySR、GPGomea、Operon、uDSR）。研究表明数值准确率提升不等同于符号结构恢复能力的提升，EvoMO-SR在高阈值下恢复正确结构的概率更高。主要局限：符号准确率普遍偏低；子结构档案仅以关联NMSE排序，未隔离子结构独立贡献。未来工作将探索更精细的档案管理（如基于信息性评分）与子结构贡献评估。

title: Physical Cross-Modal Masked Autoencoding for Seismic-to-Well Representation Learning
summary: Learning from scientific measurements often requires aligning modalities with different spatial support and resolution. Subsurface characterization is an extreme dense-sparse problem in which 3D seismic provides volumetric but indirect measurements and well logs provide high-resolution 1D measurements at sparse borehole locations. We introduce a physically grounded cross-modal masked autoencoder (CM-MAE) for seismic-to-well representation learning. The model jointly tokenizes seismic volumes and well-log depth patches, embeds both modalities in continuous physical coordinates using four-axis rotary position embeddings, and reconstructs masked targets with a cross-modal decoder. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts layers provide modality-specific capacity while dense attention allows information exchange between modalities. Pretraining uses 23 seismic volumes covering approximately 178,000 square km across U.S. offshore and onshore basins, together with approximately 92,000 wells. Matched-mask ablations show strongly asymmetric information flow. Seismic context improves held-out well-log reconstruction by 9.73%, while well-log context improves seismic reconstruction by 0.65%. We evaluate seismic-only pseudo-log predictions against independent interpreter-drawn salt-geobody masks to determine whether they contain geologic signal. Across offshore U.S. surveys, compressional-slowness-derived salt scores reach an AUROC of 0.910. In onshore basins, predicted compressional slowness preserves formation-scale structure and partial relative organization in an unseen survey despite calibration drift. CM-MAE learns useful seismic-to-well representations under extreme modality asymmetry, although absolute pseudo-log calibration remains survey-dependent.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种物理驱动的跨模态掩码自编码器CM-MAE，用于地震到井的表示学习，通过4D RoPE将3D地震体与稀疏1D井曲线嵌入共享物理坐标空间，并利用CrossMAE解码器和稀疏MoE层实现模态间的信息交换和专业化容量。
AI.motivation: 地下表征面临典型的密集-稀疏跨模态学习问题：3D地震提供密集但间接的体积测量，而井曲线仅在稀疏的1D钻孔位置提供高分辨率直接测量。两种模态在网格、分辨率、空间覆盖和深度配准上均不匹配，标准多模态方法难以适用，需要一个共享物理坐标框架来让模型学习残余对应关系。
AI.method: （1）联合分词：将128×128×2048的3D地震体和48000×7的井曲线分块并通过卷积投影生成token。（2）4D RoPE：为每个token分配(x,y,z,c)四维物理坐标，3D空间轴用标准几何频率方案，通道轴使用线性频率方案。（3）32层共享编码器+MoE（最后4层K=8，top-2路由）+6层解码器（K=4），解码器采用CrossMAE结构，掩码query仅与可见token交叉注意。（4）训练目标：MSE（地震）+方差缩放Huber（井）+负载均衡辅助损失+路由器z-loss；90%地震掩码率、75%井掩码率；随机模态dropout（地震10%、井15%）；AdamW+Warmup-Stable-Decay调度，在8×H200 GPU上训练70万步。
AI.result: 匹配掩码消融显示强烈非对称信息流：地震上下文将井重建误差提高9.73%，而井上下文仅将地震重建提高0.65%（约15倍不对称）。MoE路由分析显示解码器早期层模态分离（KL散度89%），解码器专家合并后DT/RHOB率降至接近零。在无盐标签暴露的地震伪测井测试中，DT盐体AUROC在密集覆盖的海上勘测中达0.910，OOD勘测仍达0.69。陆上Sanderson验证DT KS为0.204（r=0.740），未见Pontiac勘测KS为0.432但层间Pearson相关为正。
AI.conclusion: CM-MAE在极端模态不对称条件下学习到了有用的地震到井表示。三大关键设计（共享4D物理RoPE、CrossMAE非对称重建、稀疏MoE模态专业化）共同起作用。局限性包括未见勘测的校准漂移、盐探针范围有限、零样本评估模式以及仅基于美国盆地数据的语料。

title: On the spectral properties of generative denoiser Jacobians
summary: Generative denoising models, such as diffusion and flow-matching, learn to sample from complex distributions by training a deep neural network denoiser to recover clean data from noise-corrupted samples. While such models are typically compared on the quality of their synthesized samples, these metrics provide limited insight into how the underlying denoiser, which drives generation, differs. In this work, we propose to analyze the spectrum of the denoiser Jacobian as a tool to characterize these differences. Across pre-trained denoising models, we observe that better generative performance is associated with larger Jacobian eigenvalues. Motivated by this, we introduce a regularization scheme that controls the Jacobian spectrum by training the denoiser on perturbed inputs, with perturbations suppressing or amplifying Jacobian responses. On ImageNet, we test whether directly modifying the Jacobian spectral properties leads to improved generations. Our findings suggest that denoisers benefit from both strengthening responses along data-relevant principal eigen-directions and suppressing the noisy, data-irrelevant ones. This establishes the denoiser Jacobian as a useful tool for identifying differences between generative denoising models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将去噪器（diffusion/flow-matching）的Jacobian矩阵谱作为分析生成式去噪模型差异的工具。核心发现是：生成性能更好的模型具有更大的Jacobian特征值。基于此，提出通过在训练时扰动输入来控制Jacobian谱的正则化方案，在ImageNet上验证了增强数据相关主特征方向并抑制噪声无关方向可提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成模型评估主要依赖FID等样本质量指标，这些指标只能反映输出的差异，无法解释为何某个去噪器生成质量更好。因此需要一个能够揭示去噪函数本身内部差异的分析工具。
AI.method: 1）提出同时迭代（simultaneous iteration）算法计算去噪器Jacobian的前n个特征向量/值，结合有限差分近似加速Jacobian-向量积计算；2）在预训练SiT模型（SiT-S、SiT-XL、SiT-XL+REPA）上分析Jacobian谱与生成性能的关系；3）提出基于输入扰动的Jacobian正则化方案，包括随机扰动（抑制Frobenius范数）和残差扰动（沿数据相关特征方向增强响应），通过Rayleigh商自适应调整扰动步长δ，并采用top-5%像素掩码来平衡梯度强度；4）在2D高斯混合和ImageNet上进行验证。
AI.result: 1）预训练模型分析：SiT-S < SiT-XL < SiT-XL+REPA的生成性能排序与Jacobian特征值大小排序一致，去噪误差则无法区分模型；2）ImageNet（SiT-S，50k样本，无CFG，250步）：基线FID 59.81；残差正则化（1/δ=5）FID降至54.43；随机正则化（τ=0.1）FID降至56.12；二者组合最佳FID为52.43；3）残差正则化通过增强主特征方向响应提升质量，随机正则化通过抑制数据无关方向提升质量，二者互补可叠加；4）方法在不同架构（SiT-B、UNet）和规模上均有效，残差正则化模型FID均改善约5点。
AI.conclusion: 去噪器的Jacobian谱是揭示生成式去噪模型差异的有效工具。生成质量与Jacobian主特征值正相关，且通过训练时的输入扰动可以主动控制谱特性，从而改善生成性能。Jacobian正则化为理解现有正则化方法（如REPA）提供了原则性的视角，并为设计新的训练目标提供了方向。

title: EnergyEminence: Source-Aware Environmental Calibration and Evaluation in a Physics-Grounded Grid Digital Twin
summary: Power-grid digital twins must combine data-driven prediction with physically meaningful state evolution while preserving the provenance of environmental observations. This paper presents an early-stage EnergyEminence testbed that couples an IEEE 118-bus-style graph-temporal predictor, nonlinear AC cascade simulation, and operator-dashboard-like temporal replay. In addition, we introduce a shared bounded calibration that converts wildfire-detection confidence and spatial extent into source-comparable wildfire interpretable and explainable evidence. We then evaluate it with visually diverse fire and hard-negative videos. Sixteen synthetic environmental videos are curated to generate 160 source-tracked grid scenarios, and a source-video-disjoint test yields 10 true positives, 8 false positives, 22 true negatives, and no false negatives. The errors occur in stressed, non-cascading scenarios conditioned on an unseen growing-fire source. Our diagnostic then reveals environmental shortcut learning that is obscured by scenario-level random splitting. The paper therefore contributes a data-centric and inspectable evaluation workflow for multimodal grid-resilience models, together with evidence supporting separation of environmental alerting from electrical cascade inference

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了EnergyEminence——一个用于电网数字孪生的早期测试平台，融合图时序GNN预测器、非线性AC功放优级联仿真和环境感知，并提出源感知(source-aware)的环境校准与评估方法，揭示了场景级随机划分会掩盖的"增长火源"捷径学习(shortcut learning)问题。
AI.motivation: 电网数字孪生需要同时支持数据驱动预测与物理一致的状态演化，并保留环境观测的来源溯源(provenance)。现有方法将环境观测（如烟雾/火焰）等同于电气不稳定状态，且当合成电网场景由少量视频语料重复生成时，源特定的视觉模式会跨数据划分泄漏，损害泛化能力。本文旨在探索这些问题，旨在从场景识别转向跨未见过环境源的迁移能力评估。
AI.method: 1) 双路径推理：学习路径 f_θ（图注意力+LSTM）输出节点失效概率、失效时间和风险因子；物理路径 Φ_AC 执行非线性AC潮流级联仿真，两者共享状态 S_t=(G, X_V(t), X_E(t), s_t, F_t)。2) 源可比的边界校准：将YOLOv8n检测器的置信度 p_{t,b} 和相对包围框面积通过 q_{t,b}=w·p·(A/A_frame)^α、e_t=max(q)+β·Σ(q)、s_t=1-exp(-γ·e_t) 映射为有界共享证据，移除逐视频min-max归一化的人为单位最大伪影。3) 通过空间衰减 r_{v,t}=s_t·exp(-||p_v-p_f||_2/20) 将证据传播到电网节点。4) 16个合成视频（6类：无火、硬负例、小火、增长火、大火、夜间火），每源10条轨迹共160场景，采用源视频不重叠(8/4/4)分组划分，835,961可训练参数，CPU 3 epoch。
AI.result: 校准审计：共享映射下无火序列保持为0，夜间火与野火最大值分别为0.858和0.814（不再是强制为1），证实去除单位最大伪影。源不重叠测试：40场景中10 TP、8 FP、22 TN、0 FN；精度0.556、召回率1.000、F1=0.714、平衡准确率0.867；8个FP集中于一个未见的"增长火"源在应力而非级联条件下——揭示了被场景级随机划分隐藏的捷径学习失败模式。所有基于未见过夜间火源的级联案例均被检出，未见过的无火与工业蒸汽被正确拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 贡献包括：(1) 源可比的边界环境证据校准；(2) 数据中心、可检查的多模态电网韧性模型评估流程；(3) 证据支持将环境告警与电气级联推理解耦。结论强调环境灾害证据不应作为级联真值直接使用，环境告警与仅基于电网的GNN/LSTM推理应在数字孪生决策层独立可测后汇聚。局限：合成视频、单一IEEE 118母线拓扑、有限源集；不建立因果野火→级联预测。

title: Preconditioned Physics-Informed Neural Operator Training
summary: Neural operators are typically trained in a supervised fashion, which requires a dataset to be generated with a classical solver. Training them physics-informed, i.e., purely from the governing equations, removes this large offline cost and allows fresh samples to be drawn at every optimization step, but has so far been limited to simplified problems and trails supervised training in accuracy. The obstacle is the ill-conditioning of physics-informed losses, which differential operators induce and which worsens as the discretization is refined. We therefore propose a preconditioned residual loss function and show mesh-independent conditioning for elliptic problems and greatly improved conditioning for saddle point problems. Realized through geometric and algebraic multigrid, the construction applies to linear and nonlinear equations, steady or time-dependent, on structured and unstructured meshes, is agnostic to the neural operator architecture, and adds no cost at inference. On the Poisson, Allen-Cahn and stationary Stokes equations, the resulting label-free training matches supervised training and is four to twenty-five times more accurate than previous physics-informed operator learning methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种预条件物理约束神经operator学习方法，通过在损失函数中引入多重网格预条件器，将偏微分方程算子引起的病态条件数从 O(h^{-4}) 降至 O(1)（椭圆问题）或 O(h^{-2})（鞍点问题），在 Poisson、Allen-Cahn 和 Stokes 方程上实现了无需标注数据的训练，匹配甚至超越监督训练精度。
AI.motivation: 传统神经operator依赖监督训练，需要离线生成大量标注数据，成本高昂。物理约束训练可消除此瓶颈，但因微分算子放大高频分量导致损失函数病态（条件数随网格细化以 O(h^{-4}) 增长），使优化困难，精度远逊于监督训练。
AI.method: 提出预条件最小二乘损失 L_PLS = ½‖P(Au−f)‖²_B，其中 P 为多重网格（几何/代数）构造的近似逆预条件器，A 为离散PDE算子。该方法：(1) 改变损失景观但保持极小值不变；(2) 对椭圆问题实现网格无关条件数；(3) 通过块对角预条件器处理鞍点问题；(4) 架构无关，推理时无额外开销；(5) 可扩展至非线性问题（用近似逆Jacobian）和时间依赖问题。
AI.result: 在三个PDE问题上：(1) Poisson（结构网格+FNO）：L_PLS 达5.1%，匹配监督训练4.7%，远超PINO（33.1%）和PI-DeepONet（21.4%）；(2) Allen-Cahn时间步进（结构网格+FNO）：L_PLS 达3.2%，略逊于监督训练2.0%，优于PINO（5.3%）；(3) Stokes（无结构网格+GAOT）：L_PLS 速度误差1.6%、压力误差0.85%，超越监督训练（3.3%/1.79%），PI-DeepONet则失败（39.7%/36.7%）。无条件数预条件残差损失在Stokes上停滞于30.6%速度误差。预条件化使Hessian条件数从1.2×10^{11}降至~10^6。每epoch训练开销增加不足10%至约三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 经典数值预条件技术可有效缓解物理约束算子学习中的病态问题，使无标签训练首次在精度上匹配监督训练。该方法架构无关、推理无开销，适用于线性和非线性、定常与时间依赖问题，以及结构与非结构网格。主要局限在于依赖高效预条件器的存在，对流主导或高频波问题预条件器构造困难，是未来研究方向。代码已开源。

title: How Language Models Differ in Redistributing Attention-Head Activity Under Serial Demand
summary: The way a model distributes activity over each layer's attention heads offers a coarse view of how it routes information through depth; how this changes with the task is part of what a mechanistic account must explain. Holding prompt length fixed, we vary how many serial steps a task demands and measure, in every layer of 17 open-weight models, whether activity concentrates on a few heads or spreads across many as demand rises. Both occur: in most models, layers just before mid-depth concentrate activity and later layers spread it. Models differ in where and how strongly this happens. The Qwen2.5 base models from 0.5B to 7B, for example, spread less than the average model in every task and concentrate activity in parts of their second half, where Llama models from 1B to 8B and OLMo-2 spread; the contrast largely holds between Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen2.5-72B, which have the same number of layers and heads. These differences are reproducible, and post-trained models keep much of their base model's pattern. An ablation study suggests that, within a task, models whose activity is more concentrated on their top heads also depend more on those heads for the answer. Concentration and spreading across layers thus offer a new way to compare models, by how they route information through depth. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文研究了17个不同语言模型在需要多步串行推理的任务中，如何重新分配各层注意力头的活动。研究发现模型在深度上展现出两种模式：集中（少数头部承担更多活动）和分散（活动更均匀地分布）。不同模型家族（特别是Llama与Qwen2.5）在这些模式上存在可复现的显著差异，后训练模型倾向于保留其基础模型的模式。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性研究大多基于单一模型和任务，缺乏跨模型普遍性的检验；同时，关于固定深度Transformer如何在单次前向传播中处理需要多个串行步骤的任务（如指针追踪、链式推理），其内部注意力头活动的重新分配机制尚未被系统理解。本文旨在填补模型间比较的空白，探究不同模型在处理递增串行需求时如何路由信息。
AI.method: 提出"集中度"度量（S^(0.1)）：每层最强10%注意力头所占输出范数的份额；构造四个串行任务家族（指针追踪、模运算、变量绑定、关系查找），保持提示长度恒定，改变步骤数k；在17个开源模型（包括Llama、Qwen2.5、OLMo-2、Mistral系列）的回答位置读取每头活动；使用标准化回归斜率z_ℓ衡量每层活动随k的变化；通过方差分解分离模型签名、任务效应和交互效应；通过头部消融实验验证功能相关性；在新鲜项目上进行复制验证。
AI.result: 1) 共同趋势：中深度之后的层倾向于分散活动（均值z为负），中深度前的层倾向于集中；2) 显著差异：Qwen2.5（≤7B）后半数层几乎不分散活动，Llama与OLMo-2则显著分散；在Llama-3.1-70B与Qwen2.5-72B（层数和头数完全匹配）上对比依然成立；3) 模型签名具有可复现性（r=0.80）和部分跨任务一致性（r=0.36）；4) 后训练模型保留大部分基础模型的签名模式（r=0.64）并倾向于更分散；5) 消融实验显示，活动更集中的模型更依赖其最活跃的头部（Spearman ρ=0.59，p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型在如何随串行需求重新分配注意力头活动方面存在可复现的差异，体现在分散发生的位置、是否在中深度前出现集中带以及跨任务一致性等方面。每种模型的部分模式会跨任务重现（但跨任务类型时较弱），后训练模型保留其基础模型的大部分模式。在这些差异之下，大多数模型在中深度后会分散活动，且后训练模型倾向于比其基础模型更分散。集中度与分散度为跨模型比较提供了新维度，对电路分析和机制可解释性具有重要启示。

title: BASE: Batch-Aware Selection of Experts Using Predicted Removal Error for Efficient MoE Decoding
summary: Large language models are increasingly expensive to serve. In large-scale serving systems, autoregressive decoding is often bottlenecked by transferring model weights from accelerator high-bandwidth memory into on-chip SRAM. Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models reduce computation by activating only a small subset of experts per token, but this sparsity does not translate directly to batched decoding. Different requests select different experts; therefore, the combined active set across many concurrent requests can span a substantial fraction of the expert pool and require significantly more expert weights to be transferred. Most expert-reduction techniques make retention decisions independently for each token and therefore do not address this batch-level expansion. More recently, batch-aware methods have attempted to coordinate expert use across concurrent requests and reuse experts already fetched for the batch. Yet their selection criteria are based primarily on router rankings or expert statistics collected during calibration. Consequently, these criteria are not directly tied to the output error caused by dropping an expert, nor do they capture how an expert's contribution changes across tokens at inference time. We instead rank experts according to how much their removal would change the MoE-layer output. To apply this criterion during serving, we train a lightweight linear predictor during calibration that estimates the expert removal cost for each incoming token, and develop custom GPU kernels for cost prediction and expert selection. Across three MoE architectures, BASE improves the quality-efficiency tradeoff without retraining. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, it improves average accuracy by 29.5 points over the strongest baseline at comparable throughput under a tight expert budget. At a higher expert budget, it is 60% faster than dense inference while remaining within 0.4 accuracy points.

AI.tldr: BASE 是一种用于高效 MoE 批解码的批次感知专家选择方法。它通过校准阶段训练的轻量级线性预测器估计每个专家的"移除代价"（即移除该专家对 MoE 层输出造成的误差），在固定批次级专家预算下选择移除代价最大的 M 个专家加载，从而在内存受限的解码阶段减少从高带宽内存传输的专家权重数量。无需重新训练模型即可显著改善质量-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型虽然每个 token 只激活少量专家，但在批解码场景下，不同请求选择的专家不同，合并后的活跃专家集合可能覆盖专家池的很大比例，导致需要传输大量专家权重，成为内存带宽瓶颈。现有的批次感知方法基于路由排名或校准期统计量选择专家，与移除专家造成的输出误差无直接关联，也无法捕捉专家贡献在推理时的 token 间变化。
AI.method: 将批次专家选择问题形式化为在固定专家预算下最小化 MoE 层输出变化。证明丢弃专家间的交叉项对所选专家集影响很小，从而可将问题简化为独立对专家按"个体移除代价"排序。由于移除代价需要执行专家才能计算，BASE 在校准阶段为每个专家训练一个轻量级线性预测器（基于归一化隐藏状态预测输出能量的对数），在线推理时预测当前 token 的专家输出能量，结合路由权重平方聚合得到批次级移除代价分数，选择 top-M 专家。对于路由中被省略的专家，使用"回填"策略（即用 token 的下一个偏好专家替换）。实现方面，使用自定义 Triton GPU 内核融合评分、选择和回填操作，减少 PyTorch 调用开销。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B、Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B 和 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 三种 MoE 架构、8 个基准测试上评估。在受限专家预算下，BASE 在所有架构上均取得最高平均质量和吞吐量；Qwen3-30B-A3B 上平均准确率比最强基线（Lynx）高 29.5 个百分点。在宽松预算下，比密集推理快 60%，准确率差距在 0.4 点以内；最严格设置下快 73%，损失 6.1 点。消融实验表明：1）线性预测器将保留能量从 90.98%（平方路由权重）提升至 96.47%，接近 oracle 的 73.58% 准确率；2）回填优于替换和丢弃；3）BASE 的优势在不同批次大小下保持稳定。BASE 引入的开销仅为每个解码步骤的 3.1%–7.1%。
AI.conclusion: MoE 的 token 级稀疏性不能直接转化为高效的批解码。BASE 通过基于预测移除代价的批次级专家选择解决了这一问题，无需重新训练即可显著改善质量-效率权衡。丢弃交叉项对专家选择影响有限，使得独立排序可行。轻量级线性预测器和回填策略是 BASE 高效且有效的关键组件。该方法的局限性在于需要比简单基线更多的离线校准时间和计算。

title: The Role of Feed-Forward Layers in Transformer Dynamics
summary: We study the dynamical behavior of tokens in transformers from a control-theoretic perspective. Our model includes the feed-forward layer present after the self-attention mechanism, with the self-attention mechanism interpreted as an interacting particle system and the feed-forward layer as an independent control. Our main theoretical result establishes that the feed-forward network can steer the tokens arbitrarily close to consensus regardless of the key, query, and value matrices. Our result are easily extended to convergence to many clusters and to multi-head attention. We conduct numerical experiments to verify our results, and compare thresholding behavior from our theory to real-world LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文从控制理论视角研究Transformer推理过程中token的动态行为，证明了前馈网络（FFN）可以独立驱动token收敛到共识点，并给出了关于自注意力值矩阵范数的同步阈值条件。
AI.motivation: Transformer已被广泛部署，但其理论分析相对滞后。现有的连续时间ODE分析主要关注自注意力机制，而忽略了前馈层对token动力学的独立影响。本文旨在量化前馈层在长时动力学中的作用及其相对于自注意力的强度阈值。
AI.method: 提出FSA（Feed-forward Self-Attention）模型，将自注意力视为交互粒子系统、前馈层视为独立控制。利用通用逼近定理，设计显式的单神经元前馈控制律（Problem 1），通过Lyapunov型分析（跟踪 $1-\langle x_i, x_0\rangle$ 的演化）证明收敛性。同时构造反例（V=J）证明阈值条件在某种意义下是必要的。分析扩展到多聚类收敛和多头注意力，并通过纳米GPT、Pythia-410M、TinyLlama-1.1B进行实证研究。
AI.result: 主要理论结果（定理1.1）：对任意 $\epsilon>0$ 和自注意力参数 $A,V$，存在FFN参数使得除对极点 $-x_0$ 外的初始条件下，所有token在有限时间内收敛到 $x_0$ 的 $\epsilon$-邻域，前提是 $\|u_x\| > \|V\|_{op}$。反例表明当 $\sup\|u_x\| < \|V\|_{op}$ 时存在 $V$ 使得同步不可能。数值实验验证了 $k/k^*=1$ 处的尖锐相变。实证分析发现真实LLM中某些层的FFN幅值超过注意力尺度，表明前馈层在预训练模型中确实发挥非平凡作用。
AI.conclusion: 论文首次从控制理论角度量化了前馈层与自注意力层之间的相互作用，证明了 $\|V\|_{op}$ 是前馈层主导动力学的阈值。真实LLM的实证证据表明这一阈值行为在部署模型中确实存在，提示实际Transformer中的动力学比先前研究所揭示的更为丰富。开放问题包括：寻找弱控制律仍能强制同步的条件，以及更精确地刻画真实模型中前馈层的影响区域。

title: Transversal Pooling Neural Networks
summary: Many learning tasks require stability to small transformations while retaining sensitivity to larger ones. We introduce \emph{transversal pooling neural networks}, which generalize spatial max pooling to affine group actions. We establish equivariance to a chosen subgroup and derive explicit stability bounds for individual pooled wavelet coefficients under affine perturbations of the input. Experimentally, we demonstrate the utility of our networks in low-data environments and for predicting tropical cyclone intensification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"横向池化神经网络"（TraPNets），将空间最大池化推广到仿射群作用，在对小子变换保持稳定性的同时保留对大变换的敏感性。文章建立了关于选定子群的等变性，并给出了在仿射扰动下个体池化小波系数的显式稳定性界。实验证明该网络在低数据环境下和热带气旋快速增强预测任务中具有实用价值。
AI.motivation: 许多学习任务需要对小子变换保持稳定性同时对大变换保持敏感性。然而：(a) 完全的群不变性在实践中可能丢失有用信息（如手写数字识别中180度旋转将"6"变为"9"；热带气旋预测中风暴运动引入不对称性使方向信息具有意义）；(b) 现代神经网络中的标准最大池化非线性需要适当调整以适应一般仿射变换；(c) 需要在仿射扰动下给出定量稳定性保证。
AI.method: 1. 定义仿射群 AGL(ℝ^d) 的闭子群 G 上的连续小波变换 Ψ（voice transform）。2. 定义横向池化算子 Ξ：对 G 上函数关于子群 Λ 的右陪集代表集 H 取上确界，即 Ξ(F)(λ) = sup_{h∈H} F(λh)。3. 构造 TraPNet = τ_m ∘ ⋯ ∘ τ_1 ∘ Ψ，其中 τ_i 为 Ξ、群卷积 Υ 或激活函数 σ 的组合。4. 理论上：证明 Ψ 的 G-等变性、Ξ 的 Λ-等变性、Υ 的 Λ-等变性（Corollary 2.4 给出 TraPNet 的 Λ-等变性）；证明新的拟正则表示收敛率（Theorem 3.1），进而建立 Ξ∘Ψ 的群-Lipschitz 连续性（Theorem 3.3 和 Proposition 3.14）。5. 实验上：在合成椭圆数据上演示低数据环境下的性能优势，并应用于热带气旋快速增强预测。
AI.result: 1. 理论上：证明了 TraPNet 对 Λ 具有等变性、对 G 具有群-Lipschitz 连续性（显式稳定性界依赖于 C_A = max{ln‖A‖, ln‖A^{-1}‖} + 2 arcsin(½‖A(A^TA)^{-1/2} - I‖)）。2. 数值验证（旋转稳定性）：椭圆图像实验表明小角度旋转下池化小波系数差异近似线性增长，与理论界一致。3. 低数据环境（椭圆方向分类）：当训练样本数为 8000/4000/2000/800/400/80/40/16 时，TraPNet 准确率为 98.7/98.5/98.9/98.4/97.2/75.5/65.7/51.7%，均优于 CNN 基线（97.5-48.9%）和数据增强 CNN（98.9-51.2%）。4. 热带气旋快速增强预测：TraPNet 相比数据增强 CNN 在 F1 分数（0.328 vs 0.264）、精确率（0.305 vs 0.278）和召回率（0.354 vs 0.252）方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功引入了 TraPNets 这一神经网络架构家族，它具有以下优良性质：(i) 对子群 Μ 具有等变性；(ii) 对 G 具有群-Lipschitz 连续性；(iii) 在数据有限的环境中泛化良好；(iv) 在实际应用中表现良好。理论结果同样适用于文献中现有架构（如 CNN 标准最大池化和群等变网络中的完全群不变池化）。证明中关于拟正则表示的新稳定性界可能对小波理论有独立价值。未来工作方向包括：收紧 Theorem 3.3 的界、推广到其他群表示（如海森堡群的薛定谔表示）、将稳定性结果扩展到非仿射形变等。

title: Can Representation Learning Decouple from Loss Minimization? Polar Updates Have an Answer
summary: Does representation learning stop when the training loss stops improving? We study this question for matrix Muon, whose polar-normalised updates have a step length set by the gradient's rank rather than its norm. Near the edge of stability, full-batch Muon on teacher-student problems enters approximately period-2 loss oscillations that persist for thousands of steps: the cycle-mean loss stays flat or rises, yet the weights keep moving and the learned features continue to align with the teacher subspace. For linear teacher-student learning toys, we derive explicit cycle and alignment formulas and conditional plateau and decay bounds. For a population mean-field ReLU model, we prove that, under stated dimension, initialisation and small-head conditions, the leading eigenspace of the average gradient outer product (AGOP) recovers the teacher subspace exactly during a loss plateau, before the loss later drops. In all 33 ReLU, GELU and SiLU teacher configurations we study, direction-only alignment metrics show the student AGOP aligned with, or still aligning to, the teacher subspace during the period-2 oscillations; projected head refitting on selected configurations shows that the learned directions are useful for prediction, and further measurements distinguish AGOP alignment from weight-mass concentration. In deep residual ReLU students, freezing the downstream layers while the first layer trains with full-batch exact polar updates recreates a nearly flat cycle-mean loss with improving input-AGOP alignment; freezing and unfreezing switch between this plateau and loss decrease, and the effect is sensitive to momentum and to the choice of orthogonaliser.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"矩阵 Muon"优化器下，损失平台期（loss plateau）期间表征学习是否可以继续进行的问题。作者证明：在周期-2 损失振荡的长时间平台期内，权重持续移动，学生网络的 AGOP（平均梯度外积）主特征空间会持续对齐教师子空间；通过学习玩具（线性回归/M3）的闭式理论、一层 ReLU 网络的均值场定理以及深度残差网络的冻结干预实验三个层面验证了这一"表征学习可与损失最小化解耦"的现象。
AI.motivation: 训练损失停止下降时，网络是否仍在学习有用的表征？损失衡量当前预测器的误差，而表征学习关注预测器依赖的输入方向。已有研究表明存在解耦现象（silent alignment、catapults 等），但这些现象要么限于训练早期、要么与特定 spike 相关。本文旨在探究：在持续数千步的损失平台期内（损失持平甚至上升），表征学习能否继续，以及何种训练动力学产生这种分离。
AI.method: 聚焦矩阵 Muon 优化器的极分解（polar-normalized）更新，其步长由梯度秩决定而非范数。在三个层面建立结果：（1）学习玩具：归一化梯度下降与矩阵 Muon 的闭式周期-2 循环分析；（2）均值场模型：高斯输入下一层 ReLU 网络的精确 AGOP 主特征空间恢复定理；（3）实验：33 种 ReLU/GELU/SiLU 教师配置下 8000 步训练，以及深度残差 ReLU 学生的冻结层实验。对齐度量包括方向性 AGOP cos²度量、头部重拟合诊断、权重质量测量等。
AI.result: 所有 33 种教师配置中观察到约 10000 步的近似周期-2 损失振荡，平台期内学生 AGOP 持续或已完成与教师子空间的对齐；均值场定理证明在维度、初值和小头条件下，AGOP 领先特征空间在 1% 损失平台期内精确恢复教师子空间，随后损失下降；深度残差学生中冻结下游层可在平坦周期-2 损失下持续提升输入 AGOP 对齐，冻结/解冻可切换平台期与损失下降状态。cos²_min 在平台期内仍上升 0.38–0.53（深度配置）；诊断显示训练损失是 L_AGOP-opt 的 5–11 倍，表明学习方向有用但头未充分利用。
AI.conclusion: 极分解更新下，损失平台期不是学习的暂停：学习玩具与均值场模型在所述条件下证明了"表征学习与损失最小化的解耦"，并在一层与深度残差学生中得到测量、通过冻结下游层实现开关。损失曲线可低估网络已学到的内容，方向性表征测量是损失的有效补充。

title: Action Chunking Proximal Policy Optimization with Feedback Correction
summary: Action chunking provides temporal abstraction in reinforcement learning by selecting short action sequences instead of individual actions, but many existing approaches face two limitations in high-dimensional robotic control. First, many rely on value functions over action chunks, which can be difficult to learn as action dimensionality and chunk length grow. Second, executing chunks open-loop removes within-chunk feedback, limiting reactivity in contact-rich tasks. We present Action Chunking PPO (ACPPO), a PPO extension that uses a chunked actor while retaining a standard state-value critic, thereby avoiding chunked Q-functions. We further propose ACPPO-Corr, which augments the chunk planner with a stepwise feedback corrector that adjusts planned actions online within each chunk. Across 25 simulated robotics tasks from IsaacGym and Bi-DexHands, spanning locomotion, arm manipulation, and dexterous hand-object interaction, ACPPO-Corr achieves the strongest aggregate performance among evaluated methods and performs best on both decision-frequency-sensitive and decision-frequency-neutral task subsets. Ablations show that moderate chunk lengths work best and that corrector regularization is important for balancing chunk-level planning with local feedback. These results suggest that action chunking can be effective in online PPO when chunk-level planning is paired with closed-loop correction. The code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ACPPO 及其扩展 ACPPO-Corr，将动作分块（action chunking）引入在线同策略 PPO 框架，通过分块规划器与逐步反馈修正器的结合，在 25 个 IsaacGym 与 Bi-DexHands 仿真机器人任务上实现最优聚合性能。
AI.motivation: 现有动作分块强化学习方法在高维机器人控制中存在两大瓶颈：1)分块 Q 函数（chunked Q-function）随动作维度和分块长度增加而难以学习，常导致过估计与不稳定，且多依赖离线预训练或重型架构（如 Transformer）；2)以开环方式执行动作序列导致分块内失去反馈反应能力，限制了在接触丰富任务（如灵巧手操控）中的性能。
AI.method: 1) ACPPO：将动作分块集成到 PPO 中，采用分块 actor（预测长度为 h 的动作序列），但保留标准状态价值 V(s) 评判器，避免学习分块 Q 函数；使用分块级优势（chunked advantage）将 h 步回报与逐步 GAE 尾部结合，并对分块级联合重要性采样比率进行裁剪。2) ACPPO-Corr：在分块规划器之外增加一个逐步反馈修正器，每步基于当前状态对规划动作进行加性修正和噪声调节，融合低频分块规划与高频闭环控制；规划器与校正器通过停止梯度（stop-gradient）解耦交替更新，并加入校正器幅度正则化项 λ_r‖c_t‖²；预热阶段先冻结规划器训练 N/20 轮以稳定价值函数，再联合训练。
AI.result: 在 IsaacGym 与 Bi-DexHands 共 25 个任务（涵盖运动、臂操控与灵巧手-物体交互）上的 5 随机种子 IQM 评估中，ACPPO-Corr 最终归一化 IQM 较 PPO 提升 30.4%，在频率敏感子集（11 任务）与频率中性子集（10 任务）上均取得最佳表现；逐任务胜负比（Win/Tie/Loss）为 13/8/4，10/10 频率中性任务进入最优组，9/11 频率敏感任务进入最优组。消融实验显示：h=4 为最佳分块长度（h=1 仅略优于 PPO），校正器正则化可有效抑制校正器主导规划器；ACPPO-Corr 在 h=16 时仍保留 PPO 得分的 1.21 倍，而 ACPPO 与 QC-FQL 分别仅 0.68 与 0.29；h=32 时 ACPPO-Corr 仍有非平凡表现，ACPPO/QC-FQL 则接近 0。
AI.conclusion: 将动作分块引入在线同策略 PPO 框架时，仅依靠分块规划器（ACPPO）不足以应对接触丰富任务，需与逐步闭环修正器结合（ACPPO-Corr）方能在分块级时间抽象与分块内反应性之间取得平衡；中等分块长度（h≈4）和对校正器的正则化是实现性能增益的关键因素。该方法局限于连续动作空间与状态观测场景，对更长块长度的稳定性仍需进一步研究，未来可探索自适应分块长度、仿真到现实迁移以及潜在动作扩展。

title: The Signed Geometry of One-Shot Recourse: On-Path Validity and the Signed-Curvature Criterion
comment: Main text 8 pages; 57 pages including appendix and checklist
summary:
Closed-form recourse moves a rejected user along the unit gradient $\hat g$ of the classifier score $f$ by the promised distance $d_p=|f(x)|/\|
abla f(x)\|$, at which the linearized score reaches zero. We ask when this one-shot step succeeds and what additional model queries change. To leading order the step ends on the favorable side exactly when the path curvature $\kappa=\hat g^	op
abla^2 f(x)\,\hat g$ is nonnegative. Across 80 shallow models, the fraction of rejected users whose step ends there and the fraction with $\kappa\ge0$ correlate at $r=0.985$, although on Fashion-MNIST the first falls below the second by 8.2 points on average. No rule that uses only the score value and gradient can be valid for every score with path curvature bounded by $K$ without overshooting some by order $Kd_p^2/\|
abla f(x)\|$. When the curvature is also Lipschitz and the step is short, one evaluation of $f$ at the promised point attains the minimax rate among deterministic one-query rules that know the curvature bound and its Lipschitz constant, and split-conformal calibration makes such a rule reach the first crossing or abstain with probability at least $1-\delta$. Training with an asymmetric curvature penalty lets 99-100% of paths cross within the promised step on undershoot-prone shallow data, at about 4-22 times the overshoot of symmetric penalties (Fashion-MNIST, COMPAS). Because $\kappa$ and $d_p$ depend on how the score is scaled, part of this gain can be a longer promised step, and at matched validity a smaller audit of briefly trained models finds no uniform advantage over tuned inflation. Where a per-user line search along the ray is affordable, it is exact to grid resolution and preferable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究算法救济中"一次性"闭式推荐（alpha-1）的成功条件及其在有限模型查询下的修正机制，提出路径曲率κ = ĝᵀ∇²f(x)ĝ 的符号决定alpha-1步骤是否成功（带符号曲率准则），证明一阶梯度规则存在不可逾越的下界，并通过分割共形校准、前向探测与不对称曲率惩罚等机制在查询预算限制下改进有效性与精度。
AI.motivation: 闭式一次性救济步骤在路径弯曲时可能失败（欠冲或过冲），但何时失败及如何在有限查询预算下修复缺乏系统理论。本文试图刻画路径几何与救济有效性之间的精确联系，并分析不同查询预算下规则的最优性能。
AI.method: 核心方法包括：(1) 泰勒展开建立alpha-1端点恒等式与带符号曲率准则；(2) 证明定理5.2的双侧误差界、Theorem 6.1的一阶梯度障碍（零查询）、Theorem 6.3的一次前向查询极小极大率；(3) 分割共形校准提供一阶覆盖保证（Proposition 7.1）；(4) 提出不对称曲率惩罚[δ−κ]²₊ 以训练替代过去的纯查询修正策略；(5) 在80个浅层模型、4数据集（COMPAS、German、Adult、F-MNIST）和CIFAR-10/CelebA深度网络上验证。
AI.result: 主要结果为：(1) 80模型上alpha-1端点有效性与ℙ(κ≥0)相关系数r=0.985；(2) 一阶规则障碍定理证明仅依赖值与梯度的规则必然在某个函数上失败；(3) 一次前向探测达到确定性单查询极小极大率；(4) 不对称惩罚使99-100%路径在承诺步长内跨越（F-MNIST、COMPAS、Adult），但过冲增加4-22倍；(5) COMPAS群组差异中88%可由κ分布差异解释；(6) 共形探测（conformal-probe）在所有16数据集×方法单元中过冲低于共形二次（conformal-quadratic），综合覆盖96.0%、平均过冲0.0016。
AI.conclusion: 结论为：路径曲率的符号是alpha-1救济成功的关键量；仅有值和梯度的规则无法既经济又有效；一次前向探测在查询效率上过冲最小；不对称曲率惩罚以过冲换取有效性，但部分增益来自得分尺度的变化；在匹配有效性下与调优膨胀相比并无统一优势；若可承受每用户线搜索，则其精度至网格分辨率最优。深度网络（CelebA）上81.3%点处于歧义带，准则有效性受限。

title: CyFA: Linear Sequence Modeling with Relative-Time-Partitioned Memory
summary: Linear RNNs offer linear-time sequence processing and constant-memory decoding, but their fixed-size recurrent states must accommodate all past key--value associations. Existing forgetting mechanisms and Delta Rule updates reduce interference by selectively clearing or correcting the state, yet earlier associations can still become difficult to retrieve. We introduce CyFA (Cyclic Flow Attention), a Linear RNN with relative-time-partitioned memory. At each step, a learned clock controls the cyclic transport applied jointly to the key and value states before the current key--value pair enters the age-zero slot, thereby organizing stored associations across relative-time slots. We further derive an exact change to absolute-clock coordinates that expresses CyFA as two scalar-decay linear attention recurrences and enables efficient chunk-wise training. Across 400M--1.4B pretraining experiments with matched recurrent-state sizes, CyFA improves recall-intensive performance while maintaining competitive language modeling and high computational efficiency. At 400M, CyFA outperforms KDA on FDA (42.60 vs. 26.07) while requiring only 46.7% and 48.3% of KDA's forward and backward core-operator execution times, respectively. Our code is publicly available at \href{ this https URL }{this https URL}.

AI.tldr: CyFA（Cyclic Flow Attention）是一种新型线性循环神经网络（Linear RNN），通过引入"相对时间划分记忆"机制，利用学习到的时钟控制循环传输，在固定大小的循环状态中更好地组织历史键值关联，从而在回忆密集型任务上显著优于现有方法，同时保持高效计算。
AI.motivation: 现有线性RNN的固定大小循环状态需要容纳所有过去的键值关联，导致信息干扰。虽然遗忘门和Delta Rule更新通过选择性清除或修正状态来减少干扰，但早期关联仍难以检索。本文提出一个补充问题：能否更好地组织记忆本身，使在相同状态预算下更多关联保持可区分和可检索？
AI.method: CyFA在每个时间步用学习的时钟增量δ_t控制键值状态的循环传输（cyclic transport），将当前键值对写入"年龄零"槽位，组织跨相对时间槽的存储关联。核心创新包括：1）相对时间划分记忆机制；2）通过精确坐标变换到绝对时钟，将循环传输转化为两次标量衰减线性注意力递归（scalar-decay recurrences）；3）支持高效分块训练的两遍式（two-pass）计算；4）时钟梯度稳定化（stop-gradient）以防止训练不稳定。
AI.result: 在400M-1.4B规模的预训练实验中（匹配循环状态大小），CyFA在所有规模上均达到最高平均准确率。在回忆密集型任务上提升5.74-6.94个百分点。在400M规模，CyFA在FDA任务上以42.60 vs 26.07超越KDA，前向和反向核心算子执行时间仅为KDA的46.7%和48.3%，端到端训练吞吐量为KDA的1.37倍。长上下文评估（LongBench、RULER NIAH）也表现出色。
AI.conclusion: CyFA通过相对时间划分记忆和循环传输机制，在固定循环状态预算下更好地组织历史关联。绝对时钟坐标变换将其简化为两次标量衰减递归，实现了高效分块训练。该方法在回忆密集型任务上取得显著提升，同时保持竞争力强的语言建模能力和高计算效率，是线性RNN架构设计的有价值新方向。

title: Understanding LLM Parameter Update Sparsity through the Lens of Fisher
summary: Recent studies have observed that parameter changes during language-model post-training can be concentrated in a small subset of coordinates. This phenomenon has been reported in reinforcement learning, on-policy distillation, and supervised fine-tuning on near-policy data. Its recurrence across different post-training paradigms suggests shared structure in training dynamics. In this paper, we examine this pattern through the diagonal model Fisher, which measures the sensitivity of the model's output distribution to individual parameters and is independent of any particular reward or teacher signal. Theoretically, we show that small diagonal Fisher leads to small expected gradients across a range of training objectives, providing a common explanation for sparse gradient updates. Empirically, we test this connection in RL and OPD. We find that Fisher identifies where gradients are concentrated, and fixed sparse masks selected from the initial Fisher retain a large proportion of the improvement from full training. Finally, we investigate the mechanisms underlying low Fisher in on-policy training. Our results show that high-probability next tokens tend to have similar parameter sensitivities, contributing to low Fisher. Together, these results establish the diagonal model Fisher as a unifying perspective linking update sparsity to on-policy training dynamics in LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对角模型Fisher信息，为LLM后训练中参数更新稀疏性现象提供了统一的理论解释和实证分析。研究表明，Fisher可以预测梯度的集中分布，固定稀疏掩码能保留大部分完整训练性能，并揭示了在策略训练下低Fisher源于高概率token具有相似的参数敏感性。
AI.motivation: LLM后训练（RL、OPD、SFT）中普遍观察到参数更新高度集中在少数坐标的稀疏现象，但现有解释缺乏跨范式的统一机制。本文旨在探究何种共同结构导致学习集中在小部分参数中。
AI.method: 通过理论分析建立Fisher与期望梯度的Cauchy-Schwarz不等式关系（|g_i| ≤ √(E[a²])·√F_i）；通过token级Fisher分解，揭示token Fisher等于logit敏感性的概率加权方差；实验使用Qwen3-1.7B-Base进行RL（Dr. GRPO/MATH-500）和OPD（AIME24）训练，比较Fisher选择掩码与随机掩码在不同预算下的性能。
AI.result: （1）理论证明Fisher为期望梯度提供统一上界；（2）高Fisher坐标对大梯度坐标的recall显著高于随机基线（如1%预算时达47.40%）；（3）固定Fisher掩码在0.1%参数下恢复RL 85.21%提升、5%参数下恢复98.82%；（4）token级分析显示模型概率质量集中在敏感性相似的token上，导致Fisher偏低（Real/Uniform比率仅0.04-0.16）；（5）初始Fisher模式在训练中保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 对角模型Fisher是LLM后训练中参数更新稀疏性的统一解释视角：低Fisher源于在策略训练中高概率token的参数敏感性相似，进而限制了期望梯度大小，使得有效学习能够集中在稀疏参数子集上。

title: Stochastic Optimization Under Power-Law Spectra: Tight Bounds and Shuffling Analysis
summary: Recent work has established that power-law spectral conditions on data enable tight convergence bounds for deterministic gradient descent, resolving the conflict between classical exponential bounds and observed power-law learning curves. In this work, we extend this result to the stochastic regime of high-dimensional machine learning. We provide two main contributions: (1) We generalize the power-law spectral theory to Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), showing that the same spectral exponents govern stochastic dynamics; (2) For the fundamental case of isotropic Gaussian data, we provide a precise analysis of data shuffling, deriving exact constants that prove Single Shuffle is strictly superior to Flip-Flop and IID sampling. Our results bridge the gap between abstract spectral theory and practical stochastic training choices, offering a unified picture of how data geometry drives optimization speed.

AI.tldr: 本文将幂律谱条件下确定性梯度下降的收敛理论推广到随机梯度下降（SGD），证明了相同的谱指数控制随机动力学，并针对各向同性高斯数据精确分析了数据混洗方法，证明 Single Shuffle 在测试损失上严格优于 IID 采样和 Flip-Flop。
AI.motivation: 经典优化理论预测强凸目标上梯度方法呈指数收敛，但现代大规模训练中常观察到幂律学习曲线。Velikanov 和 Yarotsky (2024) 通过幂律谱条件为确定性 GD 提供了紧致界，但该理论未覆盖随机优化场景，且未量化数据混洗方案的实际收益。
AI.method: 1) 利用幂律谱条件 ρ((λ_min,λ]) ≍ Q(λ-λ_min)^β，将 V&Y 框架推广到 SGD，采用生成函数方法处理非对称、非交换的动态矩阵积；2) 对各向同性高斯数据（β=1/2, Q=2/π），利用自由概率理论（Lambert W 函数、S-变换乘性）推导 Single Shuffle、IID 和 Flip-Flop 三种采样方案的精确常数；3) 通过特征值 CDF 拟合 β 值，在高斯数据、CIFAR-10 ResNet 嵌入和 Wikipedia 嵌入上验证理论。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 定理 5 将 V&Y 的全梯度下降收敛界精确扩展到 IID SGD，测试损失 O(n^{-β})、训练损失 O(n^{-(β+1)})，指数和常数完全匹配；(2) 定理 7-10 给出各向同性高斯数据的精确常数：测试损失 - Single Shuffle: 1/(2√(πn))，IID/Flip-Flop: 1/√(2πn)（√2 优势）；训练损失 - Single Shuffle: 1/(8√π)·n^{-3/2}，IID: 1/(2√(2π))·n^{-3/2}，Flip-Flop: √2/(3√π)·n^{-3/2}；(3) 猜想 √2 优势对所有谱指数 β 均成立；(4) 三个标度区域（次临界、临界、超临界）的完整描述。
AI.conclusion: 幂律收敛不是全梯度下降的产物，而是幂律谱条件下优化的基本性质——谱结构而非优化算法决定收敛率。实践建议：使用 Single Shuffle（比 IID 测试损失好 √2 倍素数改进，无额外计算成本）；避免 Flip-Flop 用于插值最小二乘；为新数据集测量特征值 CDF 以预测收敛行为。理论意义：桥接抽象谱理论与实际随机训练选择，提供数据几何驱动优化速度的统一图景。开放问题：证明普遍性猜想、分析小批量 SGD、连接神经网络训练实践。

title: GNA: Granular Neighbor Assembly for Retrieval-Augmented Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Deep forecasters predict from a fixed-length lookback window, and lengthening it gives diminishing returns at a growing cost.
