AI.result: （1）温和商业指令：LLM和贝叶斯选择器均无任何选择变化；（2）显式对抗指令：LLM选择器使赞助商品选中率从40%升至70%（ΔP=+0.30），平均合成效用下降0.0547（95%上下文自助法置信区间[-0.0828, -0.0291]）；贝叶斯选择器呈现类似效应（ΔU=-0.0540）；（3）第二LLM在120个冻结问答输入上做出完全相同选择；（4）一致性判断20/20判定为一致，但5个合成遗憾>0.05的案例被遗漏——表明一致性指标无法捕捉单方面引导；（5）条件遗憾证书在定向提问下仅认证16/40案例，并不优于直接使用中性提问。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了"选择性引导"作为可观测的实验现象，提供了观测等价见证（同一问答-选择痕迹在不同偏好下指向不同最优品），并给出了关于温和激励和保守干预的明确负面结果。但作者严格声明：这些结果既不表明广告激励下的典型行为，也不涉及真实消费者效用。贡献仅限于一个受控的压力测试协议、可复现的观测等价见证，以及对一种温和激励和一种保守干预的负面结论。

title: SemPSG: A Semantic Channel-Aware Foundation Model for Polysomnography Analysis
summary: Polysomnography (PSG) integrates multiple physiological signals to provide a comprehensive characterization of human sleep, yet its heterogeneous channel configurations across centers pose substantial challenges for transferable representation learning. Existing foundation models mainly focus on physiological modeling or temporal learning, while channel identity is often treated as a fixed structural index, overlooking the physiological semantics encoded by signal modality and reference configuration. To this end, we propose SemPSG, a Semantic channel-aware foundation model for heterogeneous PSG analysis. SemPSG explicitly represents the physiological semantics of channel identity and incorporates them into both signal representation learning and channel aggregation, enabling flexible modeling across diverse data configurations. Specifically, a semantic-conditioned time-series encoder captures signal-specific temporal dynamics and cross-signal interactions, while a multi-view image encoder extracts complementary time-frequency and morphological patterns from the same physiological recordings. We evaluate SemPSG on sleep and health-related tasks, including sleep staging, sleep-disorder breathing analysis, disease prediction, cognition and emotion recognition, and demographic estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over both general-purpose time series foundation models and PSG-specific foundation models, together with generalization across heterogeneous datasets across diverse channel configurations.

AI.tldr: SemPSG is a semantic channel-aware foundation model for polysomnography (PSG) analysis that explicitly encodes the physiological semantics of channel identities (e.g., electrode location, reference configuration, derivation direction) into both temporal and image representation learning. It combines a channel semantics tokenizer, a semantic-aware time-series encoder with intra-/inter-modality modeling, and a multi-view image encoder (CWT scalograms, STFT spectrograms, morphology envelopes), pretrained with masked reconstruction, cross-view contrastive, and cross-modal alignment objectives. The model is evaluated on six downstream sleep and health tasks across heterogeneous PSG cohorts, consistently outperforming both general-purpose time-series foundation models and PSG-specific foundation models.
AI.motivation: Existing PSG foundation models treat channel identity as a fixed structural index (often collapsing distinct channels into coarse modality labels or restricting them to a predefined canonical channel vocabulary), which fails to capture the rich physiological semantics encoded by signal modality, electrode location, and reference configuration. Additionally, PSG signals exhibit multi-scale temporal dynamics (long-range waveforms, time-frequency patterns, local morphology) and entangled intra-/inter-modality dependencies that existing approaches struggle to balance and disentangle. These limitations hinder transferable representation learning across heterogeneous PSG datasets with varying channel configurations.
AI.method: SemPSG introduces three key components: (1) A Channel Semantics Tokenizer that converts raw channel names (e.g., "C3-M2") into UTF-8 byte sequences, encodes them via a convolutional stem + Transformer, and pretrains with auxiliary heads predicting semantic attributes (type, derivation, anatomical location, sensor info), alias-contrastive objectives, and direction-aware hard negatives—then freezes and adapts the semantic embeddings via a lightweight GELU adapter. (2) A Semantic-Aware Time-Series Encoder with semantic-conditioned feature-wise modulation (FiLM) applied before intra-modality joint channel-temporal self-attention, followed by a semantic-aware gating mechanism for channel aggregation, and an inter-modality Transformer with learnable modality embeddings; both intra- and inter-modality masked reconstruction objectives are used. (3) A Multi-View Image Encoder generating CWT scalograms (Morlet wavelets, 32 scales), STFT spectrograms (Hann window), and morphology envelopes as 160×160 grayscale images arranged into modality strips, processed by view-specific stems and a shared Transformer with masked latent reconstruction, cross-view contrastive learning, and learned sample-dependent view weighting. Cross-modal alignment between pooled time-series and image representations uses symmetric InfoNCE-style contrastive loss. The overall pretraining loss combines L_intra + λ_inter·L_inter + λ_mim·L_mim + L_view + L_align, with λ_inter progressively increased.
AI.result: SemPSG was pretrained on 9 PSG cohorts (37,082 participants, 49,207 recordings, 409,462 hours) and evaluated on 6 downstream tasks across SHHS, APPLES, and the unseen CFS cohort. Key results: (1) Sleep staging: 82.4% accuracy / 75.2% Kappa on SHHS-1 (+5.2 pp Kappa over SleepMaMi), 81.9% / 74.8% on CFS. (2) Sleep-disordered breathing classification: 70.2% Macro-F1 on SHHS-1 (+9.6 pp over SleepMaMi), 69.4% on CFS. (3) AHI regression: MAE of 6.29 on SHHS-1 (9.4% lower than SleepFM). (4) Disease prediction: highest C-index on 4/6 cardiovascular/cerebrovascular endpoints (CVD death, CHF, CHD death, stroke), with +7.2% on CHD death and +5.7% on CVD death vs. SleepFM. (5) Cognition/affective assessment: HAM-D MAE of 2.84 (−6.0%) and WASI MAE of 8.00 (−6.5%) on APPLES. (6) Demographic estimation: 83.5% gender accuracy on SHHS-1. Visualization analyses confirm that channel semantics capture fine-grained intra-modality structure (e.g., respiratory sub-clusters) and that shuffling channel names changes gating patterns, demonstrating that channel identity directly influences channel aggregation.
AI.conclusion: SemPSG establishes that explicitly modeling channel identity semantics—rather than collapsing channels into coarse modality labels or restricting them to fixed vocabularies—is critical for learning transferable PSG representations across heterogeneous channel configurations and acquisition systems. By integrating channel semantics into both time-series and multi-view image encoding, and by disentangling intra-modality channel dependencies from inter-modality interactions, SemPSG achieves consistent and broad improvements over both general-purpose time-series foundation models (MOMENT, UniTS, Zeus) and PSG-specific foundation models (SleepFM, SleepMaMi), as well as EEG foundation models (LaBraM) across six diverse sleep and health-related downstream tasks. The work positions SemPSG as a general-purpose foundation model for sleep and physiological signal analysis with demonstrated cross-dataset generalization to unseen cohorts.

title: Physics-Aware Machine Unlearning for Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: This paper proposes a physics-guided gradient-ascent-based machine unlearning method that couples the forgetting signal with the physical residual of the target cyber-physical systems, ensuring that weight updates during unlearning are steered toward physically feasible regions of the weight space. The physics residual acts as a safety fence during gradient ascent: the model is steered away from the poisoned behavioral basin and simultaneously toward physics-compliant territory, rather than toward an arbitrary alternative that may still violate domain constraints. We evaluate the proposed method against four baselines: naive gradient ascent, exact unlearning, SISA, and full retraining on an IEEE 34-bus distribution system, driven by two physics-informed neural network-based distribution energy resource controllers and validated through high-fidelity OpenDSS power-flow co-simulation. From the evaluation, we found that our proposed physics-guided model simultaneously removes poison and restores physical compliance, which are essential for the safe deployment of safety-critical cyber-physical systems

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhyGAMuL，一种物理引导的梯度上升机器遗忘方法，通过将物理残差作为方向约束耦合到遗忘信号中，确保权重更新保持在物理可行区域内。在IEEE 34节点配电网上的OpenDSS高保真协同仿真验证表明，PhyGAMuL能同时移除投毒行为并恢复物理合规性，是首个明确解决"统计遗忘≠物理安全恢复"这一结构性差距的工作。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器遗忘方法（如梯度上升GA）虽然在统计指标上可以满足遗忘要求（投毒MSE升高、清洁准确率恢复），但无法保证模型输出满足CPS的物理约束。对于安全关键的网络物理系统（如配电网DER控制器），一个满足统计遗忘指标的PINN模型仍可能输出物理上不可行的设定值（如EVCS最大功率充电、PV夜间注入），造成与原始投毒攻击等效的物理破坏。现有工作未研究如何在遗忘过程中保持物理可行性。
AI.method: 方法核心是PhyGAMuL算法，包含两阶段：1）物理引导的上升阶段：将CPS的物理残差R作为主动正则项耦合到梯度上升损失中，损失函数为 -MSE(ŷ, y^p) + λR(x, ŷ) + μ‖W-W_p‖²，使权重同时远离投毒盆地并被拉向物理可行子空间；2）物理丰富的微调阶段：保留完整物理权重λ=2.0，对清洁数据进行微调，并对EVCS的高负荷低SoC工况过采样。文中还提出三步法系统化构造物理残差（从器件datasheet识别不等式约束→转化为平方Hinge惩罚→加权求和），并设计了硬裁剪物理投影层Π作为推理时的安全网。
AI.result: 在IEEE 34节点系统（OpenDSS协同仿真）上对比四种基线（朴素GA、Exact Unlearning、SISA、完全重训练）：PhyGAMuL达到PVR 1.4%、VVR 2.1%，接近清洁基线（PVR 0.8%、VVR 0.0%）且优于朴素GA（PVR 18.7%、VVR 26.3%）；24小时电网仿真中PhyGAMuL是唯一完全恢复基线电网性能的方法，最小电压0.947 p.u.、负荷27.0 kW与基线完全一致。消融实验表明λ=2.0是最优权衡（与清洁训练时的物理权重一致），Naive GA的物理违规率随微调epoch延长几乎不变（证明违规是结构性问题而非收敛问题），PhyGAMuL对近似投毒批次具有鲁棒性（退化<2个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: PhyGAMuL是首个明确区分"统计遗忘"与"物理安全恢复"的机器遗忘框架，通过将物理残差作为方向性约束嵌入遗忘过程，能在已部署的单一模型上（无需checkpoint、sharding或完全重训练）同时实现投毒遗忘和物理合规恢复，恢复了与基线电网性能一致的运行状态。未来工作将拓展联邦场景、认证遗忘界限以及自动约束发现以消除手动残差构造。

title: What Makes Recurrence Effective in Looped Language Models?
summary: Looped language models (LoopLMs) increase computational depth through parameter sharing, offering a path to scale inference computation without adding parameters. However, it remains unclear when additional recurrence is beneficial and how architectural choices affect its effectiveness. Through controlled experiments, we systematically examine (1) when recurrence helps, (2) where it should be applied, and (3) how its conditioning affects performance. Our evaluation covers inference budgets below, within, and beyond the training horizon under knowledge and reasoning tasks. (1) We find that recurrence can improve reasoning beyond the training horizon while degrading knowledge performance, but harder reasoning instances do not consistently benefit more. (2) Performance also depends on how distinct layers and recurrent iterations are allocated, showing that effective depth alone is insufficient to predict behavior. Non-recurrent output layers improve robustness to under-unrolling, while the preferred placement of input and output layers varies with inference budget. (3) Finally, we find that conventional initial-state injection offers limited robustness to varying recurrence depth. We therefore propose history-state injection as an alternative, and show that channel-wise history-state injection combined with timestep conditioning offers a low-cost and more effective design, better preserving knowledge under extended unrolling while improving robustness across inference budgets. Overall, our results clarify when recurrent computation helps, where it fails, and offer practical guidelines for designing LoopLMs across variable inference budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了循环语言模型（LoopLM）中参数共享循环在不同推理预算（欠展开、训练视野、外推）下的有效性，从"何时有效"、"应用于何处"、"如何条件化"三个维度展开控制实验，提出了基于通道级历史状态注入与时间步条件化相结合的轻量级联合条件框架。
AI.motivation: LoopLM 通过参数共享在推理时灵活调整计算深度，提供了一种无需增加参数即可扩展推理计算的路径，但目前对于何时以及何种架构选择能提升循环的有效性尚不清晰，特别是在训练视野之外的外推场景下。
AI.method: 采用受控实验方法，使用 Llama3.1-1B 和 Qwen3-0.6B 两种骨干架构，在 FineWeb-Edu 数据上从头预训练不同物理深度与循环次数配置的 LoopLM，在固定有效训练深度下评估欠展开、训练视野、循环外推三种推理预算下的知识与推理任务表现，并通过角度距离、相对更新范数、状态方差以及计算交互度量等几何探针分析内部循环动力学。
AI.result: 发现：(1) 循环可在外推范围内提升推理但损害知识性能，且难度更高的推理实例并非更受益；(2) 物理深度与循环迭代的平衡分配比有效深度更能预测行为，Coda 提升欠展开稳健性，Prelude 利于推理外推；(3) 传统初始状态注入稳健性有限，提出的通道级历史状态注入结合时间步条件化（如 Loop Gating）在 3×训练深度下达到 37.30 Overall 准确率，优于各单独组件及非条件基线。
AI.conclusion: 循环扩展在 LoopLM 中具有显著潜力，但其有效性高度依赖任务语义、物理深度与循环次数的分配以及条件化方式；通道级历史状态注入与时间步条件化（尤其是 Loop Gating）的联合方案是一种低成本的互补设计，能在变化推理预算下同时保持知识与推理性能的稳健提升，为 LoopLM 设计提供了实用指导。

title: PE-OPSD: Internalizing Prompt Enhancement into Flow-matching Models via On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Text-to-image users often provide concise and underspecified prompts, whereas generative models benefit from detailed textual conditions for reliable instruction following. Existing systems bridge this gap with Prompt Enhancers (PEs) that rewrite raw prompts at inference time, introducing additional latency and leaving prompt elaboration external to the generator. We instead view enhanced prompts as privileged training information and ask whether their benefits can be internalized. We propose Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation (PE-OPSD) for text-to-image flow-matching models. During training, a raw-prompt student follows its own generation trajectory, while an enhanced-prompt teacher provides vector-field targets at the states visited by the student. This on-policy supervision distills the behavior induced by enhanced prompts into the raw-prompt student without requiring additional text--image pairs. At inference, both the PE and teacher are removed, and the student generates directly from raw prompts. Across multiple model families, PEs, and benchmarks, PE-OPSD achieves the strongest aggregate prompt fidelity among the evaluated baselines, yields positive aggregate visual appeal gains, and retains the base-model inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PE-OPSD方法，将文本到图像流匹配模型中的提示增强效果内化到生成器中，通过在线策略自蒸馏实现无需推理时提示增强的高质量图像生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的提示增强器（PE）在推理时重写用户简短的提示，带来额外延迟且未能将增强能力内化到生成器中。作者希望将增强提示作为特权训练信息，使其效果能被原始提示条件下的模型所吸收。
AI.method: 提出PE-OPSD框架：训练时，原始提示条件的学生模型生成自己的流轨迹，增强提示条件的教师模型（EMA更新）在学生访问的状态上提供向量场监督目标。学生通过匹配μ-loss（Euler单步转移目标）在自身访问的状态上模仿增强提示下的生成行为。推理时，移除PE和教师，学生直接从原始提示生成，无需提示重写。
AI.result: 在SD3.5-M、Z-Image、Z-Image-Turbo三个骨干网络上，PE-OPSD在GenEval和GenEval2上均取得最佳的聚合提示保真度（I_PF相对Base提升13.35%-16.07%），优于推理时PE、SFT和离线策略蒸馏；同时保持正面的视觉吸引力增益和基础模型的推理延迟。PE-OPSD在多种PE、不同模型规模（FLUX.2-klein 9B、QwenImage-2512 20B）和域外基准上也表现良好，相对PromptEnhancer-7B/32B实现1.96×-50.67×的推理加速。
AI.conclusion: PE-OPSD成功将提示增强的生成行为内化到流匹配生成器中，通过在线策略自蒸馏在学生自身轨迹上蒸馏增强提示下的教师监督，无需额外文本-图像对或推理时PE，在多个骨干网络、PE和基准上均优于现有方法，同时保持基础模型的推理效率。

title: A Digital Simulation Toolkit for Physics-Based Generation of Realistic Experimental Scanning Tunneling Microscopy Images
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures in main text and 2 supplementary figures
summary: Scanning Tunneling Microscopy (STM) is a widely used tool for characterizing surfaces of materials at the atomic scale, playing a crucial role in discoveries across condensed matter physics and materials science. Despite its extreme spatial resolution, STM is one of the most sensitive microscopy techniques and is highly prone to noise. While existing unsupervised denoising methods are very cheap to train, these are primarily focused on removing the noise with minimal recovery of key physical information. While supervised methods can offer superior performance, the major bottleneck is that a large amount of paired clean-noisy experimental images is required which are impractical to obtain. Thus, we developed a low-cost physics-driven digital toolkit to rapidly generate large volume of realistic STM images. Firstly, we simulate clean images from a chosen material system. Then, with prior knowledge of the physical characteristics of the artifacts and noise present in STM experiments, we formulate several artifact-noise functions such as Gaussian electronic noise, 1/f flicker noise, scan-line noise, background tilt and mechanical drift. These physically informed noise components are then added to the simulated clean images to generate realistic STM images. We demonstrated the capability of the proposed digital toolkit to generate AI-ready data for denoising images of the (111) surfaces of copper and lead, while preserving atoms, defects, and electron waves. We also validated the quality of the downstream image analysis of learning electron wave patterns induced by quantum interference from Cu(111) images. Results show that the supervised models trained on digitally generated AI-ready data can more effectively denoise and learn electron wave patterns on Cu(111) images than benchmarked unsupervised approaches, indicating that the proposed toolkit facilitate scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于物理驱动的低成本数字工具包，用于生成大量逼真的STM（扫描隧道显微镜）图像，作为AI去噪训练数据。通过模拟清洁图像并叠加多种物理启发的噪声成分（如高斯电子噪声、1/f闪烁噪声、扫描线噪声、背景倾斜和机械漂移），该工具包生成的合成图像可用于训练监督学习模型，显著提升对Cu(111)和Pb(111)表面图像的去噪效果及电子波纹学习能力。
AI.motivation: STM虽具有原子级空间分辨率，但极易受噪声影响。现有无监督去噪方法成本低但难以恢复关键物理信息，而监督学习方法虽性能优越，却因缺乏成对的干净-噪声实验图像而受限。因此，亟需一种能够生成大量逼真STM图像的方法，以解决监督学习的数据瓶颈问题。
AI.method: 1. 从选定的材料体系模拟生成清洁STM图像；2. 基于STM实验中伪影和噪声的物理特征先验，构建多种噪声函数，包括高斯电子噪声、1/f闪烁噪声、扫描线噪声、背景倾斜和机械漂移；3. 将这些物理启发的噪声成分叠加到模拟清洁图像上，生成逼真的STM图像；4. 利用生成的AI就绪数据集训练监督学习模型，并在Cu(111)和Pb(111)表面图像上进行去噪和电子波纹学习验证。
AI.result: 所提出的数字工具包能够有效生成保留原子、缺陷和电子波等关键物理信息的逼真STM图像。在Cu(111)图像的下游分析中，基于合成数据训练的监督模型在去噪和电子波纹学习方面均优于基准无监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 该物理驱动的数字工具包能够以低成本生成大量AI就绪的逼真STM图像，有效缓解监督去噪模型的数据匮乏问题，并显著提升STM图像的科学分析能力，有助于推动凝聚态物理和材料科学领域的科学发现。

title: PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Language-model agents are usually trained by reinforcement learning from one reward per episode, and privileged self-distillation enriches it by letting the same policy, given a skill, teach its skill-free self through token probabilities. However, we identify two phenomena that question this channel. Invisible Advantage: a skill in context lifts WebShop success from 42.2% to 56.2%, yet changes the probabilities of fewer than a quarter of the sampled tokens. Much to Align: a skill changes the hidden states of over 80% of response tokens, in a way that linear probes can trace back to the specific skill. To exploit this, we propose Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation (PR-OPD). After a GRPO warm start, the policy writes a hindsight skill for each trajectory, re-reads its own responses with that skill as a stop-gradient teacher, and aligns its projected hidden states to the teacher's at every layer alongside the reward objective, with no external skill library, separate teacher, or inference overhead. On ALFWorld and WebShop with two backbones, PR-OPD achieves the best overall results in every setting, improving over GRPO by up to 4.7 points in ALFWorld success and 14.0 points in WebShop accuracy. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出PR-OPD（Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation），通过对齐教师隐藏状态而非token概率，实现智能体强化学习中特权自我蒸馏的改进。
AI.motivation: 传统特权自我蒸馏依赖模仿教师token概率来传递先验信息，但作者发现技能虽能显著提升教师表现（WebShop成功率从42.2%提升至56.2%），却几乎不改变token概率分布（仅<25%响应token概率变化），而隐藏状态却广泛变化（>80% token）。这表明token级蒸馏丢失了大部分优势信号。
AI.method: PR-OPD采用两阶段训练：(1) GRPO预热N步使策略具备任务执行与反思能力；(2) 每条轨迹由策略自身生成事后技能hindsight skill，然后以无梯度方式重读响应作为教师；学生侧每层添加轻量MLP投影器，将各层隐藏状态对齐到教师的隐藏状态；总目标为L_RL + λ·L_PRA。学生、分析器、教师共享同一组权重，推理时无需技能库、独立教师或额外开销。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop两个基准上，使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct和Qwen3-1.7B-Instruct两个骨干网络，PR-OPD在所有设置下均取得最佳平均结果：相比GRPO，ALFWorld成功率最高提升4.7分，WebShop准确率最高提升14.0分（摘要数据）或11.7分（正文数据）。消融实验表明，token级OPD反而下降8.6分，隐藏状态对齐提升6.3分，验证了"Invisible Advantage"现象；小型骨干网络上投影器尤为关键，将性能从36.7%提升至46.9%。线性探针分析显示中间层隐藏状态可识别具体技能（最高98.3%），而输出特征仅接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 特权技能的真正优势存在于教师的隐藏状态而非token概率中。PR-OPD通过对齐每层投影隐藏状态，有效传递了事后反思带来的优势，无需外部资源且对架构侵入性最小。关键启示：策略必须先学会任务，其自身的事后洞察才有学习价值。

title: Scheduling Recursive Reasoning in Looped Transformers
summary: Recurrent reasoning models have attracted growing attention for scaling test-time computation, typically by iteratively refining latent states with shared parameters. However, these models apply each learned update with a fixed unit scale, which can be conservative when updates make persistent progress and overly aggressive when they fluctuate, limiting the benefit of additional loops. To understand how the scale should vary along the trajectory, we first analyze the sensitivity of terminal loss to recurrent update scale. We show that its temporal average admits an exact decomposition into persistent-progress and centered-fluctuation contributions. Based on this, we introduce the Trajectory Adaptive Progress-Fluctuation Scheduler (TAPS), which tracks their balance across recurrent updates and adapts the step size online. Theoretically, we establish sufficient conditions under which TAPS reduces expected terminal loss and reaches a target quality in fewer recurrent loops. Empirically, we show that TAPS improves terminal accuracy across structured reasoning tasks without retraining. By further incorporating the progress-fluctuation principle into training, TAPS yields additional accuracy gains with up to 1.56 times wall-clock speedup at matched baseline accuracy. The broad applicability of TAPS is supported by its effectiveness across diverse recurrent architectures and inference strategies. Together, these results establish update scale as complementary control axis of recurrent inference alongside architecture and depth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAPS（Trajectory Adaptive Progress–Fluctuation Scheduler），通过在线分析循环推理轨迹中"持久进展"与"中心化波动"的平衡，自适应调整循环Transformer的更新步长，无需重新训练即可提升推理效率，最佳配置实现1.56倍的实际加速。
AI.motivation: 现有循环推理模型（如looped transformers）在每次循环更新中均使用固定单位步长η=1，这在更新方向持续有效时过于保守，在更新方向波动时又过于激进，限制了额外循环的收益。现有工作已广泛探索了"重复何种计算"和"重复多少次"，但每次更新的"步长尺度"这一维度尚未被充分研究。核心问题是：循环轨迹本身是否包含足够信息来自适应调整更新尺度以提升任务性能？
AI.method: 1. 理论分解：将终端损失对更新步长η_k的时序平均梯度精确分解为"持久进展"P_k^w（沿轨迹的一致运动）与"中心化波动"S_k^w（偏离均值的波动）两部分。2. 算法设计：使用指数移动平均（EMA）估计P_k^w和S_k^w，借鉴Adam的一阶/二阶矩跟踪方式，定义平衡度量B_k=(P_k-γS_k)/(P_k+γS_k+ε)，据此调整η_k=clip(1+ρB_k, η_min, η_max)。3. 理论保证：给出充分条件确保TAPS降低期望终端损失并以更少循环达到目标质量。4. 训练-推理协同设计：在训练中加入正则项μΣ_k[Ŝ_k-κP̂_k]_+，抑制过度波动以更好地配合TAPS推理。5. 提供六种实例化变体（TAPS-GD、P/S-Sign、Momentum、RMSProp、Adam、BB）。
AI.result: 在三种循环架构（潜在状态循环TRM、语言模型循环Ouro/Huginn、中间层循环Qwen3-4B）和四种推理策略（固定步长、自适应退出、分层循环、固定点推理、并行循环）上验证TAPS的有效性。主要结果：Sudoku上准确率从89.67%提升至91.39%（1.300×加速），Maze上从78.80%提升至79.90%（1.561×加速）；自适应退出策略减少72.5%计算量；固定点推理以约260次更新达到基线1000次更新的精度；语言模型平均准确率提升约0.5-1.7个百分点；通过算子融合实现端到端1.042×额外加速。
AI.conclusion: TAPS确立了"更新步长尺度"作为循环推理中继架构和深度之后的互补控制轴。核心结论是：通过将更新步长与局部轨迹动态（持久进展vs.中心化波动）相匹配，可以在不修改模型权重的前提下提升推理效率和准确性，且该方法可广泛适用于多种循环架构和推理策略。训练-推理协同设计进一步增强了这些收益，表明塑造循环动态以支持自适应步长控制是未来值得探索的方向。

title: On-Policy Parameter Update Direction Underlies Generalization in LLM Post-Training
summary: The strong generalization performance of on-policy post-training paradigms has motivated studies of their parameter update behaviors. However, these studies treat the observed behaviors only as byproducts in on-policy training, overlooking their potential to serve as optimization principles for improving the generalization of other paradigms such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT). To address this limitation, we investigate whether there exists a specific on-policy update behavior that can achieve such improvements. First, our analyses reveal that SFT updates parameters along consistent directions, while the on-policy paradigm continuously adjusts the direction during training. This difference inspires us to focus on the cumulative update direction of each parameter as a promising behavior. Then, we evaluate its effectiveness for improving generalization by proposing On-Policy direction-constrained Supervised Fine-Tuning (OPSFT), which constrains SFT updates to the direction identified by on-policy paradigms. The strong performance of OPSFT indicates that the generalization advantage of on-policy paradigms can be transferred to SFT through the parameter update direction. Once such a direction is identified, even SFT can generalize with its updates constrained to this direction. This finding offers two practical benefits by combining the strong generalization of on-policy paradigms with the advantages of SFT, including the high training efficiency and ability to leverage high-quality trajectories. For efficiency, we identify update directions that support strong generalization using a few on-policy training steps, and subsequently apply OPSFT to achieve high training efficiency. For leveraging high-quality trajectories, OPSFT can utilize these trajectories to continue improving a post-trained model along its update direction without disrupting the ability learned from on-policy training.

AI.tldr: This paper investigates the parameter update direction of on-policy post-training paradigms (e.g., GRPO, OPD) and proposes OPSFT (On-Policy direction-constrained Supervised Fine-Tuning), which constrains SFT parameter updates to the directions identified by on-policy paradigms. The work shows that the on-policy update direction is the key factor underlying strong generalization, enabling SFT to achieve generalization performance comparable to on-policy paradigms while maintaining SFT's advantages in training efficiency and the ability to leverage high-quality trajectories.
AI.motivation: On-policy post-training paradigms (e.g., GRPO, OPD) demonstrate superior generalization compared to supervised fine-tuning (SFT), but existing research treats their distinctive parameter update behaviors merely as byproducts rather than as transferable optimization principles. The paper aims to bridge the gap between understanding on-policy parameter update behaviors and leveraging them as practical optimization principles to improve SFT generalization, combining the strong generalization of on-policy paradigms with the efficiency and flexibility advantages of SFT.
AI.method: The paper conducts both theoretical and experimental analyses comparing gradient formulations of on-policy paradigms and SFT. Theoretical analysis shows SFT updates parameters along consistent directions (proportional to teacher trajectory gradients), while on-policy paradigms update parameters toward the covariance between advantages and trajectory gradients, causing continuous direction adjustment. Experimentally, the authors measure cosine similarity of interval and cumulative parameter updates across training stages. OPSFT is implemented by: (1) constraining instantaneous SFT gradients using a sign vector v = sign(θ_on - θ_base) derived from on-policy training, masking gradients whose sign would cause opposite-direction updates; (2) applying a hard projection after optimizer steps to enforce that cumulative displacement aligns with the on-policy direction. This two-level constraint handles AdamW's weight decay and momentum effects.
AI.result: Across multiple models (Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B) and benchmarks (AIME24/25, HMMT25-Feb/Nov, HumanEval+, MBPP+, LiveCodeBench, and OOD benchmarks like IFEval, ARC, HaluEval), OPSFT consistently and substantially outperforms vanilla SFT and achieves performance comparable to or exceeding GRPO. Key findings: (1) OPSFT with only location constraints performs worse than vanilla SFT, confirming that update directions—not locations—are critical; (2) OPSFT achieves over 50% training time reduction compared to GRPO while maintaining superior performance; (3) OPSFT improves already post-trained models using high-quality trajectories without disrupting learned capabilities, while vanilla SFT degrades such models; (4) update directions can be reused across datasets within the same domain but not across domains; (5) OPSFT shows similar spectral properties (stable rank, principal singular vector rotation) to GRPO despite being SFT-based; (6) later-stage on-policy directions yield better OPSFT performance, with diminishing marginal returns.
AI.conclusion: The parameter update direction identified by on-policy paradigms is the key factor underlying their strong generalization performance, not merely their update locations or training objectives. By constraining SFT updates to this on-policy direction, OPSFT can transfer the generalization advantage of on-policy paradigms to SFT, achieving comparable or superior performance with significantly reduced training time. This finding offers practical benefits: (1) efficient training by using only a few on-policy steps for direction identification followed by efficient SFT, and (2) the ability to incrementally improve post-trained models with newly acquired high-quality trajectories without restarting training. The work challenges the conventional view that "SFT memorizes while RL generalizes" by demonstrating that appropriately constrained SFT can generalize effectively, and opens future research directions on how different on-policy components contribute to identifying generalization-friendly directions.

title: Byzantine-Robust Federated Representation Learning
summary: We study federated learning (FL) with adversarial clients, where the goal is to minimize the average loss of the honest (non-adversarial) clients without knowing their identity. Under heterogeneity, a single shared model parameter is statistically inappropriate: it cannot capture the distinct data-generating processes across clients, incurring an irreducible model-heterogeneity bias and severely limiting robustness to adversarial clients (a.k.a. Byzantine-robustness). We address this problem through representation learning, where each client learns a personalized linear head, while collaboratively estimating a shared nonlinear representation through Byzantine-robust aggregation. We demonstrate that the heterogeneity among honest representation gradients is controlled by the representation error and statistical errors that decay either with the number of data samples per client ($\tau$) or the number of iterations ($T$). In particular, our non-asymptotic parameter recovery error bound reveals three terms: (i) an initialization-dependent error that goes away with $T$, (ii) finite-sample noise terms that decreases with $\tau$ and the number of honest clients, and (iii) a stochastic gradient variance term that also reduces with $T$. Importantly, with no irreducible model-heterogeneity bias in our bounds. We extend the regression analysis to multiclass classification, and empirically validate it on CIFAR-10, FEMNIST, and School Exam Score datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究异构联邦学习中的拜占庭鲁棒性问题，提出将每个客户端模型分解为个性化线性头和共享非线性表示，通过拜占庭鲁棒聚合共同学习共享表示，证明了不存在不可约的模型异构性偏差。
AI.motivation: 在异构联邦学习中，传统的单一共享模型参数存在固有的模型异构性偏差（即使无限样本也无法消除），且服务器难以区分诚实客户端的异构性和对抗性行为，导致拜占庭鲁棒性受到根本性限制。
AI.method: 采用交替优化框架：(1) 每个客户端在本地拟合个性化线性头；(2) 客户端计算共享非线性表示的随机梯度动量并发送至服务器；(3) 服务器使用(f,κ)-鲁棒聚合器（如Krum、截尾均值等）聚合表示更新。通过控制表示梯度的异构性来建立收敛性和参数恢复保证。
AI.result: 非渐近参数恢复误差界包含三项：(i) 初始化依赖项随T衰减；(ii) 有限样本噪声项随τ和诚实客户端数衰减；(iii) 随机梯度方差项随√T衰减。关键是不存在不可约的模型异构性偏差。在CIFAR-10上表示学习相比基线提升38.3-42.1个百分点，在FEMNIST上提升18.9-22.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离个性化头部和共享非线性表示，可以在高概率非渐近意义下保证拜占庭鲁棒联邦表示学习，所有误差项均随通信轮数T、本地样本数τ或诚实客户端数衰减，且不存在固有的模型异构性偏差。理论结果成功扩展到多类分类问题，并在多个数据集上得到实验验证。

title: GenLimitLib: A Formal Library for Language Generation in the Limit and AI-Assisted Mathematical Research
summary: We present GenLimitLib, a source-aligned Lean 4 library for language generation in the limit. Introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan at NeurIPS 2024, language generation in the limit studies a theoretical question motivated by LLMs: how to generate valid new strings from observed examples. This young and rapidly evolving field offers a natural testbed for studying large-scale formalization. GenLimitLib contains formal developments for 30 papers. It extracts shared definitions and reusable proof components while preserving paper-specific assumptions and statements, and records relationships across papers. In this way, GenLimitLib provides a concrete and structured view of the literature. We show through mathematical case studies and LLM experiments how our library can support both human mathematical research and AI-assisted research. Our Library: this https URL .

AI.tldr: GenLimitLib 是一个面向"语言生成极限"（language generation in the limit）研究领域的 Lean 4 形式化库，覆盖 30 篇论文、405 条声明、超过 12.4 万行代码。它通过抽取共享定义（Core）、可复用证明组件（Support）和跨论文关系（Bridge）三层结构，将这一新兴研究领域组织为可检索、可审计、可重用的形式化基础设施，并展示了其对人类数学研究和 AI 辅助证明生成的双重价值。
AI.motivation: "语言生成极限"由 Kleinberg 和 Mullainathan（NeurIPS 2024）提出，是一个快速发展但结构尚不清晰的新兴领域。该论文旨在通过大规模形式化，将这一领域组织成结构化、可导航的形式化基础设施，同时利用形式化过程发现数学洞见（证明缺陷、跨论文连接、开放问题求解），并评估此类库对 AI 辅助数学研究的支持能力。
AI.method: 采用 Lean 4 形式化方法，构建源对齐（source-aligned）的形式化库。库结构分为四层：(1) Core（18 个模块）——论文无关的数学接口；(2) Support（34 个模块）——跨论文可复用的证明组件；(3) Paper（30 个论文模块）——保留各论文特定假设和陈述；(4) Bridge（17 个模块）——记录跨论文显式关系。导航提供三个层级：PaperMap（人类可读）、声明卡片（机器可读 JSON）、Lean 声明卡片。审计采用三级累积验证（语句、算法、中间引理），使用指纹追踪变更影响。AI 辅助方面，实验对比 P（最小词汇）、PML（完整子库）、PML-Oracle（理想化检索）三种资源条件下 LLM 在 Lean 证明生成和数学阅读任务上的表现。
AI.result:
**库规模**：30 篇论文、405 条声明（53.6% 完全覆盖，20.2% 部分覆盖）、124,275 行 Lean 代码、252 个 Core 声明（53.2% 被 ≥2 篇论文复用）、214 个 Support 定理、34 条显式跨论文关系。

**数学发现**：(1) 识别并修复 Charikar & Pabbaraju（2026）P13 中 Claim 7 的证明缺陷（仅修正中间断言，保持算法和收敛界不变）；(2) 将 P31 的三语言有界记忆构造转移到 P22 的回放模型，将四语言不可能性改进为三语言，并给出有限族在回放下可确定性适当生成（proper generation）的精确刻画（Theorem 1）；(3) 在阶梯族（staircase family）上确定确定性生成器的精确错误-收敛权衡（Theorem 2），解决 Kleinberg 等（2026b，P29）的开放问题特例。

**实验结果**：(1) Lean 证明生成：5 个未发表定理任务、300 次独立运行，PML 成功率从 P 的 48% 提升至 79%，PML-Oracle 达 81%；库依赖度高的任务（如 D 和 E）在 P 条件下零成功，PML 条件下几乎全部成功。(2) 数学阅读：相关 Lean 证据将准确率从 70.09% 提升至 78.55%（404 题）；相关论文地图将准确率从 60.26% 提升至 70.61%，而伪地图仅 60.51%（204 题）。(3) API 成本：PML 每份有效证明的 API 费用（$1.95）低于 P（$2.76），PML-Oracle 更低（$1.78）。
AI.conclusion: GenLimitLib 证明，将新兴且快速演进的研究文献组织为源对齐形式化库是可行的，且具有双重价值：(1) 形式化过程本身揭示证明缺陷、隐藏假设和可弱化条件，促进跨论文构造迁移和新结果推导；(2) 结构化形式化库显著提高 AI 在 Lean 证明生成和数学阅读任务上的表现，同时降低计算成本。该方法不限于语言生成极限领域，可推广至其他具有密切论文关联、共享定义和可复用证明思想的新兴研究方向。未来的工作方向包括：改进定理检索和依赖感知检索、自动化库构建过程、以及将此范式扩展到其他研究领域。

title: Stochastic Heavy Ball with Polyak Step Size and Armijo Line Search: A General Convergence Analysis
summary: Polyak step size (PS) and Armijo line search (ALS) have received increasing attention in stochastic optimization, with encouraging empirical performance and theoretical guarantees. However, their convergence theory for stochastic heavy ball (SHB) methods remains limited. In this work, we develop a unified convergence analysis for SHB equipped with PS and ALS. To this end, we introduce a modified Armijo rule that closely parallels the Polyak step size, together with a decoupling analysis that isolates the historical dependence induced by momentum. For SHB with standard PS and ALS, we establish expected convergence for strongly convex, convex, and non-convex objectives without interpolation or restrictive conditions on the momentum parameter. Under interpolation or strong growth, we further strengthen the results to almost sure rates and last-iterate convergence. Moreover, for general settings beyond interpolation, we prove almost sure convergence to the exact optimum or to stationarity for SHB with diminishing variants of PS and ALS. These results provide a more comprehensive theoretical view of Polyak step size and Armijo line search for stochastic heavy ball methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对带有Polyak步长(PS)和Armijo线搜索(ALS)的随机重球法(SHB),提出了统一的收敛性分析框架。通过设计一个与PS性质对齐的修改版Armijo规则,以及两个解耦动量依赖性的引理,作者在不需要插值假设或对动量参数β施加限制性上界的条件下,建立了强凸、凸和非凸目标下的期望收敛保证;在插值或强增长条件下进一步得到几乎处处收敛和最后迭代收敛;此外,采用递减型PS/ALS变体可在一般设定下实现几乎处处精确收敛。
AI.motivation: SHB方法因动量引入的迭代间耦合而比SGD更难分析。现有的PS和ALS与动量结合的收敛性理论仅限于受限设定(如凸目标、PL条件、插值假设或对β的额外上界),缺乏对一般凸/非凸目标、任意固定β的统一理论保证。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 核心方法包括:(1)引入与PS步长性质对齐的修改版Armijo线搜索规则;(2)提出两个解耦引理——Lemma 3将当前迭代与历史梯度的内积解耦为凸性相关项与动量累积范数项,Lemma 4刻画SHB轨迹上目标值的相邻差异;(3)基于这些引理,对标准SHB-PS/ALS在强凸、凸、非凸目标下建立期望收敛;(4)在插值(σ²=0)或强增长(δ=0)条件下,通过单调收敛定理和Robbins-Siegmund引理证明几乎处处收敛和最后迭代收敛;(5)对带递减动量与递减步长的SHB-PS/ALS变体,建立几乎处处精确收敛。
AI.result: 主要结论包括:(1)强凸目标:SHB-PS/ALS以线性速率O(r^k+σ²)收敛到最优点邻域,r由β和μγ_min决定;(2)一般凸目标:均匀平均迭代的次优性为O(1/k+σ²),对任意固定β∈[0,1)成立,不需额外上界;(3)非凸目标(弱增长条件):最优迭代梯度范数为O(1/k+δ);(4)插值或强增长下:凸目标几乎处处O(1/k)且最后迭代收敛到F(θ*),非凸下‖∇F(θ_k)‖→0 a.s.;(5)递减变体:在求和动量条件下,凸目标加权平均次优性和非凸最优迭代梯度范数均为O(1/S_k) a.s.,可进一步细化为o-速率。
AI.conclusion: 本文为随机重球法与Polyak步长/Armijo线搜索的结合提供了目前最全面的收敛理论框架,放宽了以往工作中对β的限制性上界、插值假设和凸性要求。数值实验在受控有限和问题以及LIBSVM逻辑回归、ResNet-18上验证了理论预测。局限性在于递减变体的分析仍要求∑β_k<∞,无法覆盖实践中常用的恒定动量(如β=0.9);此外,一般设定下建立最后迭代收敛仍是一个开放方向。

title: Human-inspired, Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration for Efficient Learning in High Dimensions
summary: Efficient exploration in high-dimensional decision spaces remains a central challenge for decision-making systems. Humans, in contrast, can navigate large decision spaces with remarkable efficiency. Recent behavioral studies suggest that humans reduce dimensionality in large decision spaces by probing candidate feature dimensions, identifying reward-relevant ones, and restricting the effective decision space. Inspired by this mechanism, we propose TDGE (Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration), a human-inspired, model-agnostic algorithm with an automatically constructed task-dimension--feature--item hierarchy. TDGE follows a top-down exploration strategy: it first selects task-relevant feature dimensions, then identifies informative features within those dimensions, and finally recommends concrete items based on the selected features. Experiments on MovieLens-20M, this http URL , and Amazon recommendation datasets show that TDGE substantially improves exploration efficiency and cold-start adaptation over baseline algorithms. Comparisons with other structured algorithms and ablation studies attribute these gains to TDGE's hierarchical structure and semantic feature-space exploration, with robust results across clustering methods and hierarchy depths. Recommendation-trajectory visualizations also show exploration patterns similar to human dimension-guided behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出受人类维度探索行为启发的人类启发式、模型无关的探索算法TDGE（Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration）。TDGE通过Sentence-BERT嵌入和层次聚类自动构建任务维度-特征-项目三级语义层级，采用自顶向下的探索策略（先选任务相关维度→再选信息性特征→最终推荐物品），在MovieLens-20M、Last.fm、Amazon数据集上的在线累积遗憾和冷启动遗憾均显著低于LinUCB/NeuralUCB/NeuralTS等基线及CoFineUCB、H²N-Bandit等结构化方法，验证了语义特征空间探索和维度级路由的有效性。
AI.motivation: 高维决策空间中的高效探索是决策系统的核心难题。人类通过试探性探测候选特征维度、识别奖励相关维度并限制有效决策空间来降低高维探索的难度，但现有的探索策略（如ε-greedy、UCB、Thompson采样）以及处理大动作空间的强化学习方法（动作嵌入、动作消除等）和结构化上下文赌博机方法（CoFineUCB、H²N-Bandit）未能显式建模这种语义维度的层次化探索，难以有效利用语义结构来提高样本效率。
AI.method: 1. 任务维度提取：使用Sentence-BERT将物品描述特征嵌入为768维向量，通过Ward层次聚类构建特征树状图，并使用Kelley-Gardner-Sutcliffe（KGS）准则在最小聚类大小约束下自动确定任务维度数量k*；2. 多级探索调度：三层级（维度→特征→物品）均使用相同的上下文赌博机backbone（LinUCB/NeuralUCB/NeuralTS），自顶向下通过TopK选择筛选候选集；3. 候选物品生成：基于选中特征与物品特征集合的交集及其相关性ρ进行打分排序，选取TopK物品形成候选池；4. 层级化信用分配：观测奖励后通过特征-物品交集传播反馈，特征级更新使用相关性权重ρ，维度级更新使用匹配特征的最大相关性权重ω。
AI.result: 1. 在MovieLens-20M、Last.fm、Amazon三个数据集上使用三种backbone进行在线和冷启动评估，TDGE在6个数据集-backbone对比中在线累积遗憾降低4.5%-31.0%，冷启动终轮遗憾降低10.5%-74.9%（5/6对比统计显著）；2. 在MovieLens-20M上显著优于CoFineUCB和H²N-Bandit（在线遗憾分别降低30.7%和29.9%，冷启动遗憾降低66.4%和74.6%）；3. 消融实验验证语义特征空间结构优于物品聚类结构，不同聚类方法（Ward/k-means/谱聚类/GMM）结果相当；4. 三层与四层层级深度差异无统计显著性；5. 推荐轨迹可视化显示TDGE具有类似人类的维度持续探索模式；6. 推理时间分析显示TDGE仅增加约0.26-0.32ms延迟（10万物品规模下），保持良好可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: TDGE作为一种人类启发式、模型无关的探索框架，通过显式建模语义维度-特征-物品三级层次结构，有效提升了上下文赌博机推荐系统的样本效率和冷启动适应性。实验验证了显式语义维度探索相对于参数空间结构化方法（CoFineUCB）和预定义类别层级方法（H²N-Bandit）的优势，并展示了与人类维度引导探索行为相似的轨迹模式。但仍存在固定保留尺寸K₁/K₂、层级深度收益受限以及仅在上下文赌博机设定下评估等局限，未来可向自适应保留尺寸和一般强化学习场景拓展。

title: Understanding Private Evolution as Learning-Augmented Clustering
summary: Private Evolution (PE) is a differentially private algorithm for synthetic data generation. While it can be viewed as a Wasserstein learning algorithm, it performs much better in practice than worst-case Wasserstein analyses would predict. We recast PE as generative model-augmented Wasserstein learning. We show theoretically that when we take into account the use of a generative model that is able to capture something about the true distribution, then we can obtain much better performance bounds. For example, if the generator gives samples in the same low-dimensional space as the distribution, then sample complexity depends on intrinsic, not ambient, dimension. We also show that standard variants of PE can fail to converge on simple well-clustered instances, and propose a new geometry-aware version of PE with provable convergence on such instances. Experimentally, we show that our new algorithm is competitive with standard baselines and can improve recall.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视Private Evolution (PE)算法，将其重新定义为"生成模型增强的Wasserstein学习"，从超越最坏情况分析的角度提供理论解释，并提出新的几何感知变体GAPE来解决标准PE在简单聚类数据上的失败问题。
AI.motivation: Private Evolution (PE)是一种基于基础模型的差分隐私合成数据生成算法，虽然在实践中表现优异，但现有理论分析（基于Wasserstein学习的最坏情况界）给出的样本复杂度随环境维度d呈指数级增长，与实际表现严重脱节。此外，已知PE变体（包括ranking和subsampling选择策略）在简单聚类数据上可能完全失败，缺乏对此失败模式的理论解释和改进方案。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 提出"学习增强算法"框架，将PE视为生成模型增强的Wasserstein学习，引入VariationAPI的有效秩λ和加倍维度k两个本征维度度量；(2) 通过chaining论证和最优传输的Kantorovich对偶性，分析BL距离（噪声引入的误差）和Wasserstein收缩率；(3) 提出GAPE算法，使用基于局部搜索的k-median风格选择机制替代ranking/subsampling，确保几何感知且满足差分隐私。
AI.result: (1) 理论结果：当VariationAPI的有效秩为λ、加倍维度为k时，PE的Wasserstein误差为Õ(λ^{1+1/(2k)}·(√(log(1.25/δ))/(εn))^{1/k})，仅依赖于本征维度k而非环境维度d；(2) 负面结果：标准PE变体（ranking和subsampling）在简单双聚类数据上可产生Ω(R)的覆盖误差，可能永久丢失少数聚类；(3) 正面结果：GAPE在满足R≥400rλ/c和最小聚类大小为Ω̃(n^{1/2}λ^{1/4})时，以高概率恢复O(rλ)的覆盖误差；(4) 实验：GAPE在PubMed和Reddit数据集上与AugPE竞争力相当，在大ε时recall更高，且能改善SubsamplePE的recall。
AI.conclusion: 本文为PE算法的实际成功提供了首个基于生成模型假设的理论解释，证明了访问生成模型可本质上改善Wasserstein学习的样本复杂度。识别了标准PE变体在聚类数据上的关键失败模式（选择机制未考虑几何信息），并提出几何感知的GAPE算法作为有效解决方案，在理论和实验上均得到验证。

title: MARCO: Multi-Round Agentic Reinforcement for Conditional Molecular Optimization
summary: Molecular optimization is inherently iterative: a candidate is proposed, evaluated against several objectives, and revised while preserving a relationship to the source molecule. Most instruction-following models instead emit one edited molecule, forcing validity, property improvement, and similarity control into a single response. We introduce MARCO, an evaluator-grounded reinforcement-learning framework that trains molecular editors on bounded proposal--feedback--revision trajectories. MARCO aggregates shaped turn rewards into an undiscounted trajectory return for group-relative policy optimization. We evaluate two consequences of this training: Same-1 tests the trained policy under a one-response budget, while Same-5 tests whether the same policy can use verifier feedback when up to five responses are available. Across the three-objective MuMOInstruct benchmark, three Qwen backbones, and seen/unseen instruction splits, SFT-initialized MARCO obtains the highest product of property success rate and similarity in every reported primary setting. Same-5 further improves the observed score under the tested budget, while four-objective and public-checkpoint experiments test transfer across constraint sets and initialization regimes.

AI.tldr: MARCO提出了一种基于多轮智能体强化学习的条件分子优化框架，将指令型分子优化重构为有界的"提议-反馈-修订"轨迹决策过程，通过验证器引导的轨迹回报和组相对策略优化(GRPO)训练分子编辑器，在MuMOInstruct基准上以SR×Sim指标全面超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 条件分子优化本质上是迭代任务：候选分子被提出、依据多目标评估、再修订以保留与源分子的关系。但现有指令跟随模型采用单响应映射，迫使有效性、性质改进和相似性控制集中于一次输出，造成任务迭代性与策略接口的一次性之间的核心错配。
AI.method: MARCO将单次分子编辑提升为有界T轮决策过程：策略在每轮根据历史(含验证器反馈)采样候选分子，验证器检查有效性、方向性性质改进和源分子Tanimoto相似性。系统由三部分组成：(1) 分轮奖励构建——性质质量Q_prop(截断方向性进度)、相似性质量Q_sim(范围感知，含低相似性惩罚和近拷贝惩罚)、状态质量q_t(加权组合+成功门控奖励)、趋势贡献φ_t(改进与回归项)以及无效动作固定惩罚r_inv，组成塑形轮奖励r_t；(2) 无折扣轨迹回报R(τ)=Σr_t聚合；(3) 组相对策略优化——采样K条轨迹计算优势A_i，按PPO裁剪目标更新θ，同时屏蔽验证器反馈token。验证器评估validity、property delta、source similarity、scaffold preservation和invalid action五类反馈。训练从per-subtask SFT检查点初始化。
AI.result: 在MuMOInstruct三目标BDP/BDQ/BPQ基准、Qwen2.5-3B/7B和Qwen3-4B三个骨干网络、seen/unseen指令划分下，SFT初始化的MARCO*在所有18个主设置上获得最高SR×Sim。Same-5进一步提升观察分数，4目标HMPQ/BDPQ扩展和GeLLM³O-P(6)Mistral公开检查点适配验证了跨约束集和初始化机制的迁移性。训练范围控制显示5轮训练策略在Same-1下SR×Sim相对提升5.2%、Same-5下21.7%。消融证明SFT初始化贡献显著但非必需：基础初始化的MARCO在所有单元格仍优于基础模型。成功加权相似度(SWS)审计排除近拷贝解释——GRPO在Qwen3-4B BDQ上Sim=1.000但SR=0表明高相似可来自无效改进。
AI.conclusion: MARCO解决了分子优化迭代性与一次性训练范式间的错配：从有界提议-反馈-修订轨迹学习能同时改善策略的首轮分子编辑行为(Same-1)并保留其利用验证器反馈的能力(Same-5)。Same-5增益与多轮训练相关而非仅源于更大评估预算。4目标实验和公共检查点适配将该方法推广到更密集的约束与不同初始化机制。MARCO在一个统一策略中兼顾了单响应和有界交互式分子优化。

title: Where Root Cause Analysis Fails: A Retrieval-Reranking Decomposition
summary: Identifying the root cause of an anomaly among hundreds of sensors is critical for preventing safety incidents and costly downtime in complex monitored systems. Existing studies evaluate root cause analysis (RCA) methods using top@k accuracy. We show that this metric has a fundamental blind spot: it conflates two failure modes, retrieval failure, where the true cause is never considered, and reranking failure, where it is considered but ranked too low. In this work, we introduce a retrieval-reranking decomposition and audit four well-known benchmarks to expose this blind spot. Our experiments show that, on benchmarks with complex faults, statistical baselines mis-rank the true cause 79-100% of the time, and graph-based methods never clearly beat the best statistical baseline, whether their causal graphs are learned on short fault windows, on retrieved candidate pools guaranteed to contain the cause, or on multi-day normal-operation data. Meanwhile, on simple benchmarks where faults manifest significantly at their origin, retrieval is nearly solved (98-100%). Guided by the decomposition, we build a two-stage pipeline combining a multi-signal retriever with an LLM reranker that, as one fixed configuration, matches or exceeds the best baseline's top@1 accuracy on all six benchmark suites (by up to +12 points), with no causal graph or labeled data required. When all methods rank the same retrieved candidates with the true cause guaranteed present, adding a short system-description document lets the reranker lead the best baseline by +7 to +18 points on every benchmark. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文针对根因分析（RCA）领域长期使用 top@k 指标而掩盖了检索与重排序两类独立失败模式的问题，提出"检索–重排序分解"框架，对四个公开基准（WADI、SWaT、HVAC、RCAEval）上的三类方法（统计、图基、LLM）进行系统性审计。核心发现：在传播型故障（CPS）基准上，仅用偏差幅度检索的真实因覆盖率（Retrieval@15）仅 35–64%，而直接故障基准上可达 98–100%；图基方法始终未能明显超越最佳统计基线。作者据此构建一个两阶段管道（多信号检索器 + LLM 重排序器），以单一固定配置在六个基准套件上匹配或超越最佳基线的 top@1 准确率（最多 +12 pp），且无需因果图或标注数据；当保证真实因存在于候选集中时，加入领域知识文档可使重排序器在所有基准上领先最佳基线 +7 到 +18 pp。论文同时指出异常检测与 RCA 必须协同设计的核心原则。
AI.motivation: 现有 RCA 研究普遍使用 top@k 准确率作为唯一评估指标，这一指标将"检索失败（真实因根本未进入候选集）"与"重排序失败（真实因在候选集中但排名靠后）"两种本质不同的失败模式混为一谈，导致：①无法定位方法失败的根因；②文献中报告的改进可能被掩盖在指标之下；③在传播型故障（如工业信息物理系统 CPS）中，由于真实因信号被下游效应抑制，偏差幅度排序使真实因无法进入候选集的问题被系统性忽略。因此需要一种能将两类失败解耦的评估方法论，并据此为每类失败设计独立、可解释的解决方案。
AI.method: 方法由三部分构成：(1) 检索–重排序分解形式化——定义 Retrieval@K（真实因是否在大小为 K 的候选集中）和 Rerank@k（若在，是否排进前 k），并证明 top@k = Retrieval@K × Rerank@k；(2) 多信号检索器——结合偏差幅度（ϕ_mag，对直接故障有效）、最早起始时刻（ϕ_ons，对 HVAC 渐变漂移有效）、离散状态变化（ϕ_stc，对 SWaT 阶跃式执行器故障有效）三类互补信号，将预算 K 在信号间均分并去联合并；(3) LLM 列表式重排序器——将每个候选的证据记录（z 分数、首次偏移时刻、基线与故障窗均值及变化量）以单行格式组成用户提示，以 JSON 形式返回排序；可选注入自然语言领域知识文档 D，无需形式化为因果图。整体为无监督、单配置、零标注。
AI.result: 实验在 WADI（n=14）、SWaT（n=36）、HVAC（n=48）、RCAEval 三个微服务套件（各 n=125）上进行。关键结果：①检索层面，CPS 基准偏差幅度 Retrieval@15 上限仅 35–64%，加入互补信号后提升至 63–67%，而微服务基准近乎饱和（98–100%）；②重排序层面，统计基线在 CPS 上将真实因排在首位的比例仅 0–21.4%（79–100% 误排），即使真实因已检索到，Rerank@1 也仅 24–52%，远低于微服务的 72–90%；③图基方法在 CPS 上始终未明显优于最佳统计基线，无论使用按场景学习的 PC/FCI 图、限定 ≤15 节点池的图、还是多日正常数据学习的全局图；④提出的两阶段管道以单一配置在六个基准上匹配或超越所有基线的 top@1（最高 +12 pp）；⑤在真实因必现的受控检索池下，无领域知识的 LLM 重排序器不弱于任何基线，加入领域知识后领先最佳基线 +6.7 到 +18.1 pp（平均 +11.6 pp）；⑥健壮性验证方面，更换 Llama-3.3-70B 骨架、去标识化控制、±1–2 分钟检测时刻扰动均不影响定性结论，但 CPS 检索对检测时刻误差 ≥5 分钟敏感（损失最高 27 pp）。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出四点结论：(1) top@k 指标系统性掩盖了检索与重排序两类独立失败，需要解耦评估；(2) 偏差幅度信号在传播型故障下不足以作为检索器，多信号融合是必要而非可选；(3) 在 CPS 基准上，因果图结构的额外建模收益极小，瓶颈在于图质量本身；(4) LLM 重排序器在统一配置下既适用于直接故障也适用于传播故障，领域知识文档以非形式化自然语言注入即可提升重排序质量，但需注意其在端到端指标下可能因检索缺漏而被低估。文章提出"异常检测与 RCA 必须协同设计"的设计原则，并强调 CPS 检索增益依赖于检测时刻误差小于 5 分钟。局限包括 CPS 基准样本量小、领域覆盖有限、LLM 重排序器的非确定性，以及在安全关键场景下需保留人类在环监督与候选列表呈现。

title: CHAIN: Calibrated LLM Forecasting via Causal-Temporal Hypergraph Inference
summary: Large language models have achieved significant progress in event forecasting, yet their probability outputs exhibit systematic calibration bias that varies heterogeneously across different domains and question types, undermining the trustworthiness of probabilistic outputs for decision-making under uncertainty. However, existing calibration methods typically correct probability outputs after prediction is complete, without modeling the structural sources of bias within the prediction process itself. To address this challenge, we decompose probabilistic prediction over causal-temporal hypergraphs into three stages, evidence weighting, evidence aggregation, and source fusion, and propose CHAIN, which designs stage-specific mechanisms to mitigate bias at each stage: (i) modulating the temporal decay function by causal topological distance, (ii) aggregating approximately independent causal chains via Noisy-OR after direction-aware deduplication, and (iii) driving adaptive fusion by causal coverage and directional balance. Experimental results on cross-domain forecasting benchmarks show CHAIN outperforms existing methods in expected calibration error, Brier score, and accuracy. Our project is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出CHAIN框架，通过将概率预测分解为因果-时间超图上的三个阶段（证据加权、证据聚合、源融合），并为每个阶段设计特定机制来缓解LLM事件预测中的校准偏差。
AI.motivation: LLM在事件预测中取得了显著进展，但其概率输出存在系统性的校准偏差，且在不同领域和问题类型上呈异质性，这削弱了在不确定性下概率输出对决策的可信度。现有的校准方法通常在预测完成后对概率输出进行修正，而没有建模预测过程中偏差的结构性来源。
AI.method: CHAIN框架将概率预测分解为三个阶段：(i) 通过因果拓扑距离调节时间衰减函数（CTVF），区分近因与间接背景；(ii) 通过方向感知去重后使用Noisy-OR聚合近似独立的因果链，减少冗余置信度积累；(iii) 由因果覆盖度和方向平衡驱动的自适应融合。构建因果-时间超图作为证据结构表示。
AI.result: 在8个跨领域预测基准上的实验表明，CHAIN在ECE、Brier分数和准确率方面优于现有方法。在ID和OOD数据集上均保持校准优势，且在GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-2.0-Flash和DeepSeek-V3三种LLM骨干上均表现稳定。消融实验验证了三个组件各自的贡献；与后处理校准方法（如温度缩放、Platt缩放等）相比，结构化校准持续优于输出修正。
AI.conclusion: CHAIN验证了在预测过程内进行结构性诊断和校准的有效性，而非仅在预测完成后进行后处理修正，为LLM事件预测的可靠性提供了新方法。

title: Know Thyself, Teach Thyself: Internal Information Flow for Selective Self-Distillation
summary: Self-distillation turns knowledge distillation into a closed learning loop and offers a path toward recursive self-improvement. Without an external teacher, however, the model must determine both what information can improve its supervision and which induced changes should be learned. Existing methods typically improve teacher-generated data or select training examples in isolation, leaving the information transferred between these stages unmeasured. We introduce InFlow, a retrieval-guided on-policy self-distillation framework that models this process as potential-to-realized information flow. InFlow first retrieves potentially informative sources using certainty-calibrated hidden-state trajectories, then measures their realized effect through the Jensen--Shannon divergence between the teacher's initial and retrieval-conditioned answer beliefs. Examples with larger belief shifts are selected for on-policy distillation. Our analysis formalizes the information optimized by retrieval and selection and relates the answer-level shift to the teacher--student distillation gap. Across four open-weight language models and three knowledge domains, InFlow achieves the strongest cross-model average among the compared selection methods, with ablations supporting both stages of the framework. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出InFlow，一种用于无标注自蒸馏的检索引导式选择框架，将过程建模为"潜在-实现"信息流。先用确定性校准的隐藏状态轨迹检索潜在信息源，再通过Jensen-Shannon散度衡量教师信念变化来挑选样本进行在策略蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 自蒸馏中无外部教师，模型需自主决定"哪些信息能改进监督"以及"哪些变化应被学习"。现有方法分别优化教师数据生成或样本选择，未衡量两阶段间的信息流动。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1)基于确定性校准的层间隐藏状态轨迹相似度检索top-k源；(2)比较无检索与检索条件下教师答案分布的JS散度作为信念变化指标；(3)采用EMA教师在策略反向KL蒸馏。从信息论角度形式化为局部高斯信道模型的互信息最大化问题，并证明选择策略的最优性。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B/3.5-9B、Ministral-3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B四个模型及数学/自然科学/人文社科三个领域的实验中，InFlow在跨模型平均上优于Redundancy、Consistency、NEURON、Mutual等基线方法，整体准确率提升1.0-3.2个百分点。在数学领域增益最显著。消融实验验证了检索相似度、确定性校准和信念变化三个组件均贡献性能。
AI.conclusion: InFlow将自蒸馏中检索与选择两阶段统一在信息流优化框架下，理论上证明其最大化检索供给的潜在信息和蒸馏传递的已实现信息。经验上是一种有效的样本选择信号，但作者也指出，大的信息流变化并不必然带来正确标签的修正——对Llama等基模而言，Fix-Break可能接近于零甚至为负。

title: Learned Queries and Keys Are All You Need: Replacing the Value Projection with Structured Transforms
summary: To reduce the number of parameters and cache memory requirements of transformers we introduce dual-headed transformers instead of three heads. We studied Walsh-Hadamard Transform (WHT), Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), Discrete Fourier Transform, filterbank based Shearlet Transform, and Multiplication-Avoiding (MA) operators to construct dual heads. We combine spatial patches and their orthogonal transforms (or Shearlet and MA operators) in a structure similar to the attention block. We obtained better results than triple headed transformers in ImageNet. Extensive simulation examples are presented.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种双头（dual-headed）Transformer架构，通过使用固定正交变换（如WHT、DCT、DFT、Shearlet滤波器组）或免乘法（MF）算子替代传统的值（Value）投影矩阵V，从而减少约1/3的投影参数量（约12%总参数量），同时在CIFAR-10和Tiny ImageNet上验证了可行性。其中Shearlet滤波器组配置达到了77.32%的最佳精度，而WHT因仅需加减法而最具硬件效率。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer的QKV三投影机制带来大量参数和KV缓存开销，尤其在视觉任务中token数量随图像分辨率平方增长，计算瓶颈严重。本文旨在消除冗余的值投影，同时保留token间交互能力，以降低参数、内存和硬件复杂度。
AI.method:
1. 移除值投影W_V，将输出构造为Y = A(Q,K)·T(K)，其中T(·)为恒等映射或固定变换。
2. 研究多种正交变换：WHT（仅加减法）、DCT、DFT、基于Shearlet的多尺度方向滤波器组（30个方向滤波+1个低通）、以及MF-Tanh（用sign(·)⊙|·|构造Ṽ，并用ℓ₁归一化的tanh替代softmax）。
3. 设计四种Shearlet组合方式，分别在注意力权重计算和输出表示中引入方向多尺度特征。
4. 分析参数复杂度（从3d²降至2d²）和计算复杂度。
AI.result: 在Mini-ViT（CIFAR-10，30 epochs）上：常规QKV精度76.035%；QKK 76.155%；DCT 76.140%；WHT 76.830%；Shearlet变体（QK-ShearK）最佳77.320%。所有双头变体参数量减少约12%（546k→480k）。在更大ViT（100 epochs）上，Softmax ViT在C10/Tiny-IN上分别达81.92%/40.39%，而MF-Tanh为77.80%/35.40%，减少约22万参数和1438万次乘法。
AI.conclusion: 双头Transformer在移除学习式值投影后，仍能通过固定变换或滤波器组保持有竞争力的精度。Shearlet滤波器组提供最丰富的多尺度方向特征，WHT则在硬件效率上最优。该方法为高效Transformer设计提供了新方向，未来需在大规模数据集、更多架构和硬件实现上进一步验证。

title: When Is Coarse Supervision Worth It? Cost-Aware Learning under Unknown Aggregation
summary: Modern learning systems often acquire supervision at multiple resolutions, trading annotation cost against information content. We study cost-aware two-resolution learning, where expensive fine labels reveal a vector response and cheaper coarse labels reveal a scalar aggregate formed with unknown weights, while the target remains the full response. The challenge is that unknown aggregation changes which directions coarse data can identify, so the value of coarse supervision depends jointly on cost, noise, and identification. We characterize this information geometry and develop an estimate-and-track policy that learns the aggregation rule and tracks the optimal resolution mix. We derive a closed-form break-even condition for coarse supervision and prove that the online policy attains the optimal leading cumulative-risk coefficient, with a matching local asymptotic minimax lower bound. Synthetic experiments support the predicted all-fine/mixed transition, show the online learner approaching the oracle-share benchmark, and demonstrate a finite-budget gain over all-fine acquisition when coarse supervision is sufficiently favorable. Our results provide a principled way to balance information and annotation cost across supervision resolutions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究成本敏感的双分辨率监督学习问题：昂贵的细粒度标签提供向量响应，便宜的粗粒度标签仅提供由未知权重聚合的标量。目标是预测完整的向量响应。作者刻画了未知聚合下的信息几何，提出了"估计-跟踪"在线策略，并证明了其累积风险的一阶最优性。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习中，标注成本和信息量之间存在权衡——细粒度标注（如逐标准评分）信息丰富但昂贵，粗粒度标注（如总体评分）便宜但信息有限。关键挑战在于：聚合规则通常未知，导致粗粒度标注能识别的方向本身也需要学习。因此粗粒度监督的价值取决于成本、噪声和可识别性的联合作用，需要一个原则性的方法来决定何时购买粗粒度监督。
AI.method: 在标准线性模型下：协变量为白化各向同性的，精细查询返回带高斯噪声的K维响应，粗查询返回未知单纯形权重的标量投影。作者推导了静态最优分配的闭式解，给出了粗监督值得购买的损益平衡条件（λ > dK/(d-K+1)），并提出了EET（Epochal Estimate-and-Track）在线算法：预留消失的设计流来估计聚合权重，剩余预算跟踪最优粗粒度份额，使用交叉拟合的两折一步估计器。理论工具包括Fisher信息的特征分解、局部渐近极小值下界（van Trees不等式）、以及扰动分析。
AI.result: 1) 静态已知聚合下的损益平衡阈值为λ > K（粗粒度标签沿已知方向提供信息）；未知聚合下阈值提高到λ > dK/(d-K+1)，即K-1个方向从粗粒度可识别变为仅靠细粒度可识别。2) 增益上界：已知聚合时为1/K，未知聚合时为(d-K+1)/(dK)。3) 在线EET策略达到最优累积风险系数Φ*_U log T + O(1)，并匹配局部渐近极小值下界，表明学习最优分配不带来额外一阶代价。4) 合成实验（d=20, K=5）显示EET接近oracle-share基准，在强有利粗信息区相比全精细获取有显著有限预算改善（如20×条件下5.26%改善）。
AI.conclusion: 本文为成本敏感的多分辨率监督提供了第一性原理：闭式损益平衡规则、显式最优分配份额、以及一阶最优的在线适应策略及匹配下界。未知聚合引入的"干扰代价"是不可避免的一阶项，但在线学习分配本身不增加额外的一阶惩罚。结果可用于指导实际标注预算分配决策。局限：限于线性高斯模型和固定单纯形聚合规则；当前分辨率选择在观察到协变量之前作出；维度d和K固定。

title: CALIBUDGET: Calibration-Guided Source Allocation for Fixed-Budget Mixed-Reasoning Adaptation
summary: Fixed-budget adaptation from heterogeneous data sources requires deciding not only how much data to use, but how much exposure each source receives. Size-proportional rules can crowd out small sources, whereas difficulty-only rules can chase noisy estimates or allocate residual budget to nearly saturated pools. We introduce CALIBUDGET, a floor-protected, reliability-aware integer allocator that treats source exposure as an explicit adaptation variable. From small train-internal calibration splits, it combines model need, post-floor availability, and bootstrap stability, then produces exact capacity-respecting quotas without changing the model, objective, or total budget. In a controlled setting combining mathematical and commonsense data, CALIBUDGET improves CommonAvg, FragileAvg, and MacroAvg over validation-error-with-floor, the strongest matched comparator, in all three paired LLaMA-2-7B LoRA+ runs. The respective mean gains are 0.56, 0.46, and 0.41 percentage points (pp). Overall increases by 0.18 pp, whereas MathAvg decreases by 0.20 pp, exposing a coverage-retention boundary rather than a uniform gain. CALIBUDGET changes only 1.14-1.42% of the source budget but improves performance in 15 of 24 comparisons across commonsense tasks and seeds. These results suggest that small changes in source quotas can matter; example-level selection can then determine which examples fill each quota.

AI.tldr: CALIBUDGET是一个固定预算多源适配中的源级整数配额分配器。它通过小型校准拆分估计模型需求、残余可用性和自助法稳定性，结合保底保护和容量感知舍入，生成精确满足预算的整数配额。在LLaMA-2-7B LoRA+的三种子配对实验中，仅改变1.14-1.42%的源预算，就在CommonAvg、FragileAvg和MacroAvg上稳定优于最强匹配对比器，但伴随轻微的MathAvg下降。
AI.motivation: 在多源异构数据适配中，当候选数据量超过预算上限时，如何分配固定预算到各个预定义数据源是一个关键但被忽视的决策。比例分配会挤压小源，纯难度分配可能追逐噪声估计或对已饱和源分配剩余预算。现有工作多关注连续混合权重或示例级选择，未解决精确整数配额向量问题。
AI.method: CALIBUDGET采用"保底+残差"两阶段分配：(1)为每个源分配最小覆盖保底配额防止小源被挤出；(2)基于校准拆分估计的效用函数 u_k = n_k^α · a_k^β · ρ_k^γ 分配剩余预算，其中n_k为归一化需求（结合NLL和解析器答案错误指示符），a_k为保底后残余容量的平方根，ρ_k为基于200次自助法均值的稳定性折扣(1+σ_k)^{-1}；(3)通过容量感知最大余数法舍入保证预算精确满足。冻结参数：α=1, β=0.5, γ=1, f=1150, B=10000。使用LoRA+适配（rank=128, scaling=128），固定100K MetaMath数学数据，仅改变8个常识源的配额分配。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-2-7B三种子配对实验中，CALIBUDGET在所有种子上均提升CommonAvg（+0.56pp）、FragileAvg（+0.46pp）和MacroAvg（+0.41pp）以及Overall（+0.18pp），但MathAvg下降0.20pp。仅改变114-142个示例（1.14-1.42%的源预算），在24项任务-种子对比中改进15项。Qwen2.5-7B方向一致但置信区间跨零，LLaMA-3.1-8B在固定配额转移下近乎持平。校准拆分稳定性高（Spearman ρ=1.000）。
AI.conclusion: 固定预算下源级暴露量是有效适配变量；微小的、可审计的配额调整即可带来可测量的聚合性能变化。CALIBUDGET揭示了覆盖率-保留率的权衡边界，其可靠性感知规则优于纯难度规则。但结果具有模型和种子依赖性，转移证据混合，表明精确源预算需作为适配控制手段而非通用最优解。配额保证仅涉及整数可行性和最小覆盖，不保证下游性能单调性或全局最优性。

title: Routing in Gradient Space: Balanced Usage Is Not Expert Specialization
summary: Sparse expert models can distribute traffic evenly while still grouping incompatible training signals within the same experts. We study routing as a gradient-partitioning problem and introduce gradient-aligned routing (GAR), whose load-normalized router objective rewards grouping observations with aligned gradients. On five multi-task text-classification mixtures, we compare GAR with task-loss-only routing, gradient-combination and gradient-conflict methods, and load-balancing losses. With a fully trainable RoBERTa backbone and classification-head experts, GAR has the highest aggregate validation accuracy, 1.07 percentage points above task-loss-only routing. With frozen DeBERTa and Qwen3-1.7B backbones and low-rank adapter experts, it again ranks first, 1.10 points above task-loss-only routing, with better-balanced expert load and higher gradient-mass purity, the share of each expert's gradient-norm mass from its dominant task; the load-balancing losses flatten load further but leave this purity near its task-loss-only level. Top-1 routing, trainable full-parameter feed-forward network (FFN) experts, and a larger backbone also show positive aggregate gains. The results distinguish expert-load balance from gradient-based routing organization and indicate the predictive value of gradient-informed routing in multi-task text classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出梯度对齐路由(GAR)，将MoE路由视为梯度空间划分问题，通过负载归一化的辅助目标奖励将梯度方向一致的样本分组到同一专家。在多任务文本分类实验中，GAR在可训练和冻结骨干、分类头与FFN专家、top-1与top-4路由等多种设置下均取得最高聚合精度，区分了专家负载均衡与梯度组织的关系。
AI.motivation: 稀疏专家模型可能在均匀分配流量的同时，仍将不兼容的训练信号归入同一专家；现有方法（如STGC）通过冲突检测惩罚当前分配，但未显式比较不同分组方案的梯度关联收益。作者旨在将路由重新定义为梯度划分问题，引入一个能评估整体分配质量的目标函数。
AI.method: 将路由建模为梯度空间软划分，定义亲和矩阵W为梯度内积，构建负载归一化目标A_ε = Σ ‖G_k‖²/(d_k+ε)。理论证明该目标在硬分配下等价于k-means，其正交松弛对应谱划分中的代价目标函数（top-K特征向量解）。实现上采用一阶分离对齐通路：将专家梯度在公共参数模板中求和并detach，从detach的路由输入重新计算路由器概率，通过stopgrad避免二阶导数，辅助梯度仅回传给路由器。
AI.result: 在5个多任务文本分类混合（含5-8个GLUE/SuperGLUE/PAWS/ANLI任务）上，使用RoBERTa（可训练）、DeBERTa/Qwen3-1.7B/Qwen3-8B（冻结，LoRA-FFN或全参数FFN专家）：GAR在7种方法比较中聚合验证精度最高，比仅用任务损失路由高1.07-1.24个百分点；具有更低的负载方差和更高的梯度质量纯度。负载均衡损失能进一步平坦负载但不提升梯度纯度。Top-1路由、DeBERTa单任务检查中GAR均表现最优，YingDeo Pareto主导Baseline和CAGrad。
AI.conclusion: 实验证实专家负载均衡与基于梯度的路由组织是两个不同维度，梯度引导的路由在多任务文本分类中具有预测价值。GAR通过将专家分配与梯度聚类联系起来，为多任务稀疏专家模型提供了一种有原则的路由方法。代码将开源。

title: Backpropagated Output Momentum: Relocating Optimizer History from Parameters to Task Space
summary: Optimizer momentum is usually stored as a parameter-sized moving average of past gradients, which makes history costly and fixes each past signal in the coordinates in which it was computed. We introduce Backpropagated Output Momentum (BOM), which instead stores a compact moving average of prediction errors at the model output and reprojects that history through the current network at every step. A batch-level analysis characterizes the information retained and omitted by this relocation, while the implementation preserves the current supervised gradient and can replace the first-moment component of several adaptive optimizers. As a plug-in for momentum-based optimizers, including ones that already compress their state, BOM reduces parameter-shaped optimizer state by 49.7-99.8% in three compositions and, averaged over three language backbones, paired step time by 4.0%. It also improves mean validation performance across language and vision fine-tuning, by 1.42 points in the primary five-task comparison. Language and vision pretraining studies, together with matched mechanism controls, further test the construction across output spaces and model scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Backpropagated Output Momentum (BOM)，一种将AdamW等优化器的一阶动量从参数空间(占O(P)存储)迁移到输出空间(仅O(d_out))的紧凑历史存储方法。BOM通过在每步用当前Jacobian重新投影任务空间的残差EMA实现更新，在三种优化器组合下减少49.7%-99.8%的参数级优化器状态，NLP微调宏平均提升1.42分，并在预训练中降低步时间、峰值内存和检查点大小。
AI.motivation: AdamW等自适应优化器在每个训练张量上维护两份参数级EMA（一阶动量m和二阶动量v），存储开销巨大（两倍参数大小）。此外，m_t中存储的梯度已被历史的Jacobian投影固定，随着参数更新和样本替换，这些历史投影方向与当前模型对当前样本的映射产生漂移（历史投影漂移）。本文试图回答：哪些历史梯度信息必须保留？以及该历史可以压缩到什么程度？
AI.method: 核心方法BOM：存储任务空间（输出空间）残差的指数移动平均 q_t = β₁·q_{t-1} + (1-β₁)·s_t（s_t为批次平均输出残差），而非参数空间的一阶动量。在每步通过混合目标函数 L^mix = (1-λ)·L^CE + λ·⟨z, q̂_t⟩ 的一次反向传播，用当前批次平均Jacobian J̄_t^T 重新投影历史 h_t = J̄_t^T·q̂_t，从而刷新历史在参数空间的方向。保留完整的当前监督梯度、参数级二阶动量v（用于自适应缩放）和解耦权重衰减。BOM可作为AdamW、Adam-mini、GaLore的一阶动量组件的即插即用替换。
AI.result: BOM在三种组合下参数级优化器状态减少49.7%-99.8%（AdamW 50.0%, Adam-mini 99.8%, GaLore 49.7%）。RoBERTa-base、DeBERTa-v3-base、Qwen3-1.7B三个NLP骨干网络在GLUE五任务上宏平均分别提升+1.42、+1.38、+1.35分，步时间平均降低4.0%。跨域验证：STL10（ConvNeXt-Tiny/ViT-Tiny）准确率提升+1.22/+1.02分；ImageNet-1k ResNet-50 epoch-90 top-1提升+0.35分；C4语言预训练在55M-1.1B规模上一致降低最终损失（最大-0.0547在110M）。H800单步基准测试显示步时间比在1B-2B参数间跨越平价点，4B时达到0.938。峰值内存节省达14.73 GiB（4B），检查点大小从12P缩减至8P字节。
AI.conclusion: BOM成功将一阶动量从参数空间迁移到任务空间，在显著减少优化器状态（最多99.8%）的同时，在多种骨干网络、任务域（语言/视觉）、训练阶段（微调/预训练）和模型规模（55M-1.1B）上一致提升性能或保持竞争力。精确的批次级分解证实了历史投影漂移的存在及其通过当前重新投影得到解决。校准的成本模型定位了步时间从开销到节省的规模交叉点（1B-2B参数之间）。任务空间历史是一种使基于动量的优化器更精简、更快、且在微调中表现更好的即插即用方案。第二阶动量无法做类似精确迁移，因逐元素平方运算不与向量-Jacobian映射交换。

title: Efficient Offline Learning of Ranking Policies via Top-$k$ Policy Decomposition
comment: Published as a conference paper at CIKM 2026
summary: Many recommender systems such as for e-commerce and news platforms aim to provide users with rankings they are likely to interact with. Off-Policy Learning (OPL) of ranking policies enables us to learn new ranking policies using only historical logged data. However, ranking settings make OPL remarkably challenging because their action spaces consist of permutations of unique items, being extremely large. Existing methods primarily use either policy- or regression-based approaches. The policy-based approach, which typically uses importance-weighted policy gradients, can suffer from high variance due to large action spaces. The regression-based approach, on the other hand, estimates the expected reward using conventional machine learning methods, avoiding variance issues but potentially suffering from severe bias. To circumvent these issues of existing methods, we propose a new OPL method for ranking, named Ranking Policy Optimization via Top-$k$ Policy Decomposition (R-POD), which combines the policy- and regression-based approaches in an effective fashion. Specifically, R-POD decomposes a ranking policy into a first-stage policy for selecting top-$k$ actions and a second-stage policy for choosing the bottom actions given the top-$k$ actions. It learns the first-stage policy using a new policy gradient estimator and the second-stage policy via the regression-based approach. This method can substantially reduce variance, since it applies importance weighting only to the top-$k$ actions. We also demonstrate that our policy-gradient estimator for the first-stage policy is unbiased under a conditional pairwise correctness condition, which only requires that the expected reward differences of pairs of rankings sharing the same top-$k$ actions can be estimated correctly.

title: cktFormer: Transformer-Based Approach for Automated Analog Circuit Design
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, IECON 2025 51st Annual Conference of the IEEE Industrial Electronics Society
summary: Circuit design is a complex and iterative process that requires expertise in electronic engineering. It involves selecting components while meeting performance constraints, such as power efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and signal integrity. However, manual design is time-consuming and prone to errors. Although other stages of the manufacturing pipeline have benefited from AI-driven optimizations, circuit design remains a bottleneck, limiting overall productivity. Generative AI and machine learning offer the potential to automate and improve this stage, boosting efficiency and accuracy. To address this, we introduce a dual transformer architecture that bridges the gap between AI and circuit design by leveraging attention mechanisms to model complex, non-sequential circuit relationships. Our approach structures netlist data into graph-based representations, enabling effective learning of circuit topology and component interactions. The system consists of two interlinked models: a node prediction model that proposes components and an edge prediction model that infers valid connections. This collaborative and decoupled design captures both component-level semantics and global structural coherence. In our experiments, this architecture outperforms recent models such as AnalogGenie and cktGNN in the validity of generated circuits. By addressing key limitations in existing methods, our work advances automation in electronics engineering and contributes a benchmark for AI-driven circuit synthesis.

title: QuantMLA: Function-Aligned Dual-Path Quantization for Low-Bit MLA KV Caching
summary: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) enables expressive multi-head attention with compact caches for its content and decoupled RoPE paths, yet cache memory still scales linearly with context length and batch size. In this work, we establish a systematic model of MLA's dual-path quantization errors, characterizing their distinct effects on attention-output distortion and explaining the pronounced amplification of RoPE-path errors. Guided by this analysis, we introduce QuantMLA, a function-aligned framework for low-bit dual-path quantization. We derive path-specific transformation spaces that preserve full-precision computation while remaining fully fusible into model parameters offline, eliminating online transformation overhead. Within these spaces, QuantMLA learns path-specific transformations with function-aligned objectives: attention-output reconstruction captures the content path's coupled matching and aggregation errors, while positional QK reconstruction preserves the RoPE-induced component of the attention logits and admits a theoretical bound on output distortion. Across four MLA model families, QuantMLA enables, to our knowledge, the first reported joint INT4 caching of the content and RoPE caches with minimal accuracy degradation. Further compressing the content cache to INT2 while retaining the RoPE key cache at INT4 maintains competitive performance on challenging reasoning and code benchmarks. We develop a native low-bit MLA attention kernel that integrates unpacking and dequantization directly into attention computation. The physical cache layout provides 3.59x compression at 128K context, while a cache-pressure serving workload achieves 5.168x higher whole-job output throughput than BF16. The code will be released upon acceptance.

title: Graph-Spectral Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Multivariate time series anomaly detection typically relies on evaluating discrepancies between observations and outputs produced by models trained on normal data. An alternative perspective is to characterize the distribution of normal data through the generative dynamics, i.e., the velocity field, of flow matching models. However, standard flow matching typically adopts linear probability paths that overlook dependencies among variables, leading to a misalignment with the structured data distribution. To address this issue, we propose GRASP, a flow matching framework with a graph-spectral path for multivariate time series anomaly detection. GRASP incorporates graph structure into the probability path by minimizing a fixed-endpoint action that combines kinetic energy with graph Dirichlet energy. This formulation yields a closed-form path based on graph-frequency-dependent hyperbolic interpolation. A velocity predictor trained on normal data then detects anomalies using weighted velocity discrepancies aggregated across source samples, flow times, and graph frequencies. Theoretically, we establish that GRASP is invariant to the choice of Laplacian eigenbasis and decompose its expected oracle anomaly score into bounded endpoint uncertainty and graph-frequency-weighted Fisher discrepancy. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate the superior anomaly detection performance of GRASP and validate the effectiveness of its graph-spectral path and weighting mechanism.

title: When Can Prefixes Compile LoRA? Exact Resource-Capped Tests for Frozen Attention
summary: Can a fixed continuous prefix replace a given low-rank adapter while the attention head stays frozen? In this research, we show that the answer depends on the adapter's target through three conditions. First, observability: at one causal readout, every independent key--value prefix sees the content only through the query, attention partition, and value numerator, so a target that differs on two inputs with equal summaries incurs an error floor at every prefix length; norm caps extend this floor to nearly equal summaries. Second, realizability: at a common query, any prefix reduces exactly to two aggregate variables, and the norm-capped optimum is an attained second-order-cone program, also after a fixed output projection; it places two equal-norm rank-one value updates on opposite sides of compilability. Third, implementation: under affine query exposure, $2r$ signed slots approximate a rank-$r$ value update, but their values grow as $O(\epsilon^{-3/2})$, and the construction passes all 400 tolerance checks in float64 yet only 38 in bfloat16. A first-layer GPT-2 readout with fixed token and position meets the common-query condition without clamping activations; at three such heads, the capped optimum leaves 18.4\% to 74.2\% of the projected adapter effect uncompiled, with a head-dependent value--query ordering. All claims concern local approximation at one head, not whole-network equivalence.

title: Harnessing Large Language Models to Compile Task-Relevant Context into Bayesian Optimisation
summary: Incorporating rich task-relevant context, such as domain knowledge and external observations, is a key capability yet remains challenging for Bayesian optimisation (BO). Recently, practitioners have started to use large language models (LLMs) to generate and execute BO programs through coding harnesses. In such emerging practices, the posterior belief is shaped not only by Bayesian inference but also by LLM-generated model and data artefacts, offering a flexible route for task context to enter BO as executable code. To study whether and how LLMs can be harnessed to compile diverse contextual signals for BO, we formulate LLM-compiled BO as generalised-context decision making. We propose HarBO, a BO-specialised harness that compiles generalised context into the core artefacts of standard BO through a validated multi-stage workflow. Our theory analyses the regret under imperfect compilation and the effect of adding new context. Across synthetic functions and real-world benchmarks, we find that LLM harnesses can effectively compile context into standard BO, achieving competitive performance with specialised LLM-embedding-based and direct LLM-in-the-loop BO methods. General coding harnesses can be effective in familiar domains such as hyperparameter optimisation, but fall short in unfamiliar, context-rich domains. Together, these results establish LLM harnesses as a promising, but not automatically reliable, route for making rich task context usable in BO.

title: RAE-PPG: Duration-Grounded Retain-and-Extend Pretraining for PPG Foundation Models
summary: Signal features derived from photoplethysmography (PPG) require different signal durations to characterize. Existing PPG foundation models treat duration as a pretraining or evaluation condition rather than using the different durations required by PPG features to organize self-supervision. We hypothesize that self-supervision should expand with signal duration, allowing a single encoder to progressively acquire additional features while preserving and reusing earlier learning. We introduce Retain-and-Extend PPG (RAE-PPG), which trains a single Transformer encoder successively on 10 s, 30 s, and 240 s inputs, adding supervision for signal features supported by each longer observation. The encoder is partitioned into duration-specific parameter groups, allowing later stages to reuse earlier groups while updating only the group assigned to the current stage. Selected earlier targets are reused to supervise later stages, encouraging the corresponding features to remain accessible in longer-input representations. Direct decoding from the final encoder shows that earlier features remain recoverable from longer-input representations, while later-stage features show higher mean decoding performance at their introduction durations. Controlled comparisons further show that prior-stage learning provides a better basis for learning newly introduced features at both transitions. Across 18 tasks from eight datasets, the final frozen encoder achieves the best observed score on 12 tasks compared with five existing PPG foundation models.

title: Where Does Randomness Matter in Neural Cellular Automata?
summary: Stochastic cell updates are often used throughout the life of a neural cellular automaton (NCA), from backpropagation through time to final rollout. This leaves two questions entangled: does update randomness help learn a useful rule, and must that randomness remain at execution? We separate training and evaluation update modes in controlled Growing NCA experiments, then vary the states shown during training. Under the standard constant-rate persist recipe, asynchronous training passes the short-horizon quality test in 10/10 runs, compared with 3/10 synchronous runs. All ten asynchronous models also retain the target for 4,096 steps under deterministic evaluation. For a scalar translation-invariant lattice, we derive an exact mean-square criterion: random masking can damp mean modes, but it also injects variance, and a mean-only test misclassifies four non-marginal settings. Finally, among 30 models that all pass the same reconstruction test, eight of ten grow-trained models become off-target at 4,096 steps, while all persist and regenerate models retain the target; damage recovery separates persist from regenerate. The results distinguish optimization reliability, execution mode, and task-specific behavior instead of treating them as one stability property.

title: EasyPPO: Stabilizing the Critic Is Key
summary: A key strength of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is its learned critic, which uses historical trajectories collected during reinforcement learning to estimate expected returns and reduce policy-gradient variance. However, we find that the critic is also a major source of instability in reinforcement learning for large language models (LLMs). We identify two critic failure modes that destabilize PPO. First, filtering truncated rollouts from both actor and critic shifts the policy objective to reward conditioned on completion, allowing truncation to increase even as conditional reward improves. Second, heterogeneous return noise can cause high-variance prompts to dominate critic updates in finite batches. We introduce EasyPPO to address these failures. Actor-only overlong filtering trains the critic on returns from both completed and truncated rollouts. Noise-normalized critic regression weights each prompt's critic loss by the inverse standard deviation of its sampled returns, balancing noise contributions across prompts. Moderately smaller critic mini-batches confine outlier influence to fewer rollouts during gradient clipping. Across continuous-reward coding on FrontierCS, binary-reward mathematical reasoning on AIME24, and multi-turn search on Search-R1, EasyPPO remains stable throughout the full training horizon and consistently outperforms vanilla PPO, VAPO, and HL-Gauss PPO. Its best validation scores show relative gains of 14.89%, 2.28%, and 9.47% over PPO, respectively.

title: RESCUE: Repairing Language Model Errors to Sparse Circuits via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities that mechanistic interpretability has attributed to sparse computational circuits. However, existing circuit studies emphasize preserving functionality or explaining safety, leaving the mechanisms underlying failures across a broader range of tasks largely unexplored. Extending circuit analysis from abilities to errors, we explore the perspective that such failures may likewise arise from erroneous internal computations and that targeted tuning of the corresponding parameters can correct such errors while largely preserving other capabilities. Motivated by this insight, we introduce RESCUE (Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing), a framework that localizes error-associated circuits and surgically repairs them for performance enhancement. General tasks typically involve multi-step reasoning and long-form generation, where early deviations can cause prefixes to drift from supervised references, leading SFT-based mask optimization to overlook circuits involved in generation-time errors. RESCUE therefore refines these masks through reinforcement learning with multiple masked-model rollouts, improving their relevance to observed task failures. Finally, RESCUE introduces a pruning technique and precisely fine-tunes error circuits to correct task failures, thereby translating error localization into a sparse and targeted model update. We validate RESCUE on heterogeneous repair sets across two domains: (1) mathematical reasoning, identifying a math error circuit of 1.40% density whose repair raises accuracy from 6.0% to 75.5%; and (2) medical QA, where a similarly compact 1.44% circuit improves repair-set accuracy from 0% to 81%. Our code is available at: this https URL .
